# 1287 "./dpdefs/upstream/csprogsdefs.qc"
float(float skel, float bonenum, string g1, string g2, string g3, string g4, string g5, string g6) example_skel_findbonegroup =
{
 local string bonename;
 while (bonenum >= 0)
 {
  bonename = skel_get_bonename(skel, bonenum);
  if (bonename == g1) return 1;
  if (bonename == g2) return 2;
  if (bonename == g3) return 3;
  if (bonename == g4) return 4;
  if (bonename == g5) return 5;
  if (bonename == g6) return 6;
  bonenum = skel_get_boneparent(skel, bonenum);
 }
 return 0;
};

void() example_skel_player_setup =
{
 self.skeletonindex = skel_create(self.modelindex);
};


void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime) example_skel_player_update_begin =
{

 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 0, 0, 100000);
};

void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime, float blendalpha, string groupbonename, string excludegroupname1, string excludegroupname2) example_skel_player_update_applyoverride =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local float numbones;
 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 bonenum = 0;
 numbones = skel_get_numbones(self.skeletonindex);
 while (bonenum < numbones)
 {
  if (example_skel_findbonegroup(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, groupbonename, excludegroupname1, excludegroupname2, "", "", "") == 1)
   skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 1 - blendalpha, bonenum, bonenum + 1);
  bonenum = bonenum + 1;
 }
};

void(vector eyetarget, string bonename) example_skel_player_update_eyetarget =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local vector ang;
 local vector oldforward, oldright, oldup;
 local vector relforward, relright, relup, relorg;
 local vector boneforward, boneright, boneup, boneorg;
 local vector parentforward, parentright, parentup, parentorg;
 local vector u, v;
 local vector modeleyetarget;
 bonenum = skel_find_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonename) - 1;
 if (bonenum < 0)
  return;
 oldforward = v_forward;
 oldright = v_right;
 oldup = v_up;
 v = eyetarget - self.origin;
 modeleyetarget_x = v * v_forward;
 modeleyetarget_y = 0-v * v_right;
 modeleyetarget_z = v * v_up;


 relorg = skel_get_bonerel(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 relforward = v_forward;
 relright = v_right;
 relup = v_up;
 boneorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 boneforward = v_forward;
 boneright = v_right;
 boneup = v_up;
 parentorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, skel_get_boneparent(self.skeletonindex, bonenum));
 parentforward = v_forward;
 parentright = v_right;
 parentup = v_up;

 u = modeleyetarget - boneorg;

 v_x = u * parentforward;
 v_y = u * parentright;
 v_z = u * parentup;
 ang = vectoangles2(v, relup);
 ang_x = 0 - ang_x;
 makevectors(ang);

 skel_set_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, relorg);

 v_forward = oldforward;
 v_right = oldright;
 v_up = oldup;
};


void() example_skel_player_delete =
{
 skel_delete(self.skeletonindex);
 self.skeletonindex = 0;
};

# 1 "./lib/bool.qh" 1
       



 const float true = 1;
 const float false = 0;





[[eraseable]]
float InterpretBoolean(string input)
{
 switch (strtolower(input))
 {
  case "yes":
  case "true":
  case "on":
   return true;

  case "no":
  case "false":
  case "off":
   return false;

  default: return ((stof(input)) != 0);
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
float randombit(float bits)
{
 if (!(bits & (bits - 1)))
  return bits;

 float r = random();
 float b = 0;
 float n = 0;

 for (float f = 1; f <= bits; f *= 2)
 {
  if (bits & f)
  {
   ++n;
   r *= n;
   if (r <= 1) b = f;
   else r = (r - 1) / (n - 1);
  }
 }
 return b;
}

[[eraseable]]
float randombits(float bits, float k, float error_return)
{
 float r = 0;
 while (k > 0 && bits != r)
 {
  r += randombit(bits - r);
  --k;
 }
 if (error_return)
  if (k > 0) return -1;

 return r;
}

enum {
 OP_SET,
 OP_MIN,
 OP_MAX,
 OP_PLUS,
 OP_MINUS
};

[[eraseable]]
float GiveBit(entity e, .float fld, float bit, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   else e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
  case OP_PLUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   if (val <= 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float GiveValue(entity e, .float fld, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = e.(fld);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   e.(fld) = val;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
   e.(fld) = max(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   e.(fld) = min(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_PLUS:
   e.(fld) += val;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   e.(fld) -= val;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = e.(fld);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float days_up_to_date(float Y, float M, float D)
{
 float years = (M <= 2) ? Y - 1 : Y;

 float leap_days = floor(years / 4) - floor(years / 100) + floor(years / 400);


 float months = (M <= 2) ? (M + 9) : (M - 3);
 float leftover_days = (M <= 2) ? (M + 5) : floor(0.58 * M - 1.1);

 float month_days = 30 * months + leftover_days;

 return 365 * years + month_days + D + leap_days;
}

[[eraseable]]
string strftime_s()
{
 string date = strftime(false, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S");
 float i, seconds = 0;
 i =0; float Y = stof(substring(date, i, 4));
 i+=5; float M = stof(substring(date, i, 2));
 i+=3; float D = stof(substring(date, i, 2));

 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60 * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2));





 float days_since_epoch = days_up_to_date(Y, M, D) - 719469;

 float hundreds_of_seconds = days_since_epoch * 24 * 6 * 6;
 hundreds_of_seconds += floor(seconds / 100);


 string seconds_str = ftos(seconds % 100);
 if ((seconds % 100) < 10)
  seconds_str = strcat("0", seconds_str);

 return strcat(ftos(hundreds_of_seconds), seconds_str);
}



[[eraseable]]
string seconds_tostring(float seconds)
{
 float negative = false;
 if (seconds < 0)
 {
  negative = true;
  seconds = -seconds;
  if (floor(seconds) != seconds)
   seconds += 1;
 }
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 60);
 seconds -= minutes * 60;
 if (negative)
  return sprintf("-%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
 return sprintf("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
}





[[eraseable]]
string clockedtime_tostring(float tm, float hundredths, float compact)
{
 if (tm < 0)
 {
  if (compact)
   return strcat("0.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
  else
   return strcat("0:00.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
 }
 float acc = hundredths ? 6000 : 600;
 tm = floor(tm + 0.5);
 float minutes = floor(tm / acc);
 float tm_without_minutes = tm - minutes * acc;

 string s = ftos(acc * 10 + tm_without_minutes);
 if (!compact || minutes > 0)
  return strcat(ftos(minutes), ":", substring(s, 1, 2), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

 float ofs = 2, digits = 1;
 if (tm_without_minutes >= 10 * (hundredths ? 100 : 10))
 {
  ofs = 1;
  digits = 2;
 }
 return strcat(substring(s, ofs, digits), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

}




[[eraseable]]
string format_time(float seconds)
{
 seconds = floor(seconds + 0.5);
 float days = floor(seconds / 864000);
 seconds -= days * 864000;
 float hours = floor(seconds / 36000);
 seconds -= hours * 36000;
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 600);
 seconds -= minutes * 600;
 if (days > 0) return sprintf(_("%d days, %02d:%02d:%02d"), days, hours, minutes, seconds);
 else return sprintf(_("%02d:%02d:%02d"), hours, minutes, seconds);
}

[[eraseable]]
string swapwords(string str, float i, float j)
{
 float n;
 string s1, s2, s3, s4, s5;
 float si, ei, sj, ej, s0, en;
 n = tokenizebyseparator(str, " ");
 si = argv_start_index(i);
 sj = argv_start_index(j);
 ei = argv_end_index(i);
 ej = argv_end_index(j);
 s0 = argv_start_index(0);
 en = argv_end_index(n - 1);
 s1 = substring_range(str, s0, si);
 s2 = substring_range(str, si, ei);
 s3 = substring_range(str, ei, sj);
 s4 = substring_range(str, sj, ej);
 s5 = substring_range(str, ej, en);
 return strcat(s1, s4, s3, s2, s5);
}

[[eraseable]]
string shufflewords(string str)
{
 _shufflewords_str = str;
 float n = tokenizebyseparator(str, " ");
 shuffle(n, _shufflewords_swapfunc, (0, world));
 str = _shufflewords_str;
 _shufflewords_str = nil;
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
string unescape(string in)
{
 in = strzone(in);

 float len = strlen(in);
 string str = "";
 for (float i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  string s = substring(in, i, 1);
  if (s == "\\")
  {
   s = substring(in, i + 1, 1);
   if (s == "n") str = strcat(str, "\n");
   else if (s == "\\") str = strcat(str, "\\");
   else str = strcat(str, substring(in, i, 2));
   ++i;
   continue;
  }
  str = strcat(str, s);
 }
 strunzone(in);
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
float isInvisibleString(string s)
{
 s = strdecolorize(s);
 float utf8 = cvar("utf8_enable");
 for (float i = 0, n = strlen(s); i < n; ++i)
 {
  float c = str2chr(s, i);
  switch (c)
  {
   case 0:
   case 32:
    break;
   case 192:
    if (!utf8) break;
    return false;
   case 0xE000:
   case 0xE00A:
   case 0xE0A0:
   case 0xE020:
   case 0x00A0:
   case 0x180E:
   case 0x2000:
   case 0x2001:
   case 0x2002:
   case 0x2003:
   case 0x2004:
   case 0x2005:
   case 0x2006:
   case 0x2007:
   case 0x2008:
   case 0x2009:
   case 0x200A:
   case 0x200B:
   case 0x202F:
   case 0x205F:
   case 0x3000:
   case 0xFEFF:
   case 0xFFA0:
   case 0x3164:
    if (utf8) break;
   default:
    return false;
  }
 }
 return true;
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp_recursive(string v1, string v2)
{
 float dot1 = strstrofs(v1, ".", 0);
 float dot2 = strstrofs(v2, ".", 0);
 string s1 = (dot1 == -1) ? v1 : substring(v1, 0, dot1);
 string s2 = (dot2 == -1) ? v2 : substring(v2, 0, dot2);

 float r;
 r = stof(s1) - stof(s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 r = strcasecmp(s1, s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 if (dot1 == -1) return (dot2 == -1) ? 0 : -1;
 else return (dot2 == -1) ? 1 : vercmp_recursive(substring(v1, dot1 + 1, 999), substring(v2, dot2 + 1, 999));
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp(string v1, string v2)
{
 if (strcasecmp(v1, v2) == 0) return 0;


 if (v1 == "git") return 1;
 if (v2 == "git") return -1;

 return vercmp_recursive(v1, v2);
}

[[eraseable]]
float isValidColorCodeValue(string theText, float cc_len, float tag_start)
{
 if (cc_len == 2)
  return (strstrofs(DIGITS, (substring(theText, tag_start + 1, 1)), 0) >= 0);
 if (cc_len == 5)
  return ((strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 2, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 3, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 4, 1)), 0) >= 0));
 return false;
}







[[eraseable]]
vector checkColorCode(string theText, float text_len, float pos, float check_at_the_end)
{
 if (text_len == 0)
  text_len = strlen(theText);
 string tag_type = "^";
 float cc_len = 2;
 float tag_len = 1;

 :check_color_tag

 float ofs = cc_len;
 if (!check_at_the_end)
  ofs--;
 for (; ofs >= 1; ofs--)
 {
  if (!(pos >= ofs && text_len >= pos + (cc_len - ofs)))
   continue;
  if(substring(theText, pos - ofs, tag_len) == tag_type)
  {
   if (!isCaretEscaped(theText, pos - ofs) && isValidColorCodeValue(theText, cc_len, pos - ofs))
    return eX * cc_len + eY * ofs;
  }
 }
 if (cc_len == 2)
 {
  tag_type = "^x";
  cc_len = 5;
  tag_len = 2;
  goto check_color_tag;
 }
 return '0 0 0';
}

[[eraseable]]
float rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(vector rgb, float mi, float ma)
{
 if (mi == ma)
 {
  return 0;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.x)
 {
  if (rgb.y >= rgb.z) return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi);
  else return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi) + 6;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.y)
 {
  return (rgb.z - rgb.x) / (ma - mi) + 2;
 }
 else
 {
  return (rgb.x - rgb.y) / (ma - mi) + 4;
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(float hue, float mi, float ma)
{
 vector rgb;

 hue -= 6 * floor(hue / 6);



 if (hue <= 1)
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = hue * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 2)
 {
  rgb.x = (2 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }
 else if (hue <= 3)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = (hue - 2) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 4)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = (4 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }
 else if (hue <= 5)
 {
  rgb.x = (hue - 4) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }


 else
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = (6 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }

 return rgb;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsv(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsv;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsv.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);
 hsv.z = ma;

 if (ma == 0) hsv.y = 0;
 else hsv.y = 1 - mi / ma;

 return hsv;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsv_to_rgb(vector hsv)
{
 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsv.x, hsv.z * (1 - hsv.y), hsv.z);
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsl(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsl;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsl.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);

 hsl.z = 0.5 * (mi + ma);
 if (mi == ma) hsl.y = 0;
 else if (hsl.z <= 0.5) hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 * hsl.z);
 else
  hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 - 2 * hsl.z);

 return hsl;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsl_to_rgb(vector hsl)
{
 float mi, ma, maminusmi;

 if (hsl.z <= 0.5) maminusmi = hsl.y * 2 * hsl.z;
 else maminusmi = hsl.y * (2 - 2 * hsl.z);



 mi = hsl.z - 0.5 * maminusmi;
 ma = hsl.z + 0.5 * maminusmi;

 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsl.x, mi, ma);
}

  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.y * 15 + 0.5)), 1)),
  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.z * 15 + 0.5)), 1))
              );
}

[[eraseable]]
string process_time(float outputtype, float seconds)
{
 float tmp_hours = 0, tmp_minutes = 0, tmp_seconds = 0;
 float tmp_years = 0, tmp_weeks = 0, tmp_days = 0;

 tmp_seconds = floor(seconds);

 if (tmp_seconds)
 {
  tmp_minutes = floor(tmp_seconds / 60);

  if (tmp_minutes)
  {
   tmp_seconds -= (tmp_minutes * 60);
   tmp_hours = floor(tmp_minutes / 60);

   if (tmp_hours)
   {
    tmp_minutes -= (tmp_hours * 60);
    tmp_days = floor(tmp_hours / 24);

    if (tmp_days)
    {
     tmp_hours -= (tmp_days * 24);
     tmp_weeks = floor(tmp_days / 7);

     if (tmp_weeks)
     {
      tmp_days -= (tmp_weeks * 7);
      tmp_years = floor(tmp_weeks / 52);
     }
    }
   }
  }
 }

 switch (outputtype)
 {
  case 1: return sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", tmp_hours, tmp_minutes, tmp_seconds);
  case 2:
  {
   string output = "";


   if (tmp_years) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_years, _("CI_ZER^%d years"), _("CI_FIR^%d year"), _("CI_SEC^%d years"), _("CI_THI^%d years"), _("CI_MUL^%d years")));
   if (tmp_weeks) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_weeks, _("CI_ZER^%d weeks"), _("CI_FIR^%d week"), _("CI_SEC^%d weeks"), _("CI_THI^%d weeks"), _("CI_MUL^%d weeks")));
   if (tmp_days) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")));
   if (tmp_hours) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours")));
   if (tmp_minutes) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_minutes, _("CI_ZER^%d minutes"), _("CI_FIR^%d minute"), _("CI_SEC^%d minutes"), _("CI_THI^%d minutes"), _("CI_MUL^%d minutes")));
   if (tmp_seconds) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_seconds, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds")));

   if (output == "")
    return count_fill(0, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds"));
   return output;
  }
  case 3:
  {
   string output = "";

   output = count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours"));

   if (tmp_weeks) tmp_days += (tmp_weeks * 7);
   if (tmp_years) tmp_days += (tmp_years * 365);
   if (tmp_days)
   {
    output = sprintf(
     count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")),
     ((output != "") ? strcat(", ", output) : ""));
   }

   return output;
  }
 }
 return "";
}

[[eraseable]]
float cvar_value_issafe(string s)
{
 if (strstrofs(s, "\"", 0) >= 0) return false;
 if (strstrofs(s, "\\", 0) >= 0) return false;
 if (strstrofs(s, ";", 0) >= 0) return false;
 if (strstrofs(s, "$", 0) >= 0) return false;
 if (strstrofs(s, "\r", 0) >= 0) return false;
 if (strstrofs(s, "\n", 0) >= 0) return false;
 return true;
}

 input = strreplace("$", "$$", input);

[[eraseable]]
float expr_evaluate(string s)
{
    float ret = false;
    if (str2chr(s, 0) == '+') {
        s = substring(s, 1, -1);
    } else if (str2chr(s, 0) == '-') {
        ret = true;
        s = substring(s, 1, -1);
    }
    float expr_fail = false;
    for (float i = 0, n = tokenize_console(s); i < n; ++i) {
        float o;
        string k, v;
        s = argv(i);
# 74 "./lib/cvar.qh"
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, ">=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) >= stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "<=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) <= stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, ">", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 1, -1); if (cvar(k) > stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "<", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 1, -1); if (cvar(k) < stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "==", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) == stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "!=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) != stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "===", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 3, -1); if (cvar_string(k) == v) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "!==", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 3, -1); if (cvar_string(k) != v) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        {
            k = s;
            float b = true;
            if (str2chr(k, 0) == '!') {
                k = substring(s, 1, -1);
                b = false;
            }
            float f = stof(k);
            float isnum = ftos(f) == k;
            if (((isnum ? f : cvar(k)) != 0) == b) continue; expr_fail = true; break;;
        }


    }
    if (!expr_fail) {
        ret = !ret;
    }

    return ret;
}

 void Draw_CylindricLine(vector from, vector to, float thickness, string texture, float aspect, float shift, vector rgb, float theAlpha, float drawflag, vector vieworg)
 {



  vector axis, thickdir, A, B, C, D;
  float length_tex;

  axis = normalize(to - from);
  length_tex = aspect * vlen(to - from) / thickness;


  thickdir = normalize(((axis) >< (vieworg - from)));

  A = from - thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  B = from + thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  C = to + thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  D = to - thickdir * (thickness / 2);

  R_BeginPolygon(texture, drawflag, false);
  R_PolygonVertex(A, '0 0 0' + shift * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(B, '0 1 0' + shift * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(C, '0 1 0' + (shift + length_tex) * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(D, '0 0 0' + (shift + length_tex) * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_EndPolygon();
 }

            switch (str2chr(_json_s, _json_i++)) {
                default:

                case 'u': esc = "\\u"; break;

[[eraseable]]
float json_parse(string in, float() func) {
    string trimmed = "";
    :trim {
        float o = strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        if (o >= 0) {
            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        } else {
            string part = in;
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto done;
        }
    }
    :trim_str {
        float o = strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        float esc = strstrofs(in, "\\\"", 0);
        if (o < esc || esc < 0) {

            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim;
        } else {

            string part = substring(in, 0, esc + 2); in = substring(in, esc + 2, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        }
    }
    :done;

    if(1){ _json_s = trimmed; _json_i = 0; }else voidfunc();
    _json_buffer = buf_create();
    float ret = func();
    if (!ret) {
        buf_del(_json_buffer);
        _json_buffer = -1;
    }
    return _json_buffer;
}

[[eraseable]]

{
    for (float i = 1, n = buf_getsize(buf); i < n; i += 2) {
        if (bufstr_get(buf, i) == key) return bufstr_get(buf, i + 1);
    }
    return nil;
}

    }

[[eraseable]]
void mean_accumulate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean, float value, float weight)
{
 if (weight == 0) return;
 if (mean == 0) e.(a) *= (value ** weight);
 else e.(a) += (value ** mean) * weight;
 e.(c) += weight;
}

[[eraseable]]
float mean_evaluate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean)
{
 if (e.(c) == 0) return 0;
 if (mean == 0) return (e.(a) ** (1.0 / e.(c)));
 else return ((e.(a) / e.(c)) ** (1.0 / mean));
}

[[eraseable]]
float angc(float a1, float a2)
{
 while (a1 > 180)
  a1 -= 360;
 while (a1 < -179)
  a1 += 360;
 while (a2 > 180)
  a2 -= 360;
 while (a2 < -179)
  a2 += 360;
 float a = a1 - a2;
 while (a > 180)
  a -= 360;
 while (a < -179)
  a += 360;
 return a;
}

[[eraseable]]

}

[[eraseable]]

}

[[eraseable]]
float lerpratio(float f0, float f1, float ratio)
{
 return f0 * (1 - ratio) + f1 * ratio;
}

[[eraseable]]
float lerp(float t0, float f0, float t1, float f1, float t)
{
 return lerpratio(f0, f1, (t - t0) / (t1 - t0));
}

[[eraseable]]
float lerp3ratio(float f0, float f1, float f2, float ratio)
{
 float mid = 0.5;
 return ratio < mid ? lerpratio(f0, f1, ratio / mid) : ratio > mid ? lerpratio(f1, f2, (ratio - mid) / mid) : f1;
}

vector lerpvratio(vector f0, vector f1, float ratio)
{
 return f0 * (1 - ratio) + f1 * ratio;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector lerpv3ratio(vector f0, vector f1, vector f2, float ratio)
{
 float mid = 0.5;
 return ratio < mid ? lerpvratio(f0, f1, ratio / mid) : ratio > mid ? lerpvratio(f1, f2, (ratio - mid) / mid) : f1;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector lerpv(float t0, vector v0, float t1, vector v1, float t)
{
 return v0 + (v1 - v0) * ((t - t0) / (t1 - t0));
}

[[eraseable]]
vector bezier_quadratic_getpoint(vector a, vector b, vector c, float t)
{
 return (c - 2 * b + a) * (t * t)
        + (b - a) * (2 * t)
        + a;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector bezier_quadratic_getderivative(vector a, vector b, vector c, float t)
{
 return (c - 2 * b + a) * (2 * t)
        + (b - a) * 2;
}

[[eraseable]]
float cubic_speedfunc(float startspeedfactor, float endspeedfactor, float spd)
{
 return (((startspeedfactor + endspeedfactor - 2
          ) * spd - 2 * startspeedfactor - endspeedfactor + 3
         ) * spd + startspeedfactor
        ) * spd;
}

[[eraseable]]
float float2range11(float f)
{
 return f / (fabs(f) + 1);
}


[[eraseable]]
float float2range01(float f)
{
 return 0.5 + 0.5 * float2range11(f);
}

[[eraseable]]
float median(float a, float b, float c)
{
 return (a < c) ? bound(a, b, c) : bound(c, b, a);
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals(float a, float b)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(b, -b)) * 0.001;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals_eps(float a, float b, float times_eps)
{
 float eps = max(fabs(a), fabs(b)) * FLOAT_EPSILON * times_eps;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_in_bounds(float a, float b, float c)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(c, -c)) * 0.001;
 if (a > c) eps = -eps;
 return b == median(a - eps, b, c + eps);
}

[[eraseable]]
float ExponentialFalloff(float mindist, float maxdist, float halflifedist, float d)
{
 if (halflifedist > 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - mindist) / halflifedist));
 else if (halflifedist < 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - maxdist) / halflifedist));
 else return 1;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector solve_quadratic(float a, float b, float c)
{
 vector v;
 float D;
 v = '0 0 0';
 if (a == 0)
 {
  if (b != 0)
  {
   v.x = v.y = -c / b;
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {
   if (c == 0)
   {

    v.z = 1;
   }
  }
 }
 else
 {
  D = b * b - 4 * a * c;
  if (D >= 0)
  {
   D = sqrt(D);
   if (a > 0)
   {
    v.x = ((-b) - D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = ((-b) + D) / (2 * a);
   }
   else
   {
    v.x = (-b + D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = (-b - D) / (2 * a);
   }
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {

   D = sqrt(-D);
   v.x = -b / (2 * a);
   if (a > 0) v.y = D / (2 * a);
   else v.y = -D / (2 * a);
   v.z = 0;
  }
 }
 return v;
}







[[eraseable]]
float map_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 float src_diff = src_max - src_min;
 float dest_diff = dest_max - dest_min;
 float ratio = (value - src_min) / src_diff;
 return dest_min + dest_diff * ratio;
}


[[eraseable]]
float map_bound_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 if (value <= src_min) return dest_min;
 if (value >= src_max) return dest_max;
 return map_ranges(value, src_min, src_max, dest_min, dest_max);
}

[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Brown(entity e, float dt)
{
 e.noise_baccum += random() * sqrt(dt);
 return e.noise_baccum;
}
[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Pink(entity e, float dt)
{
 float f;
 f = dt * 60;

 if (random() > (0.3190 ** f)) e.noise_paccum = 0.34848 * (2 * random() - 1);
 if (random() > (0.7756 ** f)) e.noise_paccum2 = 0.28768 * (2 * random() - 1);
 if (random() > (0.9613 ** f)) e.noise_paccum3 = 0.43488 * (2 * random() - 1);
 return e.noise_paccum + e.noise_paccum2 + e.noise_paccum3;
}
[[eraseable]]
float Noise_White(entity e, float dt)
{
 return random() * 2 - 1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Burst(entity e, float dt, float p)
{
 if (random() > (p ** dt)) e.noise_bstate = !e.noise_bstate;
 return 2 * e.noise_bstate - 1;
}

{
 vector d = vec_to_min(a, b);
 vector e = vec_to_max(a, b);

 vector c = vec_to_min(vec_to_max(point, d), e);

}

[[eraseable]]

{
 vector d = vec_to_max(a, b);
 vector e = vec_to_min(a, b);

 vector c = vec_to_min(vec_to_max(point, d), e);

 return c;
}

[[eraseable]]
float angle_snap_f(float f, float increment)
{
 for (float j = 0; j <= 360; )
 {
  if (f <= j - increment) return j - increment;
  j = j + increment;
 }

 return 0;
}

 c.z = angle_snap_f(v.z, increment);
 return c;
}

        Promise this,

{

 {
  if (e.url_rbuf == -1) (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("url_fgets: not readable in current state"));

  e.url_rbufpos += 1;
  return s;
 }
 else if (e.url_fh == URL_FH_STDOUT)
 {

  return nil;
 }
 else
 {

  return fgets(e.url_fh);
 }
}

            break;
        case "join":
            string s = substring(command, argv_start_index(2), -1);
            if (s != matrix_room && matrix_room != "") {
                MX_Leave(matrix_room);
                strunzone(matrix_room);
            }
            matrix_room = strzone(s);
            MX_Join(matrix_room);
            break;
        case "sync":
            MX_Sync(nil);
            break;
        case "typing":
            MX_Typing(true);
            break;
        case "say":
            MX_Say(substring(command, argv_start_index(2), -1));
            break;
        case "leave":
            MX_Leave(matrix_room);
            matrix_room = nil;
            break;
        case "forget":
            MX_Forget(matrix_room);
            matrix_room = "";
            break;
    }
}

string Team_ColorCode(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return COL_TEAM_1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return COL_TEAM_2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return COL_TEAM_3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return COL_TEAM_4;
 }

 return "^7";
}

vector Team_ColorRGB(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return '1 0.0625 0.0625';
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return '0.0625 0.0625 1';
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return '1 1 0.0625';
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return '1 0.0625 1';
 }

 return '0 0 0';
}

string Team_ColorName(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return CTX(_("TEAM^Red"));
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return CTX(_("TEAM^Blue"));
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return CTX(_("TEAM^Yellow"));
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return CTX(_("TEAM^Pink"));
 }

 return _("Neutral");
}


string Static_Team_ColorName(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return STATIC_NAME_TEAM_1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return STATIC_NAME_TEAM_2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return STATIC_NAME_TEAM_3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return STATIC_NAME_TEAM_4;
 }

 return _("Neutral");
}

float Team_ColorToTeam(string team_color)
{
 switch(strtolower(team_color))
 {
  case "red": return NUM_TEAM_1;
  case "blue": return NUM_TEAM_2;
  case "yellow": return NUM_TEAM_3;
  case "pink": return NUM_TEAM_4;
  case "auto": return 0;
 }

 return -1;
}




float Team_IsValidTeam(float team_num)
{
 switch (team_num)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1:
  case NUM_TEAM_2:
  case NUM_TEAM_3:
  case NUM_TEAM_4:
  {
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}




float Team_IsValidIndex(float index)
{
 switch (index)
 {
  case 1:
  case 2:
  case 3:
  case 4:
  {
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}




float Team_IndexToTeam(float index)
{
 switch (index)
 {
  case 1: return NUM_TEAM_1;
  case 2: return NUM_TEAM_2;
  case 3: return NUM_TEAM_3;
  case 4: return NUM_TEAM_4;
 }
 return -1;
}




float Team_TeamToIndex(float team_num)
{
 switch (team_num)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return 1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return 2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return 3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return 4;
 }
 return -1;
}




float Team_TeamToBit(float team_num)
{
 if (!Team_IsValidTeam(team_num))
 {
  return 0;
 }
 return (1 << (Team_TeamToIndex(team_num) - 1));
}




float Team_IndexToBit(float index)
{
 return (1 << (index - 1));
}

    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_RED;

        case NUM_TEAM_4: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_PINK;
        default: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

# 44 "./common/sounds/all.qh" 2
# 1 "./common/sounds/all.qc" 1
# 45 "./common/sounds/all.qh" 2
# 6 "./common/items/item.qh" 2
# 15 "./common/items/item.qh"
const float IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO = (1 << (0));
const float IT_UNLIMITED_SUPERWEAPONS = (1 << (1));

const float IT_JETPACK = (1 << (2));
const float IT_USING_JETPACK = (1 << (3));
const float IT_FUEL_REGEN = (1 << (4));

const float IT_RESOURCE = (1 << (5));

const float IT_KEY1 = (1 << (6));
const float IT_KEY2 = (1 << (7));

const float IT_BUFF = (1 << (8));



const float IT_INVISIBILITY = (1 << (9));
const float IT_INVINCIBLE = (1 << (10));
const float IT_SUPERWEAPON = (1 << (11));
const float IT_STRENGTH = (1 << (12));
const float IT_SPEED = (1 << (13));


const float IT_PICKUPMASK = IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO | IT_UNLIMITED_SUPERWEAPONS | IT_JETPACK | IT_FUEL_REGEN;


const float ISF_LOCATION = (1 << (1));
const float ISF_MODEL = (1 << (2));
const float ISF_STATUS = (1 << (3));
const float ISF_COLORMAP = (1 << (4));
const float ISF_DROP = (1 << (5));

entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_NEUTRAL;
    }
}
entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

entity EFFECT_CAP(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_CAP_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_CAP_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_CAP_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_CAP_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_CAP_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

entity EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER(float teamid)
{
    entity e;
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_RED; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_BLUE; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_YELLOW; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_PINK; break;
        default: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_NEUTRAL; break;
    }
    if (_particleeffectnum(e.eent_eff_name) < 0 || !Team_IsValidTeam(teamid)) { e = EFFECT_TR_NEXUIZPLASMA; }
    return e;
}

    {
        if (order & CBC_ORDER_FIRST) {
            if (order & CBC_ORDER_LAST)
                if (this.cbc_order & CBC_ORDER_ANY)
                    return false;
            if (this.cbc_order & CBC_ORDER_FIRST)

                return false;
        }

            else this.cbc_next = node;
        }

        return true;
    }

string notif_arg_frag_ping(float newline, float fping)
{
 string s = newline ? "\n" : " ";
 if (fping < 0)
  return sprintf(CCR(_("%s(^F1Bot^BG)")), s);
 else
  return sprintf(CCR(_("%s(Ping ^F1%d^BG)")), s, fping);
}

string notif_arg_frag_stats(float fhealth, float farmor, float fping)
{
 string s = notif_arg_frag_ping(false, fping);
 if (fhealth > 1)
  return sprintf(CCR(_("\n(Health ^1%d^BG / Armor ^2%d^BG)%s")), fhealth, farmor, s);
 else
  return sprintf(CCR(_("\n(^F4Dead^BG)%s")), s);
}

{

 if(autocvar_notification_show_sprees_center)
 {
  if(spree > 1)
  {



   switch(spree)
   {
    case 3: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("TRIPLE FRAG! ")); } case 5: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("RAGE! ")); } case 10: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("MASSACRE! ")); } case 15: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("MAYHEM! ")); } case 20: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("BERSERKER! ")); } case 25: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("CARNAGE! ")); } case 30: { return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) != "")) ? sprintf(_("%d score spree! "), spree) : _("ARMAGEDDON! ")); }
    default:
    {
     if (!autocvar_notification_show_sprees_center_specialonly)
     {
      return
       sprintf(
        (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%d score spree! ") != "")) ? _("%d score spree! ") : _("%d frag spree! "))


         ,
        spree);
     }
     else { return ""; }
    }
   }


  }
  else if(spree == -1)
  {
   return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("First score! ") != "")) ? _("First score! ") : _("First blood! "));
  }
  else if(spree == -2)
  {
   return (((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("First casualty! ") != "")) ? _("First casualty! ") : _("First victim! "));
  }
 }
 return "";

string notif_arg_spree_inf(float type, string input, string player, float spree)
{
 switch(type)
 {
  case 1:
  {


   if(autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 2)
   {

    string spree_newline =
     ( autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info_newline ?
      ((substring(input, 0, 1) == "\{3}") ? "\n\{3}" : "\n") : "" );





    if(spree > 1)
    {



     switch(spree)
     {
      case 3: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE SCORE! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE SCORE! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE FRAG! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 5: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 unlocked RAGE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 10: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made TEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 started a MASSACRE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 15: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made FIFTEEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made FIFTEEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 executed MAYHEM! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 20: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made TWENTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TWENTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 is a BERSERKER! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 25: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made TWENTY FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TWENTY FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 inflicts CARNAGE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 30: { return sprintf(CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made THIRTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made THIRTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 unleashes ARMAGEDDON! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); }
      default:
      {
       if (!autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info_specialonly)
       {
        return
         sprintf(
          CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 made %d scores in a row! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made %d scores in a row! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 has %d frags in a row! %s^BG"))


           ),
          player,
          spree,
          spree_newline
         );
       }
       else { return ""; }
      }
     }


    }
    else if(spree == -1)
    {
     return
      sprintf(
       CCR((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_("%s^K1 got the first score! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 got the first score! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 drew first blood! %s^BG"))


        ),
       player,
       spree_newline
      );
    }
   }
   break;
  }

  case -1:
  {
   if((spree > 1) && (autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 1))
   {
    return
     sprintf((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_(", ending their %d score spree") != "")) ? _(", ending their %d score spree") : _(", ending their %d frag spree"))


       ,
      spree
     );
   }
   break;
  }

  case -2:
  {
   if((spree > 1) && (autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 1))
   {
    return
     sprintf((((autocvar_cl_gentle || autocvar_cl_gentle_messages) && (_(", losing their %d score spree") != "")) ? _(", losing their %d score spree") : _(", losing their %d frag spree"))


       ,
      spree
     );
   }
   break;
  }
 }
 return "";
}

string notif_arg_item_wepammo(float f1, float f2)
{
 string ammoitems = "";
 Weapon wep = Weapons_from(f1);

 switch (wep.ammo_type)
 {
  case RES_SHELLS: ammoitems = ITEM_Shells.m_name; break;
  case RES_BULLETS: ammoitems = ITEM_Bullets.m_name; break;

  case RES_FUEL: ammoitems = ITEM_JetpackFuel.m_name; break;
  default: return "";
 }
 return sprintf(_(" with %d %s"), f2, strtolower(ammoitems));
}

void Announcer_Time()
{
 static float warmup_stage_prev;

 if(intermission)
  return;

 if (warmup_stage != warmup_stage_prev)
 {
  announcer_5min = announcer_1min = false;
  warmup_stage_prev = warmup_stage;
  return;
 }

 float starttime = (0, g_stat_GAMESTARTTIME);
 if(time < starttime)
 {
  announcer_5min = announcer_1min = false;
  return;
 }

 float timeleft;
 if(warmup_stage)
 {
  float warmup_timelimit = (0, g_stat_WARMUP_TIMELIMIT);
  if(warmup_timelimit > 0)
   timeleft = max(0, warmup_timelimit + starttime - time);
  else
   timeleft = 0;
 }
 else
  timeleft = max(0, (0, g_stat_TIMELIMIT) * 60 + starttime - time);

 if(autocvar_cl_announcer_maptime >= 2)
  if(1){ if(announcer_5min) { if(timeleft > 5 * 60) announcer_5min = false; } else { if(timeleft < 5 * 60 && timeleft > 5 * 60 - 1) { announcer_5min = true; Local_Notification(MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_REMAINING_MIN_5); } } }else voidfunc();

 if((autocvar_cl_announcer_maptime == 1) || (autocvar_cl_announcer_maptime == 3))
  if(1){ if(announcer_1min) { if(timeleft > 1 * 60) announcer_1min = false; } else { if(timeleft < 1 * 60 && timeleft > 1 * 60 - 1) { announcer_1min = true; Local_Notification(MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_REMAINING_MIN_1); } } }else voidfunc();
}

void Announcer()

  return;

 Announcer_Time();
}

float bgmscriptbuf;
float bgmscriptbufsize;
float bgmscriptbufloaded;

 .float bgmscriptline;
 .float bgmscriptline0;
 .float bgmscriptvolume;
 .float bgmscripttime;
 .float bgmscriptstate;
 .float bgmscriptstatetime;

float GetAttackDecaySustainAmplitude(float a, float d, float s, float t)
{





 if(t < 0)
  return 0;

 if(a)
  if(t <= a)
   return t / a;

 if(d)
  if(t <= a + d)
   return ((t - a) / d) * (s - 1) + 1;

 return s;
}

float GetReleaseAmplitude(float d, float s, float r, float t)
{
 float decayval, releaseval;

 if(!r)
  return 0;

 if(t > r)
  return 0;

 releaseval = s * (1 - t / r);

 if(t < -d)
  return 1;

 if(t < 0 && t >= -d)
 {



  decayval = ((t + d) / d) * (s - 1) + 1;
  return max(decayval, releaseval);
 }

 return releaseval;
}

float GetAttackTime(float a, float amp)
{
 return amp * a;
}

float GetReleaseTime(float d, float s, float r, float amp)
{
 float decaytime, releasetime;

 if(!s)
  return 0;


 releasetime = (1 - amp / s) * r;

 if(amp > s)
 {
  if(s == 1)
   return 0;




  decaytime = (amp - 1) / (s - 1) * d - d;
  return max(decaytime, releasetime);
 }

 return releasetime;
}

void BGMScript_Init()
{
 string s;
 float fh;
 bgmscriptbuf = bgmscriptbufsize = 0;
 bgmscriptbufloaded = 1;
 s = strcat("maps/", mi_shortname, ".bgs");
 fh = fopen(s, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
  return;
 bgmscriptbuf = buf_create();
 while((s = fgets(fh)))
 {
  bufstr_set(bgmscriptbuf, bgmscriptbufsize, s);
  ++bgmscriptbufsize;
 }
 fclose(fh);
}

void BGMScript_InitEntity(entity e)
{
 float l;
 string m;
 if(e.bgmscript != "")
 {
  if(!bgmscriptbufloaded)
   BGMScript_Init();

  float i;

  m = strcat(e.bgmscript, " ");
  l = strlen(m);

  e.bgmscriptline0 = -1;
  for(i = 0; i < bgmscriptbufsize; ++i)
  {
   if(substring(bufstr_get(bgmscriptbuf, i), 0, l) == m)
    break;
  }
  e.bgmscriptline = e.bgmscriptline0 = i;
  if(i >= bgmscriptbufsize)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/bgmscript.qc", "139")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("ERROR: bgmscript does not define %s", e.bgmscript); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (e.bgmscript) { strunzone(e.bgmscript); } e.bgmscript = nil; }else voidfunc();
  }
 }
}

float GetCurrentAmplitude(entity e, float trel)
{
 if(e.bgmscriptstate)
  return GetAttackDecaySustainAmplitude(e.bgmscriptattack, e.bgmscriptdecay, e.bgmscriptsustain, trel) * e.bgmscriptvolume;
 else
 {

  return GetReleaseAmplitude(e.bgmscriptdecay, e.bgmscriptsustain * e.bgmscriptvolume, e.bgmscriptrelease, trel);



 }
}

float GetTimeForAmplitude(entity e, float amp)
{
 if(e.bgmscriptstate)
  return GetAttackTime(e.bgmscriptattack, amp / e.bgmscriptvolume);
 else
 {

  return GetReleaseTime(e.bgmscriptdecay, e.bgmscriptsustain * e.bgmscriptvolume, e.bgmscriptrelease, amp);



 }
}

float doBGMScript(entity e)
{
 float amp, vel;

 if(e.bgmscript == "")
  return 1;

 if(autocvar_bgmvolume <= 0)
  return -1;

 e.just_toggled = false;

 if(bgmtime < 0)
  return -1;

 if(bgmtime < e.bgmscripttime)
 {
  amp = GetCurrentAmplitude(e, e.bgmscripttime - e.bgmscriptstatetime + drawframetime);

  e.bgmscriptline = e.bgmscriptline0;
  e.bgmscripttime = bgmtime;


  e.bgmscriptstate = false;
  e.bgmscriptvolume = 1;
  e.bgmscriptstatetime = bgmtime - GetTimeForAmplitude(e, amp);
 }


 for (;;)
 {
  tokenize_console(bufstr_get(bgmscriptbuf, e.bgmscriptline));
  if(stof(argv(1)) >= bgmtime || argv(0) != e.bgmscript)
  {
   e.bgmscripttime = bgmtime;
   return GetCurrentAmplitude(e, bgmtime - e.bgmscriptstatetime);
  }
  else if(bgmtime >= stof(argv(1)))
  {
   e.bgmscriptline += 1;
   e.bgmscripttime = stof(argv(1));

   amp = GetCurrentAmplitude(e, e.bgmscripttime - e.bgmscriptstatetime);


   vel = stof(argv(2));
   if(vel > 0)
   {
    e.just_toggled = e.bgmscriptstate = true;
    e.bgmscriptvolume = vel;
   }
   else
    e.just_toggled = e.bgmscriptstate = false;

   e.bgmscriptstatetime = e.bgmscripttime - GetTimeForAmplitude(e, amp);
  }
 }
}

void unpause_update()
{
 static float waspaused;
 float ispaused = ((input_buttons & (1 << (9))) != 0);
 if (ispaused == waspaused) return;
 waspaused = ispaused;

 if (ispaused) return;
 float channel = MSG_C2S;
 WriteByte(channel, NET_setpause.m_id);
 WriteByte(channel, ispaused);
}

void CSQCModel_LOD_Apply(entity this, float isplayer)
{
 float detailreduction = ((isplayer) ? autocvar_cl_playerdetailreduction : autocvar_cl_modeldetailreduction);


 if(this.lodmodelindex0 != this.modelindex && this.lodmodelindex1 != this.modelindex && this.lodmodelindex2 != this.modelindex)
 {
  string modelname = this.model;
  string s;

  vector mi = this.mins;
  vector ma = this.maxs;


  this.lodmodelindex0 = this.modelindex;
  this.lodmodelindex1 = this.modelindex;
  this.lodmodelindex2 = this.modelindex;


  s = strcat(substring(modelname, 0, strlen(modelname)-4), "_lod1", substring(modelname, -4, 4));
  if(fexists(s))
  {
   precache_model(s);
   _setmodel(this, s);
   if(this.modelindex)
    this.lodmodelindex2 = this.lodmodelindex1 = this.modelindex;
  }

  s = strcat(substring(modelname, 0, strlen(modelname)-4), "_lod2", substring(modelname, -4, 4));
  if(fexists(s))
  {
   precache_model(s);
   _setmodel(this, s);
   if(this.modelindex)
    this.lodmodelindex2 = this.modelindex;
  }

  _setmodel(this, modelname);
  setsize(this, mi, ma);
 }


 if(detailreduction <= 0)
 {
  if(detailreduction <= -2)
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex2;
  else if(detailreduction <= -1)
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex1;
  else
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex0;
 }
 else
 {
  float distance = vlen(((isplayer) ? this.origin : NearestPointOnBox(this, view_origin)) - view_origin);
  float dist1 = (this.loddistance1 > 0) ? this.loddistance1 : autocvar_cl_loddistance1;
  float dist2 = (this.loddistance2 > 0) ? this.loddistance2 : autocvar_cl_loddistance2;
  float f = (distance * current_viewzoom + 100.0) * detailreduction;
  f *= 1.0 / bound(0.01, view_quality, 1);
  if(f > dist2)
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex2;
  else if(f > dist1)
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex1;
  else
   this.modelindex = this.lodmodelindex0;
 }
}

   forceplayercolors_enabled = true;

 else if (teamplay)

    forcecolor_enemy = 0;

   float min_factor = bound(0, autocvar_cl_deathglow_min, 1);

    min_factor /= 2;
   float glow_fade = bound(0, 1 - (time - this.death_time) / autocvar_cl_deathglow, 1);
   this.glowmod *= (min_factor + glow_fade * (1 - min_factor));
   if (this.glowmod == '0 0 0')
    this.glowmod.x = 0.000001;
  }
 }

.entity tag_entity;
.float tag_entity_lastmodelindex;
.float tag_index;
void CSQCModel_AutoTagIndex_Apply(entity this)
{
 if(this.tag_entity && wasfreed(this.tag_entity))
  this.tag_entity = (0, world);

 __Mutator_Send_TagIndex_Update(0 , this);

 if(this.tag_networkentity)
 {

  float changed = 0;
  if(this.tag_entity.entnum != this.tag_networkentity)
  {
   this.tag_entity = findfloat((0, world), entnum, this.tag_networkentity);
   changed = 1;
  }


  if(this.tag_entity.classname == "ENT_CLIENT_MODEL")
  {
   CSQCModel_Hook_PreDraw(this.tag_entity, (this.tag_entity.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_CLIENT));
  }

  if(this.tag_entity.modelindex != this.tag_entity_lastmodelindex)
  {
   this.tag_entity_lastmodelindex = this.tag_entity.modelindex;
   changed = 1;
  }
  if(changed)
  {
   if(this.tag_entity)
   {

    if(substring(this.model, 0, 14) == "models/weapons")
    {
     if(substring(this.tag_entity.model, 0, 14) == "models/weapons")
     {
      this.tag_index = gettagindex(this.tag_entity, "weapon");
      if(!this.tag_index)
       this.tag_index = gettagindex(this.tag_entity, "tag_weapon");
      if(!this.tag_index)
      {

       this.tag_entity = (0, world);
       this.drawmask = 0;
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/csqcmodel_hooks.qc", "491")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("h_ model lacks weapon attachment, but v_ model is attached to it"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
      }
     }
     else if((this.tag_entity.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_MODEL))
     {
      skeleton_loadinfo(this.tag_entity);
      this.tag_index = this.tag_entity.bone_weapon;
     }
    }

    if(substring(this.tag_entity.model, 0, 14) == "models/weapons")
    {
     this.tag_index = gettagindex(this.tag_entity, "shot");
     if(!this.tag_index)
      this.tag_index = gettagindex(this.tag_entity, "tag_shot");
    }

    __Mutator_Send_TagIndex_Apply(0 , this);
   }
   else
   {

    this.drawmask = 0;
   }
  }
 }
}

.float snd_looping;
void CSQCModel_Effects_Apply(entity this)
{
 float eff = this.csqcmodel_effects & ~EF_SELECTABLE;
 float tref = this.csqcmodel_traileffect;

 this.renderflags &= ~(RF_DEPTHHACK | RF_ADDITIVE | RF_FULLBRIGHT | EF_NOSHADOW | RF_USEAXIS);
 this.effects = 0;
 this.traileffect = 0;

 if(eff & EF_BRIGHTFIELD)
  tref = EFFECT_TR_NEXUIZPLASMA.m_id;

 if(eff & EF_BRIGHTLIGHT)
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./client/csqcmodel_hooks.qc", 555, __FUNC__, "\"this.origin\", \"400\", \"'3 3 3'\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(this.origin, 400, '3 3 3'); }else voidfunc();
 if(eff & EF_DIMLIGHT)
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./client/csqcmodel_hooks.qc", 557, __FUNC__, "\"this.origin\", \"200\", \"'1.5 1.5 1.5'\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(this.origin, 200, '1.5 1.5 1.5'); }else voidfunc();
 if((eff & EF_NODRAW) || (this.alpha < 0))
  this.drawmask = 0;
 if(eff & EF_ADDITIVE)
  this.renderflags |= RF_ADDITIVE;
 if(eff & EF_BLUE)
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./client/csqcmodel_hooks.qc", 563, __FUNC__, "\"this.origin\", \"200\", \"'0.15 0.15 1.5'\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(this.origin, 200, '0.15 0.15 1.5'); }else voidfunc();
 if(eff & EF_RED)
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./client/csqcmodel_hooks.qc", 565, __FUNC__, "\"this.origin\", \"200\", \"'1.5 0.15 0.15'\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(this.origin, 200, '1.5 0.15 0.15'); }else voidfunc();

 if(eff & EF_FULLBRIGHT)
  this.renderflags |= RF_FULLBRIGHT;
 if(eff & EF_FLAME)
 {
  boxparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_EF_FLAME.eent_eff_name), this, this.absmin, this.absmax, this.velocity, this.velocity, bound(0, frametime, 0.1), 0);

 }
 if(eff & EF_SHOCK)
 {

.float anim_saveframe2time;
.float anim_prev_pmove_flags;
void CSQCModel_Hook_PreDraw(entity this, float isplayer)
{
 if(this.csqcmodel_predraw_run == framecount)
  return;
 this.csqcmodel_predraw_run = framecount;

 if(!this.modelindex || this.model == "null")
 {
  this.drawmask = 0;
  if(this.snd_looping > 0)
  {
   sound7(this, this.snd_looping, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_Null), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, autocvar_cl_jetpack_attenuation, 0, 0);
   this.snd_looping = 0;
  }
  return;
 }
 else
  this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;

 if((this.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_MODEL) && this.drawmask)
 {
  CSQCPlayer_ModelAppearance_Apply(this, (this.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_LOCAL));
  CSQCModel_LOD_Apply(this, true);

  if(!isplayer)
  {
   skeleton_loadinfo(this);
   float doblend = (this.bone_upperbody >= 0);
   CSQCPlayer_FallbackFrame_Apply(this);
   if(doblend)
   {
    skeleton_from_frames(this, this.csqcmodel_isdead);
   }
   else
   {
    free_skeleton_from_frames(this);

    this.lerpfrac = 0;
    this.lerpfrac4 = 0;
   }
  }
  else
  {

   skeleton_loadinfo(this);
   float doblend = (this.bone_upperbody >= 0);
   float onground = 0;
   if(this == csqcplayer)
   {
    if((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
     onground = 1;
    this.anim_prev_pmove_flags = this.flags;
    if(this.flags & FL_DUCKED)
     animdecide_setstate(this, this.anim_state | ANIMSTATE_DUCK, false);
    else if(this.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK)
     animdecide_setstate(this, this.anim_state - ANIMSTATE_DUCK, false);
   }
   else
   {
    tracebox(this.origin + '0 0 1', this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin - '0 0 4', MOVE_NORMAL, this);
    if(trace_startsolid || trace_fraction < 1)
     onground = 1;

    this.origin = CSQCModel_ApplyStairSmoothing(this, onground, this.origin);
   }
   animdecide_load_if_needed(this);
   animdecide_setimplicitstate(this, onground);
   animdecide_setframes(this, doblend, anim_frame, anim_frame1time, anim_frame2, anim_frame2time);
   float sf = 0;
   if(this.anim_saveframe != this.anim_frame || this.anim_saveframe1time != this.anim_frame1time)
    sf |= CSQCMODEL_PROPERTY_FRAME;
   if(this.anim_saveframe2 != this.anim_frame2 || this.anim_saveframe2time != this.anim_frame2time)
    sf |= CSQCMODEL_PROPERTY_FRAME2;
   this.anim_saveframe = this.anim_frame;
   this.anim_saveframe1time = this.anim_frame1time;
   this.anim_saveframe2 = this.anim_frame2;
   this.anim_saveframe2time = this.anim_frame2time;


   CSQCModel_InterpolateAnimation_2To4_PreNote(this, sf | CSQCMODEL_PROPERTY_LERPFRAC);
   this.lerpfrac = (doblend ? 0.5 : 0);
   this.frame = this.anim_frame;
   this.frame1time = this.anim_frame1time;
   this.frame2 = this.anim_frame2;
   this.frame2time = this.anim_frame2time;
   CSQCModel_InterpolateAnimation_2To4_Note(this, sf | CSQCMODEL_PROPERTY_LERPFRAC, false);
   CSQCModel_InterpolateAnimation_2To4_Do(this);
   if(doblend)
   {
    skeleton_from_frames(this, this.csqcmodel_isdead);
   }
   else
   {
    free_skeleton_from_frames(this);

    this.lerpfrac = 0;
    this.lerpfrac4 = 0;
   }
  }
 }
 else
  CSQCModel_LOD_Apply(this, false);

 CSQCModel_AutoTagIndex_Apply(this);

 CSQCModel_Effects_Apply(this);
}

void CSQCModel_Hook_PreUpdate(entity this, float isnew, float isplayer, float islocalplayer)
{

 this.iflags |= IFLAG_V_ANGLE_X;

 CSQCModel_Effects_PreUpdate(this);
 if((this.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_MODEL))
 {
  if(!isplayer)
   CSQCPlayer_FallbackFrame_PreUpdate(this);
  CSQCPlayer_ModelAppearance_PreUpdate(this);
 }
}

void CSQCModel_Hook_PostUpdate(entity this, float isnew, float isplayer, float islocalplayer)
{

 float is_playermodel = (substring(this.model, 0, 14) == "models/player/" || substring(this.model, 0, 17) == "models/ok_player/" ||
       (substring(this.model, 0, 16) == "models/monsters/" && (this.isplayermodel & (1 << (1)))));
 this.isplayermodel = (is_playermodel ? (this.isplayermodel) | (ISPLAYER_MODEL) : (this.isplayermodel) & ~(ISPLAYER_MODEL));
 this.csqcmodel_isdead = false;


 if((this.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_MODEL))
 {
  CSQCPlayer_ModelAppearance_PostUpdate(this);
  if(isplayer)
   CSQCPlayer_AnimDecide_PostUpdate(this, isnew);
  else
   CSQCPlayer_FallbackFrame_PostUpdate(this, isnew);
 }
 CSQCModel_Effects_PostUpdate(this);
}

void drawborderlines(float thickness, vector pos, vector dim, vector color, float theAlpha, float drawflag)
{
 vector line_dim = '0 0 0';


 pos.x -= thickness;
 line_dim.x = thickness;
 line_dim.y = dim.y;
 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), HUD_Scale(line_dim), color, theAlpha, drawflag);
 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + (dim.x + thickness) * '1 0 0'), HUD_Scale(line_dim), color, theAlpha, drawflag);


 pos.y -= thickness;
 line_dim.x = dim.x + thickness * 2;
 line_dim.y = thickness;
 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), HUD_Scale(line_dim), color, theAlpha, drawflag);
 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + (dim.y + thickness) * '0 1 0'), HUD_Scale(line_dim), color, theAlpha, drawflag);
}

void drawpic_tiled(vector pos, string pic, vector sz, vector area, vector color, float theAlpha, float drawflag)
{
 pos = HUD_Shift(pos);
 sz = HUD_Scale(sz);
 area = HUD_Scale(area);

 vector current_pos = '0 0 0', end_pos, new_size = '0 0 0', ratio = '0 0 0';
 end_pos = pos + area;

 current_pos.y = pos.y;
 while (current_pos.y < end_pos.y)
 {
  current_pos.x = pos.x;
  while (current_pos.x < end_pos.x)
  {
   new_size.x = min(sz.x, end_pos.x - current_pos.x);
   new_size.y = min(sz.y, end_pos.y - current_pos.y);
   ratio.x = new_size.x / sz.x;
   ratio.y = new_size.y / sz.y;
   drawsubpic(current_pos, new_size, pic, '0 0 0', ratio, color, theAlpha, drawflag);
   current_pos.x += sz.x;
  }
  current_pos.y += sz.y;
 }
}

float expandingbox_sizefactor_from_fadelerp(float fadelerp)
{
 return 1.2 / (1.2 - fadelerp);
}

vector expandingbox_resize_centered_box_offset(float sz, vector boxsize, float boxxsizefactor)
{
 boxsize.x *= boxxsizefactor;
 return boxsize * (0.5 * (1 - sz));
}

float PolyDrawModelSurface(entity e, float i_s)
{
 float i_t;
 float n_t;
 vector tri;
 string tex;
 tex = getsurfacetexture(e, i_s);
 if (!tex)
  return 0;
 n_t = getsurfacenumtriangles(e, i_s);
 for(i_t = 0; i_t < n_t; ++i_t)
 {
  tri = getsurfacetriangle(e, i_s, i_t);
  R_BeginPolygon(tex, 0, false);
  R_PolygonVertex(getsurfacepoint(e, i_s, tri.x), getsurfacepointattribute(e, i_s, tri.x, 4), '1 1 1', 1);
  R_PolygonVertex(getsurfacepoint(e, i_s, tri.y), getsurfacepointattribute(e, i_s, tri.y, 4), '1 1 1', 1);
  R_PolygonVertex(getsurfacepoint(e, i_s, tri.z), getsurfacepointattribute(e, i_s, tri.z, 4), '1 1 1', 1);
  R_EndPolygon();
 }
 return 1;
}
void PolyDrawModel(entity e)
{
 float i_s;
 for(i_s = 0; ; ++i_s)
  if(!PolyDrawModelSurface(e, i_s))
   break;
}

void DrawCircleClippedPic(vector centre, float radi, string pic, float f, vector rgb, float a, float drawflag)
{
 vector ringsize, v, t;
 ringsize = radi * '1 1 0';
 centre = HUD_Shift(centre);
 ringsize = HUD_Scale(ringsize);

 if(f >= 1)
 {

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x += 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y += 0.5 * ringsize.y; t += '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x -= 0.5 * ringsize.x; t -= '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y -= 0.5 * ringsize.y; t -= '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
  R_EndPolygon();
  return;
 }

 float co = cos(f * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846);
 float si = sin(f * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846);
 float q = fabs(co) + fabs(si);
 co /= q;
 si /= q;

 if(f > 0.75)
 {

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x += 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y += 0.5 * ringsize.y; t += '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x -= 0.5 * ringsize.x; t -= '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
  R_EndPolygon();

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x -= 0.5 * ringsize.x; t -= '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y -= 0.5 * ringsize.y; t -= '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
 }
 else if(f > 0.5)
 {

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x += 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y += 0.5 * ringsize.y; t += '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x -= 0.5 * ringsize.x; t -= '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
  R_EndPolygon();

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x -= 0.5 * ringsize.x; t -= '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
 }
 else if(f > 0.25)
 {

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x += 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.y += 0.5 * ringsize.y; t += '0.5 -0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
 }
 else if (f > 0)
 {

  R_BeginPolygon(pic, drawflag, true);
   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);

   v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
   v.x += 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += '0.5 0.5 0';
   R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
 }
 else
 {

  return;
 }


  v = centre; t = '0.5 0.5 0';
  v.x += co * 0.5 * ringsize.x; t += co * '0.5 0.5 0';
  v.y += si * 0.5 * ringsize.y; t += si * '0.5 -0.5 0';
  R_PolygonVertex(v, t, rgb, a);
 R_EndPolygon();
}

void AuditLists()
{
 entity e;
 entity prev;

 prev = players;
 for(e = prev.sort_next; e; prev = e, e = e.sort_next)
 {
  if(prev != e.sort_prev)
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat("sort list chain error\nplease submit the output of 'prvm_edicts client' to the developers")));
 }

 prev = teams;
 for(e = prev.sort_next; e; prev = e, e = e.sort_next)
 {
  if(prev != e.sort_prev)
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat("sort list chain error\nplease submit the output of 'prvm_edicts client' to the developers")));
 }
}

float RegisterPlayer(entity player)
{
 entity pl;
 AuditLists();
 for(pl = players.sort_next; pl; pl = pl.sort_next)
  if(pl == player)
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Player already registered!"));
 player.sort_next = players.sort_next;
 player.sort_prev = players;
 if(players.sort_next)
  players.sort_next.sort_prev = player;
 players.sort_next = player;
 AuditLists();
 return true;
}

void RemovePlayer(entity player)
{
 entity pl, parent;
 AuditLists();
 parent = players;
 for(pl = players.sort_next; pl && pl != player; pl = pl.sort_next)
  parent = pl;

 if(!pl)
 {
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Trying to remove a player which is not in the playerlist!"));
  return;
 }
 parent.sort_next = player.sort_next;
 if(player.sort_next)
  player.sort_next.sort_prev = parent;
 AuditLists();
}

void MoveToLast(entity e)
{
 AuditLists();
 entity ent = e.sort_next;
 while(ent)
 {
  e.sort_prev = ent.sort_prev; ent.sort_next = e.sort_next; if (e.sort_next) e.sort_next.sort_prev = ent; if (ent.sort_prev) ent.sort_prev.sort_next = e; ent.sort_prev = e; e.sort_next = ent;
  ent = e.sort_next;
 }
 AuditLists();
}

{
 if(1){ static float __once; if (!__once) { if(1){ if (!(Team.team)) { print_assertfailed_severe("Team.team"); eprint(Team); } }else voidfunc(); __once = true; } }else voidfunc();
 entity tm;
 AuditLists();
 for(tm = teams.sort_next; tm; tm = tm.sort_next)
  if(tm == Team)
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Team already registered!"));
 Team.sort_next = teams.sort_next;
 Team.sort_prev = teams;
 if(teams.sort_next)
  teams.sort_next.sort_prev = Team;

 AuditLists();
 return true;
}

.float has_team;
float SetTeam(entity o, float Team)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();

 entity tm;
 if(teamplay)
 {
  switch(Team)
  {
   case -1:
   case NUM_TEAM_1:
   case NUM_TEAM_2:
   case NUM_TEAM_3:
   case NUM_TEAM_4:
    break;
   default:
    if(GetTeam(Team, false) == (0, world))
    {
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/main.qc", "345")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("trying to switch to unsupported team %d", Team), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
     Team = NUM_SPECTATOR;
    }
    break;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  switch(Team)
  {
   case -1:
   case 0:
    break;
   default:
    if(GetTeam(Team, false) == (0, world))
    {
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/main.qc", "361")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("trying to switch to unsupported team %d", Team), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
     Team = NUM_SPECTATOR;
    }
    break;
  }
 }
 if(Team == -1)
 {
  if(o.has_team)
  {
   tm = GetTeam(o.team, false);
   tm.team_size -= 1;
   o.has_team = 0;
   return true;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  if (!o.has_team)
  {
   o.team = Team;
   tm = GetTeam(Team, true);
   tm.team_size += 1;
   o.has_team = 1;
   return true;
  }
  else if(Team != o.team)
  {
   tm = GetTeam(o.team, false);
   tm.team_size -= 1;
   o.team = Team;
   tm = GetTeam(Team, true);
   tm.team_size += 1;
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}

void Playerchecker_Think(entity this)
{
 float i;
 entity e;
 for(i = 0; i < maxclients; ++i)
 {
  e = playerslots[i];
  if(entcs_GetName(i) == "")
  {
   if(e.sort_prev)
   {

    SetTeam(e, -1);
    RemovePlayer(e);
    e.sort_prev = (0, world);

   }
  }
  else
  {
   if (!e.sort_prev)
   {

    if (!e)
    {
     playerslots[i] = e = __spawn("playerslot", "./client/main.qc" ":" "425", true);
    }
    e.sv_entnum = i;
    e.ping = 0;
    e.ping_packetloss = 0;
    e.ping_movementloss = 0;

    float t = entcs_GetScoreTeam(i);
    if (t) SetTeam(e, t);
    RegisterPlayer(e);
    Scoreboard_UpdatePlayerPos(e);
   }
  }
 }
 this.nextthink = time + 0.2;
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_ACCURACY(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 (this).pure_data = true; (this).solid = SOLID_NOT;;
 float sf = ReadInt24_t();
 if (sf == 0) {
  for (float w = 0; w <= (Weapons_COUNT - 1) - WEP_FIRST; ++w)
   weapon_accuracy[w] = -1;
  return true;
 }

 float f = 1;
 for (float w = 0; w <= (Weapons_COUNT - 1) - WEP_FIRST; ++w) {
  if (sf & f) {
   float b = ReadByte();
   if (b == 0)
    weapon_accuracy[w] = -1;
   else if (b == 255)
    weapon_accuracy[w] = 1.0;
   else
    weapon_accuracy[w] = (b - 1.0) / 100.0;
  }
  f = (f == 0x800000) ? 1 : f * 2;
 }
 return true;
}

float GetSpeedUnitFactor(float speed_unit)
{
 switch(speed_unit)
 {
  default:
  case 1: return 1.0;
  case 2: return 0.0254;
  case 3: return 0.0254 * 3.6;
  case 4: return 0.0254 * 3.6 * 0.6213711922;
  case 5: return 0.0254 * 1.943844492;
 }
}

string GetSpeedUnit(float speed_unit)
{
 switch(speed_unit)
 {

  default:
  case 1: return strcat(" ", _("qu/s"));
  case 2: return strcat(" ", _("m/s"));
  case 3: return strcat(" ", _("km/h"));
  case 4: return strcat(" ", _("mph"));
  case 5: return strcat(" ", _("knots"));
 }
}

float Net_Handle_TE_CSQC_RACE(entity this, entity sender, float isNew)
{
 float b = ReadByte();

 switch (b)
 {
  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_HIT_QUALIFYING:
   race_checkpoint = ReadByte();
   race_time = ReadInt24_t();
   race_previousbesttime = ReadInt24_t();
   race_mypreviousbesttime = ReadInt24_t();
   string pbestname = ReadString();
   if(autocvar_cl_race_cptimes_onlyself)
   {
    race_previousbesttime = race_mypreviousbesttime;
    race_mypreviousbesttime = 0;
    if(1){ if (race_previousbestname) { strunzone(race_previousbestname); } race_previousbestname = strzone(""); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
    if(1){ if (race_previousbestname) { strunzone(race_previousbestname); } race_previousbestname = strzone(pbestname); }else voidfunc();

   race_checkpointtime = time;

   if(race_checkpoint == 0 || race_checkpoint == 254)
   {
    race_penaltyaccumulator = 0;
    race_laptime = time;
   }
   break;

  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_CLEAR:
   race_laptime = 0;
   race_checkpointtime = 0;
   break;

  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_NEXT_SPEC_QUALIFYING:
   race_laptime = ReadCoord();
   race_checkpointtime = -99999;

  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_NEXT_QUALIFYING:
   race_nextcheckpoint = ReadByte();

   race_nextbesttime = ReadInt24_t();
   if(b != RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_NEXT_SPEC_QUALIFYING)
    race_mybesttime = ReadInt24_t();
   string newname = ReadString();
   if(autocvar_cl_race_cptimes_onlyself && b != RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_NEXT_SPEC_QUALIFYING)
   {
    race_nextbesttime = race_mybesttime;
    race_mybesttime = 0;
    if(1){ if (race_nextbestname) { strunzone(race_nextbestname); } race_nextbestname = strzone(""); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
    if(1){ if (race_nextbestname) { strunzone(race_nextbestname); } race_nextbestname = strzone(newname); }else voidfunc();
   break;

  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_HIT_RACE:
   race_mycheckpoint = ReadByte();
   race_mycheckpointtime = time;
   race_mycheckpointdelta = ReadInt24_t();
   race_mycheckpointlapsdelta = ReadByte();
   if(race_mycheckpointlapsdelta >= 128)
    race_mycheckpointlapsdelta -= 256;
   float who = ReadByte();
   if(who)
    if(1){ if (race_mycheckpointenemy) { strunzone(race_mycheckpointenemy); } race_mycheckpointenemy = strzone(entcs_GetName(who - 1)); }else voidfunc();
   else
    if(1){ if (race_mycheckpointenemy) { strunzone(race_mycheckpointenemy); } race_mycheckpointenemy = strzone(""); }else voidfunc();
   break;

  case RACE_NET_CHECKPOINT_HIT_RACE_BY_OPPONENT:
   race_othercheckpoint = ReadByte();
   race_othercheckpointtime = time;
   race_othercheckpointdelta = ReadInt24_t();
   race_othercheckpointlapsdelta = ReadByte();
   if(race_othercheckpointlapsdelta >= 128)
    race_othercheckpointlapsdelta -= 256;
   float what = ReadByte();
   if(what)
    if(1){ if (race_othercheckpointenemy) { strunzone(race_othercheckpointenemy); } race_othercheckpointenemy = strzone(entcs_GetName(what - 1)); }else voidfunc();
   else
    if(1){ if (race_othercheckpointenemy) { strunzone(race_othercheckpointenemy); } race_othercheckpointenemy = strzone(""); }else voidfunc();
   break;

  case RACE_NET_PENALTY_RACE:
  case RACE_NET_PENALTY_QUALIFYING:
   race_penaltyeventtime = time;
   race_penaltytime = ReadShort();
   string reason = ReadString();
   if (reason == "missing a checkpoint")
    reason = _("missing a checkpoint");
   if(1){ if (race_penaltyreason) { strunzone(race_penaltyreason); } race_penaltyreason = strzone(reason); }else voidfunc();
   if (b == RACE_NET_PENALTY_QUALIFYING)
    race_penaltyaccumulator += race_penaltytime;
   break;

  case RACE_NET_SERVER_RECORD:
   race_server_record = ReadInt24_t();
   break;
  case RACE_NET_SPEED_AWARD:
   race_speedaward = ReadInt24_t();
   if(1){ if (race_speedaward_holder) { strunzone(race_speedaward_holder); } race_speedaward_holder = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
   break;
  case RACE_NET_SPEED_AWARD_BEST:
   race_speedaward_alltimebest = ReadInt24_t();
   if(1){ if (race_speedaward_alltimebest_holder) { strunzone(race_speedaward_alltimebest_holder); } race_speedaward_alltimebest_holder = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
   break;
  case RACE_NET_RANKINGS_CNT:
   RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT = ReadByte();
   break;
  case RACE_NET_SERVER_RANKINGS:
   float prevpos, del;
   float pos = ReadShort();
   prevpos = ReadShort();
   del = ReadShort();


   float i;
   if (prevpos) {
    float m = min(prevpos, RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT);
    for (i=m-1; i>pos-1; --i) {
     grecordtime[i] = grecordtime[i-1];
     if(1){ if (grecordholder[i]) { strunzone(grecordholder[i]); } grecordholder[i] = strzone(grecordholder[i-1]); }else voidfunc();
    }
   } else if (del) {
    for (i=pos-1; i<= RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT-1; ++i) {
     if (i == RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT-1) {
      grecordtime[i] = 0;
      if(1){ if (grecordholder[i]) { strunzone(grecordholder[i]); } grecordholder[i] = nil; }else voidfunc();
     }
     else {
      grecordtime[i] = grecordtime[i+1];
      if(1){ if (grecordholder[i]) { strunzone(grecordholder[i]); } grecordholder[i] = strzone(grecordholder[i+1]); }else voidfunc();
     }
    }
   } else {
    for (i=RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT-1;i>pos-1;--i) {
     grecordtime[i] = grecordtime[i-1];
     if(1){ if (grecordholder[i]) { strunzone(grecordholder[i]); } grecordholder[i] = strzone(grecordholder[i-1]); }else voidfunc();
    }
   }

   if (grecordtime[RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT]) {

    grecordtime[RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT] = 0;
    if(1){ if (grecordholder[RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT]) { strunzone(grecordholder[RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT]); } grecordholder[RANKINGS_DISPLAY_CNT] = nil; }else voidfunc();
   }


   if(1){ if (grecordholder[pos-1]) { strunzone(grecordholder[pos-1]); } grecordholder[pos-1] = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
   grecordtime[pos-1] = ReadInt24_t();
   if(strdecolorize(grecordholder[pos-1]) == strdecolorize(entcs_GetName(player_localnum)))
    race_myrank = pos;
   break;
  case RACE_NET_SERVER_STATUS:
   race_status = ReadShort();
   if(1){ if (race_status_name) { strunzone(race_status_name); } race_status_name = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
 }
 return true;
}

string translate_weaponarena(string s)
{
 if (s == "") return s;
 if (s == "All Weapons Arena") return _("All Weapons Arena");
 if (s == "All Available Weapons Arena") return _("All Available Weapons Arena");
 if (s == "Most Weapons Arena") return _("Most Weapons Arena");
 if (s == "Most Available Weapons Arena") return _("Most Available Weapons Arena");
 if (s == "Dev All Weapons Arena") return s;
 if (s == "Dev All Available Weapons Arena") return s;
 if (s == "No Weapons Arena") return _("No Weapons Arena");

 float n = tokenizebyseparator(s, " & ");
 string wpn_list = "";
 for (float i = 0; i < n; i++)
 {
  Weapon wep = Weapon_from_name(argv(i));
  if (wep == WEP_Null)
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/main.qc", "1373")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("^3Warning: ^7server sent an invalid weapon name\n"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  wpn_list = cons_mid(wpn_list, " & ", wep.m_name);
 }
 if (wpn_list != "")
  return sprintf(_("%s Arena"), wpn_list);
 else
  return _("No Weapons Arena");
}

float net_handle_ServerWelcome()
{
 campaign = ReadByte();
 if (campaign)
 {
  float campaign_level = ReadByte();



  string key = _getcommandkey(_("jump"), "+jump", false);
  string msg = strcat(
   CCR("^F1"), sprintf(_("Level %d:"), campaign_level),
   sprintf(CCR(" ^BG%s\n\n"), "_LEVEL_DESC"),
   sprintf(CCR(_("^BGPress ^F2%s^BG to enter the game")), key));
  msg = MakeConsoleSafe(strreplace("\n", "\\n", msg));
  string welcomedialog_args = strcat("CAMPAIGN ", ftos(campaign_level), " \"", msg, "\"");

  localcmd("\nmenu_cmd directmenu Welcome ", welcomedialog_args, "\n");
  return true;
 }

 if(1){ if (hostname) { strunzone(hostname); } hostname = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
 string hostversion = ReadString();
 float version_mismatch = ReadByte();
 float version_check = ReadByte();
 srv_minplayers = ReadByte();
 srv_maxplayers = ReadByte();
 string modifications = translate_modifications(ReadString());
 string weaponarena_list = translate_weaponarena(ReadString());
 string cache_mutatormsg = ReadString();
 string motd = ReadString();

 string msg = GetVersionMessage(hostversion, version_mismatch, version_check);

 msg = strcat(msg, "\n\n", _("Gametype:"), " ^1", MapInfo_Type_ToText(gametype), "\n");

 msg = strcat(msg, "\n", _("Map:"), " ^2");
 if (world.message == "")
  msg = strcat(msg, mi_shortname, "\n");
 else
 {
  float i = strstrofs(world.message, " by ", 0);
  string longname = i >= 0 ? substring(world.message, 0, i) : world.message;
  msg = strcat(msg, (strcasecmp(longname, mi_shortname) ? strcat(mi_shortname, " ^7// ^2") : ""), longname, "\n");
 }

 if (srv_minplayers || srv_maxplayers)
 {
  msg = strcat(msg, "\n", _("This match supports"), " ^5");
  if (srv_minplayers == srv_maxplayers)
   msg = strcat(msg, sprintf(_("%d players"), srv_maxplayers), "\n");
  else if (srv_minplayers && srv_maxplayers)
   msg = strcat(msg, sprintf(_("%d to %d players"), srv_minplayers, srv_maxplayers), "\n");
  else if (srv_maxplayers)
   msg = strcat(msg, sprintf(_("%d players maximum"), srv_maxplayers), "\n");
  else
   msg = strcat(msg, sprintf(_("%d players minimum"), srv_minplayers), "\n");
 }

 modifications = cons_mid(modifications, ", ", weaponarena_list);
 if(modifications != "")
  msg = strcat(msg, "\n", _("Active modifications:"), " ^3", modifications, "\n");

 if (cache_mutatormsg != "")
  msg = strcat(msg, "\n", _("Special gameplay tips:"), " ^7", cache_mutatormsg, "\n");
 string mutator_msg = "";
 __Mutator_Send_BuildGameplayTipsString(0 , mutator_msg);
 mutator_msg = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_string;
 msg = strcat(msg, mutator_msg);

 if (motd != "")
  msg = strcat(msg, "\n^9↓ ", _("Server's message"), " ↓\n", motd);

 if(1){ if (welcome_msg) { strunzone(welcome_msg); } welcome_msg = strzone(msg); }else voidfunc();
 welcome_msg_menu_check_maxtime = time + 1;
 return true;
}

{
 if (!welcome_msg_menu_check_maxtime)
  return;


 if (cvar("_menu_initialized") == 2 || time > welcome_msg_menu_check_maxtime)
 {
  if (cvar("_menu_welcome_dialog_available"))
  {
   string welcomedialog_args = strcat("HOSTNAME \"", hostname, "\"");
   string msg = MakeConsoleSafe(strreplace("\n", "\\n", welcome_msg));
   welcomedialog_args = strcat(welcomedialog_args, " WELCOME \"", msg, "\"");

   if (intermission || isdemo() || !autocvar_cl_welcome)
   {
    if (cvar("_menu_cmd_closemenu_available"))
    {

     localcmd("\nmenu_cmd closemenu Welcome ", welcomedialog_args, "\n");
    }
    else
    {



     localcmd("\nmenu_cmd directmenu Welcome ", welcomedialog_args, "\n");

     localcmd("\ntogglemenu 0\n");
    }
   }
   else
    localcmd("\nmenu_cmd directmenu Welcome ", welcomedialog_args, "\n");
  }

  if(1){ if (welcome_msg) { strunzone(welcome_msg); } welcome_msg = nil; }else voidfunc();
  welcome_msg_menu_check_maxtime = 0;
 }
}

string _getcommandkey(string cmd_name, string command, float forcename)
{
 string keys;
 float n, j, k, l = 0;

 if (!autocvar_hud_showbinds)
  return cmd_name;

 keys = db_get(binddb, command);
 if (keys == "")
 {
  float joy_active = cvar("joy_active");
  n = tokenize(findkeysforcommand(command, 0));
  for(j = 0; j < n; ++j)
  {
   k = stof(argv(j));
   if(k != -1)
   {
    string key = keynumtostring(k);
    if(!joy_active && substring(key, 0, 3) == "JOY")
     continue;

    key = translate_key(key);

    if (keys == "")
     keys = key;
    else
     keys = strcat(keys, ", ", key);

    ++l;
    if (autocvar_hud_showbinds_limit > 0 && autocvar_hud_showbinds_limit <= l)
     break;
   }

  }
  if (keys == "")
   keys = "NO_KEY";
  db_put(binddb, command, keys);
 }

 if (keys == "NO_KEY") {
  if (autocvar_hud_showbinds > 1)
   return sprintf(_("%s (not bound)"), cmd_name);
  else
   return cmd_name;
 }
 else if (autocvar_hud_showbinds > 1 || forcename)
  return sprintf("%s (%s)", cmd_name, keys);
 else
  return keys;
}

}
