 float title_gap = gtv_text_size.y * 1.4;
 pos.y += title_gap;
 maxh -= title_gap;


 vector image_size = '1 1 0' * gtv_text_size.x * 3;
 if ( maxh < image_size.y )
  image_size = '1 1 0' * maxh;
 image_size *= 0.8;
 float desc_padding = gtv_text_size.x * 0.6;
 pos.x += image_size.x + desc_padding;
 tsize -= image_size.x + desc_padding;


 entity title;
 title = __spawn("entity", "./client/mapvoting.qc" ":" "155", false);
 title.message = MapVote_FormatMapItem(id, mv_pk3[id], _count, tsize, gtv_text_size);

 string thelabel = mv_desc[id], ts;
 entity last = title;
 entity next = (0, world);
 float nlines = 0;
 if( thelabel != "")
 {
  float i,n = tokenizebyseparator(thelabel, "\n");
  for(i = 0; i < n && maxh > (nlines+1)*gtv_text_size_small.y; ++i)
  {
   getWrappedLine_remaining = argv(i);
   while(getWrappedLine_remaining && maxh > (nlines+1)*gtv_text_size_small.y)
   {
    ts = getWrappedLine(tsize, gtv_text_size_small, stringwidth_colors);
    if (ts != "")
    {
     next = __spawn("entity", "./client/mapvoting.qc" ":" "173", false);
     next.message = ts;
     next.origin = pos-offset;
     last.chain = next;
     last = next;
     pos.y += gtv_text_size_small.y;
     nlines++;
    }
   }
  }
 }


 maxh -= max(nlines*gtv_text_size_small.y,image_size.y);
 if ( maxh > 0 )
  offset.y += maxh/2;


 drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(offset), title.message, gtv_text_size, rgb, alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);


 if(pic != "")
  drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift('0 1 0'*title_gap+'0.5 0 0'*desc_padding+offset), pic, HUD_Scale(image_size), '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);


 for ( last = title.chain; last ; )
 {
  drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(last.origin+offset), last.message, gtv_text_size_small, '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  next = last;
  last = last.chain;
  if(1){ entity _this = (next); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(next); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }


 if(1){ entity _this = (title); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(title); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
}

void MapVote_DrawMapPicture(string pic, vector pos, vector img_size, float theAlpha)
{
 if(pic == "")
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), HUD_Scale(img_size), '.5 .5 .5', .7 * theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 else
 {
  if(drawgetimagesize(pic) == '0 0 0')
   drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), draw_UseSkinFor("nopreview_map"), HUD_Scale(img_size), '1 1 1', theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  else
   drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), pic, HUD_Scale(img_size), '1 1 1', theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }
}

void MapVote_DrawMapItem(vector pos, float isize, float tsize, string map, string pic, float _count, float id)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 vector img_size = '0 0 0';
 string label;
 float text_size;

 float rect_margin = hud_fontsize.y / 2;

 pos.x += rect_margin + autocvar_hud_panel_mapvote_highlight_border;
 pos.y += rect_margin + autocvar_hud_panel_mapvote_highlight_border;
 isize -= 2 * (rect_margin + autocvar_hud_panel_mapvote_highlight_border);
 tsize -= 2 * (rect_margin + autocvar_hud_panel_mapvote_highlight_border);

 vector rect_pos = pos - '0.5 0.5 0' * rect_margin;
 vector rect_size = '1 1 0';
 rect_size.x = tsize + rect_margin;
 rect_size.y = isize + rect_margin;

 float img_ar = 4/3;
 img_size.x = min(tsize, isize * img_ar);
 img_size.y = img_size.x / img_ar;
 img_size.y -= hud_fontsize.y;
 img_size.x = img_size.y * img_ar;

 pos.y += (isize - img_size.y - hud_fontsize.y) / 2;

 label = MapVote_FormatMapItem(id, map, _count, tsize, hud_fontsize);

 text_size = stringwidth(label, false, hud_fontsize);

 float save_rect_sizex = rect_size.x;
 rect_size.x = max(img_size.x, text_size) + rect_margin;
 rect_pos.x += (save_rect_sizex - rect_size.x) / 2;

 vector text_pos = '0 0 0';
 text_pos.x = pos.x + (tsize - text_size) / 2;
 text_pos.y = pos.y + img_size.y;

 pos.x += (tsize - img_size.x) / 2;

 float theAlpha;
 if (!(mv_flags[id] & GTV_AVAILABLE) && mv_top2_alpha)
  theAlpha = mv_top2_alpha;
 else if (mv_winner && mv_winner_alpha)
  theAlpha = mv_winner_alpha;
 else
  theAlpha = 1;
 theAlpha *= panel_fg_alpha;

 vector rgb = MapVote_RGB(id);


 if (!mv_winner)
 {
  if(id == mv_selection && (mv_flags[id] & GTV_AVAILABLE))
   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(rect_pos), HUD_Scale(rect_size), '1 1 1', 0.1 * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);


  if(id == mv_ownvote)
  {
   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(rect_pos), HUD_Scale(rect_size), rgb, 0.1 * theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
   drawborderlines(autocvar_hud_panel_mapvote_highlight_border, rect_pos, rect_size, rgb, theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
 }

 drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(text_pos), label, hud_fontsize, rgb, theAlpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 MapVote_DrawMapPicture(pic, pos, img_size, theAlpha);
}

{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();

 float text_size;
 string label;

 rgb = MapVote_RGB(id);

vector MapVote_GridVec(vector gridspec, float i, float m)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float r = i % m;
 return
  '1 0 0' * (gridspec.x * r)
  +
  '0 1 0' * (gridspec.y * (i - r) / m);
}

float MapVote_Selection(vector topleft, vector cellsize, float rows, float columns)
{
 float c, r;
 if (mv_winner)
  return -1;

 mv_mouse_selection = -1;

 for (r = 0; r < rows; ++r)
  for (c = 0; c < columns; ++c)
  {
   if (mousepos.x >= topleft.x + cellsize.x * c &&
    mousepos.x <= topleft.x + cellsize.x * (c + 1) &&
    mousepos.y >= topleft.y + cellsize.y * r &&
    mousepos.y <= topleft.y + cellsize.y * (r + 1))
   {
    mv_mouse_selection = r * columns + c;
    break;
   }
  }

 if (mv_mouse_selection >= mv_num_maps)
  mv_mouse_selection = -1;

 if (mv_abstain && mv_mouse_selection < 0)
  mv_mouse_selection = mv_num_maps;

 if ( mv_selection_keyboard )
  return mv_selection;

 return mv_mouse_selection;
}


void MapVote_Draw()
{
 string map;
 float i;
 float tmp;
 vector pos;
 float center;
 float rows;
 vector dist = '0 0 0';


 if(!mv_active)
  return;

 HUD_Panel_LoadCvars();

 center = (vid_conwidth - 1)/2;
 xmin = vid_conwidth * 0.08;
 xmax = vid_conwidth - xmin;
 ymin = 20;
 ymax = vid_conheight - ymin;

 if(chat_posy + chat_sizey / 2 < vid_conheight / 2)
  ymin += chat_sizey;
 else
  ymax -= chat_sizey;

 hud_fontsize = HUD_GetFontsize("hud_fontsize");
 if (gametypevote)
 {
  gtv_text_size = hud_fontsize * 1.4;
  gtv_text_size_small = hud_fontsize * 1.1;
 }

 pos.y = ymin;
 pos.z = 0;

 HUD_Scale_Disable();
 drawfont = FONT_USER + 2;

 map = ((gametypevote) ? _("Decide the gametype") : _("Vote for a map"));
 if (!mv_winner)
 {
  pos.x = center - stringwidth(map, false, hud_fontsize * 2) * 0.5;
  drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), map, hud_fontsize * 2, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }
 pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 2;

 if( mapvote_chosenmap != "" )
 {
  pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 0.25;
  pos.x = center - stringwidth(mapvote_chosenmap, false, hud_fontsize * 1.5) * 0.5;
  drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), mapvote_chosenmap, hud_fontsize * 1.5, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 1.5;
 }
 pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 0.5;

 drawfont = FONT_USER + 1;

 i = ceil(max(1, mv_timeout - time));
 if (mv_winner)
  map = mv_maps[mv_winner - 1];
 else
  map = sprintf(_("%d seconds left"), i);
 pos.x = center - stringwidth(map, false, hud_fontsize * 1.5) * 0.5;
 drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), map, hud_fontsize * 1.5, '0 1 0', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 1.5;
 pos.y += hud_fontsize.y * 0.5;


 pos.y += hud_fontsize.y;
 pos.x = xmin;
 ymin = pos.y;
 float abstain_spacing = panel_bg_border + hud_fontsize.y;
 if(mv_abstain)
 {
  mv_num_maps -= 1;
  ymax -= abstain_spacing;
 }


 float item_aspect = (gametypevote) ? 3/1 : 5/3;
 vector table_size = HUD_GetTableSize_BestItemAR(mv_num_maps, (_vec2_x = (xmax - xmin), _vec2_y = (ymax - ymin), _vec2), item_aspect);
 mv_columns = table_size.x;
 rows = table_size.y;

 dist.x = (xmax - xmin) / mv_columns;
 dist.y = (ymax - pos.y) / rows;


 tmp = vid_conwidth / 3;
 if(dist.x > tmp)
 {
  dist.x = tmp;
  dist.y = min(dist.y, dist.x / item_aspect);
 }
 tmp = vid_conheight / 3;
 if(dist.y > tmp)
 {
  dist.y = tmp;
  dist.x = min(dist.x, dist.y * item_aspect);
 }


 if(dist.x / dist.y > item_aspect)
  dist.x = dist.y * item_aspect;
 else
  dist.y = dist.x / item_aspect;


 float offset;
 offset = ((xmax - pos.x) - dist.x * mv_columns) / 2;
 xmin = pos.x += offset;
 xmax -= offset;
 offset = ((ymax - pos.y) - dist.y * rows) / 2;
 ymax -= 2 * offset;


 panel_pos.x = pos.x;
 panel_pos.y = pos.y;
 panel_size.x = xmax - xmin;
 panel_size.y = ymax - ymin;
 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

 if(panel_bg_padding)
 {


  dist.x -= 2 * panel_bg_padding / mv_columns;
  dist.y -= 2 * panel_bg_padding / rows;
  xmin = pos.x += panel_bg_padding;
  ymin = pos.y += panel_bg_padding;
  xmax -= 2 * panel_bg_padding;
  ymax -= 2 * panel_bg_padding;
 }

 mv_selection = MapVote_Selection(pos, dist, rows, mv_columns);

 if (mv_top2_time)
  mv_top2_alpha = max(0.2, 1 - (time - mv_top2_time) ** 2);

 if (mv_winner_time)
  mv_winner_alpha = max(0.2, 1 - sqrt(max(0, time - mv_winner_time)));

 void (vector, float, float, string, string, float, float) DrawItem;

 if(gametypevote)
  DrawItem = GameTypeVote_DrawGameTypeItem;
 else
  DrawItem = MapVote_DrawMapItem;

 for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i)
 {
  tmp = mv_votes[i];
  map = mv_maps[i];
  if(mv_preview[i])
   DrawItem(pos + MapVote_GridVec(dist, i, mv_columns), dist.y, dist.x, map, mv_pics[i], tmp, i);
  else
   DrawItem(pos + MapVote_GridVec(dist, i, mv_columns), dist.y, dist.x, map, "", tmp, i);
 }

 if(mv_abstain)
  ++mv_num_maps;

 if(mv_abstain && i < mv_num_maps) {
  tmp = mv_votes[i];
  pos.y = ymax + abstain_spacing;
  pos.x = (xmax + xmin) * 0.5;
  MapVote_DrawAbstain(pos, dist.x, xmax - xmin, tmp, i);
 }

 if (mv_winner)
 {

  vector startsize = '0 0 0';
  startsize.y = vid_conheight * 0.1;
  startsize.x = startsize.y * 4/3;
  vector startpos = panel_pos + (panel_size - startsize) / 2;

  vector endsize = '0 0 0';
  endsize.y = vid_conheight * 0.5;
  endsize.x = endsize.y * 4/3;
  vector endpos = '0 0 0';
  endpos.y = panel_pos.y;
  endpos.x = (vid_conwidth - endsize.x) * 0.5;

  float f = bound(0, (time - mv_winner_time) * 2, 1);
  f = sqrt(f);
  float theAlpha = f;
  f = min(0.1 + f, 1);
  vector img_pos = endpos * f + startpos * (1 - f);
  vector img_size = endsize * f + startsize * (1 - f);

  MapVote_DrawMapPicture(mv_pics[mv_winner - 1], img_pos, img_size, theAlpha);
 }
}

void Cmd_MapVote_MapDownload(float argc)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 entity pak;

 if(argc != 2 || !mv_pk3list)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/mapvoting.qc", "559")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(_("mv_mapdownload: ^3You're not supposed to use this command on your own!")); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 float id = stof(argv(1));
 for(pak = mv_pk3list; pak; pak = pak.chain)
  if(pak.sv_entnum == id)
   break;

 if(!pak || pak.sv_entnum != id) {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/mapvoting.qc", "569")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(_("^1Error:^7 Couldn't find pak index.")); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 if(PreviewExists(pak.message))
 {
  mv_preview[id] = true;
  return;
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/mapvoting.qc", "578")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(_("Requesting preview...")); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  localcmd(strcat("\ncmd mv_getpicture ", ftos(id), "\n"));
 }
}

void MapVote_CheckPic(string pic, string pk3, float id)

 if(1){ }else voidfunc();

 if(mv_abstain && id == mv_num_maps - 1)
  return;

 if(PreviewExists(pic))
 {
  mv_preview[id] = true;
  return;

 MapVote_CheckPK3(pic, pk3, id);
}

void MapVote_ReadMask()
{
 float i;
 if ( mv_num_maps < 24 )
 {
  float mask;
  if(mv_num_maps < 8)
   mask = ReadByte();
  else if(mv_num_maps < 16)
   mask = ReadShort();
  else
   mask = ReadLong();

  for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i)
  {
   if (mask & (1 << (i)))
    mv_flags[i] |= GTV_AVAILABLE;
   else
    mv_flags[i] &= ~GTV_AVAILABLE;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i )
   mv_flags[i] = ReadByte();
 }
}

void MapVote_ReadOption(float i)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 string map = strzone(ReadString());
 string pk3 = strzone(ReadString());
 float j = bound(0, ReadByte(), n_ssdirs - 1);

 mv_maps[i] = map;
 mv_pk3[i] = pk3;
 mv_flags[i] = GTV_AVAILABLE;

 string pic = strzone(strcat(ssdirs[j], "/", map));
 mv_pics[i] = pic;
 mv_preview[i] = false;
 MapVote_CheckPic(pic, pk3, i);
}

void GameTypeVote_ReadOption(float i)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 string gt = strzone(ReadString());

 mv_maps[i] = gt;
 mv_flags[i] = ReadByte();

 string basetype = "";

 if ( mv_flags[i] & GTV_CUSTOM )
 {
  string name = ReadString();
  if ( strlen(name) < 1 )
   name = gt;
  mv_pk3[i] = strzone(name);
  mv_desc[i] = strzone(ReadString());
  basetype = strzone(ReadString());
 }
 else
 {
  Gametype type = MapInfo_Type_FromString(gt, false, false);
  mv_pk3[i] = strzone(MapInfo_Type_ToText(type));
  mv_desc[i] = MapInfo_Type_Description(type);
 }

 string mv_picpath = sprintf("gfx/menu/%s/gametype_%s", autocvar_menu_skin, gt);
 if(precache_pic(mv_picpath) == "")
 {
  mv_picpath = strcat("gfx/menu/default/gametype_", gt);
  if(precache_pic(mv_picpath) == "")
  {
   mv_picpath = sprintf("gfx/menu/%s/gametype_%s", autocvar_menu_skin, basetype);
   if(precache_pic(mv_picpath) == "")
   {
    mv_picpath = strcat("gfx/menu/default/gametype_", basetype);
   }
  }
 }
 string pic = strzone(mv_picpath);
 mv_pics[i] = pic;
 mv_preview[i] = PreviewExists(pic);
}

void MapVote_Init()
{
 mv_active = 1;
 if(!autocvar_hud_cursormode) mousepos = '0.5 0 0' * vid_conwidth + '0 0.5 0' * vid_conheight;
 mv_selection = -1;
 mv_selection_keyboard = 0;

 string s;
 for(n_ssdirs = 0; ; ++n_ssdirs)
 {
  s = ReadString();
  if(s == "")
   break;
  if(n_ssdirs < NUM_SSDIRS)
   ssdirs[n_ssdirs] = s;
 }
 n_ssdirs = min(n_ssdirs, NUM_SSDIRS);

 mv_num_maps = min(MAPVOTE_COUNT, ReadByte());
 mv_abstain = ReadByte();
 if(mv_abstain)
  mv_abstain = 1;
 mv_detail = ReadByte();

 mv_ownvote = -1;
 mv_timeout = ReadCoord();

 float gametypevote_flags = ReadByte();
 gametypevote = ((gametypevote_flags & (1 << (0))) != 0);
 if(gametypevote_flags)
  mapvote_chosenmap = strzone(ReadString());

 MapVote_ReadMask();
 float i;
 for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i )
  mv_flags_start[i] = mv_flags[i];


 mv_pk3list = (0, world);

 for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i)
 {
  mv_votes[i] = 0;

  if ( gametypevote )
   GameTypeVote_ReadOption(i);
  else
   MapVote_ReadOption(i);
 }

 for(i = 0; i < n_ssdirs; ++i)
  ssdirs[n_ssdirs] = nil;
 n_ssdirs = 0;
}

void MapVote_SendChoice(float index)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 localcmd(strcat("\nimpulse ", ftos(index+1), "\n"));
}

float MapVote_MoveLeft(float pos)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float imp;
 if ( pos < 0 )
  imp = mv_num_maps - 1;
 else
  imp = pos < 1 ? mv_num_maps - 1 : pos - 1;
 if ( !(mv_flags[imp] & GTV_AVAILABLE) && imp != mv_ownvote )
  imp = MapVote_MoveLeft(imp);
 return imp;
}
float MapVote_MoveRight(float pos)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float imp;
 if ( pos < 0 )
  imp = 0;
 else
  imp = pos >= mv_num_maps - 1 ? 0 : pos + 1;
 if ( !(mv_flags[imp] & GTV_AVAILABLE) && imp != mv_ownvote )
  imp = MapVote_MoveRight(imp);
 return imp;
}
float MapVote_MoveUp(float pos)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float imp;
 if ( pos < 0 )
  imp = mv_num_maps - 1;
 else
 {
  imp = pos - mv_columns;
  if ( imp < 0 )
  {
   float mv_rows = ceil(mv_num_maps / mv_columns);
   if (imp == -mv_columns)
    imp = mv_columns * mv_rows - 1;
   else
    imp = imp + mv_columns * mv_rows - 1;
  }
 }
 if ( !(mv_flags[imp] & GTV_AVAILABLE) && imp != mv_ownvote )
  imp = MapVote_MoveUp(imp);
 return imp;
}
float MapVote_MoveDown(float pos)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float imp;
 if ( pos < 0 )
  imp = 0;
 else
 {
  imp = pos + mv_columns;
  if ( imp >= mv_num_maps )
  {
   if ((imp % mv_columns) == mv_columns - 1)
    imp = 0;
   else
    imp = imp % mv_columns + 1;
  }
 }
 if ( !(mv_flags[imp] & GTV_AVAILABLE) && imp != mv_ownvote )
  imp = MapVote_MoveDown(imp);
 return imp;
}

float MapVote_InputEvent(float bInputType, float nPrimary, float nSecondary)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();

 static float first_digit = 0;
 if (!mv_active || isdemo())
  return false;

 if(bInputType == 3)
 {
  mousepos.x = nPrimary;
  mousepos.y = nSecondary;
  mv_selection_keyboard = 0;
  return true;
 }

 if (bInputType == 2)
 {
  mv_selection_keyboard = 0;
  return false;
 }


 float key_pressed = (bInputType == 0);

 if (key_pressed)
 {
  if (nPrimary == K_ALT) hudShiftState |= S_ALT;
  if (nPrimary == K_CTRL) hudShiftState |= S_CTRL;
  if (nPrimary == K_SHIFT) hudShiftState |= S_SHIFT;
 }
 else
 {
  if (nPrimary == K_ALT) hudShiftState -= (hudShiftState & S_ALT);
  if (nPrimary == K_CTRL) hudShiftState -= (hudShiftState & S_CTRL);
  if (nPrimary == K_SHIFT) hudShiftState -= (hudShiftState & S_SHIFT);

  if (nPrimary == K_CTRL)
   first_digit = 0;
 }





 if (!key_pressed) return false;

 float imp = 0;
 switch(nPrimary)
 {
  case K_RIGHTARROW:
   if (mv_winner)
    return true;
   mv_selection_keyboard = 1;
   mv_selection = MapVote_MoveRight(mv_selection);
   return true;
  case K_LEFTARROW:
   if (mv_winner)
    return true;
   mv_selection_keyboard = 1;
   mv_selection = MapVote_MoveLeft(mv_selection);
   return true;
  case K_DOWNARROW:
   if (mv_winner)
    return true;
   mv_selection_keyboard = 1;
   mv_selection = MapVote_MoveDown(mv_selection);
   return true;
  case K_UPARROW:
   if (mv_winner)
    return true;
   mv_selection_keyboard = 1;
   mv_selection = MapVote_MoveUp(mv_selection);
   return true;
  case K_KP_ENTER:
  case K_ENTER:
  case K_SPACE:
   if (mv_winner)
    return true;
   if ( mv_selection_keyboard )
    MapVote_SendChoice(mv_selection);
   return true;
  case '1': case K_KP_1: imp = 1; break;
  case '2': case K_KP_2: imp = 2; break;
  case '3': case K_KP_3: imp = 3; break;
  case '4': case K_KP_4: imp = 4; break;
  case '5': case K_KP_5: imp = 5; break;
  case '6': case K_KP_6: imp = 6; break;
  case '7': case K_KP_7: imp = 7; break;
  case '8': case K_KP_8: imp = 8; break;
  case '9': case K_KP_9: imp = 9; break;
  case '0': case K_KP_0: imp = 10; break;
 }

 if (imp && hudShiftState & S_CTRL)
 {
  if (!first_digit)
  {
   first_digit = imp % 10;
   return true;
  }
  else
   imp = first_digit * 10 + (imp % 10);
 }

 if (nPrimary == K_MOUSE1)
 {
  mv_selection_keyboard = 0;
  mv_selection = mv_mouse_selection;
  if (mv_selection >= 0)
   imp = min(mv_selection + 1, mv_num_maps);
 }

 if (nPrimary == K_MOUSE2)
  return true;

 if (imp)
 {
  if (!mv_winner && imp <= mv_num_maps)
   localcmd(strcat("\nimpulse ", ftos(imp), "\n"));
  return true;
 }

 return false;
}

void MapVote_UpdateMask()
{
 MapVote_ReadMask();
 mv_top2_time = time;
}

void MapVote_UpdateVotes()
{
 float i;
 for(i = 0; i < mv_num_maps; ++i)
 {
  if(mv_flags[i] & GTV_AVAILABLE)
  {
   if(mv_detail)
    mv_votes[i] = ReadByte();
   else
    mv_votes[i] = 0;
  }
  else
   mv_votes[i] = -1;
 }

 mv_ownvote = ReadByte()-1;
}

vector teamradar_3dcoord_to_texcoord(vector in)
{
 vector out;
 out.x = (in.x - mi_picmin.x) / (mi_picmax.x - mi_picmin.x);
 out.y = (in.y - mi_picmin.y) / (mi_picmax.y - mi_picmin.y);
 out.z = 0;
 return out;
}

vector teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(vector in)
{
 vector out;
 in -= teamradar_origin3d_in_texcoord;

 out = Rotate(in, teamradar_angle * DEG2RAD);
 out.y = - out.y;

 out = out * teamradar_size;
 if(v_flipped)
  out.x = -out.x;
 out += teamradar_origin2d;
 return out;
}


vector teamradar_2dcoord_to_texcoord(vector in)
{
 vector out;
 out = in;

 out -= teamradar_origin2d;
 if(v_flipped)
  out_x = -out_x;
 out = out / teamradar_size;

 out_y = - out_y;
 out = Rotate(out, -teamradar_angle * DEG2RAD);

 out += teamradar_origin3d_in_texcoord;

 return out;
}

vector teamradar_texcoord_to_3dcoord(vector in,float oz)
{
 vector out;
 out_x = in_x * (mi_picmax_x - mi_picmin_x) + mi_picmin_x;
 out_y = in_y * (mi_picmax_y - mi_picmin_y) + mi_picmin_y;
 out_z = oz;
 return out;
}

void draw_teamradar_background(float fg)
{
 float fga;
 vector fgc;

 if(fg > 0 && minimapname != "")
 {
  fga = 1;
  fgc = '1 1 1' * fg;
  R_BeginPolygon(minimapname, DRAWFLAG_SCREEN | DRAWFLAG_MIPMAP, true);
  if(v_flipped)
  {
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord3), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord3), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord2), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord2), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord1), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord1), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord0), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord0), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
  }
  else
  {
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord0), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord0), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord1), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord1), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord2), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord2), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
   R_PolygonVertex(teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(mi_pictexcoord3), (_yinvert = (mi_pictexcoord3), _yinvert.y = 1 - _yinvert.y, _yinvert), fgc, fga);
  }
  R_EndPolygon();
 }
}

void draw_teamradar_player_scaled(vector coord3d, vector pangles, vector rgb, float icon_scale)
{
 vector coord, rgb2;
 icon_scale = max(0.5, icon_scale);

 coord = teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(teamradar_3dcoord_to_texcoord(coord3d));

 vector forward, right, up;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./client/teamradar.qc", 96, __FUNC__, "\"pangles - '0 1 0' * teamradar_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(pangles - '0 1 0' * teamradar_angle); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 if(v_flipped)
 {
  forward.x = -forward.x;
  right.x = -right.x;
  up.x = -up.x;
 }
 forward.z = 0;
 forward = normalize(forward);
 forward.y *= -1.0;
 right.x = -forward.y;
 right.y = forward.x;

 if(rgb == '1 1 1')
  rgb2 = '0 0 0';
 else
  rgb2 = '1 1 1';

void draw_teamradar_icon(vector coord, entity icon, entity pingdata, vector rgb, float a)
{
 coord = teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(teamradar_3dcoord_to_texcoord(coord));
 drawpic_builtin(coord - '4 4 0', strcat("gfx/teamradar_icon_", ftos(icon.m_radaricon)), '8 8 0', rgb, a, 0);

 if(pingdata)
 {
  for(float i = 0; i < MAX_TEAMRADAR_TIMES; ++i)
  {
   float dt = pingdata.(teamradar_times[i]);
   if(dt == 0)
    continue;
   dt = time - dt;
   if(dt >= 1 || dt <= 0)
    continue;
   vector v = '2 2 0' * teamradar_size * dt;
   drawpic_builtin(coord - 0.5 * v, "gfx/teamradar_ping", v, '1 1 1', (1 - dt) * a, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
  }
 }
}

void draw_teamradar_link(vector start, vector end, float colors)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 vector c0, c1, norm;

 start = teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(teamradar_3dcoord_to_texcoord(start));
 end = teamradar_texcoord_to_2dcoord(teamradar_3dcoord_to_texcoord(end));
 norm = normalize(start - end);
 norm.z = norm.x;
 norm.x = -norm.y;
 norm.y = norm.z;
 norm.z = 0;

 c0 = colormapPaletteColor_(colors & 0x0F, false, time);
 c1 = colormapPaletteColor_((colors & 0xF0) / 0x10, false, time);

 R_BeginPolygon("", 0, true);
 R_PolygonVertex(start - norm, '0 0 0', c0, panel_fg_alpha);
 R_PolygonVertex(start + norm, '0 1 0', c0, panel_fg_alpha);
 R_PolygonVertex(end + norm, '1 1 0', c1, panel_fg_alpha);
 R_PolygonVertex(end - norm, '1 0 0', c1, panel_fg_alpha);
 R_EndPolygon();
}

   if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();

  screen_pos.z = 0;

   msg = argv(k);
   msg_pos = screen_pos + k * 1.25 * size * eY;
   if (align > 0)
    msg_pos.x -= stringwidth(msg, true, size * '1 1 0') * min(1, align);

   drawcolorcodedstring_builtin(msg_pos, msg, size * '1 1 0', alpha_, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
 }

 {
  vector forward, right, up;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./client/view.qc", 129, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  vel.x = view.velocity * forward;
  vel.y = view.velocity * right * -1;
  vel.z = view.velocity * up;
 }

 vel.x = bound(vel_average.x - autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit, vel.x, vel_average.x + autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit);
 vel.y = bound(vel_average.y - autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit, vel.y, vel_average.y + autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit);
 vel.z = bound(vel_average.z - autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit, vel.z, vel_average.z + autocvar_cl_followmodel_limit);

 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_followmodel_velocity_lowpass)));
 if(1){ gunorg.x = vel_average.x = vel_average.x * (1 - frac) + (vel.x) * frac;; gunorg.y = vel_average.y = vel_average.y * (1 - frac) + (vel.y) * frac;; gunorg.z = vel_average.z = vel_average.z * (1 - frac) + (vel.z) * frac;; }else voidfunc();

 gunorg *= -autocvar_cl_followmodel_speed * 0.042;



 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_followmodel_highpass)));
 if(1){ if(1){ float __f = 0; __f = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.x = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.x * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.x) * frac;; gunorg.x = (gunorg.x) - __f; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ float __f = 0; __f = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.y = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.y * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.y) * frac;; gunorg.y = (gunorg.y) - __f; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ float __f = 0; __f = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.z = gunorg_adjustment_highpass.z * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.z) * frac;; gunorg.z = (gunorg.z) - __f; }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_followmodel_lowpass)));
 if(1){ gunorg.x = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.x = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.x * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.x) * frac;; gunorg.y = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.y = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.y * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.y) * frac;; gunorg.z = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.z = gunorg_adjustment_lowpass.z * (1 - frac) + (gunorg.z) * frac;; }else voidfunc();

 if (autocvar_cl_followmodel_velocity_absolute)
 {
  vector fixed_gunorg;
  vector forward, right, up;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./client/view.qc", 155, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  fixed_gunorg.x = gunorg * forward;
  fixed_gunorg.y = gunorg * right * -1;
  fixed_gunorg.z = gunorg * up;
  gunorg = fixed_gunorg;
 }

 cl_followmodel_ofs = gunorg;
 cl_followmodel_time = time;
}

vector leanmodel_ofs(entity view)
{
 float frac;
 vector gunangles = '0 0 0';
 static vector gunangles_prev = '0 0 0';
 static vector gunangles_highpass = '0 0 0';
 static vector gunangles_adjustment_highpass;
 static vector gunangles_adjustment_lowpass;

 if (view.csqcmodel_teleported)
  gunangles_prev = view_angles;


 gunangles_highpass += gunangles_prev;
 ((gunangles_highpass).x) += 360 * floor((((view_angles).x) - ((gunangles_highpass).x)) / 360 + 0.5);
 ((gunangles_highpass).y) += 360 * floor((((view_angles).y) - ((gunangles_highpass).y)) / 360 + 0.5);
 ((gunangles_highpass).z) += 360 * floor((((view_angles).z) - ((gunangles_highpass).z)) / 360 + 0.5);
 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_leanmodel_highpass1)));
 if(1){ if(1){ float __f = 0; if(1){ float __ignore; __ignore = gunangles_highpass.x = gunangles_highpass.x * (1 - frac) + (view_angles.x) * frac;; __f = gunangles_highpass.x = bound((view_angles.x) - (autocvar_cl_leanmodel_limit), gunangles_highpass.x, (view_angles.x) + (autocvar_cl_leanmodel_limit)); }else voidfunc(); gunangles.x = (view_angles.x) - __f; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ float __f = 0; if(1){ float __ignore; __ignore = gunangles_highpass.y = gunangles_highpass.y * (1 - frac) + (view_angles.y) * frac;; __f = gunangles_highpass.y = bound((view_angles.y) - (autocvar_cl_leanmodel_limit), gunangles_highpass.y, (view_angles.y) + (autocvar_cl_leanmodel_limit)); }else voidfunc(); gunangles.y = (view_angles.y) - __f; }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 gunangles_prev = view_angles;
 gunangles_highpass -= gunangles_prev;

 ((gunangles).x) *= -autocvar_cl_leanmodel_speed;
 ((gunangles).y) *= -autocvar_cl_leanmodel_speed;


 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_leanmodel_highpass)));
 if(1){ if(1){ float __f = 0; __f = gunangles_adjustment_highpass.x = gunangles_adjustment_highpass.x * (1 - frac) + (gunangles.x) * frac;; gunangles.x = (gunangles.x) - __f; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ float __f = 0; __f = gunangles_adjustment_highpass.y = gunangles_adjustment_highpass.y * (1 - frac) + (gunangles.y) * frac;; gunangles.y = (gunangles.y) - __f; }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 frac = (1 - exp(-frametime / max(0.001, autocvar_cl_leanmodel_lowpass)));
 if(1){ gunangles.x = gunangles_adjustment_lowpass.x = gunangles_adjustment_lowpass.x * (1 - frac) + (gunangles.x) * frac;; gunangles.y = gunangles_adjustment_lowpass.y = gunangles_adjustment_lowpass.y * (1 - frac) + (gunangles.y) * frac;; }else voidfunc();

 gunangles.x = -gunangles.x;

 return gunangles;
}

vector bobmodel_ofs(entity view)
{
 float clonground = !(view.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR);
 static float oldonground;
 static float hitgroundtime;
 if (clonground)
 {
  float f = time;
  if (!oldonground)
   hitgroundtime = f;
 }
 oldonground = clonground;



 vector gunorg = '0 0 0';
 static float bobmodel_scale = 0;
 static float time_ofs = 0;
 if (clonground)
 {
  if (time - hitgroundtime > 0.05)
   bobmodel_scale = min(1, bobmodel_scale + frametime * 5);
 }
 else
  bobmodel_scale = max(0, bobmodel_scale - frametime * 5);

 float xyspeed = bound(0, vlen((_vec2 = (view.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)), 400);
 if (bobmodel_scale && xyspeed)
 {
  float bspeed = xyspeed * 0.01 * autocvar_cl_viewmodel_scale * bobmodel_scale;
  float s = (time - time_ofs) * autocvar_cl_bobmodel_speed;
  gunorg.y = bspeed * autocvar_cl_bobmodel_side * sin(s);
  gunorg.z = bspeed * autocvar_cl_bobmodel_up * cos(s * 2);
 }
 else
  time_ofs = time;

 return gunorg;
}

void viewmodel_animate(entity this)
{
 if (autocvar_chase_active || (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0) return;

 entity view = CSQCModel_server2csqc(player_localentnum - 1);

 if (autocvar_cl_followmodel)
 {
  calc_followmodel_ofs(view);
  this.origin += cl_followmodel_ofs;
 }

 if (autocvar_cl_leanmodel)
  this.angles += leanmodel_ofs(view);
# 268 "./client/view.qc"
 if (autocvar_cl_bobmodel)
  this.origin += bobmodel_ofs(view);
}

.float weapon_nextthink;
.float weapon_eta_last;
.float weapon_switchdelay;

.string name_last;

void viewmodel_draw(entity this)
{
 float mask = (intermission || ((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0) || autocvar_chase_active) ? 0 : MASK_NORMAL;
 float a = ((autocvar_cl_viewmodel_alpha) ? bound(-1, autocvar_cl_viewmodel_alpha, this.m_alpha) : this.m_alpha);
 float wepskin = this.m_skin;
 float invehicle = player_localentnum > maxclients;
 if (invehicle) a = -1;
 Weapon wep = this.activeweapon;
 float c = entcs_GetClientColors(current_player);
 vector g = weaponentity_glowmod(wep, c, this);
 entity me = CSQCModel_server2csqc(player_localentnum - 1);
 float fx = ((me.csqcmodel_effects & (EF_ADDITIVE | EF_DOUBLESIDED | EF_FULLBRIGHT | EF_NODEPTHTEST | EF_NODRAW | EF_NOSHADOW | EF_SELECTABLE | EF_TELEPORT_BIT))
  | EF_NODEPTHTEST)
  &~ (EF_FULLBRIGHT);
 for (entity e = this; e; e = e.weaponchild)
 {
  e.drawmask = mask;
  e.alpha = a;
  e.skin = wepskin;
  e.colormap = 256 + c;
  e.glowmod = g;
  e.csqcmodel_effects = fx;
  CSQCModel_Effects_Apply(e);
 }
 if(a >= 0)
 {
  string name = wep.mdl;
  string newname = wep.wr_viewmodel(wep, this);
  if(newname)
   name = newname;
  float swap = name != this.name_last;

  {
   this.name_last = name;
   CL_WeaponEntity_SetModel(this, name, swap);
   this.origin += autocvar_cl_gunoffset;
  }
  anim_update(this);
  if ((!this.animstate_override && !this.animstate_looping) || time > this.animstate_endtime)
   anim_set(this, this.anim_idle, true, false, false);
 }
 float f = 0;
 float rate = (0, g_stat_WEAPONRATEFACTOR);
 float eta = rate ? ((this.weapon_nextthink - time) / rate) : 0;
 if (eta <= 0) f = this.weapon_eta_last;
 else switch (this.state)
 {
  case WS_RAISE:
  {
   f = eta / max(eta, this.weapon_switchdelay);
   break;
  }
  case WS_DROP:
  {
   f = 1 - eta / max(eta, this.weapon_switchdelay);
   break;
  }
  case WS_CLEAR:
  {
   f = 1;
   break;
  }
 }
 this.weapon_eta_last = f;
 this.angles_x = (-90 * f * f);
 viewmodel_animate(this);
 __Mutator_Send_DrawViewModel(0 , this);
 setorigin(this, this.origin);
}

float showfps_prevfps_time;
float showfps_framecounter;

void fpscounter_update()
{
 if(!(0, g_stat_SHOWFPS))
  return;

 float currentTime = gettime(GETTIME_FRAMESTART);

 showfps_framecounter += 1;
 if(currentTime - showfps_prevfps_time > (0, g_stat_SHOWFPS))
 {
  float fps = showfps_framecounter / (currentTime - showfps_prevfps_time);
  showfps_framecounter = 0;
  showfps_prevfps_time = currentTime;

  float channel = MSG_C2S;
  WriteByte(channel, NET_fpsreport.m_id);
  WriteShort(channel, bound(0, rint(fps), 32767));
 }
}

{
 float currentTime = gettime(GETTIME_FRAMESTART);
 showfps_prevfps_time = currentTime;
}

float avgspeed;
vector GetCurrentFov(float fov)
{
 float zoomsensitivity, zoomspeed, zoomfactor, zoomdir;
 float velocityzoom, curspeed;
 vector v;

 zoomsensitivity = autocvar_cl_zoomsensitivity;
 zoomfactor = autocvar_cl_zoomfactor;
 if(zoomfactor < 1 || zoomfactor > 30)
  zoomfactor = 2.5;
 zoomspeed = autocvar_cl_zoomspeed;
 if (zoomspeed >= 0 && (zoomspeed < 0.5 || zoomspeed > 16))
  zoomspeed = 3.5;

 zoomdir = button_zoom;

 if(hud == HUD_NORMAL && !spectatee_status)
 {
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];
   if(wepent.switchweapon != wepent.activeweapon)
    continue;
   Weapon wep = wepent.activeweapon;
   if(wep != WEP_Null && wep.wr_zoomdir)
   {
    float do_zoom = wep.wr_zoomdir(wep);
    zoomdir += do_zoom;
   }
  }
 }
 if(spectatee_status > 0 || isdemo())
 {
  if(spectatorbutton_zoom)
  {
   if(zoomdir)
    zoomdir = 0;
   else
    zoomdir = 1;
  }

 }

 if(zoomdir) { zoomin_effect = 0; }

 if (spectatee_status > 0 && (0, g_stat_CAMERA_SPECTATOR) == 2)
 {
  current_viewzoom = 1;
 }
 else if (camera_active)
 {
  current_viewzoom = min(1, current_viewzoom + drawframetime);
 }
 else if(autocvar_cl_spawnzoom && zoomin_effect)
 {
  float spawnzoomfactor = bound(1, autocvar_cl_spawnzoom_factor, 30);

  current_viewzoom += (autocvar_cl_spawnzoom_speed * (spawnzoomfactor - current_viewzoom) * drawframetime);
  current_viewzoom = bound(1 / spawnzoomfactor, current_viewzoom, 1);
  if(current_viewzoom == 1) { zoomin_effect = 0; }
 }
 else
 {
  if(zoomspeed < 0)
  {
   if(zoomdir)
    current_viewzoom = 1 / zoomfactor;
   else
    current_viewzoom = 1;
  }
  else
  {
   if(zoomdir)
    current_viewzoom = 1 / bound(1, 1 / current_viewzoom + drawframetime * zoomspeed * (zoomfactor - 1), zoomfactor);
   else
    current_viewzoom = bound(1 / zoomfactor, current_viewzoom + drawframetime * zoomspeed * (1 - 1 / zoomfactor), 1);
  }
 }

 if(almost_equals(current_viewzoom, 1))
  current_zoomfraction = 0;
 else if(almost_equals(current_viewzoom, 1/zoomfactor))
  current_zoomfraction = 1;
 else
  current_zoomfraction = (current_viewzoom - 1) / (1/zoomfactor - 1);

 if(zoomsensitivity < 1)
  setsensitivityscale(current_viewzoom ** (1 - zoomsensitivity));
 else
  setsensitivityscale(1);

 if(autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_enabled && autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_type && !autocvar_cl_lockview)
 {
  if (intermission || (spectatee_status > 0 && (0, g_stat_CAMERA_SPECTATOR) == 2))
   curspeed = 0;
  else
  {
   vector forward, right, up;
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./client/view.qc", 503, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   v = pmove_vel;
   if(csqcplayer)
    v = csqcplayer.velocity;

   switch(autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_type)
   {
    case 3: curspeed = max(0, forward * v); break;
    case 2: curspeed = (forward * v); break;
    case 1: default: curspeed = vlen(v); break;
   }
  }

  velocityzoom = bound(0, drawframetime / max(0.000000001, autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_time), 1);
  avgspeed = avgspeed * (1 - velocityzoom) + (curspeed / autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_speed) * velocityzoom;
  velocityzoom = exp(float2range11(avgspeed * -autocvar_cl_velocityzoom_factor / 1) * 1);


 }
 else
  velocityzoom = 1;

 float frustumx, frustumy, fovx, fovy;
 frustumy = tan(fov * 3.14159265358979323846 / 360.0) * 0.75 * current_viewzoom * velocityzoom;
 frustumx = frustumy * vid_width / vid_height / vid_pixelheight;
 fovx = atan2(frustumx, 1) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;
 fovy = atan2(frustumy, 1) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;

 return '1 0 0' * fovx + '0 1 0' * fovy;
}

vector GetViewLocationFOV(float fov)
{
 float frustumy = tan(fov * 3.14159265358979323846 / 360.0) * 0.75;
 float frustumx = frustumy * vid_width / vid_height / vid_pixelheight;
 float fovx = atan2(frustumx, 1) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;
 float fovy = atan2(frustumy, 1) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;
 return '1 0 0' * fovx + '0 1 0' * fovy;
}

vector GetOrthoviewFOV(vector ov_worldmin, vector ov_worldmax, vector ov_mid, vector ov_org)
{
 float fovx, fovy;
 float width = (ov_worldmax.x - ov_worldmin.x);
 float height = (ov_worldmax.y - ov_worldmin.y);
 float distance_to_middle_of_world = vlen(ov_mid - ov_org);
 fovx = atan2(width/2, distance_to_middle_of_world) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;
 fovy = atan2(height/2, distance_to_middle_of_world) / 3.14159265358979323846 * 360.0;
 return '1 0 0' * fovx + '0 1 0' * fovy;
}

float eventchase_current_distance;
float eventchase_running;
float WantEventchase(entity this, float want_vehiclechase)
{
 if(autocvar_cl_orthoview)
  return 0;
 if((0, g_stat_GAME_STOPPED) || intermission)
  return 1;
 if(this.viewloc)
  return 1;
 if(spectatee_status >= 0)
 {
  if(want_vehiclechase)
   return 1;
  if(__Mutator_Send_WantEventchase(0 , this))
   return 1;
  if(autocvar_cl_eventchase_frozen && (0, g_stat_FROZEN))
   return 1;
  if(autocvar_cl_eventchase_death && ((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0))
  {
   if(autocvar_cl_eventchase_death == 2)
   {

    if(this.velocity == '0 0 0' || eventchase_running)
     return 1;
   }
   else return 1;
  }
  if (spectatee_status > 0 && autocvar_cl_eventchase_spectated_change)
  {
   if (time <= spectatee_status_changed_time + min(3, autocvar_cl_eventchase_spectated_change_time))
    return 1;
   else if (eventchase_running)
    return -1;
  }
 }
 return 0;
}

void View_EventChase(entity this)
{

 if(autocvar_chase_active <= 0)
 {
  if((0, g_stat_CAMERA_SPECTATOR))
  {
   if(spectatee_status > 0)
   {
    if(!autocvar_chase_active)
    {
     cvar_set("chase_active", "-2");
     return;
    }
   }
   else if(autocvar_chase_active == -2)
    cvar_set("chase_active", "0");

   if(autocvar_chase_active == -2)
    return;
  }
  else if(autocvar_chase_active == -2)
   cvar_set("chase_active", "0");

  float vehicle_chase = (hud != HUD_NORMAL && (autocvar_cl_eventchase_vehicle || spectatee_status > 0));

  float vehicle_viewdist = 0;
  vector vehicle_viewofs = '0 0 0';

  if(vehicle_chase)
  {
   if(hud != HUD_BUMBLEBEE_GUN)
   {
    Vehicle info = Vehicles_from(hud);
    vehicle_viewdist = info.height;
    vehicle_viewofs = info.view_ofs;
    if(vehicle_viewdist < 0)
     vehicle_chase = false;
   }
   else
    vehicle_chase = false;
  }

  float eventchase = WantEventchase(this, vehicle_chase);
  if (eventchase)
  {
   vector current_view_origin_override = '0 0 0';
   vector view_offset_override = '0 0 0';
   float chase_distance_override = 0;
   float custom_eventchase = __Mutator_Send_CustomizeEventchase(0 , this);
   if(custom_eventchase)
   {
    current_view_origin_override = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_vector;
    view_offset_override = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_vector;
    chase_distance_override = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_float;
   }
   eventchase_running = true;


   vector current_view_origin = (csqcplayer ? csqcplayer.origin : pmove_org);
   if (custom_eventchase)
    current_view_origin = current_view_origin_override;


   vector view_offset = autocvar_cl_eventchase_viewoffset;
   if(vehicle_chase)
   {
    if(vehicle_viewofs)
     view_offset = vehicle_viewofs;
    else
     view_offset = autocvar_cl_eventchase_vehicle_viewoffset;
   }
   if (custom_eventchase)
    view_offset = view_offset_override;

   if(view_offset)
   {
    WarpZone_TraceLine(current_view_origin, current_view_origin + view_offset + ('0 0 1' * autocvar_cl_eventchase_maxs.z), MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1) { current_view_origin += view_offset; }
    else { current_view_origin.z += max(0, (trace_endpos.z - current_view_origin.z) - autocvar_cl_eventchase_maxs.z); }
   }




   if(!autocvar_chase_active) { cvar_set("chase_active", "-1"); }


   float chase_distance = autocvar_cl_eventchase_distance;
   if(vehicle_chase)
   {
    if(vehicle_viewofs)
     chase_distance = vehicle_viewdist;
    else
     chase_distance = autocvar_cl_eventchase_vehicle_distance;
   }
   if (custom_eventchase)
    chase_distance = chase_distance_override;

   if(autocvar_cl_eventchase_speed && eventchase_current_distance < chase_distance)
    eventchase_current_distance += autocvar_cl_eventchase_speed * (chase_distance - eventchase_current_distance) * frametime;
   else if(eventchase_current_distance != chase_distance)
    eventchase_current_distance = chase_distance;

   vector forward, right, up;
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./client/view.qc", 721, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();

   vector eventchase_target_origin = (current_view_origin - (forward * eventchase_current_distance));
   WarpZone_TraceBox(current_view_origin, autocvar_cl_eventchase_mins, autocvar_cl_eventchase_maxs, eventchase_target_origin, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);


   if(!this.viewloc)
   if(trace_startsolid)
   {
    eventchase_target_origin = (current_view_origin - (forward * eventchase_current_distance));
    WarpZone_TraceLine(current_view_origin, eventchase_target_origin, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, (trace_endpos - (forward * autocvar_cl_eventchase_mins.z)));
   }
   else { setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, trace_endpos); }

   if(!this.viewloc)
    setproperty(VF_ANGLES, WarpZone_TransformVAngles(WarpZone_trace_transform, view_angles));
  }

  if (eventchase <= 0 && autocvar_chase_active < 0)
  {
   eventchase_running = false;
   cvar_set("chase_active", "0");
   eventchase_current_distance = 0;
  }
 }


 else if(intermission)
 {
  cvar_settemp("chase_active", "-1");
  eventchase_current_distance = 0;
 }
}

vector damage_blurpostprocess, content_blurpostprocess;

void UpdateDamage()
{

 static float damage_total_prev = 0;
 float damage_total = (0, g_stat_HITSOUND_DAMAGE_DEALT_TOTAL);
 float unaccounted_damage_new = (damage_total < damage_total_prev ? damage_total_prev + damage_total + 2 : damage_total - damage_total_prev);
 damage_total_prev = damage_total;

 static float damage_dealt_time_prev = 0;
 float damage_dealt_time = (0, g_stat_HIT_TIME);
 if (damage_dealt_time != damage_dealt_time_prev)
 {
  unaccounted_damage += unaccounted_damage_new;

 }
 damage_dealt_time_prev = damage_dealt_time;


 static float spectatee_status_prev = 0;
 if (spectatee_status != spectatee_status_prev)
  unaccounted_damage = 0;
 spectatee_status_prev = spectatee_status;
}

void HitSound()
{


 float have_arc = false;
 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];

  if(wepent.activeweapon == WEP_ARC)
   have_arc = true;
 }

 static float hitsound_time_prev = 0;

 float arc_hack = have_arc && autocvar_cl_hitsound >= 2;
 if (arc_hack || (time < hitsound_time_prev ? hitsound_time_prev + time + 2 : time - hitsound_time_prev) > autocvar_cl_hitsound_antispam_time)
 {
  if (autocvar_cl_hitsound && unaccounted_damage)
  {
   float pitch_shift = 1;
   if (autocvar_cl_hitsound == 2 || autocvar_cl_hitsound == 3)
   {

    float a = autocvar_cl_hitsound_max_pitch;
    float b = autocvar_cl_hitsound_min_pitch;
    float c = autocvar_cl_hitsound_nom_damage;
    float d = unaccounted_damage;
    pitch_shift = (b*d*(a-1) + a*c*(1-b)) / (d*(a-1) + c*(1-b));


    if (autocvar_cl_hitsound == 3)
    {
     float mirror_value = (a-b)/2 + b;
     pitch_shift = mirror_value + (mirror_value - pitch_shift);
    }
   }






   sound7((0, world), CH_INFO, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_HIT), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NONE, pitch_shift * 100, 0);
  }
  unaccounted_damage = 0;
  hitsound_time_prev = time;
 }

 static float typehit_time_prev = 0;
 float typehit_time = (0, g_stat_TYPEHIT_TIME);
 if ((typehit_time < typehit_time_prev ? typehit_time_prev + typehit_time + 2 : typehit_time - typehit_time_prev) > autocvar_cl_hitsound_antispam_time)
 {
  sound7((0, world), CH_INFO, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_TYPEHIT), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NONE, 0, 0);
  typehit_time_prev = typehit_time;
 }

 static float kill_time_prev = 0;
 float kill_time = (0, g_stat_KILL_TIME);
 if ((kill_time < kill_time_prev ? kill_time_prev + kill_time + 2 : kill_time - kill_time_prev) > autocvar_cl_hitsound_antispam_time)
 {
  sound7((0, world), CH_INFO, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_KILL), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NONE, 0, 0);
  kill_time_prev = kill_time;
 }
}

{




 if(!gametype)
  return;

 Hud_Dynamic_Frame();

 if(!intermission)
 {
  if (__Mutator_Send_HUD_Draw_overlay(0 ))

  }
  else if((0, g_stat_FROZEN))

  {
   vector col = '0.25 0.90 1' + (_vec3.x = ((0, g_stat_NADE_TIMER)), _vec3.y = (-(0, g_stat_NADE_TIMER)), _vec3.z = (-(0, g_stat_NADE_TIMER)), _vec3);
   DrawCircleClippedPic((_vec2_x = (0.5 * vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.6 * vid_conheight), _vec2), 0.1 * vid_conheight, "gfx/crosshair_ring", (0, g_stat_NADE_TIMER), col, autocvar_hud_colorflash_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
   drawstring_aspect(eY * 0.64 * vid_conheight, ((autocvar_cl_nade_timer == 2) ? _("Nade timer") : ""), (_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.025 * vid_conheight), _vec2), '1 1 1', 1, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
  else if((0, g_stat_CAPTURE_PROGRESS))
  {
   DrawCircleClippedPic((_vec2_x = (0.5 * vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.6 * vid_conheight), _vec2), 0.1 * vid_conheight, "gfx/crosshair_ring", (0, g_stat_CAPTURE_PROGRESS), '0.25 0.90 1', autocvar_hud_colorflash_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
   drawstring_aspect(eY * 0.64 * vid_conheight, _("Capture progress"), (_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.025 * vid_conheight), _vec2), '1 1 1', 1, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
  else if((0, g_stat_REVIVE_PROGRESS))
  {
   DrawCircleClippedPic((_vec2_x = (0.5 * vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.6 * vid_conheight), _vec2), 0.1 * vid_conheight, "gfx/crosshair_ring", (0, g_stat_REVIVE_PROGRESS), '0.25 0.90 1', autocvar_hud_colorflash_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
   drawstring_aspect(eY * 0.64 * vid_conheight, _("Revival progress"), (_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (0.025 * vid_conheight), _vec2), '1 1 1', 1, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
 }
 HUD_Scale_Disable();

 if(autocvar_r_letterbox == 0)
 {
  if(autocvar_viewsize < 120)
  {
   if(!__Mutator_Send_DrawScoreboardAccuracy(0 ))
    Accuracy_LoadLevels();

   HUD_Main();
   HUD_Scale_Disable();
  }
 }


 UpdateDamage();
 HUD_Crosshair(this);
 HitSound();
 Local_Notification_Queue_Process();
}

void HUD_Cursor_Show()
{
 float cursor_alpha = 1 - autocvar__menu_alpha;
 if(cursor_type == CURSOR_NORMAL)
  draw_cursor_normal(mousepos, '1 1 1', cursor_alpha);
 else if(cursor_type == CURSOR_MOVE)
  draw_cursor(mousepos, '0.5 0.5 0', "/cursor_move", '1 1 1', cursor_alpha);
 else if(cursor_type == CURSOR_RESIZE)
  draw_cursor(mousepos, '0.5 0.5 0', "/cursor_resize", '1 1 1', cursor_alpha);
 else if(cursor_type == CURSOR_RESIZE2)
  draw_cursor(mousepos, '0.5 0.5 0', "/cursor_resize2", '1 1 1', cursor_alpha);
}

void HUD_Mouse(entity player)
{
 if(autocvar__menu_alpha == 1)
  return;

 if(!cursor_active)
 {
  if(player.viewloc && (player.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEAIM))
   ViewLocation_Mouse();
  return;
 }

 if (cursor_active == -1)
 {



  cursor_active = 1;
  return;
 }

 if(!autocvar_hud_cursormode)
  update_mousepos();

 cursor_type = CURSOR_NORMAL;
 if(autocvar__hud_configure)
  HUD_Panel_Mouse();
 else
 {
  if (HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened())
   HUD_Minigame_Mouse();
  if (QuickMenu_IsOpened())
   QuickMenu_Mouse();
  if (HUD_Radar_Clickable())
   HUD_Radar_Mouse();
 }

 prevMouseClicked = mouseClicked;

 HUD_Cursor_Show();
}

void View_NightVision()
{
 if(!(autocvar_r_fakelight >= 2 || autocvar_r_fullbright) || (serverflags & SERVERFLAG_ALLOW_FULLBRIGHT))
  return;


 vector tc_00, tc_01, tc_10, tc_11;
 vector rgb = '0 0 0';
 float a;

 if(!nightvision_noise)
 {
  nightvision_noise = __spawn("nightvision_noise", "./client/view.qc" ":" "998", false);
 }
 if(!nightvision_noise2)
 {
  nightvision_noise2 = __spawn("nightvision_noise2", "./client/view.qc" ":" "1002", false);
 }


 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift('0 0 0'), HUD_Scale(autocvar_vid_conwidth * '1 0 0' + autocvar_vid_conheight * '0 1 0'), '0.5 1 0.3', 1, DRAWFLAG_MODULATE);


 a = Noise_Pink(nightvision_noise, frametime * 1.5) * 0.05 + 0.15;
 rgb = '1 1 1';
 tc_00 = '0 0 0' + '0.2 0 0' * sin(time * 0.3) + '0 0.3 0' * cos(time * 0.7);
 tc_01 = '0 2.25 0' + '0.6 0 0' * cos(time * 1.2) - '0 0.3 0' * sin(time * 2.2);
 tc_10 = '1.5 0 0' - '0.2 0 0' * sin(time * 0.5) + '0 0.5 0' * cos(time * 1.7);

 tc_11 = tc_01 + tc_10 - tc_00;
 R_BeginPolygon("gfx/nightvision-bg", DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE, true);
 R_PolygonVertex('0 0 0', tc_00, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conwidth * '1 0 0', tc_10, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conwidth * '1 0 0' + autocvar_vid_conheight * '0 1 0', tc_11, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conheight * '0 1 0', tc_01, rgb, a);
 R_EndPolygon();


 a = Noise_Pink(nightvision_noise2, frametime * 0.1) * 0.05 + 0.12;
 rgb = '0.3 0.6 0.4' + '0.1 0.4 0.2' * Noise_White(nightvision_noise2, frametime);
 tc_00 = '0 0 0' + '1 0 0' * Noise_White(nightvision_noise2, frametime) + '0 1 0' * Noise_White(nightvision_noise2, frametime);
 tc_01 = tc_00 + '0 3 0' * (1 + Noise_White(nightvision_noise2, frametime) * 0.2);
 tc_10 = tc_00 + '2 0 0' * (1 + Noise_White(nightvision_noise2, frametime) * 0.3);
 tc_11 = tc_01 + tc_10 - tc_00;
 R_BeginPolygon("gfx/nightvision-fg", DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE, true);
 R_PolygonVertex('0 0 0', tc_00, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conwidth * '1 0 0', tc_10, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conwidth * '1 0 0' + autocvar_vid_conheight * '0 1 0', tc_11, rgb, a);
 R_PolygonVertex(autocvar_vid_conheight * '0 1 0', tc_01, rgb, a);
 R_EndPolygon();
}



void HUD_Contents()
{
 if(!autocvar_hud_contents || __Mutator_Send_HUD_Contents(0 ))
  return;


 float contentalpha_temp, incontent, liquidalpha, contentfadetime;
 vector liquidcolor;

 switch(pointcontents(view_origin))
 {
  case CONTENT_WATER:
   liquidalpha = autocvar_hud_contents_water_alpha;
   liquidcolor = stov(autocvar_hud_contents_water_color);
   incontent = 1;
   break;

  case CONTENT_LAVA:
   liquidalpha = autocvar_hud_contents_lava_alpha;
   liquidcolor = stov(autocvar_hud_contents_lava_color);
   incontent = 1;
   break;

  case CONTENT_SLIME:
   liquidalpha = autocvar_hud_contents_slime_alpha;
   liquidcolor = stov(autocvar_hud_contents_slime_color);
   incontent = 1;
   break;

  default:
   liquidalpha = 0;
   liquidcolor = '0 0 0';
   incontent = 0;
   break;
 }

 if(incontent)
 {
  contentfadetime = autocvar_hud_contents_fadeintime;
  liquidalpha_prev = liquidalpha;
  liquidcolor_prev = liquidcolor;
 }
 else
  contentfadetime = autocvar_hud_contents_fadeouttime;

 contentalpha_temp = bound(0, drawframetime / max(0.0001, contentfadetime), 1);
 contentavgalpha = contentavgalpha * (1 - contentalpha_temp) + incontent * contentalpha_temp;

 if(contentavgalpha)
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift('0 0 0'), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (vid_conheight), _vec2)), liquidcolor_prev, contentavgalpha * liquidalpha_prev, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 if(autocvar_hud_postprocessing)
 {
  if(autocvar_hud_contents_blur && contentavgalpha)
  {
   content_blurpostprocess.x = 1;
   content_blurpostprocess.y = contentavgalpha * autocvar_hud_contents_blur;
   content_blurpostprocess.z = contentavgalpha * autocvar_hud_contents_blur_alpha;
  }
  else
  {
   content_blurpostprocess.x = 0;
   content_blurpostprocess.y = 0;
   content_blurpostprocess.z = 0;
  }
 }
}



void HUD_Damage()
{
 if(!autocvar_hud_damage || (0, g_stat_FROZEN))
  return;

 vector splash_pos = '0 0 0', splash_size = '0 0 0';
 splash_size.x = max(vid_conwidth, vid_conheight);
 splash_size.y = max(vid_conwidth, vid_conheight);
 splash_pos.x = (vid_conwidth - splash_size.x) / 2;
 splash_pos.y = (vid_conheight - splash_size.y) / 2;

 float myhealth_flash_temp;
 myhealth = (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH));


 myhealth_flash = max(0, myhealth_flash - autocvar_hud_damage_fade_rate * frametime);

 myhealth_flash = bound(0, myhealth_flash + dmg_take * autocvar_hud_damage_factor, autocvar_hud_damage_maxalpha);

 float pain_threshold, pain_threshold_lower, pain_threshold_lower_health;
 pain_threshold = autocvar_hud_damage_pain_threshold;
 pain_threshold_lower = autocvar_hud_damage_pain_threshold_lower;
 pain_threshold_lower_health = autocvar_hud_damage_pain_threshold_lower_health;

 if(pain_threshold_lower && myhealth < pain_threshold_lower_health)
 {
  pain_threshold = pain_threshold - max(autocvar_hud_damage_pain_threshold_pulsating_min, fabs(sin(3.14159265358979323846 * time / autocvar_hud_damage_pain_threshold_pulsating_period))) * pain_threshold_lower * (1 - max(0, myhealth)/pain_threshold_lower_health);
 }

 myhealth_flash_temp = bound(0, myhealth_flash - pain_threshold, 1);

 if(myhealth_prev < 1)
 {
  if(myhealth >= 1)
  {
   myhealth_flash = 0;
   myhealth_flash_temp = 0;
  }
  else
  {
   myhealth_flash += autocvar_hud_damage_fade_rate * frametime;
  }
 }

 if(spectatee_status == -1 || intermission)
 {
  myhealth_flash = 0;
  myhealth_flash_temp = 0;
 }

 myhealth_prev = myhealth;





 if(autocvar_cl_gentle_damage || autocvar_cl_gentle)
 {
  if(autocvar_cl_gentle_damage == 2)
  {
   if(myhealth_flash < pain_threshold)
    myhealth_gentlergb = randomvec();
  }
  else
   myhealth_gentlergb = stov(autocvar_hud_damage_gentle_color);

  if(myhealth_flash_temp > 0)
   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift('0 0 0'), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (vid_conheight), _vec2)), myhealth_gentlergb, autocvar_hud_damage_gentle_alpha_multiplier * bound(0, myhealth_flash_temp, 1) * autocvar_hud_damage, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }
 else if(myhealth_flash_temp > 0)
  drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(splash_pos), "gfx/blood", HUD_Scale(splash_size), stov(autocvar_hud_damage_color), bound(0, myhealth_flash_temp, 1) * autocvar_hud_damage, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 if(autocvar_hud_postprocessing)
 {
  if(autocvar_hud_damage_blur && myhealth_flash_temp)
  {
   damage_blurpostprocess.x = 1;
   damage_blurpostprocess.y = bound(0, myhealth_flash_temp, 1) * autocvar_hud_damage_blur;
   damage_blurpostprocess.z = bound(0, myhealth_flash_temp, 1) * autocvar_hud_damage_blur_alpha;
  }
  else
  {
   damage_blurpostprocess.x = 0;
   damage_blurpostprocess.y = 0;
   damage_blurpostprocess.z = 0;
  }
 }
}

void View_PostProcessing()
{
 float e1 = (autocvar_hud_postprocessing_maxbluralpha != 0);
 float e2 = (autocvar_hud_powerup != 0);
 if(autocvar_hud_postprocessing && (e1 || e2))
 {

  if(cvar("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec1_enable") != e1) { cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec1_enable", ftos(e1)); }
  if(cvar("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec2_enable") != e2) { cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec2_enable", ftos(e2)); }


  if((damage_blurpostprocess.x || content_blurpostprocess.x))
  {
   float blurradius = bound(0, damage_blurpostprocess.y + content_blurpostprocess.y, autocvar_hud_postprocessing_maxblurradius);
   float bluralpha = bound(0, damage_blurpostprocess.z + content_blurpostprocess.z, autocvar_hud_postprocessing_maxbluralpha);
   if(blurradius != old_blurradius || bluralpha != old_bluralpha)
   {
    cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec1", strcat(ftos(blurradius), " ", ftos(bluralpha), " 0 0"));
    old_blurradius = blurradius;
    old_bluralpha = bluralpha;
   }
  }
  else if(cvar_string("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec1") != "0 0 0 0")
  {
   cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec1", "0 0 0 0");
   old_blurradius = 0;
   old_bluralpha = 0;
  }


  float sharpen_intensity = 0;
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = StatusEffect_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.instanceOfPowerups) { { { float powerup_finished = StatusEffects_gettime(it, g_statuseffects) - time; if(powerup_finished > 0) sharpen_intensity += powerup_finished; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




    ;

  sharpen_intensity = bound(0, (((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) > 0) ? sharpen_intensity : 0), 5);

  if(autocvar_hud_powerup && sharpen_intensity > 0)
  {
   if(sharpen_intensity != old_sharpen_intensity)
   {
    cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec2", strcat(ftos((sharpen_intensity / 5) * autocvar_hud_powerup), " ", ftos(-sharpen_intensity * autocvar_hud_powerup), " 0 0"));
    old_sharpen_intensity = sharpen_intensity;
   }
  }
  else if(cvar_string("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec2") != "0 0 0 0")
  {
   cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess_uservec2", "0 0 0 0");
   old_sharpen_intensity = 0;
  }

  if(cvar("r_glsl_postprocess") == 0)
   cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess", "2");
 }
 else if(cvar("r_glsl_postprocess") == 2)
  cvar_set("r_glsl_postprocess", "0");
}

void View_Lock()
{
 float lock_type = autocvar_cl_lockview;

 if (!autocvar_hud_cursormode
  && ((autocvar__hud_configure && spectatee_status <= 0)
   || intermission > 1
   || HUD_Radar_Clickable()
   || HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened()
   || QuickMenu_IsOpened()
  )
 )
  lock_type = 1;



 if(lock_type >= 1)
  setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, freeze_org);
 else
  freeze_org = getpropertyvec(VF_ORIGIN);
 if(lock_type == 1)
  setproperty(VF_ANGLES, freeze_ang);
 else
  freeze_ang = getpropertyvec(VF_ANGLES);
}

{
 if(camera_active)
 {
  if(autocvar_camera_enable)
   CSQC_Demo_Camera();
  else
  {
   cvar_set("chase_active", ftos(chase_active_backup));
   cvar_set("cl_demo_mousegrab", "0");
   camera_active = false;
  }
 }
 else
 {



  if(autocvar_camera_enable && isdemo())

void View_CheckButtonStatus()
{

 if(isdemo())
 {

  button_zoom = (autocvar__togglezoom == "-");
 }
 else if(button_zoom
  && autocvar_cl_unpress_zoom_on_death
  && (spectatee_status >= 0)
  && (is_dead || intermission))
 {

  localcmd("-zoom\n");
  button_zoom = false;
 }

 if(autocvar_fov <= 59.5)
 {
  if(!zoomscript_caught)
  {
   localcmd("+button9\n");
   zoomscript_caught = 1;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  if(zoomscript_caught)
  {
   localcmd("-button9\n");
   zoomscript_caught = 0;
  }
 }

 if(active_minigame && HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened())
 {
  if(!minigame_wasactive)
  {
   localcmd("+button12\n");
   minigame_wasactive = true;
  }
 }
 else if(minigame_wasactive)
 {
  localcmd("-button12\n");
  minigame_wasactive = false;
 }

 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];

  if(wepent.last_switchweapon != wepent.switchweapon)
  {
   weapontime = time;
   wepent.last_switchweapon = wepent.switchweapon;
   if(slot == 0 && button_zoom && autocvar_cl_unpress_zoom_on_weapon_switch)
   {
    localcmd("-zoom\n");
    button_zoom = false;
   }
   if(slot == 0 && autocvar_cl_unpress_attack_on_weapon_switch)
   {
    localcmd("-fire\n");
    localcmd("-fire2\n");
    button_attack2 = false;
   }
  }
  if(wepent.last_activeweapon != wepent.activeweapon)
  {
   wepent.last_activeweapon = wepent.activeweapon;

   entity e = wepent.activeweapon;
   if(e.netname != "")
    localcmd(strcat("\ncl_hook_activeweapon ", e.netname), "\n");
   else if(slot == 0)
    localcmd("\ncl_hook_activeweapon none\n");
  }
 }
}

vector camera_offset, current_camera_offset, mouse_angles, current_angles, current_origin, current_position;
void CSQC_Demo_Camera()
{
 float speed, attenuation, dimensions;
 vector tmp;

 if( autocvar_camera_reset || !camera_mode )
 {
  camera_offset = '0 0 0';
  current_angles = '0 0 0';
  camera_direction = '0 0 0';
  camera_offset.z += 30;
  camera_offset.x += 30 * -cos(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD);
  camera_offset.y += 30 * -sin(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD);
  current_origin = view_origin;
  current_camera_offset = camera_offset;
  cvar_set("camera_reset", "0");
  camera_mode = CAMERA_CHASE;
 }


 if( camera_roll )
  mouse_angles.z += camera_roll * autocvar_camera_speed_roll;

 if(autocvar_camera_look_player)
 {
  vector dir;
  float n;

  dir = normalize(view_origin - current_position);
  n = mouse_angles.z;
  mouse_angles = vectoangles(dir);
  mouse_angles.x = mouse_angles.x * -1;
  mouse_angles.z = n;
 }
 else
 {
  tmp = getmousepos() * 0.1;
  if(((_vlen2 = (tmp), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_camera_mouse_threshold) ** 2)))
  {
   mouse_angles.x += tmp.y * cos(mouse_angles.z * DEG2RAD) + (tmp.x * sin(mouse_angles.z * DEG2RAD));
   mouse_angles.y -= tmp.x * cos(mouse_angles.z * DEG2RAD) + (tmp.y * -sin(mouse_angles.z * DEG2RAD));
  }
 }

 if(autocvar_camera_look_player)
  attenuation = autocvar_camera_look_attenuation;
 else
  attenuation = autocvar_camera_speed_attenuation;

 attenuation = 1 / max(1, attenuation);
 current_angles += (mouse_angles - current_angles) * attenuation;


 if (current_angles.x < -90) current_angles.x = -90;
 if (current_angles.x > 90 ) current_angles.x = 90;



 while (current_angles.y < -180 && mouse_angles.y < -180) {current_angles.y += 360; mouse_angles.y += 360;}
 while (current_angles.y > 180 && mouse_angles.y > 180 ) {current_angles.y -= 360; mouse_angles.y -= 360;}


 tmp = '0 0 0';
 dimensions = 0;

 if( camera_direction.x )
 {
  tmp.x = camera_direction.x * cos(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD);
  tmp.y = camera_direction.x * sin(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD);
  if( autocvar_camera_forward_follows && !autocvar_camera_look_player )
   tmp.z = camera_direction.x * -sin(current_angles.x * DEG2RAD);
  ++dimensions;
 }

 if( camera_direction.y )
 {
  tmp.x += camera_direction.y * -sin(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD);
  tmp.y += camera_direction.y * cos(current_angles.y * DEG2RAD) * cos(current_angles.z * DEG2RAD);
  tmp.z += camera_direction.y * sin(current_angles.z * DEG2RAD);
  ++dimensions;
 }

 if( camera_direction.z )
 {
  tmp.z += camera_direction.z * cos(current_angles.z * DEG2RAD);
  ++dimensions;
 }

 if(autocvar_camera_free)
  speed = autocvar_camera_speed_free;
 else
  speed = autocvar_camera_speed_chase;

 if(dimensions)
 {
  speed = speed * sqrt(1 / dimensions);
  camera_offset += tmp * speed;
 }

 current_camera_offset += (camera_offset - current_camera_offset) * attenuation;


 if( autocvar_camera_free )
 {
  if ( camera_mode == CAMERA_CHASE )
  {
   current_camera_offset = current_origin + current_camera_offset;
   camera_offset = current_origin + camera_offset;
  }

  camera_mode = CAMERA_FREE;
  current_position = current_camera_offset;
 }
 else
 {
  if ( camera_mode == CAMERA_FREE )
  {
   current_origin = view_origin;
   camera_offset = camera_offset - current_origin;
   current_camera_offset = current_camera_offset - current_origin;
  }

  camera_mode = CAMERA_CHASE;

  if(autocvar_camera_chase_smoothly)
   current_origin += (view_origin - current_origin) * attenuation;
  else
   current_origin = view_origin;

  current_position = current_origin + current_camera_offset;
 }

 setproperty(VF_ANGLES, current_angles);
 setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, current_position);
}

void LocalCommand_hud(float request, float argc)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if(__Mutator_Send_HUD_Command(0 , argc))
    return;

   switch (argv(1))
   {
    case "configure":
    {
     cvar_set("_hud_configure", ftos(!autocvar__hud_configure));
     return;
    }

    case "quickmenu":
    {
     if (argv(2) == "help")
     {
      if(1){ string __s = strcat1n(" quickmenu [[default | file | \"\"] <submenu> <filename>]"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
      if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Called without options (or with \"\") loads either the default quickmenu or a quickmenu file if hud_panel_quickmenu_file is set to a valid filename."); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
      if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("A submenu name can be given to open the quickmenu directly in a submenu; it requires to specify 'default', 'file' or '\"\"' option."); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
      if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("A file name can also be given to open a different quickmenu"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
      return;
     }
     string file = ((argv(4) == "") ? autocvar_hud_panel_quickmenu_file : argv(4));
     if (QuickMenu_IsOpened())
      QuickMenu_Close();
     else
      QuickMenu_Open(argv(2), argv(3), file);
     return;
    }

    case "save":
    {
     if (argv(2))
     {
      HUD_Panel_ExportCfg(argv(2));
      return;
     }
     else
     {
      break;
     }
    }

    case "scoreboard_columns_set":
    {
     Cmd_Scoreboard_SetFields(argc);
     return;
    }

    case "scoreboard_columns_help":
    {
     Cmd_Scoreboard_Help();
     return;
    }

    case "radar":
    {
     if (argv(2))
      HUD_Radar_Show_Maximized(InterpretBoolean(argv(2)), 0);
     else
      HUD_Radar_Show_Maximized(!hud_panel_radar_maximized, 0);
     return;
    }

    case "clickradar":
    {
     if(!isdemo())
      HUD_Radar_Show_Maximized(!hud_panel_radar_mouse, 1);
     return;
    }
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/command/cl_cmd.qc", "331")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 cl_cmd hud <action> [<configname> | <radartoggle> | <layout>]"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  Where <action> is the command to complete,"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  <configname> is the name to save to for 'save' action,"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  <radartoggle> is to maximize/minimize radar for 'radar' action,"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

void LocalCommand_sendcvar(float request, float argc)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (argv(1))
   {

    string thiscvar = nil; if(1){ if (thiscvar) { strunzone(thiscvar); } thiscvar = strzone(argv(1)); }else voidfunc();
    string s = cvar_string(thiscvar);

    if (thiscvar == "cl_weaponpriority")
     s = W_FixWeaponOrder(W_NumberWeaponOrder(s), 1);
    else if (substring(thiscvar, 0, 17) == "cl_weaponpriority" && strlen(thiscvar) == 18)
     s = W_FixWeaponOrder(W_NumberWeaponOrder(s), 0);

    localcmd("cmd sentcvar ", thiscvar, " \"", s, "\"\n");
    if(1){ if (thiscvar) { strunzone(thiscvar); } thiscvar = nil; }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/command/cl_cmd.qc", "420")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

void GameCommand(string command)
{
 float argc = tokenize_console(command);





 string s = strtolower(argv(0));
 if (s == "help")
 {
  if (argc == 1)
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Client console commands:"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   LocalCommand_macro_help();

   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("\nGeneric commands shared by all programs:"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   GenericCommand_macro_help();

   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("\nUsage:^3 cl_cmd <command>^7, where possible commands are listed above."); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("For help about a specific command, type cl_cmd help <command>"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

   return;
  }
  else if (GenericCommand_macro_usage(argc))
  {
   return;
  }
  else if (LocalCommand_macro_usage(argc))
  {
   return;
  }
 }

 if (GenericCommand(command)
     || LocalCommand_macro_command(argc, command)
     || __Mutator_Send__CSQC_ConsoleCommand(0 , s, argc, command)
    ) return;


 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/command/cl_cmd.qc", "545")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(((command != "") ? strcat("Unknown client command \"", command, "\"") : "No command provided"), ". For a list of supported commands, try cl_cmd help."); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
}

  { if ("+forward" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.x; } } return true; } } { if ("-forward" == s) { { { --camera_direction.x; } } return true; } } { if ("+back" == s) { { { --camera_direction.x; } } return true; } } { if ("-back" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.x; } } return true; } } { if ("+moveup" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.z; } } return true; } } { if ("-moveup" == s) { { { --camera_direction.z; } } return true; } } { if ("+movedown" == s) { { { --camera_direction.z; } } return true; } } { if ("-movedown" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.z; } } return true; } } { if ("+moveright" == s) { { { --camera_direction.y; } } return true; } } { if ("-moveright" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.y; } } return true; } } { if ("+moveleft" == s) { { { ++camera_direction.y; } } return true; } } { if ("-moveleft" == s) { { { --camera_direction.y; } } return true; } } { if ("+roll_right" == s) { { { ++camera_roll; } } return true; } } { if ("-roll_right" == s) { { { --camera_roll; } } return true; } } { if ("+roll_left" == s) { { { --camera_roll; } } return true; } } { if ("-roll_left" == s) { { { ++camera_roll; } } return true; } };

 }

 return false;
}

 ;
}

float EnemyHitCheck()
{
 float t, n;
 wcross_origin = project_3d_to_2d(trace_endpos);
 wcross_origin.z = 0;
 if(trace_ent)
  n = trace_ent.entnum;
 else
  n = trace_networkentity;
 if(n < 1)
  return SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD;
 if(n > maxclients)
  return SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD;
 t = entcs_GetTeam(n - 1);
 if(teamplay && t == myteam)
  return SHOTTYPE_HITTEAM;
 if(t == NUM_SPECTATOR)
  return SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD;
 return SHOTTYPE_HITENEMY;
}

float TrueAimCheck(entity wepent)
{
 if(wepent.activeweapon.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_NOTRUEAIM)
  return SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD;

 float nudge = 1;
 vector vecs, trueaimpoint, w_shotorg;
 vector mi, ma, dv;
 float shottype;
 entity ta;
 float mv;

 mi = ma = '0 0 0';
 ta = trueaim;
 mv = MOVE_NOMONSTERS;

 switch(wepent.activeweapon)
 {
  case WEP_VORTEX:
  case WEP_OVERKILL_NEX:
  case WEP_VAPORIZER:
   mv = MOVE_NORMAL;
   break;
  case WEP_RIFLE:
   ta = trueaim_rifle;
   mv = MOVE_NORMAL;
   if(zoomscript_caught)
   {
    tracebox(view_origin, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', view_origin + view_forward * max_shot_distance, mv, ta);
    return EnemyHitCheck();
   }
   break;
  case WEP_DEVASTATOR:
   mi = '-3 -3 -3';
   ma = '3 3 3';
   break;
  case WEP_FIREBALL:
   mi = '-16 -16 -16';
   ma = '16 16 16';
   break;
  case WEP_SEEKER:
   mi = '-2 -2 -2';
   ma = '2 2 2';
   break;
  case WEP_ELECTRO:
   mi = '0 0 -3';
   ma = '0 0 -3';
   break;
 }

 vector traceorigin = al_ftoe(al_stof(bufstr_get(_entcs.al_buf, player_localentnum - 1))).origin + (eZ * (0, getstati(STAT_VIEWHEIGHT)));

 vecs = decompressShotOrigin((0, g_stat_SHOTORG));

 traceline(traceorigin, traceorigin + view_forward * max_shot_distance, mv, ta);
 trueaimpoint = trace_endpos;


 trueaimpoint += view_forward;

 if(((_vlen2 = ((trueaimpoint - traceorigin)), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((g_trueaim_minrange) ** 2)))
  trueaimpoint = traceorigin + view_forward * g_trueaim_minrange;

 if(vecs.x > 0)
  vecs.y = -vecs.y;
 else
  vecs = '0 0 0';

 dv = view_right * vecs.y + view_up * vecs.z;
 w_shotorg = traceorigin + dv;


 tracebox(w_shotorg, mi, ma, w_shotorg + view_forward * (vecs.x + nudge), MOVE_NORMAL, ta);
 w_shotorg = trace_endpos - view_forward * nudge;

 tracebox(w_shotorg, mi, ma, trueaimpoint, MOVE_NORMAL, ta);
 shottype = EnemyHitCheck();
 if(shottype != SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD)
  return shottype;
# 161 "./client/hud/crosshair.qc"
 return SHOTTYPE_HITWORLD;
}

vector crosshair_getcolor(entity this, float health_stat)
{
 static float rainbow_last_flicker;
 static vector rainbow_prev_color;
 vector wcross_color = '0 0 0';
 switch(autocvar_crosshair_color_special)
 {
  case 1:
  {
   if(this != WEP_Null && hud == HUD_NORMAL)
   {
    wcross_color = this.wpcolor;
    break;
   }
   else { goto normalcolor; }
  }

  case 2:
  {
   vector v = healtharmor_maxdamage(health_stat, (0, getstati(STAT_ARMOR)), armorblockpercent, DEATH_WEAPON.m_id);
   float health_and_armor = floor(v.x + 1);
   wcross_color = HUD_Get_Num_Color(health_and_armor, 200, false);
   break;
  }

  case 3:
  {
   if(time >= rainbow_last_flicker)
   {
    rainbow_prev_color = randomvec() * autocvar_crosshair_color_special_rainbow_brightness;
    rainbow_last_flicker = time + autocvar_crosshair_color_special_rainbow_delay;
   }
   wcross_color = rainbow_prev_color;
   break;
  }
:normalcolor
  default: { wcross_color = stov(autocvar_crosshair_color); break; }
 }

 return wcross_color;
}

void DrawReticle(entity this)
{
 if(!autocvar_cl_reticle || __Mutator_Send_DrawReticle(0 ))
 {
  reticle_type = 0;
  return;
 }

 float is_dead = ((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0);
 string reticle_image = nil;
 float wep_zoomed = false;
 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  entity wepe = viewmodels[slot];
  Weapon wep = wepe.activeweapon;
  if(wep != WEP_Null && wep.wr_zoom)
  {
   float do_zoom = wep.wr_zoom(wep, (0, world));
   if(!reticle_image && wep.w_reticle && wep.w_reticle != "")
    reticle_image = wep.w_reticle;
   wep_zoomed += do_zoom;
  }
 }




 if(spectatee_status || is_dead || hud != HUD_NORMAL || this.viewloc)
 {

  reticle_type = 0;
 }
 else if(wep_zoomed && autocvar_cl_reticle_weapon)
 {
  if(reticle_image) { reticle_type = 2; }
  else { reticle_type = 0; }
 }
 else if(button_zoom || zoomscript_caught)
 {

  reticle_type = 1;
 }

 if(reticle_type)
 {
  vector reticle_pos = '0 0 0', reticle_size = '0 0 0';
  if(autocvar_cl_reticle_stretch)
  {
   reticle_size.x = vid_conwidth;
   reticle_size.y = vid_conheight;
   reticle_pos.x = 0;
   reticle_pos.y = 0;
  }
  else
  {
   reticle_size.x = max(vid_conwidth, vid_conheight);
   reticle_size.y = max(vid_conwidth, vid_conheight);
   reticle_pos.x = (vid_conwidth - reticle_size.x) / 2;
   reticle_pos.y = (vid_conheight - reticle_size.y) / 2;
  }

  float f = (zoomscript_caught) ? 1 : current_zoomfraction;

  if(f)
  {
   switch(reticle_type)
   {
    case 1: drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(reticle_pos), "gfx/reticle_normal", HUD_Scale(reticle_size), '1 1 1', f * autocvar_cl_reticle_normal_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); break;
    case 2: if(reticle_image) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(reticle_pos), reticle_image, HUD_Scale(reticle_size), '1 1 1', f * autocvar_cl_reticle_weapon_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); break;
   }
  }
 }
}
