void c4_hud_board(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 if ( mySize_x > mySize_y ) { pos_x += (mySize_x-mySize_y)/2; mySize_x = mySize_y; } else { pos_y += (mySize_y-mySize_x)/2; mySize_x = mySize_x; } if(panel_bg_padding) { pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding; mySize -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding; };
 c4_boardpos = pos;
 c4_boardsize = mySize;

 minigame_hud_simpleboard(pos,mySize,minigame_texture("c4/board_under"));

 drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos), minigame_texture("c4/board_over"), HUD_Scale(mySize), '1 1 1', 1, 0);

 vector tile_size = minigame_hud_denormalize_size('1 1 0' / C4_TILE_SIZE,pos,mySize);
 vector tile_pos;

 if ( (active_minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_TEAM) == minigame_self.team )
 if ( c4_valid_tile(c4_curr_pos) )
 {
  tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(c4_curr_pos,C4_NUM_CNT,C4_LET_CNT);
  tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);
  minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
    minigame_texture(strcat("c4/piece",ftos(minigame_self.team))),
    tile_size, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha/2, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
 }

 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(e.netname,C4_NUM_CNT,C4_LET_CNT);
   tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

   if ( active_minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_WIN )
   if ( !e.c4_checkwin )
    e.c4_checkwin = c4_winning_piece(e) ? 1 : -1;

   float icon_color = 1;
   if ( e.c4_checkwin == -1 )
    icon_color = 0.4;
   else if ( e.c4_checkwin == 1 )
   {
    icon_color = 2;
    minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos, minigame_texture("c4/winglow"),
      tile_size, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE );
   }

   minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
     minigame_texture(strcat("c4/piece",ftos(e.team))),
     tile_size, '1 1 1'*icon_color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
  }
 }

 if ( active_minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_WIN )
 {
  vector winfs = hud_fontsize*2;
  string pname = "";
  e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
   if ( e.classname == "minigame_player" &&
     e.team == (active_minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_TEAM) )
    pname = entcs_GetName(e.minigame_playerslot-1);

  vector win_pos = pos+eY*(mySize_y-winfs_y)/2;
  vector win_sz;
  win_sz = minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   sprintf(_("%s^7 won the game!"), pname),
   winfs, 0, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);

  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(win_pos-eY*hud_fontsize_y), HUD_Scale(win_sz+2*eY*hud_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);

  minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   sprintf(_("%s^7 won the game!"), pname),
   winfs, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);
 }
}

 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

                                                          ;

   mypos_x += tile_size_x;
  }

string c4_turn_to_string(float turnflags)
{
 if(minigame_self.team == C4_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
  return _("You are spectating");

 if ( turnflags & C4_TURN_DRAW )
  return _("Draw");

 if ( turnflags & C4_TURN_WIN )
 {
  if ( (turnflags&C4_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team )
   return _("You lost the game!");
  return _("You win!");
 }

 if ( (turnflags & C4_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team )
  return _("Wait for your opponent to make their move");

 if ( turnflags & C4_TURN_PLACE )
  return _("Click on the game board to place your piece");

 return "";
}


void c4_make_move(entity minigame)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags == (C4_TURN_PLACE|minigame_self.team) )
 {
  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"move ",c4_curr_pos);
 }
}

float c4_client_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "activate":
  {
   c4_set_curr_pos("");
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = strzone(c4_turn_to_string(minigame.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "deactivate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "key_pressed":
  case "key_released":
  {
   float event_blocked = ((event == "key_released")
    || ((minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team));
   if (!(minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_WIN) && !(minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_DRAW))
   {
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! c4_curr_pos )
       c4_set_curr_pos(c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, "a3"));
      else
       c4_set_curr_pos(c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, minigame_relative_tile(c4_curr_pos,1,0,C4_NUM_CNT,C4_LET_CNT)));
      return true;
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! c4_curr_pos )
       c4_set_curr_pos(c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, "c3"));
      else
       c4_set_curr_pos(c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, minigame_relative_tile(c4_curr_pos,-1,0,C4_NUM_CNT,C4_LET_CNT)));
      return true;
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
      return true;
# 485 "./common/minigames/minigame/c4.qc"
     case K_ENTER:
     case K_KP_ENTER:
     case K_SPACE:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      c4_make_move(minigame);
      return true;
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_pressed":
  {
   if(...(0,float) == K_MOUSE1)
   {
    c4_client_event(minigame, "mouse_moved");
    c4_make_move(minigame);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_moved":
  {
   vector mouse_pos = minigame_hud_normalize(mousepos,c4_boardpos,c4_boardsize);
   if ( minigame.minigame_flags == (C4_TURN_PLACE|minigame_self.team) )
   {
    c4_set_curr_pos(c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, minigame_tile_name(mouse_pos,C4_NUM_CNT,C4_LET_CNT)));
   }
   if ( ! c4_valid_tile(c4_curr_pos) )
    c4_set_curr_pos("");

   return true;
  }
  case "network_receive":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame" )
   {
    if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
    {
     if(1){ if (sent.message) { strunzone(sent.message); } sent.message = strzone(c4_turn_to_string(sent.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
     if ( sent.minigame_flags & minigame_self.team )
      minigame_prompt();
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float pong_team_to_angle(float nteam)
{
 switch(nteam)
 {
  default:
  case 1: return 0;
  case 2: return 3.14159265358979323846;
  case 3: return 3.14159265358979323846*3/2;
  case 4: return 3.14159265358979323846/2;
 }
}

vector pong_team_to_color(float nteam)
{
 switch(nteam)
 {
  case 1: return '1 0 0';
  case 2: return '0 0 1';
  case 3: return '1 1 0';
  case 4: return '1 0 1';
  default:return '1 1 1';
 }
}

 if(pong_keys_pressed != pong_keys_pressed_old)
  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,strcat("move ", ftos(pong_keys_pressed)));
 pong_keys_pressed_old = pong_keys_pressed;

string pong_message(float mgflags)
{
 string rmessage = "";
 if(minigame_self.team == PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
  rmessage = _("You are spectating");
 else if (mgflags & PONG_STATUS_WAIT)
  rmessage = _("Press ^1Start Match^7 to start the match with the current players");
 return rmessage;
}


float pong_client_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "activate":
   return false;
  case "deactivate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "key_pressed":
  case "key_released":
   if ((minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_PLAY) && minigame_self.team != PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event == "key_pressed")
      {

       pong_keys_pressed |= PONG_KEY_DECREASE;
      }
      else
      {

       pong_keys_pressed &= ~PONG_KEY_DECREASE;
      }
      return true;
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event == "key_pressed")
      {

       pong_keys_pressed |= PONG_KEY_INCREASE;
      }
      else
      {

       pong_keys_pressed &= ~PONG_KEY_INCREASE;
      }
      return true;
    }
   return false;
  case "network_receive":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame_player" && (sf & PONG_SF_PLAYERSCORE ) )
   {
    sent.pong_score = ReadLong();
   }
   else if ( sent.classname == "minigame" )
   {
    if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
    {
     if(1){ if (sent.message) { strunzone(sent.message); } sent.message = strzone(pong_message(sent.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
    }
   }
   return false;
  }
  case "menu_show":
  {
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Start Match"),"pong_throw");
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Add AI player"),"pong_aimore");
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Remove AI player"),"pong_ailess");
   return false;
  }
  case "menu_click":
  {
   string cmd = ...(0,string);
   if( cmd == "pong_throw" && minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_WAIT )
   {
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"throw");
   }
   else if ( cmd == "pong_aimore" || cmd == "pong_ailess" )
   {
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,cmd);
   }
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

const float PS_TURN_MOVE = 0x0100;
const float PS_TURN_WIN = 0x0200;
const float PS_TURN_DRAW = 0x0400;
const float PS_TURN_TYPE = 0x0f00;

const float PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;

const float PS_LET_CNT = 7;
const float PS_NUM_CNT = 7;

const float PS_TILE_SIZE = 8;


entity ps_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}

float ps_draw(entity minigame)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   return true;
  }

 return false;
}

float ps_tile_blacklisted(string tile)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 if(letter < 2)
 {
  if(number < 2)
   return true;
  else if(number > PS_NUM_CNT - 3)
   return true;
 }
 if(letter > PS_LET_CNT - 3)
 {
  if(number < 2)
   return true;
  else if(number > PS_NUM_CNT - 3)
   return true;
 }

 return false;
}


float ps_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return false;
 if(ps_tile_blacklisted(tile))
  return false;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < PS_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < PS_LET_CNT;
}


float ps_winning_piece(entity minigame)
{



 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   float number = minigame_tile_number(e.netname);
   float letter = minigame_tile_letter(e.netname);
   string try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter - 1, number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter - 2, number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter + 1, number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter + 2, number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number - 1);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number - 2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number + 1);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number + 2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
  }

 return true;
}

void ps_setup_pieces(entity minigame)
{
 float i, t;
 for(i = 0; i < PS_NUM_CNT; ++i)
 for(t = 0; t < PS_LET_CNT; ++t)
 {
  string try = minigame_tile_buildname(i,t);
  if(!ps_valid_tile(try))
   continue;
  if(i == floor(PS_NUM_CNT * 0.5) && t == floor(PS_LET_CNT * 0.5))
   continue;
  entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/ps.qc" ":" "128", false));
  piece.team = 1;
  piece.netname = strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(t,i));
  minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
 }

 minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
}

float ps_move_piece(entity minigame, entity piece, string pos, float leti, float numb)
{
 if(!piece)
  return false;
 if(ps_find_piece(minigame, pos))
  return false;
 entity middle = ps_find_piece(minigame, minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb));
 if(!middle)
  return false;

 if(1){ if (middle.netname) { strunzone(middle.netname); } middle.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ entity _this = (middle); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(middle); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();

 if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = strzone(pos); }else voidfunc();

 minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);

 return true;
}


void ps_move(entity minigame, entity player, string thepiece, string pos )
{
 if ( (minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_MOVE) )
 if ( pos )
 {
  if ( ps_valid_tile(pos) )
  if ( !ps_find_piece(minigame, pos) && ps_find_piece(minigame, thepiece) )
  {
   entity piece = ps_find_piece(minigame, thepiece);
   float number = minigame_tile_number(thepiece);
   float letter = minigame_tile_letter(thepiece);
   float done = false;
   string try;

   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-2,number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter - 1, number);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+2,number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter + 1, number);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter, number - 1);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter, number + 1);
   }

   if(!done)
    return;

   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);

   if ( ps_winning_piece(minigame) )
   {
    if(ps_draw(minigame))
     minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_DRAW;
    else
     minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_WIN;
   }
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_MOVE;
  }
 }
}

void ps_hud_board(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 if ( mySize_x > mySize_y ) { pos_x += (mySize_x-mySize_y)/2; mySize_x = mySize_y; } else { pos_y += (mySize_y-mySize_x)/2; mySize_x = mySize_x; } if(panel_bg_padding) { pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding; mySize -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding; };

 minigame_hud_simpleboard(pos,mySize,minigame_texture("ps/board"));

 vector tile_pos;

 float valid = ps_valid_tile(ps_curr_pos);
 float highlight = false;
 if(valid)
 {
  string try;
  float number = minigame_tile_number(ps_curr_pos);
  float letter = minigame_tile_letter(ps_curr_pos);
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-2,number);
   if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
    highlight = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+2,number);
   if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
    highlight = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-2);
   if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
    highlight = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+2);
   if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
    highlight = true;
  }
 }
 float draw_pos = false;
 if(ps_curr_piece && valid && !ps_find_piece(active_minigame, ps_curr_pos))
 {
  string try;
  float numb = minigame_tile_number(ps_curr_piece.netname);
  float leti = minigame_tile_letter(ps_curr_piece.netname);

  try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti-1,numb);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti-2,numb);
   if(try == ps_curr_pos)
    draw_pos = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti+1,numb);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti+2,numb);
   if(try == ps_curr_pos)
    draw_pos = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb-1);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb-2);
   if(try == ps_curr_pos)
    draw_pos = true;
  }
  try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb+1);
  if(ps_find_piece(active_minigame,try))
  {
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb+2);
   if(try == ps_curr_pos)
    draw_pos = true;
  }
 }

 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(e.netname,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT);
   tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

   vector tile_color = '1 1 1';

   if(highlight)
   if(e.netname == ps_curr_pos)
   if(ps_curr_piece.netname != ps_curr_pos)
   {
    minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
      minigame_texture("ps/tile_available"),
      tile_size, tile_color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
   }
   if(e == ps_curr_piece)
   {
    minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
      minigame_texture("ps/tile_selected"),
      tile_size, tile_color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE );
   }

   minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
     minigame_texture("ps/piece"),
     tile_size * 0.8, tile_color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
  }
 }

 if(draw_pos)
 {
  tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(ps_curr_pos,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT);
  tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

  minigame_drawpic_centered(tile_pos,
    minigame_texture("ps/piece"),
    tile_size * 0.8, '0.5 0.5 0.5', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }

 if ( ( active_minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_WIN ) || ( active_minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_DRAW ) )
 {
  float remaining = 0;
  e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
    ++remaining;

  vector winfs = hud_fontsize*2;
  string remaining_text;
  if(active_minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_WIN)
   remaining_text = _("All pieces cleared!");
  else
   remaining_text = strcat(_("Remaining pieces:"), " ", ftos(remaining));

  vector win_pos = pos+eY*(mySize_y-winfs_y)/2;
  vector win_sz;
  win_sz = minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   strcat(_("Game over!"), " ", remaining_text),
   winfs, 0, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);

  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(win_pos-eY*hud_fontsize_y), HUD_Scale(win_sz+2*eY*hud_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);

  minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   strcat(_("Game over!"), " ", remaining_text),
   winfs, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);
 }
}

{
 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

  hud_fontsize * 2, '0.25 0.47 0.72', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL,0.5);

 pos_y += ts_y;
 mySize_y -= ts_y;

 vector player_fontsize = hud_fontsize * 1.75;
 ts_y = ( mySize_y - 2*player_fontsize_y ) / 2;
 ts_x = mySize_x;
 vector mypos;
 vector tile_size = '48 48 0';

 if(minigame_self.team != PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
 {
  mypos = pos;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*player_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
  mypos_y += player_fontsize_y;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*tile_size_y), '1 1 1', 0.25, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
 }

 float remaining = 0;
 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
  {
   ++remaining;
  }
 }

 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_player" && e.team != PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM )
  {

   minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_trunc(mySize_x,mypos,
    entcs_GetName(e.minigame_playerslot-1),

   drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), sprintf(_("Pieces left: %s"), ftos(remaining)), '28 28 0', '0.7 0.84 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)
                                                      ;
  }
 }
}


string ps_turn_to_string(float turnflags)
{
 if(minigame_self.team == PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
  return _("You are spectating");

 if (turnflags & PS_TURN_DRAW )
  return _("No more valid moves");

 if ( turnflags & PS_TURN_WIN )
  return _("Well done, you win!");

 if ( turnflags & PS_TURN_MOVE )
  return _("Jump a piece over another to capture it");

 return "";
}


void ps_make_move(entity minigame)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags == PS_TURN_MOVE )
 {
  entity piece = ps_find_piece(minigame,ps_curr_pos);
  if(!ps_curr_piece || piece)
   ps_curr_piece = ps_find_piece(minigame,ps_curr_pos);
  else
  {
   minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"move ", ps_curr_piece.netname, " ", ps_curr_pos);
   ps_curr_piece = (0, world);
  }
 }
}

void ps_set_curr_pos(string s)
{
 if(1){ if (ps_curr_pos) { strunzone(ps_curr_pos); } ps_curr_pos = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if ( s )
  s = strzone(s);
 ps_curr_pos = s;
}


float ps_client_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "activate":
  {
   ps_set_curr_pos("");
   ps_curr_piece = (0, world);
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = strzone(ps_turn_to_string(minigame.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "deactivate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "key_pressed":
  case "key_released":
  {
   float event_blocked = (event == "key_released" || minigame_self.team == PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   if (!(minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_WIN) && !(minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_DRAW))
   {
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! ps_curr_pos )
       ps_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       ps_set_curr_pos( minigame_relative_tile(ps_curr_pos,1,0,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! ps_curr_pos )
       ps_set_curr_pos("c3");
      else
       ps_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(ps_curr_pos,-1,0,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! ps_curr_pos )
       ps_set_curr_pos("a1");
      else
       ps_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(ps_curr_pos,0,1,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! ps_curr_pos )
       ps_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       ps_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(ps_curr_pos,0,-1,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_ENTER:
     case K_KP_ENTER:
     case K_SPACE:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      ps_make_move(minigame);
      return true;
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_pressed":
  {
   if(...(0,float) == K_MOUSE1)
   {
    ps_client_event(minigame, "mouse_moved");
    ps_make_move(minigame);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_moved":
  {
   vector mouse_pos = minigame_hud_normalize(mousepos,ps_boardpos,ps_boardsize);
   if ( minigame.minigame_flags == PS_TURN_MOVE && minigame_self.team != PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM )
   {
    ps_set_curr_pos(minigame_tile_name(mouse_pos,PS_NUM_CNT,PS_LET_CNT));
   }
   if ( ! ps_valid_tile(ps_curr_pos) )
    ps_set_curr_pos("");

   return true;
  }
  case "network_receive":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame" )
   {
    if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
    {
     if(1){ if (sent.message) { strunzone(sent.message); } sent.message = strzone(ps_turn_to_string(sent.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();


    }
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

entity MINIGAME_pp; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_pp() { entity this = MINIGAME_pp; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_pp = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_pp"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_pp(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this); void pp_hud_board(vector, vector); void pp_hud_status(vector, vector); float pp_client_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("pp")); this.message = _("Push-Pull"); this.minigame_hud_board = pp_hud_board; this.minigame_hud_status = pp_hud_status; this.minigame_event = pp_client_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this);

const float PP_TURN_PLACE = 0x0100;
const float PP_TURN_WIN = 0x0200;
const float PP_TURN_DRAW = 0x0400;
const float PP_TURN_NEXT = 0x0800;
const float PP_TURN_TYPE = 0x0f00;

const float PP_TURN_TEAM1 = 0x0001;
const float PP_TURN_TEAM2 = 0x0002;
const float PP_TURN_TEAM = 0x000f;

const float PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;

const float PP_LET_CNT = 7;
const float PP_NUM_CNT = 7;

const float PP_TILE_SIZE = 7;

.float cnt;

.float pp_team1_score;
.float pp_team2_score;

.float pp_nexteam;

.entity pp_curr_piece;


entity pp_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float pp_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return 0;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < PP_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < PP_LET_CNT;
}


float pp_winning_piece(entity piece)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(piece.netname);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(piece.netname);


 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)).team == 5)
  return true;

 return false;
}

float pp_valid_move(entity minigame, string pos)
{
 if(!pp_valid_tile(pos))
  return false;
 if(pp_find_piece(minigame,pos).team == 5)
  return false;

 entity current = minigame.pp_curr_piece;
 if(!current)
  return true;

 float number = minigame_tile_number(pos);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(pos);

 if( (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)) == current)
 ) { return true; }

 return false;
}


void pp_move(entity minigame, entity player, string pos )
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_PLACE )
 if ( pos && player.team == (minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_TEAM) )
 {
  if ( pp_valid_move(minigame,pos))
  {
   entity existing = pp_find_piece(minigame,pos);

   if(existing && existing.team != 5)
   {
    if(existing.team == 1)
     minigame.pp_team1_score++;
    if(existing.team == 2)
     minigame.pp_team2_score++;
   }

   if(minigame.pp_curr_piece)
   {
    minigame.pp_curr_piece.cnt = 0;
    minigame.pp_curr_piece.team = 5;
    minigame_server_sendflags(minigame.pp_curr_piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   }

   if(existing)
   {
    if(1){ if (existing.netname) { strunzone(existing.netname); } existing.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (existing); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(existing); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }

   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "128", false));
   piece.cnt = 1;
   piece.team = player.team;
   piece.netname = strzone(pos);
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   minigame.pp_nexteam = minigame_next_team(player.team,2);
   minigame.pp_curr_piece = piece;
   if ( pp_winning_piece(piece) )
   {
    if(minigame.pp_team1_score == minigame.pp_team2_score)
     minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_DRAW;
    else
     minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_WIN | ((minigame.pp_team1_score > minigame.pp_team2_score) ? 1 : 2);
   }
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_PLACE | minigame.pp_nexteam;
  }
 }
}

void pp_setup_pieces(entity minigame)
{
 float i, t;
 for(i = 0; i < PP_LET_CNT; ++i)
 for(t = 0; t < PP_NUM_CNT; ++t)
 {
  float t2_true = ((i == 0 || i == 6) && t > 0 && t < 6);
  float t1_true = (i > 0 && i < 6 && (t == 0 || t == 6));

  if(t1_true || t2_true)
  {
   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "160", false));
   piece.team = ((t1_true) ? 1 : 2);
   piece.netname = strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(i,t));
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }

 minigame.pp_curr_piece = (0, world);
}


void pp_next_match(entity minigame, entity player)
{
# 184 "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc"
 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_PLACE | minigame.pp_nexteam;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  entity e = (0, world);
  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
   if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
  minigame.pp_team1_score = 0;
  minigame.pp_team2_score = 0;

  pp_setup_pieces(minigame);
 }
}

 if ( active_minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_WIN )
 {
  vector winfs = hud_fontsize*2;
  string pname = "";
  e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
   if ( e.classname == "minigame_player" &&
     e.team == (active_minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_TEAM) )
    pname = entcs_GetName(e.minigame_playerslot-1);

  vector win_pos = pos+eY*(mySize_y-winfs_y)/2;
  vector win_sz;
  win_sz = minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   sprintf(_("%s^7 won the game!"), pname),
   winfs, 0, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);

  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(win_pos-eY*hud_fontsize_y), HUD_Scale(win_sz+2*eY*hud_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);

  minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   sprintf(_("%s^7 won the game!"), pname),
   winfs, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);
 }
}



void pp_hud_status(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();
 vector ts;
 ts = minigame_drawstring_wrapped(mySize_x,pos,active_minigame.descriptor.message,
  hud_fontsize * 2, '0.25 0.47 0.72', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL,0.5);

 pos_y += ts_y;
 mySize_y -= ts_y;

 vector player_fontsize = hud_fontsize * 1.75;
 ts_y = ( mySize_y - 2*player_fontsize_y ) / 2;
 ts_x = mySize_x;
 vector mypos;
 vector tile_size = '48 48 0';

 if(minigame_self.team != PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
 {
  mypos = pos;
  if ( (active_minigame.minigame_flags&PP_TURN_TEAM) == 2 )
   mypos_y += player_fontsize_y + ts_y;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*player_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
  mypos_y += player_fontsize_y;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*tile_size_y), '1 1 1', 0.25, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
 }

 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_player" && e.team != PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM )
  {
   vector tile_color = '1 1 1';
   switch(e.team)
   {
    case 1: tile_color = '1 0.3 0.3'; break;
    case 2: tile_color = '0.3 0.3 1'; break;

   }

   mypos = pos;
   if ( e.team == 2 )
    mypos_y += player_fontsize_y + ts_y;
   minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_trunc(mySize_x,mypos,
    entcs_GetName(e.minigame_playerslot-1),
    player_fontsize, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

   mypos_y += player_fontsize_y;
   drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), minigame_texture(strcat("pp/piece",ftos(e.team))), HUD_Scale(tile_size), tile_color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)

                                                             ;

   mypos_x += tile_size_x;
   float myscore = 0;
   if(e.team == 1) { myscore = active_minigame.pp_team1_score; }
   if(e.team == 2) { myscore = active_minigame.pp_team2_score; }

   drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), ftos(myscore), tile_size, '0.7 0.84 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)
                                                      ;
  }
 }
}


string pp_turn_to_string(float turnflags)
{
 if(minigame_self.team == PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
  return _("You are spectating");

 if ( turnflags & PP_TURN_DRAW )
  return _("Draw");

 if ( turnflags & PP_TURN_WIN )
 {

  if ( (turnflags&PP_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team )
   return strcat(_("You lost the game!"), "\n", _("Select \"^1Next Match^7\" on the menu for a rematch!"));
  return strcat(_("You win!"), "\n", _("Select \"^1Next Match^7\" on the menu to start a new match!"));
 }

 if ( turnflags & PP_TURN_NEXT )
 {
  if ( (turnflags&PP_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team )
   return _("Select \"^1Next Match^7\" on the menu to start a new match!");
  return _("Wait for your opponent to confirm the rematch");
 }

 if ( (turnflags & PP_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team )
  return _("Wait for your opponent to make their move");

 if ( turnflags & PP_TURN_PLACE )
  return _("Click on the game board to place your piece");

 return "";
}


void pp_make_move(entity minigame)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags == (PP_TURN_PLACE|minigame_self.team) )
 {
  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"move ",pp_curr_pos);
 }
}

void pp_set_curr_pos(string s)
{
 if(1){ if (pp_curr_pos) { strunzone(pp_curr_pos); } pp_curr_pos = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if ( s )
  s = strzone(s);
 pp_curr_pos = s;
}


float pp_client_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "activate":
  {
   pp_set_curr_pos("");
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = strzone(pp_turn_to_string(minigame.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "deactivate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "key_pressed":
  case "key_released":
  {
   float event_blocked = ((event == "key_released")
    || ((minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_TEAM) != minigame_self.team));
   if (!(minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_WIN) && !(minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_DRAW))
   {
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! pp_curr_pos )
       pp_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       pp_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(pp_curr_pos,1,0,PP_LET_CNT,PP_NUM_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! pp_curr_pos )
       pp_set_curr_pos("c3");
      else
       pp_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(pp_curr_pos,-1,0,PP_LET_CNT,PP_NUM_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! pp_curr_pos )
       pp_set_curr_pos("a1");
      else
       pp_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(pp_curr_pos,0,1,PP_LET_CNT,PP_NUM_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! pp_curr_pos )
       pp_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       pp_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(pp_curr_pos,0,-1,PP_LET_CNT,PP_NUM_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_ENTER:
     case K_KP_ENTER:
     case K_SPACE:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      pp_make_move(minigame);
      return true;
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_pressed":
  {
   if(...(0,float) == K_MOUSE1)
   {
    pp_client_event(minigame, "mouse_moved");
    pp_make_move(minigame);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_moved":
  {
   vector mouse_pos = minigame_hud_normalize(mousepos,pp_boardpos,pp_boardsize);
   if ( minigame.minigame_flags == (PP_TURN_PLACE|minigame_self.team) )
    pp_set_curr_pos(minigame_tile_name(mouse_pos,PP_LET_CNT,PP_NUM_CNT));
   if ( ! pp_valid_tile(pp_curr_pos) )
    pp_set_curr_pos("");

   return true;
  }
  case "network_receive":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame" )
   {
    if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
    {
     if(1){ if (sent.message) { strunzone(sent.message); } sent.message = strzone(pp_turn_to_string(sent.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
     if ( sent.minigame_flags & minigame_self.team )
      minigame_prompt();
     sent.pp_team1_score = ReadByte();
     sent.pp_team2_score = ReadByte();
    }
   }
   else if(sent.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    sent.cnt = ReadByte();
    if(sent.cnt)
     minigame.pp_curr_piece = sent;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "menu_show":
  {
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Next Match"),"next");
   return false;
  }
  case "menu_click":
  {
   if(...(0,string) == "next")
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"next");
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

const float BD_TURN_TYPE = 0x0f00;

const float BD_SF_UPDATE_ALL = MINIG_SF_CUSTOM<<2;

entity bd_find_piece(entity minig, string tile, float check_target)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile && ((check_target) ? e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET : e.bd_tiletype != BD_TILE_TARGET) )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}

entity bd_find_controller(entity minig, float letter)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "bd_controller" && e.bd_tilelet == letter )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float bd_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return false;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < BD_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < BD_LET_CNT;
}

void bd_controller_update(entity controller, float number)
{



 minigame_server_sendflags(controller,BD_SF_UPDATE_SINGLE);
}

entity bd_find_dozer(entity minig)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}
# 149 "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc"
void minigame_read_owner(entity this);

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_BD_CONTROLLER(entity this, entity sender, float isNew)
{
 this.classname = "bd_controller";
 return = true;

 float sf = ReadByte();
 this.bd_tilelet = ReadByte();
 minigame_read_owner(this);

 if(sf & BD_SF_UPDATE_SINGLE)
 {
  float number = ReadByte();
  this.bd_tiletypes[number] = ReadByte();
  this.bd_dirs[number] = ReadByte();
 }

 if(sf & BD_SF_UPDATE_ALL)
 {
  for(float j = 0; j < BD_NUM_CNT; ++j)
  {
   this.bd_tiletypes[j] = ReadByte();
   this.bd_dirs[j] = ReadByte();
  }
 }
}


void bd_check_winner(entity minig)
{
 float total = 0, valid = 0;
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET )
  {
   ++total;
   if(bd_find_piece(minig, e.netname, false).bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_BOULDER)
    ++valid;
  }

 if(valid >= total)
 {
  minig.minigame_flags = BD_TURN_WIN;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minig,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
 }
}

vector bd_get_dir(float bdir)
{
 switch(bdir)
 {
  case BD_DIR_UP: return '0 1 0';
  default:
  case BD_DIR_DN: return '0 -1 0';
  case BD_DIR_LF: return '-1 0 0';
  case BD_DIR_RT: return '1 0 0';
 }
}

string bd_get_dir_name(float bdir)
{
 switch(bdir)
 {
  case BD_DIR_UP: return "u";
  default:
  case BD_DIR_DN: return "d";
  case BD_DIR_LF: return "l";
  case BD_DIR_RT: return "r";
 }
}

float bd_dir_fromname(string bdir)
{
 if(bdir == "up" || bdir == "u")
  return BD_DIR_UP;
 if(bdir == "down" || bdir == "dn" || bdir == "d")
  return BD_DIR_DN;
 if(bdir == "left" || bdir == "lt" || bdir == "l")
  return BD_DIR_LF;
 if(bdir == "right" || bdir == "rt" || bdir == "r")
  return BD_DIR_RT;

 return BD_DIR_DN;
}

float bd_canfill(float ttype)
{
 switch(ttype)
 {
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return true;
 }

 return false;
}

float bd_move_dozer(entity minigame, entity dozer)
{



 float myx = minigame_tile_letter(dozer.netname);
 float myy = minigame_tile_number(dozer.netname);

 vector dir = bd_get_dir(dozer.bd_dir);

 myx += dir.x;
 myy += dir.y;

 string newpos = minigame_tile_buildname(myx, myy);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(newpos))
  return false;

 entity hit = bd_find_piece(minigame, newpos, false);

 if(hit)
 switch(hit.bd_tiletype)
 {
  case BD_TILE_DOZER:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
  case BD_TILE_BOULDER:
  {
   string testpos;
   float tx = minigame_tile_letter(hit.netname);
   float ty = minigame_tile_number(hit.netname);

   tx += dir.x;
   ty += dir.y;

   testpos = minigame_tile_buildname(tx, ty);
   if(!bd_valid_tile(testpos))
    return false;
   entity testhit = bd_find_piece(minigame, testpos, false);
   if(testhit)
    return false;

   entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, minigame_tile_letter(testpos));
   float tnum = minigame_tile_number(testpos);
   switch(controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum])
   {
    case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
   }

   if(1){ if (hit.netname) { strunzone(hit.netname); } hit.netname = strzone(testpos); }else voidfunc();
   minigame_server_sendflags(hit,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   break;
  }
 }

 entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, minigame_tile_letter(newpos));
 float number = minigame_tile_number(newpos);
 switch(controller.bd_tiletypes[number])
 {
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
 }

 if(1){ if (dozer.netname) { strunzone(dozer.netname); } dozer.netname = strzone(newpos); }else voidfunc();

 return true;
}


void bd_move(entity minigame, entity player, string dir)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_MOVE )
 if ( dir )
 {


  {
   entity dozer = bd_find_dozer(minigame);
   if(!dozer)
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "350")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Dozer wasn't found!"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }

   string thedir = strtolower(dir);
   float bdir = bd_dir_fromname(thedir);

   float moved = 0;
   entity e = (0, world);
   while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
    if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER )
    {
     e.bd_dir = bdir;

     if(bd_move_dozer(minigame, e))
      ++moved;

     minigame_server_sendflags(e,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    }

   if(moved)
    player.bd_moves++;

   bd_check_winner(minigame);

   minigame_server_sendflags(player,BD_SF_PLAYERMOVES);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }
}


void bd_editor_place(entity minigame, entity player, string pos, float thetile, string thedir)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT )
 if ( pos && thetile )
 {
  if ( bd_valid_tile(pos) )
  {
   entity found_piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);
   entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);

   if(found_piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER && thedir != "")
   {
    string newdir = strtolower(thedir);
    float bdir = bd_dir_fromname(newdir);

    found_piece.bd_dir = bdir;
    minigame_server_sendflags(found_piece,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    return;
   }





   float tlet = minigame_tile_letter(pos);
   float tnum = minigame_tile_number(pos);
   entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, tlet);
   if(controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum])
   {
    controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum] = 0;
    controller.bd_dirs[tnum] = 0;
    bd_controller_update(controller, tnum);
    return;
   }

   if(found_piece || (targ && thetile != BD_TILE_BOULDER))
   {
    entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);
    if(!piece) piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);
    if(!piece)
     return;

    if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (piece); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(piece); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
    minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    return;
   }

   if(bd_canfill(thetile))
   {
    float number = minigame_tile_number(pos);
    float letter = minigame_tile_letter(pos);
    entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, letter);
    controller.bd_tiletypes[number] = thetile;
    controller.bd_dirs[number] = 0;
    bd_controller_update(controller, number);
   }
   else
   {
    entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc" ":" "441", false));
    piece.team = 1;
    piece.netname = strzone(pos);
    piece.bd_tiletype = thetile;
    piece.bd_dir = 0;
    minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   }

   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }
}

void bd_fill_recurse(entity minigame, entity player, float thetype, float letter, float number)
{
 string pos = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(pos))
  return;
 if(bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false) || bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true))
  return;

 bd_editor_place(minigame, player, pos, thetype, "");

 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter - 1, number);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter + 1, number);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number - 1);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number + 1);
}

void bd_unfill_recurse(entity minigame, entity player, float thetype, float letter, float number)
{
 string pos = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(pos))
  return;

 entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);
 entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);

 if(targ && thetype == targ.bd_tiletype)
 {
  if(1){ if (targ.netname) { strunzone(targ.netname); } targ.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
  if(1){ entity _this = (targ); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(targ); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(piece && thetype == piece.bd_tiletype)
 {
  if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
  if(1){ entity _this = (piece); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(piece); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else return;

 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter - 1, number);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter + 1, number);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number - 1);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number + 1);
}

void bd_do_fill(entity minigame, entity player, string dir, string thetile)
{
# 516 "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc"
 if(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
 {
  float thetype = stof(thetile);

  entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, dir, true);
  entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, dir, false);

  if(!bd_canfill(thetype) || (piece || targ))
  {
   float killtype = 0;

   if(targ) { killtype = targ.bd_tiletype; }
   if(piece) { killtype = piece.bd_tiletype; }

   if(killtype)
   {
    float letter = minigame_tile_letter(dir);
    float number = minigame_tile_number(dir);
    bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, killtype, letter, number);
   }

   return;
  }

  float letter = minigame_tile_letter(dir);
  float number = minigame_tile_number(dir);

  bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number);
 }
}

string bd_save_controller_piece(entity minigame, entity e, float number)
{

float bd_fix_dir(vector dir)
{
 if(dir.x == 0 && dir.y == 1) { return BD_DIR_UP; }
 if(dir.x == 0 && dir.y == -1) { return BD_DIR_DN; }
 if(dir.x == -1 && dir.y == 0) { return BD_DIR_LF; }
 if(dir.x == 1 && dir.y == 0) { return BD_DIR_RT; }

 return BD_DIR_DN;
}

void bd_load_piece(entity minigame, string s)
{

 string bd_string = s;

 tokenize_console(bd_string);

 float argv_num = 0;
 string tilename = strzone(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;
 float tiletype = stof(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;
 float dir = stof(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;

 if(bd_canfill(tiletype))
 {
  float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tilename);
  float number = minigame_tile_number(tilename);
  entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, letter);
  controller.bd_tiletypes[number] = tiletype;
  controller.bd_dirs[number] = dir;

  bd_controller_update(controller, number);
 }
 else
 {
  entity e = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc" ":" "715", false));
  e.netname = tilename;
  e.team = 1;
  e.bd_dir = dir;
  e.bd_tiletype = tiletype;
  minigame_server_sendflags(e,MINIG_SF_ALL);
 }
}

float bd_save_level(entity minigame)
{
 if(minigame.bd_levelname && minigame.bd_levelname != "")
 {
  float target_count = 0, boulder_count = 0;
  entity piece = (0, world);
  while((piece = findentity(piece,owner,minigame)))
   if(piece.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_BOULDER)
     ++boulder_count;
    else if(piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET)
     ++target_count;
   }

  if(boulder_count != target_count)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "741")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Not enough targets or boulders, fix your level!"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }


  string file_name;
  float file_get;

  file_name = strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_levelname, ".txt");
  file_get = fopen(file_name, FILE_WRITE);
  fputs(file_get, strcat("// bulldozer storage \"", minigame.bd_levelname, "\" last updated ", strftime(true, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S"), "\n"));

  if(minigame.bd_nextlevel && minigame.bd_nextlevel != "" && fexists(strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_nextlevel, ".txt")))
   fputs(file_get, strcat("nextlevel = \"", minigame.bd_nextlevel, "\"\n"));

  entity e = (0, world);
  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "bd_controller" )
  {
   for(float j = 0; j < BD_NUM_CNT; ++j)
   {

    fputs(file_get, strcat(bd_save_controller_piece(minigame, e, j), "\n"));
   }
  }
  e = (0, world);

  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {

   fputs(file_get, strcat(bd_save_piece(minigame, e), "\n"));
  }
  fclose(file_get);

  return true;
 }

 return false;
}

void bd_load_level(entity minigame)
{

 string file_read, file_name;
 float file_get;

 file_name = strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_levelname, ".txt");
 file_get = fopen(file_name, FILE_READ);
 if(file_get < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "792")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("^3BULLDOZER: ^7could not find storage file ^3", file_name, "^7, no items were loaded"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  for(;;)
  {
   file_read = fgets(file_get);
   if(file_read == "")
    break;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 2) == "//")
    continue;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 1) == "#")
    continue;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 9) == "nextlevel")
   {
    bd_set_nextlevel(minigame, file_read);
    continue;
   }

   bd_load_piece(minigame, file_read);
  }
 }
 fclose(file_get);
}

void bd_hud_board(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 if ( mySize_x > mySize_y ) { pos_x += (mySize_x-mySize_y)/2; mySize_x = mySize_y; } else { pos_y += (mySize_y-mySize_x)/2; mySize_x = mySize_x; } if(panel_bg_padding) { pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding; mySize -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding; };
 bd_boardpos = pos;
 bd_boardsize = mySize;

 minigame_hud_simpleboard(pos,mySize,minigame_texture("bd/board"));

 vector tile_size = minigame_hud_denormalize_size('1 1 0' / BD_TILE_SIZE,pos,mySize);
 vector tile_pos;

 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
  {
   if(e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET)
   {
    e.bd_enemy = (0, world);
    e.bd_enemy = bd_find_piece(active_minigame, e.netname, false);
   }
   else if(e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_BOULDER)
   {
    e.bd_hide = false;
    e.bd_hide = ((bd_find_piece(active_minigame, e.netname, true)) != (0, world));
   }
  }
 }
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "bd_controller" )
  {
   for(float j = 0; j < BD_NUM_CNT; ++j)
   {
    if(!e.bd_tiletypes[j]) continue;

    float letter = e.bd_tilelet;
    string mypos = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, j);

    tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(mypos,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT);
    tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

    string thepiece = bd_get_tile_pic(e.bd_tiletypes[j]);

    minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
      minigame_texture(thepiece),
      tile_size, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
   }
  }
  else if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   if(e.bd_tiletype != BD_TILE_DOZER && !e.bd_hide)
   {
    tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(e.netname,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT);
    tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

    string thepiece = bd_get_tile_pic(e.bd_tiletype);

    if(e.bd_enemy)
     thepiece = "bd/boulder_target";

    minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
      minigame_texture(thepiece),
      tile_size, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
   }
  }
 }


 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER )
  {
   tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(e.netname,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT);
   tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);

   float bdir = e.bd_dir;
   float theang = 0;

   switch(bdir)
   {
    case BD_DIR_UP: theang = 0; break;
    default:
    case BD_DIR_DN: theang = 3.14159265358979323846; break;
    case BD_DIR_LF: theang = 3.14159265358979323846 * 3 / 2; break;
    case BD_DIR_RT: theang = 3.14159265358979323846 / 2; break;
   }

   drawrotpic(tile_pos, theang, minigame_texture("bd/dozer"),
      tile_size, tile_size/2, '1 1 1',
      panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
  }
 }

 if(active_minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
 if(bd_valid_tile(bd_curr_pos))
 {
  entity piece = bd_find_piece(active_minigame, bd_curr_pos, false);
  entity targ = bd_find_piece(active_minigame, bd_curr_pos, true);
  string thepiece = ((piece || (targ && bd_curr_tile != BD_TILE_BOULDER)) ? "bd/delete" : bd_get_tile_pic(bd_curr_tile));

  tile_pos = minigame_tile_pos(bd_curr_pos,BD_LET_CNT,BD_NUM_CNT);
  tile_pos = minigame_hud_denormalize(tile_pos,pos,mySize);
  if(bd_curr_tile == BD_TILE_DOZER)
  {
   drawrotpic(tile_pos, 3.14159265358979323846, minigame_texture("bd/dozer"),
      tile_size, tile_size/2, '1 1 1',
      panel_fg_alpha/2, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
  }
  else
  {
   minigame_drawpic_centered( tile_pos,
     minigame_texture(thepiece),
     tile_size, '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha/2, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL );
  }
 }

 if ( (active_minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_LOSS) || (active_minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_WIN) )
 {
  vector winfs = hud_fontsize*2;
  string victory_text = _("Game over!");

  if(active_minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_WIN)
   victory_text = _("Well done! Click 'Next Level' to continue");

  vector win_pos = pos+eY*(mySize_y-winfs_y)/2;
  vector win_sz;
  win_sz = minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   victory_text, winfs, 0, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);

  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(win_pos-eY*hud_fontsize_y), HUD_Scale(win_sz+2*eY*hud_fontsize_y), '0.3 0.3 1', 0.8, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);

  minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_wrapped(mySize_x,win_pos,
   victory_text, winfs, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, 0.5);
 }
}



void bd_hud_status(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

  hud_fontsize * 2, '0.25 0.47 0.72', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL,0.5);

 pos_y += ts_y;
 mySize_y -= ts_y;

 vector player_fontsize = hud_fontsize * 1.75;
 ts_y = ( mySize_y - 2*player_fontsize_y ) / BD_TEAMS;
 ts_x = mySize_x;
 vector mypos;
 vector tile_size = '48 48 0';

 if(minigame_self.team != BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
 {
  mypos = pos;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*player_fontsize_y), '1 1 1', 0.5, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
  mypos_y += player_fontsize_y;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), HUD_Scale(eX*mySize_x+eY*tile_size_y), '1 1 1', 0.25, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
 }

 entity e;
 e=(0, world); while( (e = findentity(e,owner,active_minigame)) )
 {
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_player" && e.team != BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM )
  {
   mypos = pos;
   minigame_drawcolorcodedstring_trunc(mySize_x,mypos,
    entcs_GetName(e.minigame_playerslot-1),
    player_fontsize, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

   mypos_y += player_fontsize_y;
   string thepiece = "bd/dozer";
   if(active_minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
    thepiece = bd_get_tile_pic(bd_curr_tile);
   const float tile_scale = 0.7;
   drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos + tile_size * 0.5 * (1 - tile_scale)), minigame_texture(thepiece), HUD_Scale(tile_size * tile_scale), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)

                                                                       ;

   mypos_x += tile_size_x;

   drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), ftos(e.bd_moves), tile_size, '0.7 0.84 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)
                                                      ;
  }
 }
}


string bd_turn_to_string(float turnflags)
{
 if(minigame_self.team == BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
  return _("You are spectating");

 if ( turnflags & BD_TURN_LOSS )
  return _("Better luck next time!");

 if ( turnflags & BD_TURN_WIN )
 {
  if(random() > 0.5)
   return _("Tubular! Press \"Next Level\" to continue!");
  else
   return _("Wicked! Press \"Next Level\" to continue!");
 }

 if( turnflags & BD_TURN_EDIT )
  return _("Press the space bar to change your currently selected tile");

 if ( turnflags & BD_TURN_MOVE )
  return _("Push the boulders onto the targets");

 return "";
}

 if ( minigame.minigame_flags == BD_TURN_MOVE )
 {
  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"move ", dir);
 }

  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"move ", bd_curr_pos, " ", ftos(bd_curr_tile), " ", dir);
 }

 if ( minigame.minigame_flags == BD_TURN_EDIT )

  minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"fill ", bd_curr_pos, " ", ftos(bd_curr_tile));
 }
}

void bd_set_curr_pos(string s)
{
 if(1){ if (bd_curr_pos) { strunzone(bd_curr_pos); } bd_curr_pos = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if ( s )
  s = strzone(s);
 bd_curr_pos = s;
}

float bd_change_dozer_angle(entity minigame)
{
 entity dozer = bd_find_piece(minigame, bd_curr_pos, false);
 if(!dozer || dozer.bd_tiletype != BD_TILE_DOZER)
  return false;

 switch(dozer.bd_dir)
 {
  case BD_DIR_UP: dozer.bd_dir = BD_DIR_LF; break;
  default:
  case BD_DIR_DN: dozer.bd_dir = BD_DIR_RT; break;
  case BD_DIR_LF: dozer.bd_dir = BD_DIR_DN; break;
  case BD_DIR_RT: dozer.bd_dir = BD_DIR_UP; break;
 }
 string thedir = bd_get_dir_name(dozer.bd_dir);

 bd_editor_make_move(minigame, thedir);
 return true;
}


float bd_client_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "activate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = strzone(bd_turn_to_string(minigame.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();
   bd_set_curr_pos("");
   bd_curr_tile = BD_TILE_BRICK1;
   return false;
  }
  case "deactivate":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.message) { strunzone(minigame.message); } minigame.message = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "key_pressed":
  case "key_released":
  {
   float event_blocked = ((event == "key_released")
    || !(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_MOVE) || (minigame_self.team == BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM));
   if (!(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_WIN) && !(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_LOSS))
   {
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      bd_make_move(minigame, "r");
      return true;
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      bd_make_move(minigame, "l");
      return true;
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      bd_make_move(minigame, "u");
      return true;
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      bd_make_move(minigame, "d");
      return true;
    }
   }

   if(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
   {
    switch ( ...(0,float) )
    {
     case K_RIGHTARROW:
     case K_KP_RIGHTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! bd_curr_pos )
       bd_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       bd_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(bd_curr_pos,1,0,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_LEFTARROW:
     case K_KP_LEFTARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! bd_curr_pos )
       bd_set_curr_pos("c3");
      else
       bd_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(bd_curr_pos,-1,0,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_UPARROW:
     case K_KP_UPARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! bd_curr_pos )
       bd_set_curr_pos("a1");
      else
       bd_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(bd_curr_pos,0,1,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_DOWNARROW:
     case K_KP_DOWNARROW:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if ( ! bd_curr_pos )
       bd_set_curr_pos("a3");
      else
       bd_set_curr_pos(minigame_relative_tile(bd_curr_pos,0,-1,BD_NUM_CNT,BD_LET_CNT));
      return true;
     case K_ENTER:
     case K_KP_ENTER:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      bd_editor_make_move(minigame, "");
      return true;
     case K_SPACE:
      if (event_blocked)
       return true;
      if(bd_change_dozer_angle(minigame))
       return true;
      bd_curr_tile += 1;
      if(bd_curr_tile > BD_TILE_LAST)
       bd_curr_tile = 1;
      return true;
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_pressed":
  {
   if((minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT) && minigame_self.team != BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
   {
    if(...(0,float) == K_MOUSE1)
    {
     bd_client_event(minigame, "mouse_moved");
     bd_editor_make_move(minigame, "");
     return true;
    }

    if(...(0,float) == K_MOUSE2)
    {
     bd_client_event(minigame, "mouse_moved");
     bd_editor_fill(minigame);
     return true;
    }
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "mouse_moved":
  {
   if((minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT) && minigame_self.team != BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM)
   {
    vector mouse_pos = minigame_hud_normalize(mousepos,bd_boardpos,bd_boardsize);
    bd_set_curr_pos(minigame_tile_name(mouse_pos,BD_LET_CNT,BD_NUM_CNT));
    if ( ! bd_valid_tile(bd_curr_pos) )
     bd_set_curr_pos("");
   }
   return true;
  }
  case "network_receive":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame" )
   {
    if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
    {
     if(1){ if (sent.message) { strunzone(sent.message); } sent.message = strzone(bd_turn_to_string(sent.minigame_flags)); }else voidfunc();


    }
   }
   else if(sent.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE)
    {
     float letter = ReadByte();
     float number = ReadByte();
     if(1){ if (sent.netname) { strunzone(sent.netname); } sent.netname = strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number)); }else voidfunc();

     sent.bd_tiletype = ReadByte();

     sent.bd_dir = ReadByte();
    }
   }
   else if(sent.classname == "minigame_player" && (sf & BD_SF_PLAYERMOVES))
    sent.bd_moves = ReadShort();

   return false;
  }
  case "menu_show":
  {
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Next Level"),"next");
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Restart"),"restart");
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Editor"),"edit");
   HUD_MinigameMenu_CustomEntry(...(0,entity),_("Save"),"save");
   return false;
  }
  case "menu_click":
  {
   if(...(0,string) == "next")
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"next");
   if(...(0,string) == "restart")
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"restart");
   if(...(0,string) == "edit")
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"edit");
   if(...(0,string) == "save")
    minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"save");
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float HUD_mouse_over(entity somepanel)
{
 vector pos = stov(cvar_string(strcat("hud_panel_", somepanel.panel_name, "_pos")));
 vector sz = stov(cvar_string(strcat("hud_panel_", somepanel.panel_name, "_size")));
 return mousepos_x >= pos_x*vid_conwidth && mousepos_x <= (pos_x+sz_x)*vid_conwidth &&
        mousepos_y >= pos_y*vid_conheight && mousepos_y <= (pos_y+sz_y)*vid_conheight ;
}

 HUD_Panel_LoadCvars();


 vector pos, mySize;

 hud_minigame.minigame_hud_board(pos,mySize);
}

entity HUD_MinigameMenu_entries;

entity HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry;


void HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry(entity newentry, entity prev)
{
 if ( !HUD_MinigameMenu_entries )
 {
  HUD_MinigameMenu_entries = newentry;
  HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry = newentry;
  return;
 }

 newentry.list_prev = prev;
 newentry.list_next = prev.list_next;
 if ( prev.list_next )
  prev.list_next.list_prev = newentry;
 else
  HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry = newentry;
 prev.list_next = newentry;
}



entity HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem;


void HUD_MinigameMenu_Click(entity menuitem)
{
 if ( menuitem )
 {
  menuitem.use1(menuitem, (0, world), (0, world));
 }
}



void HUD_MinigameMenu_EraseEntry ( entity e )
{

 if ( e.flags & 2 )
 {
  HUD_MinigameMenu_Click(e);
 }

 if ( e.list_prev )
  e.list_prev.list_next = e.list_next;
 else
  HUD_MinigameMenu_entries = e.list_next;

 if ( e.list_next )
  e.list_next.list_prev = e.list_prev;
 else
  HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry = e.list_prev;

 if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem == e )
  HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = (0, world);

 if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
}


entity HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(entity entry, string s, vector offset, vector fontsize, vector color,void(entity, entity, entity) click)
{
 entry.message = s;
 entry.origin = offset;
 entry.size = fontsize;
 entry.colormod = color;
 entry.flags = 0;
 entry.use1 = click;
 panel_pos_y += fontsize_y;
 return entry;
}


entity HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnSubEntry(string s, void(entity, entity, entity) click, entity parent)
{
 vector item_fontsize = hud_fontsize*1.25;
 vector item_offset = '1 0 0' * item_fontsize_x;
 entity item = HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(__spawn("hud_minigamemenu_subentry", "./common/minigames/cl_minigames_hud.qc" ":" "200", false),
    s,item_offset,item_fontsize,'0.8 0.8 0.8', click );
 item.owner = parent;
 return item;
}


void HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickCreate_Entry(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 minigame_cmd_workaround(0,"create ", this.netname);
}



float HUD_MinigameMenu_Click_ExpandCollapse(entity this)
{
 entity e;
 if ( this.flags & 2 )
 {
  if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem &&
    HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem.owner == this )
   HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = (0, world);
  this.flags &= ~2;
  for ( e = this.list_next; e != (0, world) && e.owner == this; e = this.list_next )
  {
   if ( e.flags & 2 )
    HUD_MinigameMenu_Click(e);
   this.list_next = e.list_next;
   if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
  }
  if ( this.list_next )
   this.list_next.list_prev = this;
  else
   HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry = this;
 }
 else
 {
  for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_entries; e != (0, world); e = e.list_next )
  {
   if ( (e.flags & 2) && e.origin_x == this.origin_x)
    HUD_MinigameMenu_Click(e);
  }

  this.flags |= 2;

  return true;
 }
 return false;
}


void HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickCreate(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_Click_ExpandCollapse(this) )
 {
  entity curr;
  entity prev = this;
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Minigames_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { { curr = HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnSubEntry(it.message, HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickCreate_Entry, this); curr.netname = it.netname; curr.model = strzone(minigame_texture(strcat(it.netname,"/icon"))); HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry( curr, prev ); prev = curr; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





    ;
 }
}

void HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickJoin(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{

 {
  entity e = (0, world);
  entity curr;

  while( (e = find(e,classname,"minigame")) )

    curr.model = strzone(minigame_texture(strcat(e.descriptor.netname,"/icon")));
    HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry( curr, prev );
    prev = curr;
   }
  }
 }

void HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickInvite(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_Click_ExpandCollapse(this) )
 {
  entity e;
  entity prev = this;
  for(float i = 0; i < maxclients; ++i)
  {
   if ( player_localnum != i && playerslots[i] && entcs_GetName(i) != "" &&
    !findfloat((0, world),minigame_playerslot,i+1) && playerslots[i].ping )
   {
    e = HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnSubEntry(
     strzone(entcs_GetName(i)), HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickInvite_Entry,
     this );
    e.flags |= 1;
    e.netname = strzone(ftos(i+1));
    e.origin_x *= 2;
    HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry(e,prev);
    prev = e;
   }
  }
 }
}

void HUD_MinigameMenu_Close(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened() )
 {
  entity e, p;
  for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_entries; e != (0, world); e = p )
  {
   p = e.list_next;
   if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
  }
  HUD_MinigameMenu_entries = (0, world);
  HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry = (0, world);
  HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = (0, world);
 }
}


void HUD_MinigameMenu_CurrentButton()
{
 entity e;
 if ( active_minigame )
 {
  for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry; e != (0, world); e = e.list_prev )
   if ( e.classname == "hud_minigamemenu_exit" )
   {
    HUD_MinigameMenu_EraseEntry(e);
    break;
   }
  entity currb = HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(__spawn("hud_minigamemenu_current", "./common/minigames/cl_minigames_hud.qc" ":" "406", false),
   _("Current Game"), '0 0 0', hud_fontsize*1.5,'0.7 0.84 1', HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickCurrentGame );
  currb.model = strzone(minigame_texture(strcat(active_minigame.descriptor.netname,"/icon")));
  HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry(currb,HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry);
  HUD_MinigameMenu_Click(currb);
 }
 else
 {
  entity p;
  for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry; e != (0, world); e = p.list_prev )
  {
   p = e;
   if ( e.classname == "hud_minigamemenu_current" )
   {
    p = e.list_next;
    if ( !p )
     p = HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry;
    HUD_MinigameMenu_EraseEntry(e);
    break;
   }
  }
  for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry; e != (0, world); e = e.list_prev )
   if ( e.classname == "hud_minigamemenu_exit" )
    return;
  entity exit = HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(__spawn("hud_minigamemenu_exit", "./common/minigames/cl_minigames_hud.qc" ":" "430", false),
   _("Exit Menu"),'0 0 0',hud_fontsize*1.5,'0.7 0.84 1', HUD_MinigameMenu_Close);
  HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry ( exit, HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry );
 }
}


void HUD_MinigameMenu_Open()
{
 if ( !mv_active && !HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened() )
 {
  HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry( HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(__spawn("hud_minigamemenu_entry", "./common/minigames/cl_minigames_hud.qc" ":" "441", false),
   _("Create"), '0 0 0', hud_fontsize*1.5,'0.7 0.84 1', HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickCreate),
   HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry );
  HUD_MinigameMenu_InsertEntry ( HUD_MinigameMenu_SpawnEntry(__spawn("hud_minigamemenu_entry", "./common/minigames/cl_minigames_hud.qc" ":" "444", false),
   _("Join"),'0 0 0',hud_fontsize*1.5,'0.7 0.84 1', HUD_MinigameMenu_ClickJoin),
   HUD_MinigameMenu_last_entry );
  HUD_MinigameMenu_CurrentButton();
  HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = (0, world);
 }
}


void HUD_MinigameMenu_MouseInput()
{
 panel = HUD_PANEL_MINIGAMEMENU;

 HUD_Panel_LoadCvars();

 if(panel_bg_padding)
 {
  panel_pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding;
  panel_size -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding;
 }

 entity e;

 panel_pos_y += hud_fontsize_y*2;

 HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = (0, world);
 vector sz;
 for ( e = HUD_MinigameMenu_entries; e != (0, world); e = e.list_next )
 {
  sz = eX*panel_size_x + eY*e.size_y;
  if ( e.model )
   sz_y = 22;
  if ( !HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem && mousepos_y >= panel_pos_y && mousepos_y <= panel_pos_y + sz_y )
  {
   HUD_MinigameMenu_activeitem = e;
  }
  panel_pos_y += sz_y;
 }
}
