void HUD_StrafeHUD()
{
 static float hud_lasttime = 0;
 entity strafeplayer;
 float islocal;


 if(!autocvar__hud_configure)
 {
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud ||
     (spectatee_status == -1 && (autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud == 1 || autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud == 3)) ||
     (autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud == 3 && !__Mutator_Send_HUD_StrafeHUD_showoptional(0 ))) { hud_lasttime = time; return; }
 }

 HUD_Panel_LoadCvars();

 if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_dynamichud)
  HUD_Scale_Enable();
 else
  HUD_Scale_Disable();

 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

 if(panel_bg_padding)
 {
  panel_pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding;
  panel_size -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding;
 }


 if(spectatee_status > 0 || isdemo())
 {
  islocal = false;
  strafeplayer = CSQCModel_server2csqc(player_localentnum - 1);
 }
 else
 {
  islocal = true;
  strafeplayer = csqcplayer;
 }


 if(csqcplayer && strafeplayer)
 {
  float strafe_waterlevel;


  {

   void old_contentstransition(float, float) = strafeplayer.contentstransition;
   float old_watertype = strafeplayer.watertype;
   float old_waterlevel = strafeplayer.waterlevel;

   strafeplayer.contentstransition = nil;
   _Movetype_CheckWater(strafeplayer);
   strafe_waterlevel = strafeplayer.waterlevel;


   strafeplayer.contentstransition = old_contentstransition;
   strafeplayer.watertype = old_watertype;
   strafeplayer.waterlevel = old_waterlevel;
  }

  float keys = (0, g_stat_PRESSED_KEYS);

  float jumpheld = false;
  if(islocal)
  {
   if((((input_buttons & (1 << (1))) != 0) || ((input_buttons & (1 << (12))) != 0)) && !(0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_CL_TRACK_CANJUMP))
    jumpheld = true;
  }
  else
  {
   if((keys & KEY_JUMP) && !(0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_TRACK_CANJUMP))
    jumpheld = true;
  }


  static float onground_lasttime = 0;
  static float onslick_last = false;
  static float turn_lasttime = 0;
  static float turn = false;
  static float turnangle;
  static float dt_update = 0;
  static float dt_time = 0;
  static float dt_sum = 0;
  static float dt = 0;



  float real_onground = islocal ? (((strafeplayer).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) : !(strafeplayer.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR);

  float real_onslick = false;

  float onground = real_onground && !jumpheld;
  float onslick = real_onslick;
  float onground_expired;
  float strafekeys;

  float swimming = strafe_waterlevel >= WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING;

  float speed = !autocvar__hud_configure ? vlen((_vec2 = (csqcplayer.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)) : 1337;

  float maxspeed_mod = ((((csqcplayer).flags & FL_DUCKED) != 0)) ? .5 : 1;
  float maxspeed_phys = onground ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) : (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED);
  float maxspeed = !autocvar__hud_configure ? maxspeed_phys * maxspeed_mod : 320;
  float movespeed;
  float bestspeed;
  float maxaccel_phys = onground ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_ACCELERATE) : (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCELERATE);
  float maxaccel = !autocvar__hud_configure ? maxaccel_phys : 1;

  float vel_angle = vectoangles(strafeplayer.velocity).y - (vectoangles(strafeplayer.velocity).y > 180 ? 360 : 0);
  float view_angle = input_angles.y;
  float angle;
  vector movement = input_movevalues;
  float fwd;
  float keys_fwd;
  float wishangle;
  float direction;


  float mode;
  float speed_conversion_factor = GetSpeedUnitFactor(autocvar_hud_speed_unit);
  float length_conversion_factor = GetLengthUnitFactor(autocvar_hud_speed_unit);

  float length_decimals = autocvar_hud_speed_unit >= 3 && autocvar_hud_speed_unit <= 5 ? 6 : 2;
  float antiflicker_angle = bound(0, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_antiflicker_angle, 180);
  float minspeed;
  float shift_offset = 0;
  float straight_overturn = false;
  float immobile = speed <= 0;
  float hudangle;
  float hidden_width;
  float neutral_offset;
  float neutral_width;
  vector currentangle_color = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_neutral_color;
  float currentangle_offset;
  vector currentangle_size;
  float bestangle;
  float prebestangle;
  float odd_bestangle;
  float bestangle_offset;
  float switch_bestangle_offset;
  float odd_angles = false;
  float odd_bestangle_offset = 0;
  float switch_odd_bestangle_offset = 0;
  float bestangle_width;
  float accelzone_left_offset;
  float accelzone_right_offset;
  float accelzone_width;
  float preaccelzone_left_offset;
  float preaccelzone_right_offset;
  float preaccelzone_width;
  float overturn_offset;
  float overturn_width;
  float slickdetector_height;
  vector direction_size_vertical;
  vector direction_size_horizontal;
  float range_minangle;
  float text_offset_top = 0;
  float text_offset_bottom = 0;


  float real_bestangle;
  float real_prebestangle;

  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_mode >= 0 && autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_mode <= 1)
   mode = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_mode;
  else
   mode = STRAFEHUD_MODE_VIEW_CENTERED;


  float arrow_size = max(panel_size.y * min(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_arrow_size, 10), 0);

  if(onground)
  {
   if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION) == 0)
   {
    onslick = true;
   }
   else
   {
    trace_dphitq3surfaceflags = 0;
    tracebox(strafeplayer.origin, strafeplayer.mins, strafeplayer.maxs, strafeplayer.origin - '0 0 1', MOVE_NOMONSTERS, strafeplayer);
    onslick = trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SLICK;
   }
   real_onslick = onslick;

   onground_lasttime = time;
   onslick_last = onslick;
  }
  else if(jumpheld || swimming)
  {
   onground_lasttime = 0;
  }

  if(onground_lasttime == 0)
   onground_expired = true;
  else
   onground_expired = (time - onground_lasttime) >= autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_timeout_ground;

  if(!onground && !onground_expired)
  {
   onground = true;
   onslick = onslick_last;

   if(!autocvar__hud_configure)
   {
    maxspeed = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) * maxspeed_mod;
    maxaccel = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_ACCELERATE);
   }
  }

  movespeed = vlen((_vec2 = (movement), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2));
  if(movespeed == 0)
   movespeed = maxspeed;
  else
   movespeed = min(movespeed, maxspeed);

  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
   arrow_size = max(arrow_size, 1);


  if((csqcplayer_status == CSQCPLAYERSTATUS_PREDICTED) && (input_timelength > 0))
  {
   float dt_client = input_timelength;

   if(dt_client > .05)
    dt_client /= 2;


   dt_sum += dt_client * dt_client;
   dt_time += dt_client;

   if(((time - dt_update) > autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_fps_update) || (dt_update == 0))
   {
    dt = dt_sum / dt_time;
    dt_update = time;
    dt_time = dt_sum = 0;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   dt = ticrate;
   dt_update = dt_time = dt_sum = 0;
  }


  if(islocal)
  {
   if(movement.x > 0)
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_FORWARD;
   else if(movement.x < 0)
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_BACKWARD;
   else
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_NONE;
  }
  else
  {
   if((keys & KEY_FORWARD) && !(keys & KEY_BACKWARD))
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_FORWARD;
   else if(!(keys & KEY_FORWARD) && (keys & KEY_BACKWARD))
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_BACKWARD;
   else
    keys_fwd = STRAFEHUD_KEYS_NONE;
  }


  if(islocal)
  {
   if(movement.x == 0)
   {
    if(movement.y < 0)
     wishangle = -90;
    else if(movement.y > 0)
     wishangle = 90;
    else
     wishangle = 0;
   }
   else
   {
    if(movement.y == 0)
    {
     wishangle = 0;
    }
    else
    {
     wishangle = RAD2DEG * atan2(movement.y, movement.x);

     if(fabs(wishangle) > 90)
     {
      if(wishangle < 0)
       wishangle += 180;
      else
       wishangle -= 180;

      wishangle *= -1;
     }
    }
   }
  }
  else
  {
   if(keys & KEY_FORWARD || keys & KEY_BACKWARD)
    wishangle = 45;
   else
    wishangle = 90;
   if(keys & KEY_LEFT)
    wishangle *= -1;
   else if(!(keys & KEY_RIGHT))
    wishangle = 0;
  }

  strafekeys = fabs(wishangle) > 45;


  range_minangle = fabs(wishangle) % 90;
  if(range_minangle > 45) range_minangle = 45 - fabs(wishangle) % 45;
  range_minangle = 90 - range_minangle;
  range_minangle *= 2;

  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_range == 0)
  {
   if(autocvar__hud_configure)
    hudangle = 90;
   else
    hudangle = range_minangle;
  }
  else
  {
   hudangle = bound(0, fabs(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_range), 360);
  }


  if((!strafekeys && vlen((_vec2 = (movement), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)) > 0) || onground || autocvar__hud_configure)
  {
   turn = false;
  }
  else
  {
   float turn_expired = (time - turn_lasttime) >= autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_timeout_turn;

   if(strafekeys)
    turn = true;
   else if(turn_expired)
    turn = false;

   if(turn)
   {
    if(strafekeys)
    {
     turn_lasttime = time;
     turnangle = wishangle;
    }
    else
    {
     wishangle = turnangle;
    }


    float strafity = 1 - (90 - fabs(wishangle)) / 45;

    if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSTRAFESPEED) != 0)
     maxspeed = min(maxspeed, GeomLerp((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED), strafity, (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSTRAFESPEED)));

    movespeed = min(movespeed, maxspeed);

    if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCELERATE) != 0)
     maxaccel = GeomLerp((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCELERATE), strafity, (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCELERATE));
   }
  }

  maxaccel *= dt * movespeed;
  bestspeed = max(movespeed - maxaccel, 0);

  float frictionspeed;
  float strafespeed;

  if((speed > 0) && onground)
  {
   float strafefriction = onslick ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION_SLICK) : (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION);

   frictionspeed = speed * dt * strafefriction * max((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STOPSPEED) / speed, 1);
   strafespeed = max(speed - frictionspeed, 0);
  }
  else
  {
   frictionspeed = 0;
   strafespeed = speed;
  }

  minspeed = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_minspeed;
  if(minspeed < 0)
   minspeed = bestspeed + frictionspeed;


  if(!autocvar__hud_configure)
  {
   if(speed > 0)
   {

    angle = vel_angle - view_angle;


    if(angle > 180)
     angle -= 360;
    else if(angle < -180)
     angle += 360;



    if(fabs(wishangle) != 90)
    {
     if(keys_fwd == STRAFEHUD_KEYS_FORWARD)
      fwd = true;
     else if(keys_fwd == STRAFEHUD_KEYS_BACKWARD)
      fwd = false;
     else
      fwd = fabs(angle) <= 90;
    }

    else
    {
     if(wishangle < 0)
      fwd = angle <= -wishangle;
     else
      fwd = angle >= -wishangle;
    }


    if(!fwd)
    {
     if(angle < 0)
      angle += 180;
     else
      angle -= 180;
    }


    if(angle > (180 - antiflicker_angle) || angle < (-180 + antiflicker_angle))
     straight_overturn = true;
   }
   else
   {
    angle = 0;
    fwd = true;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   const float demo_maxangle = 55;
   const float demo_turnspeed = 40;

   static float demo_position = -37 / demo_maxangle;

   if(autocvar__hud_panel_strafehud_demo)
   {
    float demo_dt = time - hud_lasttime;
    float demo_step = (demo_turnspeed / demo_maxangle) * demo_dt;
    demo_position = ((demo_position + demo_step) % 4 + 4) % 4;
   }


   if(demo_position > 3)
    angle = -1 + (demo_position - 3);
   else if(demo_position > 1)
    angle = +1 - (demo_position - 1);
   else
    angle = demo_position;
   angle *= demo_maxangle;

   fwd = true;
   wishangle = 45;
   if(angle < 0)
    wishangle *= -1;
  }


  if(!fwd)
   wishangle *= -1;


  if(autocvar_v_flipped)
  {
   angle *= -1;
   wishangle *= -1;
  }


  if(wishangle > 0)
  {
   direction = STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_RIGHT;
  }
  else if(wishangle < 0)
  {
   direction = STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT;
  }
  else
  {
   if(angle > antiflicker_angle && angle < (180 - antiflicker_angle))
    direction = STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_RIGHT;
   else if(angle < -antiflicker_angle && angle > (-180 + antiflicker_angle))
    direction = STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT;
   else
    direction = STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE;
  }



  real_bestangle = bestangle = (strafespeed > bestspeed ? acos(bestspeed / strafespeed) * RAD2DEG : 0);
  real_prebestangle = prebestangle = (strafespeed > movespeed ? acos(movespeed / strafespeed) * RAD2DEG : 0);
  if(direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT)
  {
   bestangle *= -1;
   prebestangle *= -1;
  }
  odd_bestangle = -bestangle - wishangle;
  bestangle -= wishangle;
  prebestangle -= wishangle;



  hidden_width = (360 - hudangle) / hudangle * panel_size.x;


  currentangle_size.x = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_width;
  currentangle_size.y = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_height;
  currentangle_size.z = 0;
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
  {
   currentangle_size.x = min(currentangle_size.x, 10);
   currentangle_size.y = min(currentangle_size.y, 10);
  }
  currentangle_size.x *= panel_size.x;
  currentangle_size.y *= panel_size.y;
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
  {
   currentangle_size.x = max(currentangle_size.x, 1);
   currentangle_size.y = max(currentangle_size.y, 1);
  }
  else
  {
   currentangle_size.y = max(currentangle_size.y, 0);
  }
  if(mode == STRAFEHUD_MODE_VIEW_CENTERED)
   currentangle_offset = angle / hudangle * panel_size.x;
  else

   currentangle_offset = bound(-hudangle / 2, angle, hudangle / 2) / hudangle * panel_size.x + panel_size.x / 2;


  bestangle_offset = bestangle / hudangle * panel_size.x + panel_size.x / 2;
  switch_bestangle_offset = -bestangle / hudangle * panel_size.x + panel_size.x / 2;
  bestangle_width = panel_size.x * autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_width;
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
   bestangle_width = max(bestangle_width, 1);

  if((angle > -wishangle && direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT) || (angle < -wishangle && direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_RIGHT))
  {
   odd_angles = true;
   odd_bestangle_offset = odd_bestangle / hudangle * panel_size.x + panel_size.x / 2;
   switch_odd_bestangle_offset = (odd_bestangle + bestangle * 2) / hudangle * panel_size.x + panel_size.x / 2;
  }

  direction_size_vertical.x = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_width;
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
   direction_size_vertical.x = min(direction_size_vertical.x, 1);
  direction_size_vertical.x *= panel_size.y;
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
   direction_size_vertical.x = max(direction_size_vertical.x, 1);
  direction_size_vertical.y = panel_size.y + direction_size_vertical.x * 2;
  direction_size_vertical.z = 0;
  direction_size_horizontal.x = panel_size.x * min(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_length, .5);
  direction_size_horizontal.y = direction_size_vertical.x;
  direction_size_horizontal.z = 0;


  if(immobile)
  {

   if(panel_size.x > 0 && panel_size.y > 0 && autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_alpha * panel_fg_alpha > 0)
   {
    switch(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style)
    {
     default:
     case STRAFEHUD_STYLE_DRAWFILL:
      drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos), HUD_Scale(panel_size), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                       ;
      break;

     case STRAFEHUD_STYLE_PROGRESSBAR:
      HUD_Panel_DrawProgressBar(
       panel_pos, panel_size, "progressbar", 1, 0, 0,
       autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_color,
       autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
       DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
    }
   }
  }
  else
  {

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_preaccel)
    preaccelzone_width = (fabs(bestangle - prebestangle)) / hudangle * panel_size.x;
   else
    preaccelzone_width = 0;
   accelzone_width = (90 - fabs(bestangle + wishangle)) / hudangle * panel_size.x;
   overturn_width = 180 / hudangle * panel_size.x;
   neutral_width = 360 / hudangle * panel_size.x - accelzone_width * 2 - preaccelzone_width * 2 - overturn_width;

   {
    float current_offset = 0;
    preaccelzone_right_offset = current_offset;
    current_offset += preaccelzone_width;

    accelzone_right_offset = current_offset;
    current_offset += accelzone_width;

    overturn_offset = current_offset;
    current_offset += overturn_width;

    accelzone_left_offset = current_offset;
    current_offset += accelzone_width;

    preaccelzone_left_offset = current_offset;
    current_offset += preaccelzone_width;


    neutral_offset = direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT ? current_offset : -neutral_width;
   }


   if(mode == STRAFEHUD_MODE_VIEW_CENTERED)
   {
    shift_offset = -currentangle_offset;
    bestangle_offset += shift_offset;
    switch_bestangle_offset += shift_offset;
    odd_bestangle_offset += shift_offset;
    switch_odd_bestangle_offset += shift_offset;
   }
   if(direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT)
    shift_offset += -360 / hudangle * panel_size.x;


   shift_offset += (panel_size.x + neutral_width) / 2 - wishangle / hudangle * panel_size.x;


   neutral_offset += shift_offset;
   accelzone_left_offset += shift_offset;
   accelzone_right_offset += shift_offset;
   preaccelzone_left_offset += shift_offset;
   preaccelzone_right_offset += shift_offset;
   overturn_offset += shift_offset;


   HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
    accelzone_left_offset, accelzone_width, hidden_width,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_color,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_LEFT);

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_preaccel)
    HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
     preaccelzone_left_offset, preaccelzone_width, hidden_width,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_color,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_RIGHT);


   HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
    accelzone_right_offset, accelzone_width, hidden_width,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_color,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_RIGHT);

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_preaccel)
    HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
     preaccelzone_right_offset, preaccelzone_width, hidden_width,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_color,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_accel_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_LEFT);





   HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
    overturn_offset, overturn_width, hidden_width,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_overturn_color,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_overturn_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_BOTH);


   HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
    neutral_offset, neutral_width, hidden_width,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_color,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
    autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_NONE);


   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch && speed >= minspeed && bestangle_width > 0 && autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_alpha > 0)
   {

    float offset = !odd_angles ? bestangle_offset : odd_bestangle_offset;
    float switch_offset = !odd_angles ? switch_bestangle_offset : switch_odd_bestangle_offset;


    if(direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT)
    {
     if(!odd_angles)
      offset -= bestangle_width;
     else
      switch_offset -= bestangle_width;
    }
    else
    {
     if(!odd_angles)
      switch_offset -= bestangle_width;
     else
      offset -= bestangle_width;
    }

    HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
     switch_offset, bestangle_width, hidden_width,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_color,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
     STRAFEHUD_STYLE_DRAWFILL, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_NONE);

    if(direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
     HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(
      offset, bestangle_width, hidden_width,
      autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_color,
      autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_switch_alpha * panel_fg_alpha,
      STRAFEHUD_STYLE_DRAWFILL, STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_NONE);
   }
  }


  slickdetector_height = max(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_height, 0);
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
   slickdetector_height = min(slickdetector_height, 1);
  slickdetector_height *= panel_size.y;
  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector &&
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_range > 0 &&
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_alpha > 0 &&
     slickdetector_height > 0 &&
     panel_size.x > 0)
  {
   float slicksteps = max(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_granularity, 0);
   float slickdetected = false;

   if(!autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_uncapped)
    slicksteps = min(slicksteps, 4);
   slicksteps = 90 / 2 ** slicksteps;

   slickdetected = real_onslick;


   trace_dphitq3surfaceflags = 0;
   vector traceorigin = strafeplayer.origin + eZ * strafeplayer.mins.z;
   for(float i = 0; i < 90 && !slickdetected; i += slicksteps)
   {
    vector slickoffset;
    float slickrotate;
    slickoffset.z = -cos(i * DEG2RAD) * autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_range;
    slickrotate = sin(i * DEG2RAD) * autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_range;

    for(float j = 0; j < 360 && !slickdetected; j += slicksteps)
    {
     slickoffset.x = sin(j * DEG2RAD) * slickrotate;
     slickoffset.y = cos(j * DEG2RAD) * slickrotate;

     traceline(traceorigin, traceorigin + slickoffset, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, strafeplayer);
     if(((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION) == 0 && trace_fraction < 1) || trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SLICK)
      slickdetected = true;
     if(i == 0)
      break;
    }
   }


   if(slickdetected)
   {
    vector slickdetector_size = panel_size;
    slickdetector_size.y = slickdetector_height;


    drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * slickdetector_size.y), HUD_Scale(slickdetector_size), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                     ;


    drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eY * panel_size.y), HUD_Scale(slickdetector_size), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_slickdetector_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                     ;
   }

   text_offset_top = text_offset_bottom = slickdetector_height;
  }

  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction &&
     direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE &&
     direction_size_vertical.x > 0 &&
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_alpha * panel_fg_alpha > 0)
  {
   float indicator_direction = direction == STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_LEFT;


   if(!fwd != odd_angles)
    indicator_direction = !indicator_direction;



   if(direction_size_vertical.y > 0)
    drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * direction_size_horizontal.y + eX * (indicator_direction ? -direction_size_vertical.x : panel_size.x)), HUD_Scale(direction_size_vertical), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                     ;


   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eX * (indicator_direction ? 0 : panel_size.x - direction_size_horizontal.x) - eY * direction_size_horizontal.y), HUD_Scale(direction_size_horizontal), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                    ;


   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eX * (indicator_direction ? 0 : panel_size.x - direction_size_horizontal.x) + eY * panel_size.y), HUD_Scale(direction_size_horizontal), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_direction_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                    ;
  }


  if(!immobile)
  {
   float moveangle = fabs(angle + wishangle);
   float strafe_ratio = 0;


   if(moveangle >= 90)
   {
    currentangle_color = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_overturn_color;
    strafe_ratio = (moveangle - 90) / 90;
    if(strafe_ratio > 1) strafe_ratio = 2 - strafe_ratio;
    strafe_ratio *= -1;
   }

   else if(moveangle >= real_bestangle)
   {
    currentangle_color = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_accel_color;
    strafe_ratio = (90 - moveangle) / (90 - real_bestangle);
   }
   else if(moveangle >= real_prebestangle)
   {
    if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_preaccel)
     currentangle_color = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_accel_color;
    strafe_ratio = (moveangle - real_prebestangle) / (real_bestangle - real_prebestangle);
   }

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_style == STRAFEHUD_STYLE_GRADIENT)
    currentangle_color = StrafeHUD_mixColors(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_neutral_color, currentangle_color, fabs(strafe_ratio));
  }

  if(mode == STRAFEHUD_MODE_VIEW_CENTERED || straight_overturn)
   currentangle_offset = panel_size.x / 2;

  float angleheight_offset = currentangle_size.y;
  float ghost_offset = 0;
  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
   ghost_offset = bound(0, (odd_angles ? odd_bestangle_offset : bestangle_offset), panel_size.x);

  switch(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_style)
  {
   case STRAFEHUD_INDICATOR_SOLID:
    if(currentangle_size.x > 0 && currentangle_size.y > 0)
    {
     if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
      drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * ((currentangle_size.y - panel_size.y) / 2) + eX * (ghost_offset - currentangle_size.x / 2)), HUD_Scale(currentangle_size), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                       ;
     drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * ((currentangle_size.y - panel_size.y) / 2) + eX * (currentangle_offset - currentangle_size.x / 2)), HUD_Scale(currentangle_size), currentangle_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)



                      ;
    }
    break;
   case STRAFEHUD_INDICATOR_DASHED:
    if(currentangle_size.x > 0 && currentangle_size.y > 0)
    {
     vector line_size = currentangle_size;
     line_size.y = currentangle_size.y / (bound(2, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_dashes, currentangle_size.y) * 2 - 1);
     for(float i = 0; i < currentangle_size.y; i += line_size.y * 2)
     {
      if(i + line_size.y * 2 >= currentangle_size.y)
       line_size.y = currentangle_size.y - i;
      if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
       drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * ((currentangle_size.y - panel_size.y) / 2 - i) + eX * (ghost_offset - line_size.x / 2)), HUD_Scale(line_size), autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)


                                                                                       ;
      drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos - eY * ((currentangle_size.y - panel_size.y) / 2 - i) + eX * (currentangle_offset - line_size.x / 2)), HUD_Scale(line_size), currentangle_color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)


                                                                                  ;
     }
    }
    break;
   case STRAFEHUD_INDICATOR_NONE:
   default:

    angleheight_offset = panel_size.y;
    currentangle_size = '0 0 0';
  }

  float angle_offset_top = 0, angle_offset_bottom = 0;


  if((autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_alpha > 0) ||
     (autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_alpha > 0))
  {

   angle_offset_top = angle_offset_bottom = (angleheight_offset - panel_size.y) / 2;
  }

  if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_arrow > 0)
  {
   if(arrow_size > 0)
   {
    if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_arrow == 1 || autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_arrow >= 3)
    {
     if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
      StrafeHUD_drawStrafeArrow(
       panel_pos + eY * ((panel_size.y - angleheight_offset) / 2) + eX * ghost_offset,
       arrow_size, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_color,
       autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, true, currentangle_size.x);
     StrafeHUD_drawStrafeArrow(
      panel_pos + eY * ((panel_size.y - angleheight_offset) / 2) + eX * currentangle_offset,
      arrow_size, currentangle_color,
      autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, true, currentangle_size.x);

     angle_offset_top += arrow_size;
    }
    if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_arrow >= 2)
    {
     if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle && direction != STRAFEHUD_DIRECTION_NONE)
      StrafeHUD_drawStrafeArrow(
       panel_pos + eY * ((panel_size.y - angleheight_offset) / 2 + angleheight_offset) + eX * ghost_offset,
       arrow_size, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_color,
       autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bestangle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, false, currentangle_size.x);
     StrafeHUD_drawStrafeArrow(
      panel_pos + eY * ((panel_size.y - angleheight_offset) / 2 + angleheight_offset) + eX * currentangle_offset,
      arrow_size, currentangle_color,
      autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_angle_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, false, currentangle_size.x);

     angle_offset_bottom += arrow_size;
    }
   }
  }


  text_offset_top = max(angle_offset_top, text_offset_top);
  text_offset_bottom = max(angle_offset_bottom, text_offset_bottom);

  drawfont = FONT_USER + 2;


  {
   static float startspeed = 0, starttime = 0;


   if((race_nextcheckpoint == 1) || (race_checkpoint == 254 && race_nextcheckpoint == 255))
   {
    if((race_checkpointtime > 0) && (starttime != race_checkpointtime))
    {
     starttime = race_checkpointtime;
     startspeed = speed;
    }
   }

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_startspeed)
   {
    float startspeed_height = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_startspeed_size * panel_size.y;
    string startspeed_text = ftos_decimals(startspeed * speed_conversion_factor, 2);
    if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_unit_show)
     startspeed_text = strcat(startspeed_text, GetSpeedUnit(autocvar_hud_speed_unit));

    float was_drawn = StrafeHUD_drawTextIndicator(
     startspeed_text, startspeed_height,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_startspeed_color,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_startspeed_fade,
     starttime, text_offset_bottom, STRAFEHUD_TEXT_BOTTOM);

    if(was_drawn)
     text_offset_bottom += startspeed_height;
   }
  }




  {
   static float height_min = 0, height_max = 0;
   static float jumpheight = 0, jumptime = 0;


   if((strafeplayer.velocity.z <= 0) || real_onground || swimming || (((strafeplayer).classname == "ENT_CLIENT_MODEL") ? (strafeplayer).csqcmodel_isdead : (GetResource((strafeplayer), RES_HEALTH) <= 0)) || !((strafeplayer).isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_PLAYER))
   {
    height_min = height_max = strafeplayer.origin.z;
   }
   else if(strafeplayer.origin.z > height_max)
   {
    height_max = strafeplayer.origin.z;
    float jumpheight_new = height_max - height_min;

    if((jumpheight_new * length_conversion_factor) > max(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_jumpheight_min, 0))
    {
     jumpheight = jumpheight_new;
     jumptime = time;
    }
   }

   if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_jumpheight)
   {
    float jumpheight_height = autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_jumpheight_size * panel_size.y;
    string jumpheight_text = ftos_decimals(jumpheight * length_conversion_factor, length_decimals);
    if(autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_unit_show)
     jumpheight_text = strcat(jumpheight_text, GetLengthUnit(autocvar_hud_speed_unit));

    float was_drawn = StrafeHUD_drawTextIndicator(
     jumpheight_text, jumpheight_height,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_jumpheight_color,
     autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_jumpheight_fade,
     jumptime, text_offset_top, STRAFEHUD_TEXT_TOP);

    if(was_drawn)
     text_offset_top += jumpheight_height;
   }
  }

  drawfont = FONT_USER + 1;
 }
 hud_lasttime = time;
}


void HUD_Panel_DrawStrafeHUD(float offset, float width, float hidden_width, vector color, float alpha, float type, float gradientType)
{
 float mirror_offset, mirror_width;
 vector size = panel_size;
 vector mirror_size = panel_size;
 float overflow_width = 0, overflow_mirror_width = 0;
 float original_width = width;

 if(type == STRAFEHUD_STYLE_GRADIENT && gradientType == STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_NONE)
  type = STRAFEHUD_STYLE_DRAWFILL;

 if(alpha <= 0 && type != STRAFEHUD_STYLE_GRADIENT || width <= 0)
  return;

 if(offset < 0)
 {
  mirror_width = min(fabs(offset), width);
  mirror_offset = panel_size.x + hidden_width - fabs(offset);
  width += offset;
  offset = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  mirror_width = min(offset + width - panel_size.x - hidden_width, width);
  mirror_offset = max(offset - panel_size.x - hidden_width, 0);
 }

 width = max(width, 0);
 if((offset + width) > panel_size.x)
 {
  overflow_width = (offset + width) - panel_size.x;
  width = panel_size.x - offset;
 }
 size.x = width;

 if(mirror_offset < 0)
 {
  mirror_width += mirror_offset;
  mirror_offset = 0;
 }

 mirror_width = max(mirror_width, 0);
 if((mirror_offset + mirror_width) > panel_size.x)
 {
  overflow_mirror_width = (mirror_offset + mirror_width) - panel_size.x;
  mirror_width = panel_size.x - mirror_offset;
 }
 mirror_size.x = mirror_width;

 switch(type)
 {
  default:
  case STRAFEHUD_STYLE_DRAWFILL:
   if(mirror_size.x > 0 && mirror_size.y > 0)
    drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eX * mirror_offset), HUD_Scale(mirror_size), color, alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
   if(size.x > 0 && size.y > 0)
    drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eX * offset), HUD_Scale(size), color, alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
   break;

  case STRAFEHUD_STYLE_PROGRESSBAR:
   if(mirror_size.x > 0 && mirror_size.y > 0)
    HUD_Panel_DrawProgressBar(
     panel_pos + eX * mirror_offset,
     mirror_size, "progressbar",
     1, 0, 0, color, alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
   if(size.x > 0 && size.y > 0)
    HUD_Panel_DrawProgressBar(
     panel_pos + eX * offset,
     size, "progressbar",
     1, 0, 0, color, alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
   break;

  case STRAFEHUD_STYLE_GRADIENT:

   float gradient_start;
   float gradient_offset, gradient_mirror_offset;

   if(offset == 0 && mirror_offset == 0)
    gradient_start = width > mirror_width ? 2 : 1;
   else if(offset == 0)
    gradient_start = 2;
   else if(mirror_offset == 0)
    gradient_start = 1;
   else
    gradient_start = 0;

   switch(gradient_start)
   {
    default:
    case 0:
     gradient_offset = gradient_mirror_offset = 0;
     break;
    case 1:
     gradient_offset = 0;
     gradient_mirror_offset = original_width - (mirror_width + overflow_mirror_width);
     break;
    case 2:
     gradient_offset = original_width - (width + overflow_width);
     gradient_mirror_offset = 0;
   }

   StrafeHUD_drawGradient(
    color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_color,
    mirror_size, original_width, mirror_offset,
    alpha, gradient_mirror_offset, gradientType);

   StrafeHUD_drawGradient(
    color, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_color,
    size, original_width, offset,
    alpha, gradient_offset, gradientType);
 }
}

vector StrafeHUD_mixColors(vector color1, vector color2, float ratio)
{
 vector mixedColor;
 if(ratio <= 0) return color1;
 if(ratio >= 1) return color2;
 mixedColor.x = color1.x + (color2.x - color1.x) * ratio;
 mixedColor.y = color1.y + (color2.y - color1.y) * ratio;
 mixedColor.z = color1.z + (color2.z - color1.z) * ratio;
 return mixedColor;
}

void StrafeHUD_drawGradient(vector color1, vector color2, vector size, float original_width, float offset, float alpha, float gradientOffset, float gradientType)
{
 float color_ratio, alpha1, alpha2;
 vector segment_size = size;
 alpha1 = bound(0, alpha, 1);
 alpha2 = bound(0, autocvar_hud_panel_strafehud_bar_neutral_alpha, 1);
 if((alpha1 + alpha2) == 0) return;
 color_ratio = alpha1 / (alpha1 + alpha2);
 for(float i = 0; i < size.x; ++i)
 {
  float ratio, alpha_ratio, combine_ratio1, combine_ratio2;
  segment_size.x = min(size.x - i, 1);
  ratio = (i + segment_size.x / 2 + gradientOffset) / original_width * (gradientType == STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_BOTH ? 2 : 1);
  if(ratio > 1) ratio = 2 - ratio;
  if(gradientType != STRAFEHUD_GRADIENT_RIGHT) ratio = 1 - ratio;
  alpha_ratio = alpha1 - (alpha1 - alpha2) * ratio;
  combine_ratio1 = ratio * (1 - color_ratio);
  combine_ratio2 = (1 - ratio) * color_ratio;
  ratio = (combine_ratio1 + combine_ratio2) == 0 ? 1 : combine_ratio1 / (combine_ratio1 + combine_ratio2);

  if(alpha_ratio > 0)
   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(panel_pos + eX * (offset + i)), HUD_Scale(segment_size), StrafeHUD_mixColors(color1, color2, ratio), alpha_ratio, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL)




                    ;
 }
}


void StrafeHUD_drawStrafeArrow(vector origin, float size, vector color, float alpha, float flipped, float connection_width)
{
 origin = HUD_Shift(origin);
 float width = (size * 2 + connection_width * hud_scale.x);
 float height = (size * hud_scale.y);
 if(flipped) origin -= size * eY;
 R_BeginPolygon("", DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, true);
 if(connection_width > 0)
 {
  R_PolygonVertex(origin + (connection_width / 2 * eX) + (flipped ? height * eY : '0 0 0'), '0 0 0', color, alpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(origin - (connection_width / 2 * eX) + (flipped ? height * eY : '0 0 0'), '0 0 0', color, alpha);
 }
 else
 {
  R_PolygonVertex(origin + (flipped ? height * eY : '0 0 0'), '0 0 0', color, alpha);
 }
 R_PolygonVertex(origin + (flipped ? '0 0 0' : height * eY) - (width / 2) * eX, '0 0 0', color, alpha);
 R_PolygonVertex(origin + (flipped ? '0 0 0' : height * eY) + (width / 2) * eX, '0 0 0', color, alpha);
 R_EndPolygon();
}


float StrafeHUD_drawTextIndicator(string text, float height, vector color, float fadetime, float lasttime, float offset, float position)
{
 if((height <= 0) || (lasttime <= 0) || (fadetime <= 0) || ((time - lasttime) >= fadetime))
  return false;

 float alpha = cos(((time - lasttime) / fadetime) * 90 * DEG2RAD);
 vector size = panel_size;
 size.y = height;

 switch(position)
 {
  case STRAFEHUD_TEXT_TOP:
   offset += size.y;
   offset *= -1;
   break;
  case STRAFEHUD_TEXT_BOTTOM:
   offset += panel_size.y;
   break;
 }

 drawstring_aspect(panel_pos + eY * offset, text, size, color, alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 return true;
}


float GetLengthUnitFactor(float length_unit)
{
 switch(length_unit)
 {
  default:
  case 1: return 1.0;
  case 2: return 0.0254;
  case 3: return 0.0254 * 0.001;
  case 4: return 0.0254 * 0.001 * 0.6213711922;
  case 5: return 0.0254 * 0.001 * 0.5399568035;
 }
}

string GetLengthUnit(float length_unit)
{
 switch(length_unit)
 {

  default:
  case 1: return strcat(" ", _("qu"));
  case 2: return strcat(" ", _("m"));
  case 3: return strcat(" ", _("km"));
  case 4: return strcat(" ", _("mi"));
  case 5: return strcat(" ", _("nmi"));
 }
}

vector HUD_Timer_Color(float timeleft)
{
 if(timeleft <= 60)
  return '1 0 0';
 else if(timeleft <= 300)
  return '1 1 0';
 else
  return '1 1 1';
}

float HUD_Timer_TimeElapsed(float curtime, float starttime)
{
 float time_elapsed = curtime - starttime;
 if (!autocvar_hud_panel_timer_unbound)
  time_elapsed = max(0, time_elapsed);
 return floor(time_elapsed);
}

float HUD_Timer_TimeLeft(float curtime, float starttime, float timelimit)
{
 float timeleft = timelimit + starttime - curtime;
 if (!autocvar_hud_panel_timer_unbound)
  timeleft = bound(0, timeleft, timelimit);
 return ceil(timeleft);
}

void HUD_Timer()
{
 if(!autocvar__hud_configure)
 {
  if(!autocvar_hud_panel_timer) return;
 }

 HUD_Panel_LoadCvars();

 drawfont = FONT_USER + 2;

 vector pos, mySize;
 pos = panel_pos;
 mySize = panel_size;

 if (autocvar_hud_panel_timer_dynamichud)
  HUD_Scale_Enable();
 else
  HUD_Scale_Disable();
 if(panel_bg_padding)
 {
  pos += '1 1 0' * panel_bg_padding;
  mySize -= '2 2 0' * panel_bg_padding;
 }

 string timer_str = nil;
 string subtimer_str = nil;
 string subtext = nil;
 float curtime, timelimit, timeleft;
 vector timer_size, subtext_size, subtimer_size;
 vector timer_color = '1 1 1';
 vector subtimer_color = '1 1 1';
 float swap = (autocvar_hud_panel_timer_secondary == 2 && (0, g_stat_ROUNDSTARTTIME));


 curtime = (intermission_time ? intermission_time : time);
 timelimit = (warmup_stage ? (0, g_stat_WARMUP_TIMELIMIT) : (0, g_stat_TIMELIMIT) * 60);


 timeleft = HUD_Timer_TimeLeft(curtime, (0, g_stat_GAMESTARTTIME), timelimit);


 if(!intermission_time && !warmup_stage && timelimit > 0)
  timer_color = HUD_Timer_Color(timeleft);


 if (autocvar_hud_panel_timer_increment || timelimit <= 0)
  timer = HUD_Timer_TimeElapsed(curtime, (0, g_stat_GAMESTARTTIME));
 else
  timer = timeleft;


 if((0, g_stat_ROUNDSTARTTIME) && autocvar_hud_panel_timer_secondary)
 {
  if((0, g_stat_ROUNDSTARTTIME) == -1) {

   subtimer_str = "--:--";
   subtimer_color = '1 0 0';
  } else {
   float round_curtime, round_timelimit, round_timeleft;


   round_curtime = (game_stopped_time ? game_stopped_time : time);
   round_timelimit = (0, g_stat_ROUND_TIMELIMIT);


   round_timeleft = HUD_Timer_TimeLeft(round_curtime, (0, g_stat_ROUNDSTARTTIME), round_timelimit);


   if(!intermission_time && round_timelimit > 0)
    subtimer_color = HUD_Timer_Color(round_timeleft);


   if (autocvar_hud_panel_timer_increment || round_timelimit <= 0)
    subtimer_str = seconds_tostring(HUD_Timer_TimeElapsed(round_curtime, (0, g_stat_ROUNDSTARTTIME)));
   else
    subtimer_str = seconds_tostring(round_timeleft);
  }
 }


 float overtimes = (0, g_stat_OVERTIMES);

 if(warmup_stage || autocvar__hud_configure)
 {
  if ((0, g_stat_WARMUP_TIMELIMIT) > 0)
   subtext = _("Warmup");
  else
  {
   Scoreboard_UpdatePlayerTeams();
   if (srv_minplayers - numplayers > 0)
    subtext = _("Warmup: too few players");
   else
    subtext = _("Warmup: no time limit");
  }
 }
 else if((0, g_stat_TIMEOUT_STATUS) == 2)
  subtext = _("Timeout");
 else if (overtimes == -1)
  subtext = _("Sudden Death");
 else if(overtimes == 1)
  subtext = _("Overtime");
 else if (overtimes >= 2)
  subtext = sprintf(_("Overtime #%d"), overtimes);

 subtext_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y / 3), _vec2);
 timer_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y - subtext_size.y), _vec2);
 subtimer_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x / 3), _vec2_y = (mySize.y - subtext_size.y), _vec2);
 timer_str = seconds_tostring(timer);

 panel_size.y -= subtext_size.y;
 if(1){ if(panel.current_panel_bg != "0" && panel.current_panel_bg != "") draw_BorderPicture( HUD_Shift(panel_pos - '1 1 0' * panel_bg_border), panel.current_panel_bg, HUD_Scale(panel_size + '1 1 0' * 2 * panel_bg_border), panel_bg_color, panel_bg_alpha, HUD_Scale('1 1 0' * BORDER_MULTIPLIER * panel_bg_border) ); }else voidfunc();

 if(subtimer_str) {
  float subtimer_padding = subtimer_size.y / 5;
  timer_size.x -= subtimer_size.x;
  drawstring_aspect(pos + eX * timer_size.x + eY * subtimer_padding, (swap ? timer_str : subtimer_str), subtimer_size - eY * subtimer_padding * 2, (swap ? timer_color : subtimer_color), panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }

 drawstring_aspect(pos, (swap ? subtimer_str : timer_str), timer_size, (swap ? subtimer_color : timer_color), panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 if(subtext)
  drawstring_aspect(pos + eY * timer_size.y, subtext, subtext_size, '0 1 0', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 drawfont = FONT_USER + 1;
}

void Accuracy_LoadLevels()
{
 if(autocvar_accuracy_color_levels != acc_color_levels)
 {
  if(1){ if (acc_color_levels) { strunzone(acc_color_levels); } acc_color_levels = strzone(autocvar_accuracy_color_levels); }else voidfunc();
  acc_levels = tokenize_console(acc_color_levels);
  if(acc_levels > MAX_ACCURACY_LEVELS)
   acc_levels = MAX_ACCURACY_LEVELS;
  if(acc_levels < 2)
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./client/hud/panel/weapons.qc", "47")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Warning: accuracy_color_levels must contain at least 2 values"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

  float i;
  for(i = 0; i < acc_levels; ++i)
   acc_lev[i] = stof(argv(i)) / 100.0;
 }
}

void Accuracy_LoadColors()
{
 if(time > acc_col_loadtime)
 if(acc_levels >= 2)
 {
  float i;
  for(i = 0; i < acc_levels; ++i)
   acc_col[i] = stov(cvar_string(strcat("accuracy_color", ftos(i))));
  acc_col_loadtime = time + 2;
 }
}

vector Accuracy_GetColor(float accuracy)
{
 float factor;
 vector color;
 if(acc_levels < 2)
  return '0 0 0';


 float j = acc_levels-1;
 while(j && accuracy < acc_lev[j])
  --j;


 factor = (accuracy - acc_lev[j]) / (acc_lev[j+1] - acc_lev[j]);
 color = acc_col[j];
 color = color + factor * (acc_col[j+1] - color);
 return color;
}

void weaponorder_swap(float i, float j, entity pass)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 entity h = weaponorder[i];
 weaponorder[i] = weaponorder[j];
 weaponorder[j] = h;
}

string weaponorder_cmp_str;
float weaponorder_cmp(float i, float j, entity pass)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float ai = strstrofs(weaponorder_cmp_str, sprintf(" %d ", weaponorder[i].m_id), 0);
 float aj = strstrofs(weaponorder_cmp_str, sprintf(" %d ", weaponorder[j].m_id), 0);
 return aj - ai;
}

    panel_fg_alpha *= (f);
   }

   {

    }
    else
    {
     if ((vid_conwidth - center.x)/center.y < screen_ar)
      panel_pos.x += f * (vid_conwidth - panel_pos.x);

      panel_pos.y -= f * (panel_pos.y + panel_size.y);

{
 if(wantsimple)
 {
  string _fn2 = substring(this.mdl, 0 , strlen(this.mdl) -4);

void ItemDraw(entity this)
{
 float wantsimple = autocvar_cl_simple_items && this.ItemStatus & ITS_ALLOWSI;
 if(wantsimple != this.item_simple && this.item_simple != -1)
  ItemSetModel(this, wantsimple);


 float animate = autocvar_cl_items_animate & 1 && this.item_simple <= 0 && (this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE1 || this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE2);


 if(!animate)
 {
  this.avelocity_y = 0;
  this.angles = this.angles_held;
 }
 else if(!this.avelocity_y)
 {
  if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE1)
   this.avelocity_y = 180;
  else if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE2)
   this.avelocity_y = -90;
 }


 float bobheight = 0;
 if(this.move_movetype && (!(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) || this.velocity != '0 0 0'))
 {


  if(animate)
   bobheight = this.origin_z - this.oldorigin_z;
  Movetype_Physics_NoMatchTicrate(this, frametime, true);
  this.oldorigin = this.origin;
  if(animate)
  {
   if(bobheight)
   {
    this.anim_start_time += frametime;
    this.oldorigin_z -= bobheight;
   }
   else
   {
    this.anim_start_time = time;
    if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE1)
     bobheight = 10;
    else if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE2)
     bobheight = 8;
   }
  }
 }
 else if(animate)
 {
  this.angles += this.avelocity * frametime;

  if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE1)
   bobheight = 10 + 8 * sin((time - this.anim_start_time) * 2);
  else if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ANIMATE2)
   bobheight = 8 + 4 * sin((time - this.anim_start_time) * 3);
 }


 if (bobheight != this.origin_z - this.oldorigin_z)
 {
  this.origin_z = this.oldorigin_z + bobheight;
  this.mins_z = 0 - bobheight;
  this.maxs_z = 48 - bobheight;

 }


 this.alpha = 1;
 this.drawmask = 0;
 if(this.fade_end && !warpzone_warpzones_exist)
 {
  vector org = getpropertyvec(VF_ORIGIN);
  if(((_vlen2 = (org - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((this.fade_end) ** 2)))
   this.alpha = 0;
  else if(autocvar_cl_items_fadedist > 0)
  {
   this.fade_start = max(500, this.fade_end - autocvar_cl_items_fadedist);
   if(((_vlen2 = (org - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((this.fade_start) ** 2)))
    this.alpha = bound(0, (this.fade_end - vlen(org - this.origin - 0.5 * (this.mins + this.maxs))) / (this.fade_end - this.fade_start), 1);
  }
 }

 if(!this.alpha)
  return;


 if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_AVAILABLE)
 {
  if(hud)
  {
   this.alpha *= autocvar_cl_items_vehicle_alpha;
   this.colormod = this.glowmod = autocvar_cl_items_vehicle_color;
  }
  else if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_STAYWEP)
  {
   this.alpha *= autocvar_cl_weapon_stay_alpha;
   this.colormod = this.glowmod = autocvar_cl_weapon_stay_color;
  }
  else
  {
   this.colormod = '1 1 1';
   this.glowmod = this.item_glowmod;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  this.alpha *= autocvar_cl_ghost_items;
  this.colormod = this.glowmod = autocvar_cl_ghost_items_color;
 }

 if(!this.alpha)
  return;


 if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_EXPIRING)
 {
  if(!this.wait)
  {
   this.wait = time + IT_DESPAWNFX_TIME;
   this.delay = 0.25;
  }

  if(autocvar_cl_items_animate & 2)
   this.alpha *= (this.wait - time) / IT_DESPAWNFX_TIME;

  if(autocvar_cl_items_animate & 4 && time >= this.pointtime)
  {
   __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_ITEM_DESPAWN.eent_eff_name), this.origin + '0 0 16', '0 0 0', 1);
   if (this.delay > 0.0625)
    this.delay *= 0.5;
   this.pointtime = time + this.delay;
  }
 }

 this.drawmask = this.alpha <= 0 ? 0 : MASK_NORMAL;
}

void ItemRemove(entity this)
{
 if(this.alpha)
 if(!this.wait || time < this.wait - ticrate)
  __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_ITEM_PICKUP.eent_eff_name), (this.absmin + this.absmax) * 0.5, '0 0 0', 1);
 if(1){ if (this.mdl) { strunzone(this.mdl); } this.mdl = nil; }else voidfunc();
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_ITEM(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 float sf = ReadByte();

 if(sf & ISF_LOCATION)
 {
  float bobheight = this.origin_z - this.oldorigin_z;
  this.origin = this.oldorigin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  this.origin_z += bobheight;
  setorigin(this, this.origin);
 }

 if(sf & ISF_ANGLES)
 {
  this.angles = this.angles_held = (_vec3.x = (ReadAngle()), _vec3.y = (ReadAngle()), _vec3.z = (ReadAngle()), _vec3);
 }
# 248 "./client/items/items.qc"
 if(sf & ISF_STATUS)
 {
  float prevItemStatus = this.ItemStatus;
  this.ItemStatus = ReadByte();

  if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_ALLOWFB)
   this.effects |= EF_FULLBRIGHT;
  else
   this.effects &= ~EF_FULLBRIGHT;

  if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_AVAILABLE)
  {
   if(this.solid != SOLID_TRIGGER)
   {
    this.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
    setorigin(this, this.origin);
   }

   if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_GLOW)
    this.effects |= (EF_ADDITIVE | EF_FULLBRIGHT);
   if(!(prevItemStatus & ITS_AVAILABLE) && this.alpha && !isnew)
    __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_ITEM_RESPAWN.eent_eff_name), (this.absmin + this.absmax) * 0.5, '0 0 0', 1);
  }
  else
  {
   if(this.solid != SOLID_NOT)
   {
    this.solid = SOLID_NOT;
    setorigin(this, this.origin);
   }

   if(this.ItemStatus & ITS_GLOW)
    this.effects &= ~(EF_ADDITIVE | EF_FULLBRIGHT);
   if(prevItemStatus & ITS_AVAILABLE && this.alpha)
    __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_ITEM_PICKUP.eent_eff_name), (this.absmin + this.absmax) * 0.5, '0 0 0', 1);
  }
 }

 if(sf & ISF_MODEL)
 {
  if(isnew)
  {
   IL_PUSH(g_drawables, this);
   this.draw = ItemDraw;
   this.flags |= FL_ITEM;
  }

  this.fade_end = ReadShort();

  if(1){ if (this.mdl) { strunzone(this.mdl); } this.mdl = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
  this.item_simple = -2;

  this.skin = ReadByte();
 }

 if(sf & ISF_COLORMAP)
 {
  this.colormap = ReadShort();
  this.item_glowmod_x = ReadByte() / 255.0;
  this.item_glowmod_y = ReadByte() / 255.0;
  this.item_glowmod_z = ReadByte() / 255.0;
 }

 if(sf & ISF_DROP)
 {
  this.gravity = 1;
  this.pushable = true;
  set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_TOSS);
  this.velocity = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
 }
 else if (this.gravity)
 {

  this.gravity = 0;
  this.pushable = false;
  set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NONE);
  this.velocity = '0 0 0';
  ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
 }

 this.entremove = ItemRemove;

 return true;
}

void Projectile_ResetTrail(entity this, vector to)
{
 this.trail_oldorigin = to;
 this.trail_oldtime = time;
}

void Projectile_DrawTrail(entity this, vector to)
{
 vector from = this.trail_oldorigin;

 this.trail_oldorigin = to;
 this.trail_oldtime = time;


 if (this.cnt == PROJECTILE_FIREMINE)
  if (from == to)
   from.z += 1;

 if (this.traileffect)
 {
  particles_alphamin = particles_alphamax = particles_fade = sqrt(this.alpha);
  entity eff = Effects_from(this.traileffect);
  boxparticles(_particleeffectnum(eff.eent_eff_name), this, from, to, this.velocity, this.velocity, 1, PARTICLES_USEALPHA | PARTICLES_USEFADE | PARTICLES_DRAWASTRAIL);
 }
}

void Projectile_Draw(entity this)
{
 vector rot;
 vector trailorigin;
 float f;
 float drawn;
 float t;
 float a;

 f = this.flags;

 if (this.count & 0x80)
 {

  if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_NONE || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY)
   Movetype_Physics_NoMatchServer(this);





  else
   Movetype_Physics_MatchServer(this, autocvar_cl_projectiles_sloppy);
  if (!(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
   if (this.velocity != '0 0 0')
    this.angles = vectoangles(this.velocity);
 }
 else
 {
  InterpolateOrigin_Do(this);
 }

 if (this.count & 0x80)
 {
  drawn = (time >= this.spawntime - 0.02);
  t = max(time, this.spawntime);
 }
 else
 {
  drawn = (this.iflags & IFLAG_VALID);
  t = time;
 }
 float is_nade = Projectile_isnade(this.cnt);

 if (!(f & FL_ONGROUND))
 {
  rot = '0 0 0';
  if (is_nade) rot = this.avelocity;
  else switch (this.cnt)
  {
   case PROJECTILE_GRENADE_BOUNCING:
    rot = '0 -1000 0';
    break;
   case PROJECTILE_HOOKBOMB:
    rot = '1000 0 0';
    break;
   case PROJECTILE_ROCKET:
    rot = '0 0 720';
    break;
  }

  if (rot)
  {
   if (!rot.x && !rot.y)
   {

    this.angles.z = (rot.z * (t - this.spawntime)) % 360;
    if (this.angles.z < 0)
     this.angles.z += 360;
   }
   else
    this.angles = AnglesTransform_ToAngles(AnglesTransform_Multiply(AnglesTransform_FromAngles(this.angles), rot * (t - this.spawntime)));
  }
 }

 a = 1 - (time - this.fade_time) * this.fade_rate;
 this.alpha = bound(0, this.alphamod * a, 1);
 if (this.alpha <= 0)
  drawn = 0;
 this.renderflags = 0;

 vector ang = this.angles;
 ang.x = -ang.x;
 trailorigin = this.origin;
 if (is_nade)
 {
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./client/weapons/projectile.qc", 135, __FUNC__, "\"ang\""); _makevectors_hidden(ang); }else voidfunc();
  trailorigin += v_up * 4;
 }
 else switch (this.cnt)
 {
  case PROJECTILE_GRENADE:
  case PROJECTILE_GRENADE_BOUNCING:
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./client/weapons/projectile.qc", 142, __FUNC__, "\"ang\""); _makevectors_hidden(ang); }else voidfunc();
   trailorigin += v_right * 1 + v_forward * -10;
   break;
 }

 if (drawn)
  Projectile_DrawTrail(this, trailorigin);
 else
  Projectile_ResetTrail(this, trailorigin);

 this.drawmask = 0;

 if (!drawn)
  return;

 switch (this.cnt)
 {

  default:
   break;
 }

 this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
}

void loopsound(entity e, float ch, Sound samp, float vol, float attn)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 if (e.silent)
  return;

 sound7(e, ch, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (samp), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), vol, attn, 0, 0);
 e.snd_looping = ch;
}

void Ent_RemoveProjectile(entity this)
{
 if (this.count & 0x80)
 {
  tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin + this.velocity * 0.05, MOVE_NORMAL, this);
  Projectile_DrawTrail(this, trace_endpos);
 }
}

# 1 "./common/anim.qc" 1





void anim_set(entity e, vector anim, float looping, float override, float restart)
{
 if (!anim) return;

 if (anim.x == e.animstate_startframe)
 {
  if (anim.y == e.animstate_numframes)
  {
   if (anim.z == e.animstate_framerate)
   {
    if (!restart) return;
    if (anim.y == 1)
     ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
   }
  }
 }
 e.animstate_startframe = anim.x;
 e.animstate_numframes = anim.y;
 e.animstate_framerate = anim.z;
 e.animstate_starttime = time - 0.1 * frametime;
 e.animstate_endtime = e.animstate_starttime + e.animstate_numframes / e.animstate_framerate;
 e.animstate_looping = looping;
 e.animstate_override = override;
 e.frame = e.animstate_startframe;
 e.frame1time = time;
}




void anim_update(entity e)
{
 if (time >= e.animstate_endtime)
 {
  if (e.animstate_looping)
  {
   e.animstate_starttime = e.animstate_endtime;
   e.animstate_endtime = e.animstate_starttime + e.animstate_numframes / e.animstate_framerate;
  }
  e.animstate_override = false;
 }
 float frameofs = bound(0, (time - e.animstate_starttime) * e.animstate_framerate, e.animstate_numframes - 1);
 e.frame = e.animstate_startframe + frameofs;
}

float monsters_animoverride(entity this)
{
 Monster monster_id = (0, world);
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Monsters_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != MON_Null && it.m_model.model_str() == this.model) { { { monster_id = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


   ;

 if(!monster_id) { return false; }

 monster_id.mr_anim(monster_id, this);

 vector none = '0 0 0';
 this.anim_duckwalk = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckjump = animfixfps(this, '5 1 10', none);
 this.anim_duckidle = this.anim_idle;
 this.anim_jump = animfixfps(this, '8 1 10', none);
 this.anim_taunt = animfixfps(this, '12 1 0.33', none);
 this.anim_runbackwards = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_strafeleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_straferight = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_forwardright = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_forwardleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_backright = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_backleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackwards = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkstrafeleft = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkstraferight = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkforwardright = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkforwardleft = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackright = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackleft = this.anim_walk;


 this.anim_shoot_z = 0.001;
 this.anim_melee_z = 0.001;

 return true;
}

void animdecide_load_if_needed(entity e)
{
 float mdlidx = e.modelindex;
 if (mdlidx == e.animdecide_modelindex) return;
 e.animdecide_modelindex = mdlidx;

 if(substring(e.model, 0, 16) == "models/monsters/")
 {
  if(monsters_animoverride(e))
   return;
 }



 vector none = '0 0 0';
 e.anim_die1 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_die1, mdlidx, 1, 0.5), none);
 e.anim_die2 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_die2, mdlidx, 1, 0.5), none);
 e.anim_draw = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_draw, mdlidx, 1, 3), none);
 e.anim_duckwalk = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalk, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_duckjump = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckjump, mdlidx, 1, 10), none);
 e.anim_duckidle = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckidle, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_idle = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_idle, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_jump = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_jump, mdlidx, 1, 10), none);
 e.anim_pain1 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_pain1, mdlidx, 1, 2), none);
 e.anim_pain2 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_pain2, mdlidx, 1, 2), none);
 e.anim_shoot = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_shoot, mdlidx, 1, 5), none);
 e.anim_taunt = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_taunt, mdlidx, 1, 0.33), none);
 e.anim_run = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_run, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_runbackwards = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_runbackwards, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_strafeleft = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_strafeleft, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_straferight = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_straferight, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_forwardright = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_forwardright, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_straferight, mdlidx, 1, 1));
 e.anim_forwardleft = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_forwardleft, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_strafeleft, mdlidx, 1, 1));

 e.anim_backleft = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_backleft, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_strafeleft, mdlidx, 1, 1));
 e.anim_melee = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_melee, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_shoot, mdlidx, 1, 1));
 e.anim_duckwalkbackwards = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalkbackwards, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalk, mdlidx, 1, 1));
 e.anim_duckwalkstrafeleft = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalkstrafeleft, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalk, mdlidx, 1, 1));
 e.anim_duckwalkstraferight = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalkstraferight, mdlidx, 1, 1), anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalk, mdlidx, 1, 1));

 e.anim_melee_z = 0.001;

const float ANIMPRIO_IDLE = 0;
const float ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE = 1;
const float ANIMPRIO_CROUCH = 2;
const float ANIMPRIO_DEAD = 3;

vector animdecide_getupperanim(entity e)
{

 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FROZEN)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD1)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die1_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD2)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die2_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);


 vector outframe = '-1 0 0';
 float t, a;
 if(e.anim_upper_time >= e.anim_upper_implicit_time)
 {
  a = e.anim_upper_action;
  t = e.anim_upper_time;
 }
 else
 {
  a = e.anim_upper_implicit_action;
  t = e.anim_upper_implicit_time;
 }
 switch(a)
 {
  case ANIMACTION_DRAW: outframe = e.anim_draw; break;
  case ANIMACTION_PAIN1: outframe = e.anim_pain1; break;
  case ANIMACTION_PAIN2: outframe = e.anim_pain2; break;
  case ANIMACTION_SHOOT: outframe = e.anim_shoot; break;
  case ANIMACTION_TAUNT: outframe = e.anim_taunt; break;
  case ANIMACTION_MELEE: outframe = e.anim_melee; break;
 }
 if(outframe.x >= 0)
 {
  if(time <= t + outframe.y / outframe.z)
  {

   return (_vec3.x = (outframe.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
 }

 t = max(e.anim_time, e.anim_implicit_time);

 return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_IDLE), _vec3);
}

vector animdecide_getloweranim(entity e)
{

 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FOLLOW)
  return (_vec3.x = (((e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK) ? e.anim_duckidle_x : e.anim_idle_x)), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FROZEN)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD1)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die1_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD2)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die2_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);


 vector outframe = '-1 0 0';
 float t, a;
 if(e.anim_lower_time >= e.anim_lower_implicit_time)
 {
  a = e.anim_lower_action;
  t = e.anim_lower_time;
 }
 else
 {
  a = e.anim_lower_implicit_action;
  t = e.anim_lower_implicit_time;
 }
 switch(a)
 {
  case ANIMACTION_JUMP: if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR) { if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK) outframe = e.anim_duckjump; else outframe = e.anim_jump; } break;
 }
 if(outframe.x >= 0)
 {
  if(time <= t + outframe.y / outframe.z)
  {

   return (_vec3.x = (outframe.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
 }

 t = max(e.anim_time, e.anim_implicit_time);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK)
 {
  if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR)
   return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckjump.x), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
  else switch(e.anim_implicit_state & (ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT))
  {
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalk.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackwards.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkstraferight.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkstrafeleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkforwardright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkforwardleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
  }
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckidle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
 }
 else
 {
  if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR)
   return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_jump.x), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  else switch(e.anim_implicit_state & (ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT))
  {
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_run.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_runbackwards.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_straferight.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_strafeleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_forwardright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_forwardleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_backright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_backleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_IDLE), _vec3);
 }


}

void animdecide_setimplicitstate(entity e, float onground)
{
 float s = 0;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/animdecide.qc", 252, __FUNC__, "\"e.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(e.angles); }else voidfunc();
 vector v;
 v.x = e.velocity * v_forward;
 v.y = e.velocity * v_right;
 v.z = 0;
# 268 "./common/animdecide.qc"
 if(((_vlen2 = (v), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((10) ** 2)))
 {
  if(v.x > fabs(v.y) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD;
  if(v.x < -fabs(v.y) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS;
  if(v.y > fabs(v.x) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT;
  if(v.y < -fabs(v.x) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT;
 }
 if(!onground)
  s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR;



 if(!(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR) && (s & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR))
 {
  e.anim_lower_implicit_action = ANIMACTION_JUMP;
  e.anim_lower_implicit_time = time;
 }

 if(s != e.anim_implicit_state)
 {
  e.anim_implicit_state = s;
  e.anim_implicit_time = time;
 }
}
void animdecide_setframes(entity e, float support_blending, .float fld_frame, .float fld_frame1time, .float fld_frame2, .float fld_frame2time)
{



 vector upper = animdecide_getupperanim(e);
 vector lower = animdecide_getloweranim(e);

 if(support_blending)
 {
  if(upper.z && !lower.z)
   lower = upper;
  else if(lower.z && !upper.z)
   upper = lower;
  if(e.frame1time != upper.y || e.frame2time != lower.y)
   ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
  e.(fld_frame) = upper.x;
  e.(fld_frame1time) = upper.y;
  e.(fld_frame2) = lower.x;
  e.(fld_frame2time) = lower.y;
 }
 else
 {
  if(upper.z > lower.z)
   lower = upper;
  else if(lower.z > upper.z)
   upper = lower;
  if(e.frame1time != upper.y)
   ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
  e.(fld_frame) = upper.x;
  e.(fld_frame1time) = upper.y;
 }
}

void animdecide_setstate(entity e, float newstate, float restart)
{
 if(!restart)
  if(newstate == e.anim_state)
   return;
 e.anim_state = newstate;
 e.anim_time = time;
}
void animdecide_setaction(entity e, float action, float restart)
{
 if(action < 0)
 {
  if(!restart)
   if(action == e.anim_lower_action)
    return;
  e.anim_lower_action = action;
  e.anim_lower_time = time;
 }
 else
 {
  if(!restart)
   if(action == e.anim_upper_action)
    return;
  e.anim_upper_action = action;
  e.anim_upper_time = time;
 }
}

string unquote(string s)
{
 float l = strlen(s);
 for(float i = 0; i < l; ++i)
 {
  string ch = substring(s, i, 1);
  if((ch != " ") && (ch != "\""))
  {
   for(float j = l - i - 1; j > 0; --j)
   {
    ch = substring(s, i+j, 1);
    if(ch != " ") if(ch != "\"")
     return substring(s, i, j+1);
   }
   return substring(s, i, 1);
  }
 }
 return "";
}

float _MapInfo_Generate(string pFilename)
{

 if(fh < 0)
  return 0;
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "291")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Analyzing ", fn, " to generate initial mapinfo"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

 mapMaxs = '0 0 0';

  float arena_fh = -1;
  string arena_fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".arena");
  if(arena_fn != "")
   arena_fh = fopen(arena_fn, FILE_READ);
  if(arena_fh < 0)
  {
   isdefi = true;
   arena_fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".defi");
   if(arena_fn != "")
    arena_fh = fopen(arena_fn, FILE_READ);
  }
  if(arena_fh >= 0)
  {
   _MapInfo_ParseArena(arena_fn, arena_fh, pFilename, (0, world), isdefi, true);
   fclose(arena_fh);
  }
 }

   break;
  if(inWorldspawn == 1)

   else if(k == "_description")

   else if(k == "noise")

   {

     MapInfo_Map_author = substring(v, i + 4, strlen(v) - (i + 4));
    }
    else
     MapInfo_Map_title = v;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   if(k == "origin")
   {
    o = stov(strcat("'", v, "'"));
    mapMins.x = min(mapMins.x, o.x);
    mapMins.y = min(mapMins.y, o.y);
    mapMins.z = min(mapMins.z, o.z);
    mapMaxs.x = max(mapMaxs.x, o.x);
    mapMaxs.y = max(mapMaxs.y, o.y);
    mapMaxs.z = max(mapMaxs.z, o.z);
   }
   else if(k == "race_place")
   {
    if(stof(v) > 0)
     spawnplaces = 1;
   }
   else if(k == "classname")
   {
    if(v == "info_player_team1")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_team2")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_start")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_deathmatch")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "weapon_nex")
     { }
    else if(v == "weapon_railgun")
     { }
    else if((strstrofs(v, "weapon_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;
    else if((strstrofs(v, "turret_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_TURRETS;
    else if((strstrofs(v, "vehicle_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_VEHICLES;
    else if((strstrofs(v, "monster_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_MONSTERS;
    else if(v == "target_music" || v == "trigger_music")
     _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music = nil;
    else if(v == "target_stopTimer")
     is_q3df_map = true;
    else
     if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { it.m_generate_mapinfo(it, v); } } } }else voidfunc();
   }
  }
 }
 if(inWorldspawn)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "407")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(fn, " ended still in worldspawn, BUG"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return 0;
 }
 diameter = vlen(mapMaxs - mapMins);

 float twoBaseModes = 0;
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_isTwoBaseMode()) { { twoBaseModes |= it.m_flags; } } } }else voidfunc();
 if(twoBaseModes && (twoBaseModes &= MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes))
 {

 }
 else if(!is_q3df_map)
 {
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_isAlwaysSupported(it, spawnpoints, diameter)) { { MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= it.m_flags; } } } }else voidfunc();
 }

 if(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes & MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE.m_flags)
 if(!spawnplaces)
 {
  MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes &= ~MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE.m_flags;
  MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS.m_flags;
 }

 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "430")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("-> diameter ", ftos(diameter)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "431")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(";  spawnpoints ", ftos(spawnpoints)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "432")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(";  modes ", ftos(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();

 fclose(fh);

 return r;
}

void _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype(string s, Gametype pWantedType, Gametype pThisType, float load_default)
{
 string sa;
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= pThisType.m_flags;
 if(!(pThisType.m_flags & pWantedType.m_flags))
  return;

 if(load_default)
  _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype(_MapInfo_GetDefault(pThisType), pWantedType, pThisType, false);

 if(!pWantedType.frags)
 {
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");
 }
 else
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }

 sa = car(s);
 if(sa != "")
  cvar_set("timelimit", sa);
 s = cdr(s);

 if(pWantedType.m_setTeams)
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   pWantedType.m_setTeams(sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }


 if(pWantedType == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE)
 {
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");

  sa = car(s); if(sa == "") sa = cvar_string("timelimit");
  cvar_set("g_race_qualifying_timelimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);

  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   if(cvar("g_race_teams") < 2)
    cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);

  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   if(cvar("g_race_teams") >= 2)
    cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }

 if(!pWantedType.frags)
 {
  cvar_set("leadlimit", "0");
 }
 else
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   cvar_set("leadlimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }
}

void _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametypeEx(string s, Gametype pWantedType, Gametype pThisType)
{
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= pThisType.m_flags;
 if (!(pThisType.m_flags & pWantedType.m_flags))
  return;



 cvar_set("timelimit", cvar_defstring("timelimit"));
 cvar_set("leadlimit", cvar_defstring("leadlimit"));
 cvar_set("fraglimit", cvar_defstring("fraglimit"));
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { it.m_parse_mapinfo(nil, nil); } } } }else voidfunc();

 string fraglimit_normal = nil;
 string fraglimit_teams = nil;

 for (s = strcat(_MapInfo_GetDefaultEx(pWantedType), " ", s); s != ""; s = cdr(s)) {
  string sa = car(s);
  if (sa == "") continue;
  float p = strstrofs(sa, "=", 0);
  if (p < 0) {
   if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "561")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Invalid gametype setting in mapinfo for gametype %s: %s", MapInfo_Type_ToString(pWantedType), sa), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   continue;
  }
  string k = substring(sa, 0, p);
  string v = substring(sa, p + 1, -1);
  float handled = true;
  switch (k) {
   case "timelimit":
   {
    cvar_set("timelimit", v);
    break;
   }
   case "leadlimit":
   {
    cvar_set("leadlimit", v);
    break;
   }
   case "pointlimit":
   case "fraglimit":
   case "lives":
   case "laplimit":
   case "caplimit":
   {
    fraglimit_normal = v;
    break;
   }
   case "teampointlimit":
   case "teamlaplimit":
   {
    fraglimit_teams = v;
    break;
   }
   default:
   {
       handled = false;
       break;
   }
  }
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { handled |= it.m_parse_mapinfo(k, v); } } } }else voidfunc();
  if (!handled && (!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
            if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "601")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Invalid gametype setting in mapinfo for gametype %s: %s", MapInfo_Type_ToString(pWantedType), sa), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }

 if (pWantedType == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE && cvar("g_race_teams") >= 2)
 {
  if(fraglimit_teams)
   cvar_set("fraglimit", fraglimit_teams);
 }
 else
 {
  if(fraglimit_normal)
   cvar_set("fraglimit", fraglimit_normal);
 }
}

Gametype MapInfo_Type_FromString(string gtype, float dowarn, float is_q3compat)
{
 string replacement = "";
 float do_warn = true;
 switch (gtype)
 {
  case "nexball": replacement = "nb"; break;
  case "freezetag": replacement = "ft"; break;
  case "keepaway": replacement = "ka"; break;
  case "invasion": replacement = "inv"; break;
  case "assault": replacement = "as"; break;
  case "race": replacement = "rc"; break;

  case "ffa": replacement = "dm"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "cctf":
  case "oneflag": replacement = "ctf"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "tournament":
  case "tourney": replacement = "duel"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "arena": if(is_q3compat) { replacement = "ca"; do_warn = false; } break;
 }
 if (replacement != "")
 {
  if (dowarn && (!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "639")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("MapInfo_Type_FromString (probably %s): using deprecated name '%s'. Should use '%s'.", MapInfo_Map_bspname, gtype, replacement), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  gtype = replacement;
 }
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.mdl == gtype) { { return it; } } } }else voidfunc();
 return (0, world);
}
