void _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(string pFilename, string acl, float type, string s, float recurse)
{
 string t;
 float o;

 s = strreplace("\t", "", s);

 t = car(s); s = cdr(s);



 if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "\"")
 {
  if(substring(t, -1, 1) == "\"")
   t = substring(t, 1, -2);
 }


 if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "\"")
 {
  s = substring(s, 1, -1);
 }

 o = strstrofs(s, "\"", 0);
 if(o >= 0)
  s = substring(s, 0, o);


 o = strstrofs(s, "//", 0);
 if(o >= 0)
  s = substring(s, 0, o);


 while(substring(s, -1, 1) == " ")
  s = substring(s, 0, -2);

 if(t == "#include")
 {
  if(recurse > 0)
  {
   float fh = fopen(s, FILE_READ);
   if(fh < 0)
   {
    if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "706")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " references not existing config file ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
   {
    while((s = fgets(fh)))
    {
     s = strreplace("\t", "", s);

     if(s == "")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "#")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "_")
      continue;

     if(substring(s, 0, 4) == "set ")
      s = substring(s, 4, -1);
     if(substring(s, 0, 5) == "seta ")
      s = substring(s, 5, -1);

     _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(pFilename, acl, type, s, recurse - 1);
    }
    fclose(fh);
   }
  }
  else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "734")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " uses too many levels of inclusion"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(t == ""
  || !cvar_value_issafe(t)
  || !cvar_value_issafe(s)
  || matchacl("-g_mapinfo_* -rcon_* -_* -g_ban* +*", t) <= 0)
 {
  if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "742")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a potentially harmful setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(matchacl(acl, t) <= 0)
 {
  if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "747")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a denied setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  if(type == 0)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "753")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Applying temporary setting ", t, " := ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();





    cvar_settemp(t, s);
  }
  else
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "763")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Applying temporary client setting ", t, " := ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   MapInfo_Map_clientstuff = strcat(
     MapInfo_Map_clientstuff, "cl_cmd settemp \"", t, "\" \"", s, "\"\n"
     );
  }
 }
}

float MapInfo_isRedundant(string fn, string t)
{

 fn = strreplace("_", "", fn);
 fn = strreplace("-", "", fn);


 t = strreplace(":", "", t);
 t = strreplace(" ", "", t);
 t = strreplace("_", "", t);
 t = strreplace("-", "", t);
 t = strreplace("'", "", t);
 t = strdecolorize(t);



 if(!strcasecmp(fn, t))
  return true;

 return false;
}

float _MapInfo_ParseArena(string arena_filename, float fh, string pFilename, Gametype pGametypeToSet, float isdefi, float isgenerator)
{


 float in_brackets = false;
 float dosave = false;
 string stored_Map_description = "";
 string stored_Map_title = "";
 string stored_Map_author = "";
 float stored_supportedGametypes = 0;
 float stored_supportedFeatures = 0;
 float stored_flags = 0;
 string t, s;
 for (;;)
 {
  if (!((s = fgets(fh))))
   break;


  if(s == "")
   continue;
  if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
   continue;
  if(strstrofs(s, "{", 0) >= 0)
  {
   if(in_brackets)
    return false;
   in_brackets = true;
   continue;
  }
  else if(!in_brackets)
  {

   continue;
  }
  if(strstrofs(s, "}", 0) >= 0)
  {
   if(!in_brackets)
    return false;
   in_brackets = false;
   if(dosave)
   {
    MapInfo_Map_description = stored_Map_description;
    if(stored_Map_title != "")
     MapInfo_Map_title = stored_Map_title;
    MapInfo_Map_author = stored_Map_author;
    if(isgenerator)
     MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes = stored_supportedGametypes;
    else
    {
     if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_flags & stored_supportedGametypes) { { { _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype ("", pGametypeToSet, it, true); }; } } } }else voidfunc()


       ;
    }
    MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures = stored_supportedFeatures;
    MapInfo_Map_flags = stored_flags;
    return true;
   }
   else
   {

    stored_Map_description = "";
    stored_Map_title = "";
    stored_Map_author = "";
    stored_supportedGametypes = 0;
    stored_supportedFeatures = 0;
    stored_flags = 0;
    continue;
   }
  }

  s = strreplace("\t", " ", s);

  float p = strstrofs(s, "//", 0);
  if(p >= 0)
   s = substring(s, 0, p);



  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);

  t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
  t = strtolower(t);


  while(substring(t, -1, 1) == " ")
   t = substring(t, 0, -2);


  while(substring(s, -1, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 0, -2);

  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);


  if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "\"")
  {
   if(substring(s, -1, 1) == "\"")
    s = substring(s, 1, -2);
  }
  if(t == "longname")
   stored_Map_title = s;
  else if(t == "author")
   stored_Map_author = s;
  else if(t == "type")
  {

   stored_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;


   string types = s;
   types = strreplace("team", "tdm ft", types);
   types = strreplace("ffa", "dm lms ka", types);
   if(strstrofs(types, "tournament", 0) < 0 && strstrofs(types, "tdm", 0) >= 0)
    types = cons(types, "ca kh");
   if(1){ string _words = types; float _i = 0; for (string _it; (_it = car(_words)); (_words = cdr(_words), ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref string it = _it; if (true) { { { Gametype f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(it, false, true); if(f) stored_supportedGametypes |= f.m_flags; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




     ;
  }
  else if(t == "style" && isdefi)
  {


   stored_supportedGametypes |= MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS.m_flags;
  }
  else if(t == "map")
  {
   if(strtolower(s) == strtolower(pFilename))
    dosave = true;
  }
  else if(t == "quote")
   stored_Map_description = s;

 }


 return false;
}

string _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(string pFilename, string pMapname)
{


 float fh = fopen(pFilename, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
  return "";
 for(string s; (s = fgets(fh)); )
 {
  s = strreplace("\t", "", s);
  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);
  if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
   continue;
  if(s == "")
   continue;
  float offset = strstrofs(s, "map", 0);
  if(offset >= 0)
  {
   if(strstrofs(strtolower(s), strcat("\"", strtolower(pMapname), "\""), offset) >= 0)
   {
    fclose(fh);
    return pFilename;
   }
  }
 }
 fclose(fh);
 return "";
}

string _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(string pFilename, string extension)
{
 string fallback = strcat("scripts/", pFilename, extension);
 if(!checkextension("DP_QC_FS_SEARCH_PACKFILE"))
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);
 string base_pack = whichpack(strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".bsp"));
 if(base_pack == "")
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);

 float glob = search_packfile_begin(strcat("scripts/*", extension), true, true, base_pack);
 if(glob < 0)
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);
 float n = search_getsize(glob);
 for(float j = 0; j < n; ++j)
 {
  string file = search_getfilename(glob, j);
  if(_MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(file, pFilename) != "")
  {
   search_end(glob);
   return file;
  }
 }

 search_end(glob);
 return "";
}


float MapInfo_Get_ByName_NoFallbacks(string pFilename, float pAllowGenerate, Gametype pGametypeToSet)
{
 string fn;
 string s, t;
 float fh;
 float f, i;
 float r, n;
 string acl;

 acl = cvar_string("g_mapinfo_settemp_acl");

 if(strstrofs(pFilename, "/", 0) >= 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1009")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Invalid character in map name, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return 0;
 }

 if(pGametypeToSet == (0, world))
  if(MapInfo_Cache_Retrieve(pFilename))
   return 1;

 r = 1;

 MapInfo_Map_bspname = pFilename;


 fn = strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".mapinfo");
 fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat)
  {
   float isdefi = false;
   if(autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat == 1)
   {
    fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".arena");
    if(fn != "")
     fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   }
   if(fh < 0 || autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat == 2)
   {
    isdefi = true;
    fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".defi");
    if(fn != "")
     fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   }
   if(fh >= 0)
   {
    _MapInfo_Map_Reset();
    if(_MapInfo_ParseArena(fn, fh, pFilename, pGametypeToSet, isdefi, false))
     goto mapinfo_handled;
   }
  }

  fn = strcat("maps/autogenerated/", pFilename, ".mapinfo");
  fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
  if(fh < 0)
  {
   if(!pAllowGenerate)
    return 0;
   _MapInfo_Map_Reset();
   r = _MapInfo_Generate(pFilename);
   if(!r)
    return 0;
   fh = fopen(fn, FILE_WRITE);
   fputs(fh, strcat("title ", MapInfo_Map_title, "\n"));
   fputs(fh, strcat("description ", MapInfo_Map_description, "\n"));
   fputs(fh, strcat("author ", MapInfo_Map_author, "\n"));
   if(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music != "")
   {
    if(strcasecmp(substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, -4, 4), ".wav") == 0 || strcasecmp(substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, -4, 4), ".ogg") == 0)
     fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, 0, -4), "\n"));
    else
     fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, "\n"));

    {
     i = floor(random() * n);
     if(strstrofs(s, strcat(" ", argv(i), " "), 0) < 0)
      break;
    }
    fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", ftos(i + 1), "\n"));
   }
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS)
    fputs(fh, "has weapons\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added weapon pickups: has weapons\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_TURRETS)
    fputs(fh, "has turrets\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added turrets: has turrets\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_VEHICLES)
    fputs(fh, "has vehicles\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added vehicles: has vehicles\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_flags & MAPINFO_FLAG_FRUSTRATING)
    fputs(fh, "frustrating\n");

     ;

   fputs(fh, "// optional: fog density red green blue alpha mindist maxdist\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: settemp_for_type (all|gametypename) cvarname value\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: clientsettemp_for_type (all|gametypename) cvarname value\n");

   fputs(fh, "// optional: hidden\n");

   fclose(fh);
   r = 2;

   fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   if(fh < 0)
    (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("... but I just wrote it!"));
  }

  if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))

  else if(t == "type")
  {

   Gametype f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(t, true, false);

   else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))

     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1278")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a potentially harmful fog setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   }

  }
  else if(t == "cdtrack")

 :mapinfo_handled

 if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))

float MapReadSizes(string map)
{

 string readsize_msg = strcat("MapReadSizes ", map);
 float fh = fopen(strcat("maps/", map, ".sizes"), FILE_READ);
 if(fh >= 0)
 {
  map_minplayers = stof(fgets(fh));
  map_maxplayers = stof(fgets(fh));
  fclose(fh);
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1354")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf(readsize_msg, ": ok, min %d max %d", map_minplayers, map_maxplayers), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return true;
 }
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1357")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(readsize_msg, ": not found"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 return false;
}

float MapInfo_FindName(string s)
{



 float l, r, m, cmp;
 l = 0;
 r = MapInfo_count;

 while(l != r)
 {
  m = floor((l + r) / 2);
  MapInfo_FindName_match = _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(m));
  cmp = strcasecmp(MapInfo_FindName_match, s);
  if(cmp == 0)
   return m;
  if(cmp < 0)
   l = m + 1;
  else
   r = m;
 }
 MapInfo_FindName_match = _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(l));
 MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = l;



 if(l == MapInfo_count)
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = -1;
  return -1;
 }
 if(!startsWithNocase(MapInfo_FindName_match, s))
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = -1;
  return -1;
 }
 if(l == MapInfo_count - 1)
  return l;
 if(startsWithNocase(_MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(l + 1)), s))
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  return -1;
 }
 return l;
}

string MapInfo_FixName(string s)
{
 MapInfo_FindName(s);
 return MapInfo_FindName_match;
}

float MapInfo_CurrentFeatures()
{
 float req = 0;

 if(!(cvar("g_instagib") || cvar("g_overkill") || cvar("g_nix") || cvar("g_weaponarena") || !cvar("g_pickup_items") || !cvar("g_melee_only")
  || cvar("g_race") || cvar("g_cts") || cvar("g_nexball") || cvar("g_ca") || cvar("g_freezetag") || cvar("g_lms")))
  req |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;
 return req;
}

Gametype MapInfo_CurrentGametype()
{
 Gametype prev = MapInfo_Type_FromString(cvar_string("gamecfg"), false, false);
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (cvar(it.netname) && it != prev) { { return it; } } } }else voidfunc();
 return prev ? prev : MAPINFO_TYPE_DEATHMATCH;
}

float _MapInfo_CheckMap(string s, float gametype_only)
{
 if(!MapInfo_Get_ByName(s, 1, (0, world)))
  return 0;
 if((MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes & MapInfo_CurrentGametype().m_flags) == 0)
  return 0;
 if (gametype_only)
  return 1;
 if((MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MapInfo_CurrentFeatures()) != MapInfo_CurrentFeatures())
  return 0;
 return 1;
}

float MapInfo_CheckMap(string s)
{
 float r;
 r = _MapInfo_CheckMap(s, false);
 MapInfo_ClearTemps();
 return r;
}

{
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { cvar_set(it.netname, (it == t) ? "1" : "0"); } } } }else voidfunc();
}

void MapInfo_LoadMap(string s, float reinit)
{
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes = 0;







 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1468")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Switching to map ", s); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

  localcmd(strcat("\nmap ", s, "\n"));
 else

}

string MapInfo_ListAllowedMaps(Gametype type, float pRequiredFlags, float pForbiddenFlags)
{
 string out;


 MapInfo_Enumerate();
 MapInfo_FilterGametype(type, MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), pRequiredFlags, pForbiddenFlags, 0);

 out = "";
 for(float i = 0; i < MapInfo_count; ++i)
  out = strcat(out, " ", _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(i)));
 return substring(out, 1, strlen(out) - 1);
}

string MapInfo_ListAllAllowedMaps(float pRequiredFlags, float pForbiddenFlags)
{
 string out;


 MapInfo_Enumerate();
 _MapInfo_FilterGametype(MAPINFO_TYPE_ALL, 0, pRequiredFlags, pForbiddenFlags, 0);

 out = "";
 for(float i = 0; i < MapInfo_count; ++i)
  out = strcat(out, " ", _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(i)));

 MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), pRequiredFlags, pForbiddenFlags, 0);

 return substring(out, 1, strlen(out) - 1);
}

void MapInfo_LoadMapSettings(string s)
{
 Gametype t = MapInfo_CurrentGametype();
 MapInfo_LoadMapSettings_SaveGameType(t);

 if(!_MapInfo_CheckMap(s, true))
 {

vector findbetterlocation (vector org, float mindist)
{
 vector vec = mindist * '1 0 0';
 float c = 0;
 while (c < 6)
 {
  traceline (org, org + vec, true, (0, world));
  vec = vec * -1;
  if (trace_fraction < 1)
  {
   vector loc = trace_endpos;
   traceline (loc, loc + vec, true, (0, world));
   if (trace_fraction >= 1)
    org = loc + vec;
  }
  if (c & 1)
  {
   float h = vec.y;
   vec.y = vec.x;
   vec.x = vec.z;
   vec.z = h;
  }
  c = c + 1;
 }

 return org;
}




vector real_origin(entity ent)
{
 vector v = ((ent.absmin + ent.absmax) * 0.5);
 entity e = ent.tag_entity;

 while(e)
 {
  v = v + ((e.absmin + e.absmax) * 0.5);
  e = e.tag_entity;
 }

 return v;
}


string wordwrap_buffer;

void wordwrap_buffer_put(string s)
{
 wordwrap_buffer = strcat(wordwrap_buffer, s);
}

string wordwrap(string s, float l)
{
 string r;
 wordwrap_buffer = "";
 wordwrap_cb(s, l, wordwrap_buffer_put);
 r = wordwrap_buffer;
 wordwrap_buffer = "";
 return r;
}

void mut_set_active(float mut)
{
 if (mut >= 24)
  active_mutators[1] |= (1 << (mut - 24));
 else
  active_mutators[0] |= (1 << (mut));
}

float mut_is_active(float mut)
{
 if (mut >= 24)
  return (active_mutators[1] & ((1 << (mut - 24))));
 else
  return (active_mutators[0] & (1 << (mut)));
}

void wordwrap_cb(string s, float l, void(string) callback)
{
 string c;
 float lleft, i, j, wlen;

 s = strzone(s);
 lleft = l;
 float len = strlen(s);
 for (i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  if (substring(s, i, 2) == "\\n")
  {
   callback("\n");
   lleft = l;
   ++i;
  }
  else if (substring(s, i, 1) == "\n")
  {
   callback("\n");
   lleft = l;
  }
  else if (substring(s, i, 1) == " ")
  {
   if (lleft > 0)
   {
    callback(" ");
    --lleft;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   for (j = i+1; j < len; ++j)







   {
    c = substring(s, j, 1);
    if (c == " ")
     break;
    if (c == "\\")
     break;
    if (c == "\n")
     break;



    callback("");
   }
   wlen = j - i;
   if (lleft < wlen)
   {
    callback("\n");
    lleft = l;
   }
   callback(substring(s, i, wlen));
   lleft -= wlen;
   i = j - 1;
  }
 }
 strunzone(s);
}

void depthfirst(entity start, .entity up, .entity downleft, .entity right, void(entity, entity) funcPre, void(entity, entity) funcPost, entity pass)
{
 entity e;
 e = start;
 funcPre(pass, e);
 while (e.(downleft))
 {
  e = e.(downleft);
  funcPre(pass, e);
 }
 funcPost(pass, e);
 while(e != start)
 {
  if (e.(right))
  {
   e = e.(right);
   funcPre(pass, e);
   while (e.(downleft))
   {
    e = e.(downleft);
    funcPre(pass, e);
   }
  }
  else
   e = e.(up);
  funcPost(pass, e);
 }
}


string ScoreString(float pFlags, float pValue, float rounds_played)
{
 string valstr;
 float l;

 pValue = floor(pValue + 0.5);

 if((pValue == 0) && (pFlags & (SFL_HIDE_ZERO | SFL_RANK | SFL_TIME)))
  valstr = "";
 else if(pFlags & SFL_RANK)
  valstr = (pValue < 256 ? count_ordinal(pValue) : _("N/A"));
 else if(pFlags & SFL_TIME)
  valstr = clockedtime_tostring(pValue, true, true);
 else if (rounds_played)
  valstr = sprintf("%.1f", pValue / rounds_played);
 else
  valstr = ftos(pValue);

 return valstr;
}
# 407 "./common/util.qc"
float lengthLogTable[128];

float invertLengthLog(float dist)
{
 float l, r, m;

 if(dist >= lengthLogTable[127])
  return 127;
 if(dist <= lengthLogTable[0])
  return 0;

 l = 0;
 r = 127;

 while(r - l > 1)
 {
  m = floor((l + r) / 2);
  if(lengthLogTable[m] < dist)
   l = m;
  else
   r = m;
 }


 float lerr = (dist - lengthLogTable[l]);
 float rerr = (lengthLogTable[r] - dist);
 if(lerr < rerr)
  return l;
 return r;
}

vector decompressShortVector(float data)
{
 vector out;
 if(data == 0)
  return '0 0 0';
 float p = (data & 0xF000) / 0x1000;
 float q = (data & 0x0F80) / 0x80;
 float len = (data & 0x007F);



 if(p == 0)
 {
  out.x = 0;
  out.y = 0;
  if(q == 31)
   out.z = -1;
  else
   out.z = +1;
 }
 else
 {
  q = .19634954084936207740 * q;
  p = .19634954084936207740 * p - 1.57079632679489661922;
  out.x = cos(q) * cos(p);
  out.y = sin(q) * cos(p);
  out.z = -sin(p);
 }



 return out * lengthLogTable[len];
}

float compressShortVector(vector vec)
{
 vector ang;
 float p, y, len;
 if(vec == '0 0 0')
  return 0;

 ang = vectoangles(vec);
 ang.x = -ang.x;
 if(ang.x < -90)
  ang.x += 360;
 if(ang.x < -90 && ang.x > +90)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("BOGUS vectoangles"));


 p = floor(0.5 + (ang.x + 90) * 16 / 180) & 15;
 if(p == 0)
 {
  if(vec.z < 0)
   y = 31;
  else
   y = 30;
 }
 else
  y = floor(0.5 + ang.y * 32 / 360) & 31;
 len = invertLengthLog(vlen(vec));



 return (p * 0x1000) + (y * 0x80) + len;
}

[[accumulate]] void _static_compressShortVector_1(); [[accumulate]] void __static_init_1() { _static_compressShortVector_1(); } void _static_compressShortVector_1()
{
 float l = 1;
 float f = (2 ** (1/8));
 float i;
 for(i = 0; i < 128; ++i)
 {
  lengthLogTable[i] = l;
  l *= f;
 }

 if(cvar("developer") > 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "517")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Verifying vector compression table..."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  for(i = 0x0F00; i < 0xFFFF; ++i)
   if(i != compressShortVector(decompressShortVector(i)))
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^1FATAL""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "521")), "\n"))); (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("BROKEN vector compression: %s -> %s -> %s", ftos(i), vtos(decompressShortVector(i)), ftos(compressShortVector(decompressShortVector(i)))), "\n"))); }else voidfunc()




                 ;
   }
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "528")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Done."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
}


float CheckWireframeBox(entity forent, vector v0, vector dvx, vector dvy, vector dvz)
{
 traceline(v0, v0 + dvx, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0, v0 + dvy, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0, v0 + dvz, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvx, v0 + dvx + dvy, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvx, v0 + dvx + dvz, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvy, v0 + dvy + dvx, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvy, v0 + dvy + dvz, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvz, v0 + dvz + dvx, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvz, v0 + dvz + dvy, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;

 traceline(v0 + dvx + dvz, v0 + dvx + dvy + dvz, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 traceline(v0 + dvy + dvz, v0 + dvx + dvy + dvz, true, forent); if(trace_fraction < 1) return 0;
 return 1;
}


string fixPriorityList(string order, float from, float to, float subtract, float complete)
{
 string neworder;
 float i, n, w;

 n = tokenize_console(order);
 neworder = "";
 for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
 {
  w = stof(argv(i));
  if(w == floor(w))
  {
   if(w >= from && w <= to)
    neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
   else
   {
    w -= subtract;
    if(w >= from && w <= to)
     neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
   }
  }
 }

 if(complete)
 {
  n = tokenize_console(neworder);
  for(w = to; w >= from; --w)
  {
   float wflags = Weapons_from(w).spawnflags;
   if(wflags & WEP_FLAG_SPECIALATTACK)
    continue;
   for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    if(stof(argv(i)) == w)
     break;
   if(i == n)
    neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
  }
 }

 return substring(neworder, 0, strlen(neworder) - 1);
}

string mapPriorityList(string order, string(string) mapfunc)
{
 string neworder;
 float n;

 n = tokenize_console(order);
 neworder = "";
 for(float i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  neworder = strcat(neworder, mapfunc(argv(i)), " ");

 return substring(neworder, 0, strlen(neworder) - 1);
}

string swapInPriorityList(string order, float i, float j)
{
 float n = tokenize_console(order);

 if(i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && i != j)
 {
  string s = "";
  for(float w = 0; w < n; ++w)
  {
   if(w == i)
    s = strcat(s, argv(j), " ");
   else if(w == j)
    s = strcat(s, argv(i), " ");
   else
    s = strcat(s, argv(w), " ");
  }
  return substring(s, 0, strlen(s) - 1);
 }

 return order;
}

void get_mi_min_max_texcoords(float mode)
{
 vector extend;

 get_mi_min_max(mode);

 mi_picmin = mi_min;
 mi_picmax = mi_max;



 extend = mi_picmax - mi_picmin;
 if(extend.y > extend.x)
 {
  mi_picmin.x -= (extend.y - extend.x) * 0.5;
  mi_picmax.x += (extend.y - extend.x) * 0.5;
 }
 else
 {
  mi_picmin.y -= (extend.x - extend.y) * 0.5;
  mi_picmax.y += (extend.x - extend.y) * 0.5;
 }


 extend = (mi_picmax - mi_picmin) * (1 / 64.0);
 mi_picmin -= extend;
 mi_picmax += extend;


 mi_pictexcoord0 = mi_pictexcoord1 = mi_pictexcoord2 = mi_pictexcoord3 = '0 0 0';

 mi_pictexcoord0_x = (mi_min.x - mi_picmin.x) / (mi_picmax.x - mi_picmin.x);
 mi_pictexcoord0_y = (mi_min.y - mi_picmin.y) / (mi_picmax.y - mi_picmin.y);
 mi_pictexcoord2_x = (mi_max.x - mi_picmin.x) / (mi_picmax.x - mi_picmin.x);
 mi_pictexcoord2_y = (mi_max.y - mi_picmin.y) / (mi_picmax.y - mi_picmin.y);

 mi_pictexcoord1_x = mi_pictexcoord0_x;
 mi_pictexcoord1_y = mi_pictexcoord2_y;
 mi_pictexcoord3_x = mi_pictexcoord2_x;
 mi_pictexcoord3_y = mi_pictexcoord0_y;
}

float textLengthUpToWidth(string theText, float maxWidth, vector theSize, textLengthUpToWidth_widthFunction_t w)
{





 if(w(theText, theSize) <= maxWidth)
  return strlen(theText);

 float colors = (w("^7", theSize) == 0);


 float len, left, right, middle;
 left = 0;
 right = len = strlen(theText);
 float ofs = 0;
 do
 {
  middle = floor((left + right) / 2);
  if(colors)
  {
   vector res = checkColorCode(theText, len, middle, false);
   ofs = (res.x) ? res.x - res.y : 0;
  }

  if(w(substring(theText, 0, middle + ofs), theSize) <= maxWidth)
   left = middle + ofs;
  else
   right = middle;
 }
 while(left < right - 1);

 return left;
}

float textLengthUpToLength(string theText, float maxLength, textLengthUpToLength_lenFunction_t w)
{





 if(w(theText) <= maxLength)
  return strlen(theText);

 float colors = (w("^7") == 0);


 float len, left, right, middle;
 left = 0;
 right = len = strlen(theText);
 float ofs = 0;
 do
 {
  middle = floor((left + right) / 2);
  if(colors)
  {
   vector res = checkColorCode(theText, len, middle, true);
   ofs = (!res.x) ? 0 : res.x - res.y;
  }

  if(w(substring(theText, 0, middle + ofs)) <= maxLength)
   left = middle + ofs;
  else
   right = middle;
 }
 while(left < right - 1);

 return left;
}

string find_last_color_code(string s)
{
 float start = strstrofs(s, "^", 0);
 if (start == -1)
  return "";
 float len = strlen(s)-1;
 for(float i = len; i >= start; --i)
 {
  if(substring(s, i, 1) != "^")
   continue;

  float carets = 1;
  while (i-carets >= start && substring(s, i-carets, 1) == "^")
   ++carets;


  if (carets & 1)
  {
   if(i+1 <= len)
   if((strstrofs(DIGITS, (substring(s, i+1, 1)), 0) >= 0))
    return substring(s, i, 2);

   if(i+4 <= len)
   if(substring(s, i+1, 1) == "x")
   if((strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 2, 1)), 0) >= 0))
   if((strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 3, 1)), 0) >= 0))
   if((strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 4, 1)), 0) >= 0))
    return substring(s, i, 5);
  }
  i -= carets;
 }

 return "";
}

string getWrappedLine(float maxWidth, vector theFontSize, textLengthUpToWidth_widthFunction_t tw)
{
 string s = getWrappedLine_remaining;

 if(maxWidth <= 0)
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }

 float take_until = textLengthUpToWidth(s, maxWidth, theFontSize, tw);
 if(take_until > 0 && take_until < strlen(s))
 {
  float last_word = take_until - 1;
  while(last_word > 0 && substring(s, last_word, 1) != " ")
   --last_word;

  float skip = 0;
  if(last_word != 0)
  {
   take_until = last_word;
   skip = 1;
  }

  getWrappedLine_remaining = substring(s, take_until + skip, strlen(s) - take_until);
  if(getWrappedLine_remaining == "")
   getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  else if (tw("^7", theFontSize) == 0)
   getWrappedLine_remaining = strcat(find_last_color_code(substring(s, 0, take_until)), getWrappedLine_remaining);
  return substring(s, 0, take_until);
 }
 else
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }
}

 string s = getWrappedLine_remaining;

 if(maxLength <= 0)
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }

 float take_until = textLengthUpToLength(s, maxLength, tw);
 if(take_until > 0 && take_until < strlen(s))
 {
  float last_word = take_until - 1;
  while(last_word > 0 && substring(s, last_word, 1) != " ")
   --last_word;

  float skip = 0;
  if(last_word != 0)
  {
   take_until = last_word;
   skip = 1;
  }

  getWrappedLine_remaining = substring(s, take_until + skip, strlen(s) - take_until);
  if(getWrappedLine_remaining == "")
   getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  else if (tw("^7") == 0)
   getWrappedLine_remaining = strcat(find_last_color_code(substring(s, 0, take_until)), getWrappedLine_remaining);
  return substring(s, 0, take_until);
 }
 else
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }
}

float isGametypeInFilter(Gametype gt, float tp, float ts, string pattern)
{
 string subpattern, subpattern2, subpattern3, subpattern4;
 subpattern = strcat(",", MapInfo_Type_ToString(gt), ",");
 if(tp)
  subpattern2 = ",teams,";
 else
  subpattern2 = ",noteams,";
 if(ts)
  subpattern3 = ",teamspawns,";
 else
  subpattern3 = ",noteamspawns,";
 if(gt == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE || gt == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS)
  subpattern4 = ",race,";
 else
  subpattern4 = nil;

 if(substring(pattern, 0, 1) == "-")
 {
  pattern = substring(pattern, 1, strlen(pattern) - 1);
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern2, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern3, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(subpattern4 && strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern4, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
 }
 else
 {
  if(substring(pattern, 0, 1) == "+")
   pattern = substring(pattern, 1, strlen(pattern) - 1);
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern, 0) < 0)
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern2, 0) < 0)
  if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern3, 0) < 0)
  {
   if (!subpattern4)
    return 0;
   if(strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern4, 0) < 0)
    return 0;
  }
 }
 return 1;
}

vector solve_shotdirection(vector myorg, vector myvel, vector eorg, vector evel, float spd, float newton_style)
{
 vector ret;


 eorg -= myorg;
 if(newton_style)
  evel -= myvel;







 vector solution = solve_quadratic(evel * evel - spd * spd, 2 * (eorg * evel), eorg * eorg);


 if(!solution.z)
 {







  return '0 0 0';
 }
 else if(solution.x > 0)
 {


  ret = normalize(eorg + solution.x * evel);
 }
 else if(solution.y > 0)
 {


  ret = normalize(eorg + solution.y * evel);
 }
 else
 {
# 1136 "./common/util.qc"
  return '0 0 0';
 }



 if(newton_style == 2)
  ret = normalize(ret * spd + myvel);

 return ret;
}

vector get_shotvelocity(vector myvel, vector mydir, float spd, float newton_style, float mi, float ma)
{
 if(!newton_style)
  return spd * mydir;

 if(newton_style == 2)
 {
# 1167 "./common/util.qc"
  vector solution = solve_quadratic(1, -2 * (mydir * myvel), myvel * myvel - spd * spd);

  float outspeed;
  if(solution.z)
   outspeed = solution.y;
  else
  {

   outspeed = solution.x;

  }

  outspeed = bound(spd * mi, outspeed, spd * ma);
  return mydir * outspeed;
 }


 return myvel + spd * mydir;
}

float compressShotOrigin(vector v)
{
 float rx = rint(v.x * 2);
 float ry = rint(v.y * 4) + 128;
 float rz = rint(v.z * 4) + 128;
 if(rx > 255 || rx < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1194")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " x out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  rx = bound(0, rx, 255);
 }
 if(ry > 255 || ry < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1199")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " y out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  ry = bound(0, ry, 255);
 }
 if(rz > 255 || rz < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1204")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " z out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  rz = bound(0, rz, 255);
 }
 return rx * 0x10000 + ry * 0x100 + rz;
}
vector decompressShotOrigin(float f)
{
 vector v;
 v.x = ((f & 0xFF0000) / 0x10000) / 2;
 v.y = ((f & 0xFF00) / 0x100 - 128) / 4;
 v.z = ((f & 0xFF) - 128) / 4;
 return v;
}


vector healtharmor_maxdamage(float h, float a, float armorblock, float deathtype)
{

 float healthdamage, armordamage, armorideal;
 if (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) && (Deathtypes_from(deathtype - DT_FIRST)) == DEATH_DROWN))
  armorblock = 0;
 vector v;
 healthdamage = (h - 1) / (1 - armorblock);
 armordamage = a + (h - 1);
 armorideal = healthdamage * armorblock;
 v.y = armorideal;
 if(armordamage < healthdamage)
 {
  v.x = armordamage;
  v.z = 1;
 }
 else
 {
  v.x = healthdamage;
  v.z = 0;
 }
 return v;
}

vector healtharmor_applydamage(float a, float armorblock, float deathtype, float damage)
{
 vector v;
 if (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) && (Deathtypes_from(deathtype - DT_FIRST)) == DEATH_DROWN))
  armorblock = 0;
 if (deathtype & HITTYPE_ARMORPIERCE)
  armorblock = 0;
 v.y = bound(0, damage * armorblock, a);
 v.x = bound(0, damage - v.y, damage);
 v.z = 0;
 return v;
}

float matchacl(string acl, string str)
{
 string t, s;
 float r, d;
 r = 0;
 while(acl)
 {
  t = car(acl); acl = cdr(acl);

  d = 1;
  if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "-")
  {
   d = -1;
   t = substring(t, 1, strlen(t) - 1);
  }
  else if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "+")
   t = substring(t, 1, strlen(t) - 1);

  if(substring(t, -1, 1) == "*")
  {
   t = substring(t, 0, strlen(t) - 1);
   s = substring(str, 0, strlen(t));
  }
  else
   s = str;

  if(s == t)
  {
   r = d;
   break;
  }
 }
 return r;
}

 else
  m = strcat(m, "*");
 return strcat(m, ".", fil);
}

float get_model_parameters(string m, float sk)
{
 get_model_parameters_modelname = nil;
 get_model_parameters_modelskin = -1;
 get_model_parameters_name = nil;
 get_model_parameters_species = -1;
 get_model_parameters_sex = nil;
 get_model_parameters_weight = -1;
 get_model_parameters_age = -1;
 get_model_parameters_desc = nil;
 get_model_parameters_bone_upperbody = nil;
 get_model_parameters_bone_weapon = nil;
 for(float i = 0; i < MAX_AIM_BONES; ++i)
 {
  get_model_parameters_bone_aim[i] = nil;
  get_model_parameters_bone_aimweight[i] = 0;
 }
 get_model_parameters_fixbone = 0;
 get_model_parameters_hidden = false;


 __Mutator_Send_ClearModelParams(0 );


 if (!m)
  return 1;

 if(substring(m, -9, 5) == "_lod1" || substring(m, -9, 5) == "_lod2")
  m = strcat(substring(m, 0, -10), substring(m, -4, -1));

 if(sk < 0)
 {
  if(substring(m, -4, -1) != ".txt")
   return 0;
  if(substring(m, -6, 1) != "_")
   return 0;
  sk = stof(substring(m, -5, 1));
  m = substring(m, 0, -7);
 }

 string fn = get_model_datafilename(m, sk, "txt");
 float fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
 {
  sk = 0;
  fn = get_model_datafilename(m, sk, "txt");
  fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
  if(fh < 0)
   return 0;
 }

 get_model_parameters_modelname = m;
 get_model_parameters_modelskin = sk;
 string s, c;
 while((s = fgets(fh)))
 {
  if(s == "")
   break;
  c = car(s);
  s = cdr(s);
  if(c == "name")
   get_model_parameters_name = s;
  if(c == "species")
   switch(s)
   {
    case "human": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_HUMAN; break;
    case "alien": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ALIEN; break;
    case "robot_shiny": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_SHINY; break;
    case "robot_rusty": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_RUSTY; break;
    case "robot_solid": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_SOLID; break;
    case "animal": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ANIMAL; break;
    case "reserved": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_RESERVED; break;
   }
  if(c == "sex")
  {
   if (s == "Male") s = _("Male");
   else if (s == "Female") s = _("Female");
   else if (s == "Undisclosed") s = _("Undisclosed");
   get_model_parameters_sex = s;
  }
  if(c == "weight")
   get_model_parameters_weight = stof(s);
  if(c == "age")
   get_model_parameters_age = stof(s);
  if(c == "description")
   get_model_parameters_description = s;
  if(c == "bone_upperbody")
   get_model_parameters_bone_upperbody = s;
  if(c == "bone_weapon")
   get_model_parameters_bone_weapon = s;

  __Mutator_Send_GetModelParams(0 , c, s);

  for(float i = 0; i < MAX_AIM_BONES; ++i)
   if(c == strcat("bone_aim", ftos(i)))
   {
    get_model_parameters_bone_aimweight[i] = stof(car(s));
    get_model_parameters_bone_aim[i] = cdr(s);
   }
  if(c == "fixbone")
   get_model_parameters_fixbone = stof(s);
  if(c == "hidden")
   get_model_parameters_hidden = stof(s);
 }

 while((s = fgets(fh)))
 {
  if(get_model_parameters_desc)
   get_model_parameters_desc = strcat(get_model_parameters_desc, "\n");
  if(s != "")
   get_model_parameters_desc = strcat(get_model_parameters_desc, s);
 }

 fclose(fh);

 return 1;
}

const string XENCODE_2 = "xX";
const string XENCODE_22 = "0123456789abcdefABCDEF";
string xencode(float f)
{
 float a, b, c, d;
 d = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 c = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 b = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 a = f % 2;
 return strcat(
  "^",
  substring(XENCODE_2, a, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, b, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, c, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, d, 1)
 );
}
float xdecode(string s)
{
 float a, b, c, d;
 if(substring(s, 0, 1) != "^")
  return -1;
 if(strlen(s) < 5)
  return -1;
 a = strstrofs(XENCODE_2, substring(s, 1, 1), 0);
 b = strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 2, 1), 0);
 c = strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 3, 1), 0);
 d = strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 4, 1), 0);
 if(a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 || d < 0)
  return -1;
 return ((a * 22 + b) * 22 + c) * 22 + d;
}

.float FindConnectedComponent_processing;
void FindConnectedComponent(entity e, .entity fld, findNextEntityNearFunction_t nxt, isConnectedFunction_t iscon, entity pass)
{
 entity queue_start, queue_end;





 if(e.FindConnectedComponent_processing)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("recursion or broken cleanup"));


 queue_start = queue_end = e;
 queue_end.(fld) = (0, world);
 queue_end.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 1;


 for (; queue_start; queue_start = queue_start.(fld))
 {

  entity t;
  for(t = (0, world); (t = nxt(t, queue_start, pass)); )
  {
   if(t.FindConnectedComponent_processing)
    continue;
   if(iscon(t, queue_start, pass))
   {

    queue_end.(fld) = t;
    queue_end = t;
    queue_end.(fld) = (0, world);
    queue_end.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 1;
   }
  }
 }


 for (queue_start = e; queue_start; queue_start = queue_start.(fld))
  queue_start.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 0;
}

float trace_hits_box_a0, trace_hits_box_a1;

float trace_hits_box_1d(float end, float thmi, float thma)
{
    if (end == 0)
    {

        if (0 < thmi)
            return false;
        if (0 > thma)
            return false;
    }
    else
    {


        trace_hits_box_a0 = max(trace_hits_box_a0, min(thmi / end, thma / end));
        trace_hits_box_a1 = min(trace_hits_box_a1, max(thmi / end, thma / end));
        if (trace_hits_box_a0 > trace_hits_box_a1)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

float trace_hits_box(vector start, vector end, vector thmi, vector thma)
{
    end -= start;
    thmi -= start;
    thma -= start;


    trace_hits_box_a0 = 0;
    trace_hits_box_a1 = 1;

    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.x, thmi.x, thma.x))
        return false;
    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.y, thmi.y, thma.y))
        return false;
    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.z, thmi.z, thma.z))
        return false;

    return true;
}

float tracebox_hits_box(vector start, vector mi, vector ma, vector end, vector thmi, vector thma)
{
    return trace_hits_box(start, end, thmi - ma, thma - mi);
}

float IsMoveInDirection(vector mv, float ang)
{
 if (mv_x == 0 && mv_y == 0)
  return 0;
 ang -= RAD2DEG * atan2(mv_y, mv_x);
 ang = remainder(ang, 360) / 45;
 return ang > 1 ? 0 : ang < -1 ? 0 : 1 - fabs(ang);
}

float GeomLerp(float a, float _lerp, float b)
{
 return a == 0 ? (_lerp < 1 ? 0 : b)
  : b == 0 ? (_lerp > 0 ? 0 : a)
  : a * (fabs(b / a) ** _lerp);
}

void PM_ClientMovement_UpdateStatus(entity this)

 if(!((this).isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_PLAYER))
  return;

 float have_hook = false;
 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {

  entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];




  if(wepent.hook && !wasfreed(wepent.hook))
  {
   have_hook = true;
   break;
  }
 }
 float do_crouch = ((input_buttons & (1 << (4))) != 0);
 if(this.viewloc && !(this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE) && (this).movement.x < 0)
  do_crouch = true;
 if (have_hook) {
  do_crouch = false;


 } else if ((((hud != HUD_NORMAL) != 0))) {
  do_crouch = false;
 } else if ((0, g_stat_FROZEN) || (((this).classname == "ENT_CLIENT_MODEL") ? (this).csqcmodel_isdead : (GetResource((this), RES_HEALTH) <= 0))) {
  do_crouch = false;
 }

 __Mutator_Send_PlayerCanCrouch(0 , this, do_crouch);
 do_crouch = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_bool;

 if (do_crouch) {
  if (!((((this).flags & FL_DUCKED) != 0))) {
   ((this).flags |= FL_DUCKED);
   this.view_ofs = (0, g_stat_PL_CROUCH_VIEW_OFS);
   setsize(this, (0, g_stat_PL_CROUCH_MIN), (0, g_stat_PL_CROUCH_MAX));

  }
 } else if (((((this).flags & FL_DUCKED) != 0))) {
  tracebox(this.origin, (0, g_stat_PL_MIN), (0, g_stat_PL_MAX), this.origin, MOVE_NORMAL, this);

   ((this).flags &= ~FL_DUCKED);
   this.view_ofs = (0, g_stat_PL_VIEW_OFS);
   setsize(this, (0, g_stat_PL_MIN), (0, g_stat_PL_MAX));
  }
 }

 _Movetype_CheckWater(this);
}

void CPM_PM_Aircontrol(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed)
{
 float movity = IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, 0);
 if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_BACKWARDS))
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, 180);
 if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_SIDEWARDS))
 {
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, 90);
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, -90);
 }

 float k = 32 * (2 * movity - 1);
 if (k <= 0)
  return;

 k *= bound(0, wishspeed / (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED), 1);

 float zspeed = this.velocity_z;
 this.velocity_z = 0;
 float xyspeed = vlen(this.velocity);
 this.velocity = normalize(this.velocity);

 float dot = this.velocity * wishdir;

 if (dot > 0)
 {
  k *= (dot ** (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_POWER)) * dt;
  xyspeed = max(0, xyspeed - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_PENALTY) * sqrt(max(0, 1 - dot*dot)) * k/32);
  k *= (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL);
  this.velocity = normalize(this.velocity * xyspeed + wishdir * k);
 }

 this.velocity = this.velocity * xyspeed;
 this.velocity_z = zspeed;
}

float AdjustAirAccelQW(float accelqw, float factor)
{
 return copysign(bound(0.000001, 1 - (1 - fabs(accelqw)) * factor, 1), accelqw);
}






void PM_Accelerate(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed, float wishspeed0, float accel, float accelqw, float stretchfactor, float sidefric, float speedlimit)
{
 float speedclamp = stretchfactor > 0 ? stretchfactor
 : accelqw < 0 ? 1
 : -1;

 accelqw = fabs(accelqw);

 if (((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_Q2AIRACCELERATE) != 0)))
  wishspeed0 = wishspeed;

 float vel_straight = this.velocity * wishdir;
 float vel_z = this.velocity_z;
 vector vel_xy = (_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2);
 vector vel_perpend = vel_xy - vel_straight * wishdir;

 float step = accel * dt * wishspeed0;

 float vel_xy_current = vlen(vel_xy);
 if (speedlimit)
  accelqw = AdjustAirAccelQW(accelqw, (speedlimit - bound(wishspeed, vel_xy_current, speedlimit)) / max(1, speedlimit - wishspeed));
 float vel_xy_forward = vel_xy_current + bound(0, wishspeed - vel_xy_current, step) * accelqw + step * (1 - accelqw);
 float vel_xy_backward = vel_xy_current - bound(0, wishspeed + vel_xy_current, step) * accelqw - step * (1 - accelqw);
 vel_xy_backward = max(0, vel_xy_backward);
 vel_straight = vel_straight + bound(0, wishspeed - vel_straight, step) * accelqw + step * (1 - accelqw);

 if (sidefric < 0 && (vel_perpend*vel_perpend))

 {
  float f = max(0, 1 + dt * wishspeed * sidefric);
  float themin = (vel_xy_backward * vel_xy_backward - vel_straight * vel_straight) / (vel_perpend * vel_perpend);





  if (themin <= 0)
   vel_perpend *= f;
  else
  {
   themin = sqrt(themin);
   vel_perpend *= max(themin, f);
  }
 }
 else
  vel_perpend *= max(0, 1 - dt * wishspeed * sidefric);

 vel_xy = vel_straight * wishdir + vel_perpend;

 if (speedclamp >= 0)
 {
  float vel_xy_preclamp;
  vel_xy_preclamp = vlen(vel_xy);
  if (vel_xy_preclamp > 0)
  {
   vel_xy_current += (vel_xy_forward - vel_xy_current) * speedclamp;
   if (vel_xy_current < vel_xy_preclamp)
    vel_xy *= (vel_xy_current / vel_xy_preclamp);
  }
 }

 this.velocity = vel_xy + vel_z * '0 0 1';
}

void PM_AirAccelerate(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed)
{
 if (wishspeed == 0)
  return;

 vector curvel = this.velocity;
 curvel_z = 0;
 float curspeed = vlen(curvel);

 if (wishspeed > curspeed * 1.01)
  wishspeed = min(wishspeed, curspeed + (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_AIRFORWARDACCEL) * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) * dt);
 else
 {
  float f = max(0, ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TOPSPEED) - curspeed) / ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TOPSPEED) - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED)));
  wishspeed = max(curspeed, (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED)) + (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_ACCEL) * f * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) * dt;
 }
 vector wishvel = wishdir * wishspeed;
 vector acceldir = wishvel - curvel;
 float addspeed = vlen(acceldir);
 acceldir = normalize(acceldir);

 float accelspeed = min(addspeed, (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TURNACCEL) * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) * dt);

 if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_BACKTOSIDERATIO) < 1)
 {
  vector curdir = normalize(curvel);
  float dot = acceldir * curdir;
  if (dot < 0)
   acceldir -= (1 - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_BACKTOSIDERATIO)) * dot * curdir;
 }

 this.velocity += accelspeed * acceldir;
}

void PM_jetpack(entity this, float maxspd_mod, float dt)
{

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/physics/player.qc", 711, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 vector wishvel = v_forward * (this).movement_x
     + v_right * (this).movement_y;

 float maxairspd = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED) * max(1, maxspd_mod);

 wishvel = normalize(wishvel) * min(1, vlen(wishvel) / maxairspd);

 wishvel_z = 0;


  wishvel_z = sqrt(max(0, 1 - wishvel * wishvel));


 float a_side = (0, g_stat_JETPACK_ACCEL_SIDE);
 float a_up = (0, g_stat_JETPACK_ACCEL_UP);
 float a_add = (0, g_stat_JETPACK_ANTIGRAVITY) * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);

 if((0, g_stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST) && ((input_buttons & (1 << (4))) != 0)) { a_up = (0, g_stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST); }

 wishvel_x *= a_side;
 wishvel_y *= a_side;
 wishvel_z *= a_up;
 wishvel_z += a_add;

 if((0, g_stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST) && ((input_buttons & (1 << (4))) != 0)) { wishvel_z *= -1; }

 float best = 0;
# 748 "./common/physics/player.qc"
 float a_diff = a_side * a_side - a_up * a_up;
 float f;
 if (a_diff != 0)
 {
  f = a_add * a_up / a_diff;
  if (f > -1 && f < 1)
  {
   best = (a_diff + a_add * a_add) * (a_diff + a_up * a_up) / a_diff;

  }
 }

 f = (a_up + a_add) * (a_up + a_add);
 if (f > best)
 {
  best = f;

 }

 f = (a_up - a_add) * (a_up - a_add);
 if (f > best)
 {
  best = f;

 }
 best = sqrt(best);




 float fxy, fz;
 fxy = bound(0, 1 - (this.velocity * normalize(wishvel_x * '1 0 0' + wishvel_y * '0 1 0')) / (0, g_stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_SIDE), 1);
 if (wishvel_z - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY) > 0)
  fz = bound(0, 1 - this.velocity_z / (0, g_stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_UP), 1);
 else
  fz = bound(0, 1 + this.velocity_z / (0, g_stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_UP), 1);

 float fvel;
 fvel = vlen(wishvel);
 wishvel_x *= fxy;
 wishvel_y *= fxy;
 wishvel_z = (wishvel_z - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY)) * fz + (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);

 fvel = min(1, vlen(wishvel) / best);
 if ((0, g_stat_JETPACK_FUEL) && !(((this).items) & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO))
  f = min(1, (0, g_stat_FUEL) / ((0, g_stat_JETPACK_FUEL) * dt * fvel));
 else
  f = 1;



 if (f > 0 && wishvel != '0 0 0')
 {
  this.velocity = this.velocity + wishvel * f * dt;
  ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
# 813 "./common/physics/player.qc"
 }
}

void movelib_groundalign4point(entity this, float spring_length, float spring_up, float blendrate, float _max);
# 2 "./common/physics/movelib.qc" 2
# 185 "./common/physics/movelib.qc"
void movelib_groundalign4point(entity this, float spring_length, float spring_up, float blendrate, float _max)
{
    vector a, b, c, d, e, r, push_angle, ahead, side;

    push_angle.y = 0;
    r = (this.absmax + this.absmin) * 0.5 + (v_up * spring_up);
    e = v_up * spring_length;


    ahead = v_forward * (this.maxs.x * 0.8);
    side = v_right * (this.maxs.y * 0.8);

    a = r + ahead + side;
    b = r + ahead - side;
    c = r - ahead + side;
    d = r - ahead - side;

    traceline(a, a - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    a.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r = trace_endpos;

    traceline(b, b - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    b.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    traceline(c, c - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    c.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    traceline(d, d - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    d.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    a.x = r.z;
    r = this.origin;
    r.z = r.z;

    push_angle.x = (a.z - c.z) * _max;
    push_angle.x += (b.z - d.z) * _max;

    push_angle.z = (b.z - a.z) * _max;
    push_angle.z += (d.z - c.z) * _max;




    this.angles_x = ((1-blendrate) * this.angles.x) + (push_angle.x * blendrate);
    this.angles_z = ((1-blendrate) * this.angles.z) + (push_angle.z * blendrate);


    setorigin(this, r);
}

void _Movetype_Physics_Toss(entity this, float dt)
{
 if((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
 {
  if(this.velocity.z >= (1 / 32) && (0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_UPVELOCITYCLEARSONGROUND))
  {

   ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
  }
  else if(!this.groundentity || !(0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_NOAIRBORNCORPSE))
  {
   return;
  }
  else if(this.move_suspendedinair && wasfreed(this.groundentity))
  {
   this.groundentity = (0, world);
   if((0, g_stat_NOAIRBORNCORPSE_ALLOWSUSPENDED))
    return;
  }
  else if(boxesoverlap(this.absmin, this.absmax, this.groundentity.absmin, this.groundentity.absmax))
  {

   return;
  }
 }

 this.move_suspendedinair = false;

 _Movetype_CheckVelocity(this);

 if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_TOSS)
 {
  this.move_didgravity = true;
  this.velocity_z -= (((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_GRAVITYUNAFFECTEDBYTICRATE) != 0)) ? 0.5 : 1)
      * dt
      * ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1)
      * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);
 }







 this.angles = this.angles + this.avelocity * dt;

 float movetime = dt;
 for (float bump = 0; bump < MAX_CLIP_PLANES && movetime > 0; bump++)
 {
  vector move = this.velocity * movetime;
  if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, move, true))
   return;
  if (wasfreed(this))
   return;


  if (trace_startsolid && trace_ent.solid == SOLID_BSP)
  {

   float oldtrace_fraction = trace_fraction;
   vector oldtrace_plane_normal = trace_plane_normal;
   entity oldtrace_ent = trace_ent;
   _Movetype_UnstickEntity(this);
   trace_fraction = oldtrace_fraction;
   trace_plane_normal = oldtrace_plane_normal;
   trace_ent = oldtrace_ent;
   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, move, true))
    return;
   if (wasfreed(this))
    return;
  }

  if (trace_fraction == 1)
   break;

  movetime *= 1 - min(1, trace_fraction);

  if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE)
  {
   float bouncefac = (!this.bouncefactor) ? 1.0 : this.bouncefactor;
   this.velocity = _Movetype_ClipVelocity(this.velocity, trace_plane_normal, 1 + bouncefac);
   ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
   if(!(0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_SLIDEMOVEPROJECTILES))
    movetime = 0;
  }
  else if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE)
  {
   float bouncefac = (!this.bouncefactor) ? 0.5 : this.bouncefactor;
   float bstop = (!this.bouncestop) ? (60 / 800) : this.bouncestop;
   float grav = ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1);

   this.velocity = _Movetype_ClipVelocity(this.velocity, trace_plane_normal, 1 + bouncefac);

   float d = trace_plane_normal * this.velocity;
   if(!(0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_GRENADEBOUNCESLOPES))
    d = this.velocity.z;
   if (trace_plane_normal.z > 0.7 && d < (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY) * bstop * grav)
   {
    ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
    this.groundentity = trace_ent;
    this.velocity = '0 0 0';
    this.avelocity = '0 0 0';
    movetime = 0;
   }
   else
   {

void _Movetype_Physics_Walk(entity this, float dt)
{

 if (dt <= 0)
  return;

 if ((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_UNSTICKPLAYERS))
  _Movetype_CheckStuck(this);

 float applygravity = (!_Movetype_CheckWater(this) && this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_WALK && !(this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP));

 _Movetype_CheckVelocity(this);


 float oldonground = (((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0);

 vector start_origin = this.origin;
 vector start_velocity = this.velocity;

 if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WALLCLIP) && this.pm_time)
 {
  if(dt >= this.pm_time || (this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP))
   this.pm_time = 0;
  else
   this.pm_time -= dt;
 }

 float clip = _Movetype_FlyMove(this, dt, applygravity, false, (0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_STEPMULTIPLETIMES) ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT) : 0);

 if ((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_DOWNTRACEONGROUND) && !(clip & 1))
 {



  vector upmove = this.origin + '0 0 1';
  vector downmove = this.origin - '0 0 1';
  float type;
  if (this.move_nomonsters)
   type = max(0, this.move_nomonsters);
  else if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE)
   type = MOVE_MISSILE;
  else if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY)
   type = MOVE_WORLDONLY;
  else if (this.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER || this.solid == SOLID_NOT)
   type = MOVE_NOMONSTERS;
  else
   type = MOVE_NORMAL;
  tracebox(upmove, this.mins, this.maxs, downmove, type, this);
  if (trace_fraction < 1 && trace_plane_normal.z > 0.7)
  {
   clip |= 1;

   this.groundentity = trace_ent;
  }
 }


 if (!(clip & 1))
  ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
 else if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WALLCLIP) && !this.groundentity && ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WALLCLIP) == 2 || start_velocity.z < -200))
  this.pm_time = 0.25;

 _Movetype_CheckVelocity(this);
 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, true);

 if (clip & 8)
  return;

 if (this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP)
  return;

 if ((0, g_stat_NOSTEP))
  return;

 vector originalorigin = this.origin;
 vector originalvelocity = this.velocity;

 float originalflags = this.flags;
 entity originalmove_groundentity = this.groundentity;


 if (clip & 2)
 {

  if (fabs(start_velocity.x) < 0.03125 && fabs(start_velocity.y) < 0.03125)
   return;

  if (this.move_movetype != MOVETYPE_FLY)
  {

   if (this.move_movetype != MOVETYPE_WALK)
    return;


   if (!(0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_JUMPSTEP))
    if (!oldonground && this.waterlevel == 0)
     return;
  }



  this.origin = start_origin;
  this.velocity = start_velocity;


  vector upmove = '0 0 1' * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT);
  if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, upmove, true))
  {

   return;
  }


  this.velocity_z = 0;
  clip = _Movetype_FlyMove(this, dt, applygravity, true, 0);
  this.velocity_z += start_velocity.z;
  if (clip & 8)
  {


   return;
  }

  _Movetype_CheckVelocity(this);
  _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, true);



  if (clip
      && fabs(originalorigin.y - this.origin.y) < 0.03125
      && fabs(originalorigin.x - this.origin.x) < 0.03125)
  {


   this.origin = originalorigin;
   this.velocity = originalvelocity;

   this.flags = originalflags;
   this.groundentity = originalmove_groundentity;


   return;
  }




  if ((clip & 2) && (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WALLFRICTION))
   _Movetype_WallFriction(this, move_stepnormal);
 }

 else if (!(0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_STEPDOWN) || this.waterlevel >= 3 || start_velocity.z >= (1.0 / 32.0)

  return;
 }

 if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, downmove, true))

 }

 if (trace_fraction < 1 && trace_plane_normal.z > 0.7)
 {




  if((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_STEPDOWN) == 2)
  {
   ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
   this.groundentity = trace_ent;
  }
 }
 else
 {




  this.origin = originalorigin;
  this.velocity = originalvelocity;
  this.flags = originalflags;
  this.groundentity = originalmove_groundentity;
 }

 _Movetype_CheckVelocity(this);
 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, true);
}

void _Movetype_Physics_Push(entity this, float dt)
{
 float oldltime = this.ltime;
 float movetime = dt;
 if(this.nextthink < this.ltime + dt)
 {
  movetime = this.nextthink - this.ltime;
  if(movetime < 0)
   movetime = 0;
 }

 if(movetime)
 {

  _Movetype_PushMove(this, movetime);
 }

 if(this.nextthink > oldltime && this.nextthink <= this.ltime)
 {
  this.nextthink = 0;
  (0, (this).selfthink)(this);
 }
}

float _Movetype_NudgeOutOfSolid_PivotIsKnownGood(entity this, vector pivot)
{
 vector stuckorigin = this.origin;
 vector goodmins = pivot, goodmaxs = pivot;
 for(float bump = 0; bump < 6; bump++)
 {
  float coord = 2 - (bump >> 1);
  float dir = (bump & 1);

  for(float subbump = 0; ; ++subbump)
  {
   vector testorigin = stuckorigin;
   if(dir)
   {

    switch(coord)
    {
     case 0: testorigin.x += this.maxs_x - goodmaxs.x; break;
     case 1: testorigin.y += this.maxs_y - goodmaxs.y; break;
     case 2: testorigin.z += this.maxs_z - goodmaxs.z; break;
    }
   }
   else
   {

    switch(coord)
    {
     case 0: testorigin.x += this.mins_x - goodmins.x; break;
     case 1: testorigin.y += this.mins_y - goodmins.y; break;
     case 2: testorigin.z += this.mins_z - goodmins.z; break;
    }
   }

   tracebox(stuckorigin, goodmins, goodmaxs, testorigin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
   if(trace_startsolid && trace_ent.solid == SOLID_BSP)
   {

    return false;
   }

   if(trace_fraction >= 1)
    break;

   if(subbump >= 10)
   {

    return false;
   }


   vector move = trace_endpos - testorigin;
   float nudge = (trace_plane_normal * move) + 0.03125;
   stuckorigin = stuckorigin + nudge * trace_plane_normal;
  }

  if(dir)
  {

   switch(coord)
   {
    case 0: goodmaxs.x = this.maxs_x; break;
    case 1: goodmaxs.y = this.maxs_y; break;
    case 2: goodmaxs.z = this.maxs_z; break;
   }
  }
  else
  {

   switch(coord)
   {
    case 0: goodmins.x = this.mins_x; break;
    case 1: goodmins.y = this.mins_y; break;
    case 2: goodmins.z = this.mins_z; break;
   }
  }
 }


 this.origin = stuckorigin;

 return true;
}

vector planes[MAX_CLIP_PLANES];
float _Movetype_FlyMove(entity this, float dt, float applygravity, float applystepnormal, float stepheight)
{
 move_stepnormal = '0 0 0';

 if(dt <= 0)
  return 0;

 float blockedflag = 0;
 float numplanes = 0;
 float time_left = dt, grav = 0;
 vector push;
 vector primal_velocity, original_velocity;
 vector restore_velocity = this.velocity;

 for(float j = 0; j < MAX_CLIP_PLANES; ++j)
  planes[j] = '0 0 0';

 if(applygravity)
 {
  this.move_didgravity = 1;
  grav = dt * (this.gravity ? this.gravity : 1) * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);

  if(!((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_NOGRAVITYONGROUND) != 0)) || !(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
  {
   if(((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_GRAVITYUNAFFECTEDBYTICRATE) != 0)))
    this.velocity_z -= grav * 0.5;
   else
    this.velocity_z -= grav;
  }
 }

 original_velocity = primal_velocity = this.velocity;

 for(float bumpcount = 0;bumpcount < MAX_CLIP_PLANES;bumpcount++)
 {
  if(this.velocity == '0 0 0')
   break;

  push = this.velocity * time_left;
  if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, push, false))
  {


   blockedflag |= 8;
   break;
  }



  if(trace_startsolid && trace_allsolid)
  {
   this.velocity = restore_velocity;
   return 3;
  }

  if(trace_fraction == 1)
   break;

  time_left *= 1 - trace_fraction;

  float my_trace_fraction = trace_fraction;
  vector my_trace_plane_normal = trace_plane_normal;

  if(trace_plane_normal.z)
  {
   if(trace_plane_normal.z > 0.7)
   {

    blockedflag |= 1;

    if(!trace_ent)
    {

     trace_ent = (0, world);
    }

    ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
    this.groundentity = trace_ent;
   }
  }
  else if(stepheight)
  {

   vector org = this.origin;
   vector steppush = (_vec3.x = (0), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (stepheight), _vec3);
   push = this.velocity * time_left;

   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, steppush, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }
   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, push, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }
   float trace2_fraction = trace_fraction;
   steppush = (_vec3.x = (0), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (org.z - this.origin_z), _vec3);
   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, steppush, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }



   if(this.origin_x - org.x || this.origin_y - org.y)
   {
    trace_endpos = this.origin;
    time_left *= 1 - trace2_fraction;
    numplanes = 0;
    continue;
   }
   else
    this.origin = org;
  }
  else
  {

   blockedflag |= 2;

   if(applystepnormal)
    move_stepnormal = trace_plane_normal;
  }

  if(my_trace_fraction >= 0.001)
  {

   original_velocity = this.velocity;
   numplanes = 0;
  }


  if(numplanes >= MAX_CLIP_PLANES)
  {

   this.velocity = '0 0 0';
   blockedflag = 3;
   break;
  }

  planes[numplanes] = my_trace_plane_normal;
  numplanes++;


  vector new_velocity = '0 0 0';
  float plane;
  for (plane = 0;plane < numplanes;plane++)
  {
   float newplane;
   new_velocity = _Movetype_ClipVelocity(original_velocity, planes[plane], 1);
   for (newplane = 0;newplane < numplanes;newplane++)
   {
    if(newplane != plane)
    {

     if((new_velocity * planes[newplane]) < 0)
      break;
    }
   }
   if(newplane == numplanes)
    break;
  }

  if(plane != numplanes)
  {

   this.velocity = new_velocity;
  }
  else
  {

   if(numplanes != 2)
   {
    this.velocity = '0 0 0';
    blockedflag = 7;
    break;
   }
   vector dir = ((planes[0]) >< (planes[1]));

   dir = normalize(dir);
   float d = (dir * this.velocity);
   this.velocity = dir * d;
  }



  if((this.velocity * primal_velocity) <= 0)
  {
   this.velocity = '0 0 0';
   break;
  }
 }


 if((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_EASIERWATERJUMP) && (this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP) && !(blockedflag & 8))
  this.velocity = primal_velocity;

 if((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WALLCLIP) && this.pm_time && !(this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP) && !(blockedflag & 8))
  this.velocity = primal_velocity;

 if(applygravity)
 {
  if(!((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_NOGRAVITYONGROUND) != 0)) || !(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
  {
   if(((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_GRAVITYUNAFFECTEDBYTICRATE) != 0)))
    this.velocity_z -= grav * 0.5f;
  }
 }

 return blockedflag;
}

float _Movetype_CheckWater(entity this)
{
 vector point = this.origin;
 point.z += this.mins.z + 1;

 float nativecontents = pointcontents(point);
 if(this.watertype && this.watertype != nativecontents)
 {

  if(this.contentstransition)
   this.contentstransition(this.watertype, nativecontents);
 }

 this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_NONE;
 this.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;

 float supercontents = Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(nativecontents);
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
 {
  this.watertype = nativecontents;
  this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_WETFEET;
  point.z = this.origin.z + (this.mins.z + this.maxs.z) * 0.5;
  if(Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(pointcontents(point)) & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
  {
   this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING;
   point.z = this.origin.z + this.view_ofs.z;
   if(Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(pointcontents(point)) & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED;
  }
 }

 return this.waterlevel > 1;
}

void _Movetype_CheckWaterTransition(entity ent)
{
 float contents = pointcontents(ent.origin);

 if(!ent.watertype)
 {

  if(!(0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_WATERTRANSITION))
  {
   ent.watertype = contents;
   ent.waterlevel = 1;
   return;
  }
 }
 else if(ent.watertype != contents)
 {

  if(ent.contentstransition)
   ent.contentstransition(ent.watertype, contents);
 }

 if(contents <= CONTENT_WATER)
 {
  ent.watertype = contents;
  ent.waterlevel = 1;
 }
 else
 {
  ent.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;
  ent.waterlevel = ((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_WATERTRANSITION) ? 0 : contents);
 }
}

float autocvar__movetype_debug = false;
void _Movetype_LinkEdict(entity this, float touch_triggers)
{
 if(autocvar__movetype_debug)
 {
  vector mi, ma;
  if(this.solid == SOLID_BSP)
  {

   mi = this.mins;
   ma = this.maxs;
  }
  else
  {
   mi = this.mins;
   ma = this.maxs;
  }
  mi += this.origin;
  ma += this.origin;

  if(this.flags & FL_ITEM)
  {
   mi -= '15 15 1';
   ma += '15 15 1';
  }
  else
  {
   mi -= '1 1 1';
   ma += '1 1 1';
  }

  this.absmin = mi;
  this.absmax = ma;
 }
 else
 {
  setorigin(this, this.origin);


  this.absmin -= '1 1 1';
  this.absmax += '1 1 1';

 }

 if(touch_triggers)
  _Movetype_LinkEdict_TouchAreaGrid(this);
}

float _Movetype_ContentsMask(entity this)
{
 if(this)
 {
  if(this.dphitcontentsmask)
   return this.dphitcontentsmask;
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_SLIDEBOX)
  {
   if(this.flags & FL_MONSTER)
    return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_MONSTERCLIP;
   else
    return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP;
  }
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_CORPSE)
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY;
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER)
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY;
  else
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
 }
 else
  return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
}

entity _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent;
float _Movetype_TestEntityPosition(vector ofs)
{
    entity this = _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent;
 vector org = this.origin + ofs;



 tracebox(org, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin, ((this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY) ? MOVE_WORLDONLY : MOVE_NOMONSTERS), this);

 if(trace_dpstartcontents & _Movetype_ContentsMask(this))
  return true;

 if((_vlen2 = (trace_endpos - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= 0.0001)
 {
  tracebox(trace_endpos, this.mins, this.maxs, trace_endpos, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  if(!trace_startsolid)
   this.origin = trace_endpos;
 }
 return false;
}

float _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_Offset(float offset)
{




    for(float j = 2; j <= offset; ++j)
    {
     if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('0 0 -1' * j))
      return false;
     if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('0 0 1' * j))
      return false;
    }

 return true;
}

float _Movetype_UnstickEntity(entity this)
{
    _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent = this;
 if (!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 0  0  0')) {
     return UNSTICK_FINE;
 }

 if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('0  0  -1')) if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 0  0  1'))
 if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('-1  0  0')) if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 1  0  0'))
 if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 0 -1  0')) if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 0  1  0'))
 if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('-1 -1  0')) if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 1 -1  0'))
 if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('-1  1  0')) if (_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 1  1  0'))

 {
        if(_Movetype_TestEntityPosition_Offset(rint((this.maxs.z - this.mins.z) * 0.36)))
        {
            if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/physics/movetypes/movetypes.qc", "640")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Can't unstick an entity (edict: %d, classname: %s, origin: %s)", num_for_edict(this), this.classname, vtos(this.origin)), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc()
                                                              ;
            return UNSTICK_STUCK;
        }
 }
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/physics/movetypes/movetypes.qc", "645")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Sucessfully unstuck an entity (edict: %d, classname: %s, origin: %s)", num_for_edict(this), this.classname, vtos(this.origin)), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc()
                                                ;
 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);
 return UNSTICK_FIXED;
}

void _Movetype_CheckStuck(entity this)
{
 float unstick = _Movetype_UnstickEntity(this);
 switch(unstick)
 {
  case UNSTICK_FINE:
   this.oldorigin = this.origin;
   break;
  case UNSTICK_FIXED:
   break;
  case UNSTICK_STUCK:
   vector offset = this.oldorigin - this.origin;
   if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(offset))
    _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);

   break;
 }
}

vector _Movetype_ClipVelocity(vector vel, vector norm, float f)
{
 vel -= ((vel * norm) * norm) * f;

 if(vel.x > -0.1 && vel.x < 0.1) vel.x = 0;
 if(vel.y > -0.1 && vel.y < 0.1) vel.y = 0;
 if(vel.z > -0.1 && vel.z < 0.1) vel.z = 0;

 return vel;
}

void _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(entity this, vector push)
{
 vector end = this.origin + push;
 float type;
 if(this.move_nomonsters)
  type = max(0, this.move_nomonsters);
 else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE)
  type = MOVE_MISSILE;
 else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY)
  type = MOVE_WORLDONLY;
 else if(this.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER || this.solid == SOLID_NOT)
  type = MOVE_NOMONSTERS;
 else
  type = MOVE_NORMAL;

 tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, end, type, this);
}

float _Movetype_PushEntity(entity this, vector push, float dolink)
{
 _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, push);


 if(trace_startsolid)
 {
  float oldtype = this.move_nomonsters;
  this.move_nomonsters = MOVE_WORLDONLY;
  _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, push);
  this.move_nomonsters = oldtype;
  if(trace_startsolid)
   return true;
 }

 this.origin = trace_endpos;

 vector last_origin = this.origin;

 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, dolink);

 if((this.solid >= SOLID_TRIGGER && trace_fraction < 1 && (!(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) || this.groundentity != trace_ent)))
  _Movetype_Impact(this, trace_ent);

 return (this.origin == last_origin);
}

void _Movetype_Physics_Frame(entity this, float movedt)
{
 this.move_didgravity = -1;
 switch (this.move_movetype)
 {
  case MOVETYPE_PUSH:
  case MOVETYPE_FAKEPUSH:
   _Movetype_Physics_Push(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NONE:
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_FOLLOW:
   _Movetype_Physics_Follow(this);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NOCLIP:
   _Movetype_CheckWater(this);
   this.origin = this.origin + movedt * this.velocity;
   this.angles = this.angles + movedt * this.avelocity;
   _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_STEP:
   _Movetype_Physics_Step(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_WALK:
   _Movetype_Physics_Walk(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_TOSS:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCE:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY:
   _Movetype_Physics_Toss(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_PHYSICS:
   break;
 }
}

void _Movetype_Physics_ClientFrame(entity this, float movedt)
{
 this.move_didgravity = -1;
 switch (this.move_movetype)
 {
  case MOVETYPE_PUSH:
  case MOVETYPE_FAKEPUSH:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/physics/movetypes/movetypes.qc", "772")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Physics: Lacking QuakeC support for Push movetype, FIX ME by using engine physics!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NONE:
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_FOLLOW:
   _Movetype_Physics_Follow(this);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NOCLIP:
   _Movetype_CheckWater(this);
   this.origin = this.origin + movedt * this.velocity;
   this.angles = this.angles + movedt * this.avelocity;
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_STEP:
   _Movetype_Physics_Step(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_WALK:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY:
   _Movetype_Physics_Walk(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_TOSS:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCE:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE:
   if ((0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_UNSTICKPLAYERS) == 2)
    _Movetype_CheckStuck(this);
   _Movetype_Physics_Toss(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_PHYSICS:
   break;
 }



 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, true);


}

void Movetype_Physics_NoMatchTicrate(entity this, float movedt, float isclient)
{
 float didmove = (this.move_time != 0);
 this.move_time = time;

 if(isclient)
  _Movetype_Physics_ClientFrame(this, movedt);
 else
 {







  if(!didmove && (0, g_stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_DELAYPROJECTILES) > 0)
   return;
  _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, movedt);
 }
 if(wasfreed(this))
  return;

 setorigin(this, this.origin);
}

void Movetype_Physics_NoMatchServer(entity this)
{
 float movedt = time - this.move_time;
 this.move_time = time;

 _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, movedt);
 if(wasfreed(this))
  return;

 setorigin(this, this.origin);
}

void Movetype_Physics_MatchServer(entity this, float sloppy)
{
 Movetype_Physics_MatchTicrate(this, ticrate, sloppy);
}

.vector tic_velocity;
.float tic_flags;
.vector tic_avelocity;
.vector tic_angles;

void Movetype_Physics_MatchTicrate(entity this, float tr, float sloppy)
{






 if(this.(origin) != this.tic_saved_origin) this.tic_origin = this.(origin);
 if(this.(velocity) != this.tic_saved_velocity) this.tic_velocity = this.(velocity);
 if(this.(flags) != this.tic_saved_flags) this.tic_flags = this.(flags);
 if(this.(avelocity) != this.tic_saved_avelocity) this.tic_avelocity = this.(avelocity);
 if(this.(angles) != this.tic_saved_angles) this.tic_angles = this.(angles);


 this.flags = this.tic_flags;
 this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;
 setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
 this.avelocity = this.tic_avelocity;
 this.angles = this.tic_angles;

 if(tr <= 0)
 {
  Movetype_Physics_NoMatchServer(this);

  this.tic_saved_flags = this.tic_flags = this.flags;
  this.tic_saved_velocity = this.tic_velocity = this.velocity;
  this.tic_saved_origin = this.tic_origin = this.origin;
  this.tic_saved_avelocity = this.tic_avelocity = this.avelocity;
  this.tic_saved_angles = this.tic_angles = this.angles;
  return;
 }

 float dt = time - this.move_time;

 float n = bound(0, floor(dt / tr), 32);
 dt -= n * tr;
 this.move_time += n * tr;

 if(!this.move_didgravity)
  this.move_didgravity = ((this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_TOSS) && !(this.tic_flags & FL_ONGROUND));

 for (float j = 0; j < n; ++j)
 {
  _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, tr);
  if(wasfreed(this))
   return;
 }


 this.tic_origin = this.origin;
 this.tic_velocity = this.velocity;
 this.tic_avelocity = this.avelocity;
 this.tic_angles = this.angles;
 this.tic_flags = this.flags;


 this.flags = this.tic_saved_flags;
 this.velocity = this.tic_saved_velocity;
 setorigin(this, this.tic_saved_origin);

 this.angles = this.tic_saved_angles;

 this.avelocity = this.tic_avelocity;

 if(dt > 0 && this.move_movetype != MOVETYPE_NONE && !(this.tic_flags & FL_ONGROUND))
 {

  this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;

  if(this.move_didgravity > 0)
  {
   this.velocity_z -= (((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_GRAVITYUNAFFECTEDBYTICRATE) != 0)) ? 0.5 : 1)
       * dt
       * ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1)
       * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);
  }

  this.angles = this.tic_angles + dt * this.avelocity;

  if(sloppy || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_NOCLIP)
  {
   setorigin(this, this.tic_origin + dt * this.velocity);
  }
  else
  {
   setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
   _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, dt * this.velocity);
   if(!trace_startsolid)
    setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
   else
    setorigin(this, this.tic_saved_origin);
  }

  if(this.move_didgravity > 0 && ((((0, g_stat_MOVEFLAGS) & MOVEFLAG_GRAVITYUNAFFECTEDBYTICRATE) != 0)))
   this.velocity_z -= 0.5 * dt * ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1) * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);
 }
 else
 {
  this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;
  this.angles = this.tic_angles;
  setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
 }

 this.flags = this.tic_flags;

 this.tic_saved_flags = this.flags;
 this.tic_saved_velocity = this.velocity;
 this.tic_saved_origin = this.origin;
 this.tic_saved_avelocity = this.avelocity;
 this.tic_saved_angles = this.angles;
}
