void Ent_Wall_PreDraw(entity this)
{
 float alph = this.alpha;
 if (this.inactive)
 {
  alph = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  vector org = getpropertyvec(VF_ORIGIN);
  if(!checkpvs(org, this))
   alph = 0;
  else if(this.fade_start || this.fade_end) {
   vector offset = '0 0 0';
   offset_z = this.fade_vertical_offset;
   vector player_dist_math = org - this.origin - 0.5 * (this.mins + this.maxs) + offset;
   if (this.fade_end == this.fade_start)
   {
    if (((_vlen2 = (player_dist_math), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= ((this.fade_start) ** 2)))
     alph = 0;
    else
     alph = 1;
   }
   else
   {
    float player_dist = vlen(player_dist_math);
    alph = (this.alpha_min + this.alpha_max * bound(0,
          (this.fade_end - player_dist)
          / (this.fade_end - this.fade_start), 1)) / 100.0;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   alph = 1;
  }
 }
 this.alpha = alph;
 this.drawmask = (alph <= 0) ? 0 : MASK_NORMAL;
}

   setmodelindex(this, this.modelindex);
   setsize(this, pmin, pmax);
   this.loddistance1 = 0;
   this.loddistance2 = 0;
  }
  this.solid = ReadByte();
  this.scale = ReadShort() / 256.0;
  if(f & 0x20)

   this.maxs = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  }
  else
   this.mins = this.maxs = '0 0 0';
  setsize(this, this.mins, this.maxs);

  string s = ReadString();
  if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "<")
  {
   if(1){ if (this.bgmscript) { strunzone(this.bgmscript); } this.bgmscript = strzone(substring(s, 1, -1)); }else voidfunc();
   this.bgmscriptangular = 1;
  }

   this.bgmscriptangular = 0;
  }
  if(this.bgmscript != "")

   this.bgmscriptattack = ReadByte() / 64.0;
   this.bgmscriptdecay = ReadByte() / 64.0;
   this.bgmscriptsustain = ReadByte() / 255.0;
   this.bgmscriptrelease = ReadByte() / 64.0;
   this.movedir = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
   this.lip = ReadByte() / 255.0;
  }
  this.fade_start = ReadShort();
  this.fade_end = ReadShort();
  this.alpha_max = ReadByte() / 255.0;
  this.alpha_min = ReadByte() / 255.0;
  this.inactive = ReadByte();
  this.fade_vertical_offset = ReadShort();
  BGMScript_InitEntity(this);
 }

 return = true;

void SUB_CalcMove_controller_think (entity this)
{
 float traveltime;
 float phasepos;
 float nexttick;
 vector delta;
 vector delta2;
 vector veloc;
 vector angloc;
 vector nextpos;
 delta = this.destvec;
 delta2 = this.destvec2;
 if(time < this.animstate_endtime)
 {
  nexttick = time + serverdeltatime;

  traveltime = this.animstate_endtime - this.animstate_starttime;
  phasepos = (nexttick - this.animstate_starttime) / traveltime;
  phasepos = cubic_speedfunc(this.platmovetype_start, this.platmovetype_end, phasepos);
  nextpos = this.origin + (delta * phasepos) + (delta2 * phasepos * phasepos);


  if(this.owner.platmovetype_turn)
  {
   vector destangle;
   destangle = delta + 2 * delta2 * phasepos;
   destangle = vectoangles(destangle);
   destangle_x = -destangle_x;


   vector v = this.owner.angles;
   v.x -= 360 * floor((v.x - destangle_x) / 360 + 0.5);
   v.y -= 360 * floor((v.y - destangle_y) / 360 + 0.5);
   v.z -= 360 * floor((v.z - destangle_z) / 360 + 0.5);
   this.owner.angles = v;
   angloc = destangle - this.owner.angles;
   angloc = angloc * (1 / serverdeltatime);
   this.owner.avelocity = angloc;
  }
  if(nexttick < this.animstate_endtime)
   veloc = nextpos - this.owner.origin;
  else
   veloc = this.finaldest - this.owner.origin;
  veloc = veloc * (1 / serverdeltatime);

  this.owner.velocity = veloc;
  this.nextthink = nexttick;
 }
 else
 {

  entity own = this.owner;
  (_selftemp = (own), _selftemp.__think = ((this.think1) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (this.think1));

  own.move_controller = (0, world);
  if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
  (0, (own).selfthink)(own);
 }
}

typedef entity PointParticles;
 .float cnt;
 .vector velocity;
 .float waterlevel;
 .float count;
 .float impulse;
 .string noise;
 .float atten;
 .float volume;
 .float absolute;
 .vector movedir;
 .float glow_color;

const float ABSOLUTE_ONLY_SPAWN_AT_TOGGLE = 2;

void Draw_PointParticles(entity this)
{
 float n, i, fail;
 vector p;
 vector sz;
 vector o;
 o = this.origin;
 sz = this.maxs - this.mins;
 n = doBGMScript(this);
 if(this.absolute == ABSOLUTE_ONLY_SPAWN_AT_TOGGLE)
 {
  if(n >= 0)
   n = this.just_toggled ? this.impulse : 0;
  else
   n = this.impulse * drawframetime;
 }
 else
 {
  n *= this.impulse * drawframetime;
  if(this.just_toggled)
   if(n < 1)
    n = 1;
 }
 if(n == 0)
  return;
 fail = 0;
 for(i = random(); i <= n && fail <= 64*n; ++i)
 {
  p = o + this.mins;
  p.x += random() * sz.x;
  p.y += random() * sz.y;
  p.z += random() * sz.z;
  if(WarpZoneLib_BoxTouchesBrush(p, p, this, (0, world)))
  {
   if(this.movedir != '0 0 0')
   {
    traceline(p, p + normalize(this.movedir) * 4096, 0, (0, world));
    p = trace_endpos;
    float eff_num;
    if(this.cnt)
     eff_num = this.cnt;
    else
     eff_num = _particleeffectnum(this.mdl);
    __pointparticles(eff_num, p, trace_plane_normal * vlen(this.movedir) + this.velocity + randomvec() * this.waterlevel, this.count);
   }
   else
   {
    float eff_num;
    if(this.cnt)
     eff_num = this.cnt;
    else
     eff_num = _particleeffectnum(this.mdl);
    __pointparticles(eff_num, p, this.velocity + randomvec() * this.waterlevel, this.count);
   }
   if(this.noise != "")
   {
    setorigin(this, p);
    sound7(this, CH_AMBIENT, this.noise, VOL_BASE * this.volume, this.atten, 0, 0);
   }
   this.just_toggled = 0;
  }
  else if(this.absolute)
  {
   ++fail;
   --i;
  }
 }
 setorigin(this, o);
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_POINTPARTICLES(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 float i;
 vector v;
 float sendflags = ReadByte();
 if(sendflags & SF_TRIGGER_UPDATE)
 {
  i = ReadCoord();
  if(i && !this.impulse && (this.cnt || this.mdl))
   this.just_toggled = 1;
  this.impulse = i;
 }
 if(sendflags & SF_TRIGGER_RESET)

   {

    this.maxs = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
   }
   else
   {
    this.mins = '0 0 0';
    this.maxs = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
   }

   this.mins = this.maxs = '0 0 0';
  }

  this.cnt = ReadShort();
  this.mdl = strzone(ReadString());

  if(sendflags & SF_POINTPARTICLES_MOVING)
  {
   this.velocity = decompressShortVector(ReadShort());
   this.movedir = decompressShortVector(ReadShort());
  }
  else
  {
   this.velocity = this.movedir = '0 0 0';
  }
  if(sendflags & SF_POINTPARTICLES_JITTER_AND_COUNT)
  {
   this.waterlevel = ReadShort() / 16.0;
   this.count = ReadByte() / 16.0;
  }
  else
  {
   this.waterlevel = 0;
   this.count = 1;
  }
  if(1){ if (this.noise) { strunzone(this.noise); } this.noise = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();

  {
   this.atten = ReadByte() / 64.0;

   this.bgmscriptdecay = ReadByte() / 64.0;
   this.bgmscriptsustain = ReadByte() / 255.0;
   this.bgmscriptrelease = ReadByte() / 64.0;

{

 vector effbox_max = vec_to_min(view_origin + maxdist, this.origin + this.maxs);

 vector mysize = effbox_max - effbox_min;
 float mycount = bound(1, 0.1 * this.count * (mysize.x / 1024) * (mysize.y / 1024), 65535);

 if(boxesoverlap(view_origin - maxdist, view_origin + maxdist, this.absmin, this.absmax))
 {
  if(this.state == RAINSNOW_RAIN)
      te_particlerain(effbox_min, effbox_max, this.velocity, floor(mycount * drawframetime + random()), this.glow_color);
     else
      te_particlesnow(effbox_min, effbox_max, this.velocity, floor(mycount * drawframetime + random()), this.glow_color);
 }
}

{
 entity targ;
 float pushdeltatime;
 float str;

 if (this.active != ACTIVE_ACTIVE)
  return;

 if (!isPushable(toucher))
  return;

 if(!WarpZoneLib_ExactTrigger_Touch((this), (toucher), true)) return;

 targ = find((0, world), targetname, this.target);
 if(!targ)
 {
  if(1){ if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapobjects/trigger/impulse.qc", "20")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("======OBJECT ERROR======"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); entity _e = (this); eprint(_e); ; if(1){ entity _this = (_e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(_e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapobjects/trigger/impulse.qc", "20")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("%s OBJECT ERROR in %s:\n%s\nTip: read above for entity information", "CSQC", __FUNC__, "trigger_force without a (valid) .target!\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }


 str = this.strength;

 pushdeltatime = time - toucher.lastpushtime;
 if (pushdeltatime > IMPULSE_MAX_PUSHDELTATIME)
 {
  pushdeltatime = 0;
 }
 toucher.lastpushtime = time;
 if(!pushdeltatime)
 {
  return;
 }

 if(this.spawnflags & IMPULSE_DIRECTIONAL_SPEEDTARGET)
 {
  float addspeed = str - toucher.velocity * normalize(targ.origin - this.origin);
  if (addspeed > 0)
  {
   float accelspeed = min(IMPULSE_DIRECTIONAL_MAX_ACCEL_FACTOR * pushdeltatime * str, addspeed);
   toucher.velocity += accelspeed * normalize(targ.origin - this.origin);
  }
 }
 else
  toucher.velocity = toucher.velocity + normalize(targ.origin - this.origin) * str * pushdeltatime;

 ((toucher).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);




}


void trigger_impulse_touch_accel(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 float pushdeltatime;

 if (this.active != ACTIVE_ACTIVE)
  return;

 if (!isPushable(toucher))
  return;

 if(!WarpZoneLib_ExactTrigger_Touch((this), (toucher), true)) return;

 pushdeltatime = time - toucher.lastpushtime;
 if (pushdeltatime > IMPULSE_MAX_PUSHDELTATIME)
 {
  pushdeltatime = 0;
 }
 toucher.lastpushtime = time;
 if(!pushdeltatime)
 {
  return;
 }


 toucher.velocity = toucher.velocity * (this.strength ** pushdeltatime);




}


void trigger_impulse_touch_radial(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 float pushdeltatime;
 float str;

 if (this.active != ACTIVE_ACTIVE)
  return;

 if (!isPushable(toucher))
  return;

 if(!WarpZoneLib_ExactTrigger_Touch((this), (toucher), true)) return;

 pushdeltatime = time - toucher.lastpushtime;
 if (pushdeltatime > IMPULSE_MAX_PUSHDELTATIME)
 {
  pushdeltatime = 0;
 }
 toucher.lastpushtime = time;
 if(!pushdeltatime)
 {
  return;
 }

 setsize(this, '-1 -1 -1' * this.radius,'1 1 1' * this.radius);

 str = min(this.radius, vlen(this.origin - toucher.origin));

 if(this.falloff == FALLOFF_LINEAR)
  str = (1 - str / this.radius) * this.strength;
 else if(this.falloff == FALLOFF_LINEAR_INV)
  str = (str / this.radius) * this.strength;
 else
  str = this.strength;

 toucher.velocity = toucher.velocity + normalize(toucher.origin - this.origin) * str * pushdeltatime;




}

vector trigger_push_calculatevelocity(vector org, entity tgt, float ht, entity pushed_entity)
{
 float grav, sdist, zdist, vs, vz, jumpheight;
 vector sdir, torg;

 torg = tgt.origin + (tgt.mins + tgt.maxs) * 0.5;

 grav = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_GRAVITY);
 if(pushed_entity && pushed_entity.gravity)
  grav *= pushed_entity.gravity;






 if ((0, g_stat_Q3COMPAT))
  grav /= 750/800;

 zdist = torg.z - org.z;
 sdist = vlen(torg - org - zdist * '0 0 1');
 sdir = normalize(torg - org - zdist * '0 0 1');


 jumpheight = fabs(ht);
 if(zdist > 0)
  jumpheight = jumpheight + zdist;
# 81 "./common/mapobjects/trigger/jumppads.qc"
 vz = sqrt(fabs(2 * grav * jumpheight));


 if(ht < 0)
  if(zdist < 0)
   vz = -vz;

 vector solution;
 solution = solve_quadratic(0.5 * grav, -vz, zdist);

 if(!solution.z)
  solution_y = solution.x;
 if(zdist == 0)
  solution_x = solution.y;

 float flighttime;
 if(zdist < 0)
 {

  if(ht < 0)
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
  else
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
 }
 else
 {

  if(ht < 0)
  {



   flighttime = solution.x;
  }
  else
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
 }
 vs = sdist / flighttime;


 return sdir * vs + '0 0 1' * vz;
}

void viewloc_PlayerPhysics(entity this)
{
 if(this.viewloc)
 {
  if(this.viewloc.goalentity == this.viewloc.enemy)
   return;

  vector old_movement = (this).movement;
  (this).movement_x = old_movement_y;
  if((this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE) && !this.ladder_entity)
   (this).movement_y = old_movement_x;
  else
   (this).movement_y = 0;

  vector level_start, level_end;
  level_start = this.viewloc.enemy.origin;
  level_end = this.viewloc.goalentity.origin;
  vector forward = vectoangles(normalize(level_end - level_start));
  vector backward = vectoangles(normalize(level_start - level_end));

  if((this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE) && this.angles_y < 0 && !this.ladder_entity)
   (this).movement_y = -(this).movement_y;

  if(this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEAIM)
  {
   if(this.angles_y > 0)
    (this).movement_x = -(this).movement_x;
  }
  else
  {
   if((this).movement_x < 0)
    (this).movement_x = -(this).movement_x;

   if((this).movement_x < 0)
    this.angles_y = backward.y;
   if((this).movement_x > 0)
    this.angles_y = forward.y;
  }
# 69 "./common/viewloc.qc"
 }
}

{
 vector wnear = cs_unproject((_vec2 = (mpos), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2));
 vector wfar = cs_unproject((_vec3.x = (mpos.x), _vec3.y = (mpos.y), _vec3.z = (max_shot_distance), _vec3));

 return trace_endpos;
}

vector old_camera_angle = '0 0 0';
void viewloc_SetViewLocation()
{
 entity view = CSQCModel_server2csqc(player_localentnum - 1);
 if (!view) return;
 entity viewloc_ent = view.viewloc;
 if(viewloc_ent && !wasfreed(viewloc_ent) && viewloc_ent.enemy && viewloc_ent.goalentity)
 {
  float have_sidescroll = (viewloc_ent.enemy != viewloc_ent.goalentity);
  vector position_a = viewloc_ent.enemy.origin;
  vector position_b = viewloc_ent.goalentity.origin;
  vector camera_angle = '0 0 0';
  vector camera_position;



  camera_position = vec_bounds_in(view.origin, position_a, position_b);


  if (!(viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_CAM_NOANGLE)) {
   camera_angle = viewloc_ent.enemy.movedir;
  }


  if ((viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_CAM_TRACK) || !have_sidescroll) {
   camera_angle = aim_vec (camera_position, view.origin);
  }


  if (viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_CAM_SNAP_HARD) {
   camera_angle = angle_snap_vec(aim_vec(camera_position, view.origin), 90);
  }


  if (viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_CAM_SNAP_CLOSE) {

   camera_angle = aim_vec(camera_position, view.origin);





   float camera_angle_diff = max(camera_angle.y, old_camera_angle.y) - min(camera_angle.y, old_camera_angle.y);

   if (60 <= camera_angle_diff) {
    old_camera_angle.y = angle_snap_f(camera_angle.y, 90);
   } else {
    camera_angle.y = old_camera_angle.y;
   }
  }


  if (!(viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_CAM_SNAP_UNLOCK)) {
   camera_angle.x = 0;
   camera_angle.z = 0;
  }







  freeze_org = getpropertyvec(VF_ORIGIN);
  freeze_ang = getpropertyvec(VF_ANGLES);
  setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, camera_position);
  setproperty(VF_ANGLES, camera_angle);

  if(spectatee_status)
   return;

  if (have_sidescroll) {
   vector view_angle = view.angles;
   if (!(viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEAIM)) {
    vector avatar_facing_dir;

    if (0 == input_movevalues.y) {
     avatar_facing_dir = view_angle;
    } else if (0 > input_movevalues.y) {
     avatar_facing_dir = vectoangles(normalize(vec_to_max(position_b, position_a) - vec_to_min(position_b, position_a)));
    } else {
     avatar_facing_dir = vectoangles(normalize(vec_to_min(position_b, position_a) - vec_to_max(position_b, position_a)));
    }
    view_angle.y = avatar_facing_dir.y;


    if (!(viewloc_ent.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE)) {
     if (0 > input_movevalues.x) {
      view_angle.x = 50;
     } else if (0 < input_movevalues.x) {
      view_angle.x = -50;
     }
    }
   } else {
    vector mpos = CursorToWorldCoord(viewloc_mousepos);
    mpos.x = view.origin.x;
    view_angle = aim_vec(view.origin + view.view_ofs, mpos);
   }
   view.angles_y = view_angle.y;
   setproperty(VF_CL_VIEWANGLES, view_angle);
  }
 }
}

{
 return strcat(chr2str('a'+letter),ftos(number+1));
}


string minigame_relative_tile(string start_id, float dx, float dy, float rows, float columns)
{
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(start_id);
 float number = minigame_tile_number(start_id);
 letter = (letter+dx) % columns;
 number = (number+dy) % rows;
 if ( letter < 0 )
  letter = columns + letter;
 if ( number < 0 )
  number = rows + number;
 return minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number);
}


string minigame_tile_name(vector pos, float rows, float columns)
{
 if ( pos_x < 0 || pos_x > 1 || pos_y < 0 || pos_y > 1 )
  return "";

 float letter = floor(pos_x * columns);
 float number = floor((1-pos_y) * rows);
 return minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number);
}

void deactivate_minigame()
{
 if ( !active_minigame )
  return;

 active_minigame.minigame_event(active_minigame,"deactivate");
 entity e = (0, world);
 while( (e = findentity(e, owner, active_minigame)) )
  if ( e.minigame_autoclean )
  {
   minigame_autoclean_entity(e);
  }

 minigame_self = (0, world);
 active_minigame = (0, world);

 if ( auto_close_minigamemenu )
 {
  HUD_MinigameMenu_Close((0, world), (0, world), (0, world));
  auto_close_minigamemenu = 0;
 }
 else
  HUD_MinigameMenu_CurrentButton();
}

void activate_minigame(entity minigame)
{
 if ( !minigame )
 {
  deactivate_minigame();
  return;
 }

 if ( !minigame.descriptor || minigame.classname != "minigame" )
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/cl_minigames.qc", "124")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Trying to activate unregistered minigame ",minigame.netname," in client"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 if ( minigame == active_minigame )
  return;

 if ( active_minigame )
 {
  deactivate_minigame();
 }

 if ( minigame_self.owner != minigame )
  minigame_self = (0, world);
 active_minigame = minigame;
 active_minigame.minigame_event(active_minigame,"activate");

 if ( HUD_MinigameMenu_IsOpened() )
  HUD_MinigameMenu_CurrentButton();
 else
 {
  auto_close_minigamemenu = 1;
  HUD_MinigameMenu_Open();
 }
}

string minigame_getWrappedLine(float w, vector theFontSize, textLengthUpToWidth_widthFunction_t tw)
{
 string s = getWrappedLine_remaining;

 if(w <= 0)
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }

 float take_until = textLengthUpToWidth(s, w, theFontSize, tw);

 if ( take_until > strlen(s) )
  take_until = strlen(s);

 float skip = 0;
 for ( float i = 0; i < take_until; i++ )
  if ( substring(s,i,1) == "\n" )
  {
   take_until = i;
   skip = 1;
   break;
  }

 if ( take_until > 0 || skip > 0 )
 {
  if ( skip == 0 && take_until < strlen(s) )
  {
   float last_word = take_until;
   while(last_word > 0 && substring(s, last_word, 1) != " ")
    --last_word;

   if ( last_word != 0 )
   {
    take_until = last_word;
    skip = 1;
   }
  }

  getWrappedLine_remaining = substring(s, take_until+skip, strlen(s) - (take_until+skip));
  if(getWrappedLine_remaining == "")
   getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  else if (tw("^7", theFontSize) == 0)
   getWrappedLine_remaining = strcat(find_last_color_code(substring(s, 0, take_until)), getWrappedLine_remaining);
  return substring(s, 0, take_until);
 }
 else
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }
}

vector minigame_drawstring_wrapped( float maxwidth, vector pos, string text,
 vector fontsize, vector color, float theAlpha, float drawflags, float align )
{
 getWrappedLine_remaining = text;
 vector mypos = pos;
 while ( getWrappedLine_remaining )
 {
  string line = minigame_getWrappedLine(maxwidth,fontsize,stringwidth_nocolors);
  if ( line == "" )
   break;
  mypos_x = pos_x + (maxwidth - stringwidth_nocolors(line, fontsize)) * align;
  drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(mypos), line, fontsize, color, theAlpha, drawflags);
  mypos_y += fontsize_y;
 }
 mypos_x = maxwidth;
 mypos_y -= pos_y;
 return mypos;
}

void GenericCommand_qc_curl(float request, float argc)
{
 switch(request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   float do_exec = false;
   string do_cvar = nil;
   float key = -1;
   float i;
   for(i = 1; i+1 < argc; ++i)
   {
    if(argv(i) == "--cvar" && i+2 < argc)
    {
     ++i;
     do_cvar = strzone(argv(i));
     continue;
    }
    if(argv(i) == "--exec")
    {
     do_exec = true;
     continue;
    }
    if(argv(i) == "--key" && i+2 < argc)
    {
     ++i;
     key = stof(argv(i));
     continue;
    }
    break;
   }



   string url = argv(i);
   ++i;
   float buf = buf_create();
   float j;
   for(j = 0; i+1 < argc; i += 2)
    bufstr_set(buf, ++j, sprintf("%s=%s", uri_escape(argv(i)), uri_escape(argv(i+1))));
   if(i < argc)
    bufstr_set(buf, ++j, sprintf("submit=%s", uri_escape(argv(i))));

   float r;
   if(j == 0)
    r = crypto_uri_postbuf(url, URI_GET_CURL + curl_uri_get_pos, nil, nil, -1, key);
   else
    r = crypto_uri_postbuf(url, URI_GET_CURL + curl_uri_get_pos, "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "&", buf, key);

   if(r)
   {
    curl_uri_get_exec[curl_uri_get_pos] = do_exec;
    curl_uri_get_cvar[curl_uri_get_pos] = do_cvar;
    curl_uri_get_pos = (curl_uri_get_pos + 1) % (URI_GET_CURL_END - URI_GET_CURL + 1);
   }
   else
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "156")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(_("error creating curl handle")); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

   buf_del(buf);

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 ", "cl_cmd", " qc_curl [--key <n>] [--cvar] [--exec] <url> [<postargs>]"); print("^7", __s, (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
}

       cvar_set("g_maplist", strcat(argv(2), " ", cvar_string("g_maplist")));

      return;
     }
     break;
    }

    case "cleanup":
    {
     MapInfo_Enumerate();
     MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), MapInfo_RequiredFlags(), MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags(), 0);
     string filtered = "";
     if(1){ string _words = cvar_string("g_maplist"); float _i = 0; for (string _it; (_it = car(_words)); (_words = cdr(_words), ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref string it = _it; if (MapInfo_CheckMap(it)) { { filtered = cons(filtered, it); } } } }else voidfunc();
     cvar_set("g_maplist", filtered);
     return;
    }

    case "remove":
    {
     if(argc == 3)
     {

      string del_map_name = argv(2);
      argc = tokenizebyseparator(cvar_string("g_maplist"), " ");

      tmp_string = "";
      for(i = 0; i < argc; ++i)
       if(argv(i) != del_map_name)
        tmp_string = strcat(tmp_string, " ", argv(i));

      tmp_string = substring(tmp_string, 1, strlen(tmp_string) - 1);
      cvar_set("g_maplist", tmp_string);

      return;
     }
     break;
    }

    case "shuffle":
    {
     cvar_set("g_maplist", shufflewords(cvar_string("g_maplist")));
     return;
    }

    default: break;
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "305")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

float GenericCommand(string command)
{
 float argc = tokenize_console(command);
 float n, j, f, i;
 string s, s2, c;
 vector rgb;






 if(GenericCommand_macro_command(argc, command))
 {
  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && argv(0) == "red")
 {
  s = substring(command, argv_start_index(2), argv_end_index(-1) - argv_start_index(2));
  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", GenericCommand_markup(s)));
  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && crc16(0, argv(0)) == 38566 && crc16(0, strcat(argv(0), argv(0), argv(0))) == 59830)
 {

  s = strconv(2, 0, 0, substring(command, argv_start_index(2), argv_end_index(-1) - argv_start_index(2)));

  n = floor(random() * 6 + 2);

  s2 = "";
  for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  {
   s2 = strcat(s2, "AH");
  }

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s2 = strcat(substring(s2, 1, strlen(s2) - 1), "A");

  if(s == "")
   s = s2;
  else
   if(random() < 0.8)
    s = strcat(s, " ", s2);
   else
    s = strcat(s2, " ", s);

  s2 = substring(s, strlen(s) - 2, 2);
  if(s2 == "AH" || s2 == "AY")
   s = strcat(s, "))");
  else
   s = strcat(s, " ))");

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s = substring(s, 0, strlen(s) - 1);

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s = strconv(1, 0, 0, s);

  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", s));

  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && crc16(0, argv(0)) == 3826 && crc16(0, strcat(argv(0), argv(0), argv(0))) == 55790)
 {

  s = strdecolorize(substring(command, argv_start_index(2), argv_end_index(-1) - argv_start_index(2)));
  s2 = "";

  n = strlen(s);
  j = ((6 * max(1, floor(strlen(s)/32 + random() * 2 - 1))) / n) * (1 - 2 * (random() > 0.5));
  f = random() * 6;

  for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  {
   c = substring(s, i, 1);

   if(c == ";")
    c = ":";
   else if(c == "^")
   {
    c = "^^";
    if(substring(s, i+1, 1) == "^")
     ++i;
   }

   if(c != " ")
   {
    rgb = hsl_to_rgb('1 0 0' * (j * i + f) + '0 1 .5');
    c = strcat(rgb_to_hexcolor(rgb), c);
   }
   s2 = strcat(s2, c);
  }

  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", s2));

  return true;
 }

 return false;
}

string GenericCommand_markup(string s2)
{
 float red, ccase, i, j;
 string s, s3;

 GenericCommand_markup_init();

 s = "";

 red = 0;
 ccase = 0;
 float len = strlen(s2);
 for (i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  for(j = 0; j < NUM_MARKUPS; ++j)
  {
   s3 = substring(s2, i, strlen(markup_from[j]));
   if (s3 == markup_from[j])
   {
    s = strcat(s, markup_to[j]);
    i += strlen(markup_from[j]) - 1;
    break;
   }
  }

  if(j == NUM_MARKUPS)
  {
   if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&&")
   {
    s = strcat(s, strconv(ccase, red, red, "&"));
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&d")
   {
    red = 2;
    ccase = 0;
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&a")
   {
    red = 2;
    ccase = 2;
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&n")
   {
    red = 0;
    ccase = 0;
    ++i;
   }
   else
    s = strcat(s, strconv(ccase, red, red, substring(s2, i, 1)));
  }
 }

 return s;
}

string rpn_pop()
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  --rpn_sp;
  return rpn_stack[rpn_sp];
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "17")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: stack underflow"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
  return "";
 }
}
void rpn_push(string s)
{
 if(rpn_sp < MAX_RPN_STACK) {
  rpn_stack[rpn_sp] = s;
  ++rpn_sp;
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "28")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: stack overflow"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
 }
}
string rpn_get()
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  return rpn_stack[rpn_sp - 1];
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "37")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: empty stack"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
  return "";
 }
}
void rpn_set(string s)
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  rpn_stack[rpn_sp - 1] = s;
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "47")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: empty stack"); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
 }
}

     } else if(stof(substring(rpncmd, 0, 1)) > 0) {

     } else if(f >= 2 && substring(rpncmd, 0, 1) == "-") {
      rpn_push(rpncmd);

      }
      else
      {

       rpn_error = true;
      }
     } else if(rpncmd == "defs" || rpncmd == "@") {
      s = "";
      i = rpn_popf();
      j = (i == 0);
      while(rpn_sp > 1 && (j || i > 0))
      {
       s = strcat("/", rpn_pop(), " ", s);
       --i;

       rpn_error = true;
      }
     } else if(rpncmd == "load") {
      rpn_set(cvar_string(rpn_get()));
     } else if(rpncmd == "exch") {
      s = rpn_pop();
      s2 = rpn_get();
      rpn_set(s);
      rpn_push(s2);
     } else if(rpncmd == "dup") {

     } else if(rpncmd == "sub" || rpncmd == "-") {

string Process_Notif_Line(
 MSG typeId,
 float chat,
 string input,
 string notiftype,
 string notifname,
 string stringtype)
{

 if(typeId == MSG_INFO)
 {
  if((chat && autocvar_notification_allow_chatboxprint)
   || (autocvar_notification_allow_chatboxprint == 2))
  {

   input = strcat("\{3}", input);



   input = strreplace("\n", "\n\{3}", input);


   if(substring(input, (strlen(input) - 1), 1) == "\{3}")
    { input = substring(input, 0, (strlen(input) - 1)); }
  }
 }



 if(substring(input, (strlen(input) - 1), 1) == "\n")
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/notifications/all.qc", "203")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf(( "^1TRAILING NEW LINE AT END OF NOTIFICATION: " "^7net_type = %s, net_name = %s, string = %s." ), notiftype, notifname, stringtype); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()







   ;
  notif_error = true;
  input = substring(input, 1, (strlen(input) - 1));
 }

 return input;
}

string Process_Notif_Args(

{

 float sel_num = 0;

 for (;(remaining != "");)
 {

  switch(arg_type)

      ;
     notif_error = true;
     break;
    }

    switch(strtolower(selected))

       ;
      notif_error = true;
      break;
     }
    }
    break;
   }
   case 2:

      ;
     notif_error = true;
     break;
    }

    switch(strtolower(selected))
    {







     case "s1": ++sel_num; break; case "s2": ++sel_num; break; case "s3": ++sel_num; break; case "s4": ++sel_num; break; case "f1race_time": ++sel_num; break; case "f2race_time": ++sel_num; break; case "f3race_time": ++sel_num; break; case "minigame1_name": ++sel_num; break; case "minigame1_d": ++sel_num; break;

      ;
     notif_error = true;
     break;
    }

    switch(strtolower(selected))
    {







     case "f1": ++sel_num; break; case "f2": ++sel_num; break; case "item_centime": ++sel_num; break;







     default:
     {
      if(ftos(stof(selected)) != "") { ++sel_num; }
      else

       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/notifications/all.qc", "375")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf(( "^1NOTIFICATION WITH UNKNOWN TOKEN IN ARGUMENT STRING: " "^7net_type = %s, net_name = %s, durcnt arg = '%s'." ), notiftype, notifname, selected); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()







        ;

      }

    }

  }

void Create_Notification_Entity(entity notif,
 float var_default,
 float var_cvar,
 MSG typeId,
 string namestring,
 float teamnum)
{



 notif.nent_default = var_default;
 notif.nent_enabled = (var_cvar >= 1);
 notif.nent_type = typeId;
 notif.nent_name = strzone(namestring);
 notif.nent_teamnum = teamnum;


 notif_error = false;

 switch (typeId)
 {
  case MSG_ANNCE:
  case MSG_INFO:
  case MSG_CENTER:
  case MSG_MULTI:
  case MSG_CHOICE:
   break;
  default:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/notifications/all.qc", "424")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf(( "^1NOTIFICATION WITH IMPROPER TYPE: " "^7net_type = %d, net_name = %s." ), typeId, namestring); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()






    ;
   notif_error = true;
   break;
 }


 if (notif_error)
 {
  notif.nent_enabled = false;
  notif_global_error = true;
 }
}

  }

  {

   {

     centername_stringcount = notif.nent_msgcenter.nent_stringcount;
     centername_floatcount = notif.nent_msgcenter.nent_floatcount;
    }


    notif.nent_stringcount = max(infoname_stringcount, centername_stringcount);
    notif.nent_floatcount = max(infoname_floatcount, centername_floatcount);
   }
  }

void Local_Notification_Queue_Run(MSG net_type, entity notif)
{
 switch (net_type)
 {
  case MSG_ANNCE:
  {
   Local_Notification_sound(notif.nent_channel, notif.nent_snd, notif.nent_vol, notif.nent_position);
   break;
  }
 }

void Local_Notification_Queue_Add(MSG net_type, entity notif, float queue_time)
{

 if(queue_time == 0)
  queue_time = soundlength(sprintf("announcer/%s/%s.wav", AnnouncerOption(), notif.nent_snd));

 if(queue_time == -1 || time > notif_queue_next_time) {

  Local_Notification_Queue_Run(net_type, notif);
  notif_queue_next_time = time + queue_time;
 } else {

  if(notif_queue_length >= NOTIF_QUEUE_MAX) return;

  notif_queue_type[notif_queue_length] = net_type;
  notif_queue_entity[notif_queue_length] = notif;
  notif_queue_time[notif_queue_length] = notif_queue_next_time;

  notif_queue_next_time += queue_time;
  ++notif_queue_length;
 }
}

void Local_Notification_Queue_Process()
{
 if(!notif_queue_length || notif_queue_time[0] > time)
  return;

 Local_Notification_Queue_Run(notif_queue_type[0], notif_queue_entity[0]);


 --notif_queue_length;
 for (float j = 0; j < notif_queue_length; j++) {
  notif_queue_type[j] = notif_queue_type[j+1];
  notif_queue_entity[j] = notif_queue_entity[j+1];
  notif_queue_time[j] = notif_queue_time[j+1];
 }
}

 {






  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/notifications/all.qc", "1248")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Incorrect usage of Local_Notification: %s", "Null notification"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();

  case MSG_CHOICE:
  {
   entity found_choice = notif.nent_optiona;
   if (notif.nent_challow_var && (warmup_stage || (notif.nent_challow_var == 2))) {

float explosion_calcpush_getmultiplier(vector explosion_v, vector target_v)
{
 float a;
 a = explosion_v * (explosion_v - target_v);

 if(a <= 0)

  return 0;

 a /= (explosion_v * explosion_v);


 return a;
}

vector cliptoplane(vector v, vector p)
{
 return v - (v * p) * p;
}

vector solve_cubic_pq(float p, float q)
{
 float D, u, v, a;
 D = q*q/4.0 + p*p*p/27.0;
 if(D < 0)
 {

  a = 1.0/3.0 * acos(-q/2.0 * sqrt(-27.0/(p*p*p)));
  u = sqrt(-4.0/3.0 * p);




  return u * (_vec3.x = (cos(a + 2.0/3.0*3.14159265358979323846)), _vec3.y = (cos(a + 4.0/3.0*3.14159265358979323846)), _vec3.z = (cos(a)), _vec3)



   ;
 }
 else if(D == 0)
 {

  if(p == 0)
   return '0 0 0';
  u = 3*q/p;
  v = -u/2;
  return (u >= v) ? (_vec3.x = (v), _vec3.y = (v), _vec3.z = (u), _vec3) : (_vec3.x = (u), _vec3.y = (v), _vec3.z = (v), _vec3);
 }
 else
 {



  a = cbrt(-q/2.0 + sqrt(D)) + cbrt(-q/2.0 - sqrt(D));
  return (_vec3.x = (a), _vec3.y = (a), _vec3.z = (a), _vec3);
 }
}
vector solve_cubic_abcd(float a, float b, float c, float d)
{


 float p, q;
 vector v;
 p = (9*a*c - 3*b*b);
 q = (27*a*a*d - 9*a*b*c + 2*b*b*b);
 v = solve_cubic_pq(p, q);
 v = (v - b * '1 1 1') * (1.0 / (3.0 * a));
 if(a < 0)
  v += '1 0 -1' * (v.z - v.x);
 return v;
}

vector findperpendicular(vector v)
{
 return normalize(cliptoplane((_vec3.x = (v.z), _vec3.y = (-v.x), _vec3.z = (v.y), _vec3), v));
}

vector W_CalculateSpread(vector forward, float spread, float spreadfactor, float spreadstyle)
{
 float sigma;
 vector v1 = '0 0 0', v2;
 float dx, dy, r;
 spread *= spreadfactor;
 if(spread <= 0)
  return forward;

 switch(spreadstyle)
 {
  case 0:
  {



   return forward + randomvec() * spread;
  }
  case 1:
  {

   return normalize(forward + cliptoplane(randomvec() * spread, forward));
  }
  case 2:
  {

   sigma = spread * 0.89442719099991587855;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = sqrt(r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 3:
  {
   sigma = spread * 0.44721359549996;

   v1 = forward;
   v1_x += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_y += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_z += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   return v1;
  }
  case 4:
  {
   sigma = spread * 0.44721359549996;

   v1_x = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_y = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_z = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   return normalize(forward + cliptoplane(v1, forward));
  }
  case 5:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.154700538379252;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = solve_cubic_abcd(-2, 3, 0, -r) * '0 1 0';
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 6:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.095445115010332;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = sqrt(1 - r);
   r = sqrt(1 - r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 7:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.224744871391589;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = 1 - sqrt(r);
   r = 1 - sqrt(r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  default:
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("g_projectiles_spread_style must be 0 (sphere), 1 (flattened sphere), 2 (circle), 3 (gauss 3D), 4 (gauss plane), 5 (linear falloff), 6 (quadratic falloff), 7 (stronger falloff)!"));
 }

 return '0 0 0';

}

   {
    max_allowed_segments = min(
     ARC_MAX_SEGMENTS,
     1 + (vlen(wantdir / this.beam_distancepersegment))
    );
   }
   else { max_allowed_segments = ARC_MAX_SEGMENTS; }

   if(this.beam_degreespersegment)
   {
    segments = bound(
     1,
     (
      min(
       angle,
       this.beam_maxangle
      )
      /
      this.beam_degreespersegment
     ),
     max_allowed_segments
    );
   }
   else { segments = 1; }
  }
  else { segments = 1; }
 }

 setorigin(this, start_pos);
 this.beam_muzzleentity.angles_z = random() * 360;

 vector beam_endpos = (start_pos + (beamdir * this.beam_range));
 vector beam_controlpoint = start_pos + wantdir * (this.beam_range * (1 - this.beam_tightness));

 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_entity = this;
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_thickness = 0;
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_top = start_pos;
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_bottom = start_pos;

 vector last_origin = start_pos;
 vector original_start_pos = start_pos;

 float i;
 for(i = 1; i <= segments; ++i)
 {






  vector new_origin = bezier_quadratic_getpoint(
   start_pos,
   beam_controlpoint,
   beam_endpos,
   i / segments);

  WarpZone_TraceBox_ThroughZone(
   last_origin,
   '0 0 0',
   '0 0 0',
   new_origin,
   MOVE_NORMAL,
   (0, world),
   (0, world),
   Draw_ArcBeam_callback
  );



  last_origin = trace_endpos;
  start_pos = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, start_pos);
  beam_controlpoint = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, beam_controlpoint);
  beam_endpos = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, beam_endpos);
  beamdir = WarpZone_TransformVelocity(WarpZone_trace_transform, beamdir);
  Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_top = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_top);
  Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_bottom = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_bottom);

  if(trace_fraction < 1) { break; }
 }


 if(this.beam_hiteffect)
 {



  if((trace_ent || trace_fraction < 1) && !(trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_NOIMPACT))
  __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(this.beam_hiteffect.eent_eff_name), last_origin, beamdir * -1, dt * 2)




   ;
 }
 if(this.beam_hitlight[0])
 {
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./common/weapons/weapon/arc.qc", 1177, __FUNC__, "\"last_origin\", \"this.beam_hitlight[0]\", \"vec3( this.beam_hitlight[1], this.beam_hitlight[2], this.beam_hitlight[3] )\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(last_origin, this.beam_hitlight[0], (_vec3.x = (this.beam_hitlight[1]), _vec3.y = (this.beam_hitlight[2]), _vec3.z = (this.beam_hitlight[3]), _vec3)); }else voidfunc()







   ;
 }
 if(this.beam_muzzleeffect && autocvar_r_drawviewmodel)
 {
  __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(this.beam_muzzleeffect.eent_eff_name), original_start_pos + wantdir * 20, wantdir * 1000, dt * 0.1)




   ;
 }
 if(this.beam_muzzlelight[0])
 {
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "adddynamiclight", "./common/weapons/weapon/arc.qc", 1198, __FUNC__, "\"original_start_pos + wantdir * 20\", \"this.beam_muzzlelight[0]\", \"vec3( this.beam_muzzlelight[1], this.beam_muzzlelight[2], this.beam_muzzlelight[3] )\""); _adddynamiclight_hidden(original_start_pos + wantdir * 20, this.beam_muzzlelight[0], (_vec3.x = (this.beam_muzzlelight[1]), _vec3.y = (this.beam_muzzlelight[2]), _vec3.z = (this.beam_muzzlelight[3]), _vec3)); }else voidfunc()







   ;
 }


 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_entity = (0, world);
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_thickness = 0;
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_top = '0 0 0';
 Draw_ArcBeam_callback_last_bottom = '0 0 0';
}

float autocvar_cl_grapplehook_alpha = 1;

void Draw_CylindricLine(vector from, vector to, float thickness, string texture, float aspect, float shift, vector rgb, float theAlpha, float drawflag, vector vieworg);

typedef entity Hook;
 .entity HookType;
 .vector origin;
 .vector velocity;
 .float HookSilent;
 .float HookRange;

string Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_tex;
float Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rnd;
vector Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rgb;
float Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_a;
void Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback(vector start, vector hit, vector end)
{
 float i;
 vector vorg;
 vorg = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, view_origin);
 for(i = 0; i < Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_a; ++i)
  Draw_CylindricLine(hit, start, 8, Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_tex, 0.25, Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rnd, Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rgb, min(1, Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_a - i), DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, vorg);
 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rnd += 0.25 * vlen(hit - start) / 8;
}

 .float teleport_time;
void Draw_GrapplingHook(entity this)
{
 vector a, b, atrans;
 string tex;
 vector rgb;
 float t;
 vector vs;
 float intensity, offset;

 if(this.teleport_time)
 if(time > this.teleport_time)
 {
  sound7(this, CH_SHOTS_SINGLE, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_Null), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0);
  this.teleport_time = 0;
 }

 InterpolateOrigin_Do(this);

 float s = W_GunAlign(viewmodels[this.cnt], (0, g_stat_GUNALIGN)) - 1;

 switch(this.HookType)
 {
  default:
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
   vs = hook_shotorigin[s];
   break;
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
   vs = lightning_shotorigin[s];
   break;
 }

 if((this.owner.sv_entnum == player_localentnum - 1))
 {
  switch(this.HookType)
  {
   default:
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
    if(autocvar_chase_active)
     a = csqcplayer.origin + csqcplayer.view_ofs;
    else
     a = view_origin + view_forward * vs.x + view_right * -vs.y + view_up * vs.z;
    b = this.origin;
    break;
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
    if(this.HookRange)
     b = view_origin + view_forward * this.HookRange;
    else
     b = view_origin + view_forward * vlen(this.velocity - this.origin);
    WarpZone_TraceLine(view_origin, b, MOVE_NORMAL, (0, world));
    b = WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, trace_endpos);
    a = view_origin + view_forward * vs.x + view_right * -vs.y + view_up * vs.z;
    break;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  switch(this.HookType)
  {
   default:
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
    a = this.velocity;
    b = this.origin;
    break;
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
    a = this.origin;
    b = this.velocity;
    break;
  }
 }

 t = entcs_GetTeamColor(this.owner.sv_entnum);

 switch(this.HookType)
 {
  default:
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
   intensity = autocvar_cl_grapplehook_alpha;
   offset = 0;
   switch(t)
   {
    case NUM_TEAM_1: tex = "particles/hook_red"; rgb = '1 0.3 0.3'; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_2: tex = "particles/hook_blue"; rgb = '0.3 0.3 1'; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_3: tex = "particles/hook_yellow"; rgb = '1 1 0.3'; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_4: tex = "particles/hook_pink"; rgb = '1 0.3 1'; break;
    default: tex = "particles/hook_white"; rgb = entcs_GetColor(this.sv_entnum - 1); break;
   }
   break;
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
   intensity = bound(0.2, 1 + Noise_Pink(this, frametime) * 1 + Noise_Burst(this, frametime, 0.03) * 0.3, 2);
   offset = Noise_Brown(this, frametime) * 10;
   tex = "particles/lgbeam";
   rgb = '1 1 1';
   break;
 }

 __Mutator_Send_DrawGrapplingHook(0 , this, tex, rgb, t);
 tex = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_string;
 rgb = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_vector;

 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_tex = tex;
 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rnd = offset;
 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_rgb = rgb;
 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_a = intensity;
 WarpZone_TraceBox_ThroughZone(a, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', b, ((this.HookType == NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK) ? -1 : MOVE_NORMAL), (0, world), (0, world), Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback);
 Draw_GrapplingHook_trace_callback_tex = nil;

 atrans = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, a);

 switch(this.HookType)
 {
  default:
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
   if(((_vlen2 = (trace_endpos - atrans), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((0.5) ** 2)))
   {
    setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
    this.angles = vectoangles(trace_endpos - atrans);
    this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
   }
   else
   {
    this.drawmask = 0;
   }
   break;
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
   setorigin(this, a);
   break;
 }

 switch(this.HookType)
 {
  default:
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
   break;
  case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
   __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_ARC_LIGHTNING2.eent_eff_name), trace_endpos, normalize(atrans - trace_endpos), frametime * intensity);
   break;
 }
}

void Remove_GrapplingHook(entity this)
{
 sound7(this, CH_SHOTS_SINGLE, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_Null), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0);

 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  entity wep = viewmodels[slot];
  if(wep.hook == this)
   wep.hook = (0, world);
 }
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK(entity this, entity sender, float bIsNew)
{
 this.HookType = NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK;

 float sf = ReadByte();

 this.HookSilent = (sf & 0x80);
 this.iflags = IFLAG_VELOCITY | IFLAG_ORIGIN;

 InterpolateOrigin_Undo(this);

 if(sf & 1)
 {
  float myowner = ReadByte();
  float slot = ReadByte();
  this.owner = playerslots[myowner - 1];
  this.sv_entnum = myowner;
  if(myowner == player_localentnum)
   viewmodels[slot].hook = this;
  this.cnt = slot;
  switch(this.HookType)
  {
   default:
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:
    this.HookRange = 0;
    break;
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
    this.HookRange = ReadCoord();
    break;
  }
 }
 if(sf & 2)
 {
  this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  setorigin(this, this.origin);
 }
 if(sf & 4)
 {
  this.velocity = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
 }

 InterpolateOrigin_Note(this);

 if(bIsNew || !this.teleport_time)
 {
  this.draw = Draw_GrapplingHook;
  IL_PUSH(g_drawables, this);
  this.entremove = Remove_GrapplingHook;

  switch(this.HookType)
  {
   default:
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_HOOK:

    if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_HOOK); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((this), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();
    this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
    break;
   case NET_ENT_CLIENT_ARC_BEAM:
    sound7(this, CH_SHOTS_SINGLE, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_LGBEAM_FLY), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0);
    break;
  }
 }

 this.teleport_time = time + 10;
 return true;
}

const float polyline_length = 16;
.vector polyline[polyline_length];
void Porto_Draw(entity this)
{
 if (spectatee_status || intermission == 1 || intermission == 2 || (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0 || (_wep_porto.wepvar_secondary)) return;

 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];

  if (wepent.activeweapon != WEP_PORTO) continue;

  vector pos = view_origin;
  vector dir = view_forward;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/porto.qc", 26, __FUNC__, "\"((autocvar_chase_active) ? warpzone_save_view_angles : view_angles)\""); _makevectors_hidden(((autocvar_chase_active) ? warpzone_save_view_angles : view_angles)); }else voidfunc();
  pos += v_right * -wepent.movedir.y
   + v_up * wepent.movedir.z;

  if (wepent.angles_held_status)
  {
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/porto.qc", 32, __FUNC__, "\"wepent.angles_held\""); _makevectors_hidden(wepent.angles_held); }else voidfunc();
   dir = v_forward;
  }

  wepent.polyline[0] = pos;

  float portal_number = 0, portal1_idx = 1, portal_max = 2;
  float n = 1 + 2;
  for (float idx = 0; idx < n && idx < polyline_length - 1; )
  {
   traceline(pos, pos + 65536 * dir, true, this);
   dir = reflect(dir, trace_plane_normal);
   pos = trace_endpos;
   wepent.polyline[++idx] = pos;
   if ((trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SLICK) || (trace_dphitcontents & DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP))
   {
    n += 1;
    continue;
   }
   if (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_NOIMPACT)
   {
    n = max(2, idx);
    break;
   }

   {
    vector ang = vectoangles2(trace_plane_normal, dir);
    ang.x = -ang.x;
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/porto.qc", 60, __FUNC__, "\"ang\""); _makevectors_hidden(ang); }else voidfunc();
    if (!CheckWireframeBox(this, pos - 48 * v_right - 48 * v_up + 16 * v_forward, 96 * v_right, 96 * v_up, 96 * v_forward))
    {
     n = max(2, idx);
     break;
    }
   }
   portal_number += 1;
   if (portal_number >= portal_max) break;
   if (portal_number == 1) portal1_idx = idx;
  }
  for (float idx = 0; idx < n - 1; ++idx)
  {
   vector p = wepent.polyline[idx], q = wepent.polyline[idx + 1];
   if (idx == 0) p -= view_up * 16;
   vector rgb = (idx < portal1_idx) ? '1 0 0' : '0 0 1';
   Draw_CylindricLine(p, q, 4, "", 1, 0, rgb, 0.5, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, view_origin);
  }
 }
}

const float TUBA_MIN = -18;
const float TUBA_MAX = 27;
const float TUBA_INSTRUMENTS = 3;

float Tuba_PitchStep;

void tubasound(entity e, float restart)
{
 string snd1 = nil;
 if (Tuba_PitchStep) {
  float vol1 = 1;
  float speed1 = 1;
  string snd2 = nil;
  float vol2 = 0;
  float speed2 = 1;

  float m = pymod(e.note, Tuba_PitchStep);
  if (m) {
   if (e.note - m < TUBA_MIN) {
    if (restart) {
     snd1 = _Sound_fixpath(W_Sound(strcat("tuba", (e.tuba_instrument ? ftos(e.tuba_instrument) : ""), "_loopnote", ftos(e.note - m + Tuba_PitchStep))));
    }
    speed1 = (2.0 ** ((m - Tuba_PitchStep) / 12.0));
   } else if (e.note - m + Tuba_PitchStep > TUBA_MAX) {
    if (restart) {
     snd1 = _Sound_fixpath(W_Sound(strcat("tuba", (e.tuba_instrument ? ftos(e.tuba_instrument) : ""), "_loopnote", ftos(e.note - m))));
    }
    speed1 = (2.0 ** (m / 12.0));
   } else {
    if (restart) {
     snd1 = _Sound_fixpath(W_Sound(strcat("tuba", (e.tuba_instrument ? ftos(e.tuba_instrument) : ""), "_loopnote", ftos(e.note - m))));
    }
    vol1 = cos(M_PI_2 * m / Tuba_PitchStep);
    speed1 = (2.0 ** (m / 12.0));
    if (restart) {
     snd2 = _Sound_fixpath(W_Sound(strcat("tuba", (e.tuba_instrument ? ftos(e.tuba_instrument) : ""), "_loopnote", ftos(e.note - m + Tuba_PitchStep))));
    }
    vol2 = sin(M_PI_2 * m / Tuba_PitchStep);
    speed2 = (2.0 ** ((m - Tuba_PitchStep) / 12.0));
   }
  } else if (restart) {
   snd1 = _Sound_fixpath(W_Sound(strcat("tuba", (e.tuba_instrument ? ftos(e.tuba_instrument) : ""), "_loopnote", ftos(e.note))));
  }

  sound7(e, CH_TUBA_SINGLE, snd1, e.tuba_volume * vol1, e.tuba_attenuate * autocvar_g_balance_tuba_attenuation, 100 * speed1, 0);
  if (vol2) {

  }

WepSet _WepSet_FromWeapon(float a)
{
 a -= WEP_FIRST;
 if (Weapons_MAX > 24)
  if (a >= 24)
  {
   a -= 24;
   if (Weapons_MAX > 48)
    if (a >= 24)
    {
     a -= 24;
     return '0 0 1' * (1 << (a));
    }
   return '0 1 0' * (1 << (a));
  }
 return '1 0 0' * (1 << (a));
}

float W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[Weapons_MAX];
string W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_order;
void W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_swap(float i, float j, entity pass)
{
 float h;
 h = W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[i];
 W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[i] = W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[j];
 W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[j] = h;
}
float W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_cmp(float i, float j, entity pass)
{
 float si = W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[i];
 Weapon e1 = Weapons_from(si);
 float sj = W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[j];
 Weapon e2 = Weapons_from(sj);
 float d = (e1.impulse + 9) % 10 - (e2.impulse + 9) % 10;
 if (d != 0) return -d;
 string s = strcat(" ", W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_order, " ");
 return strstrofs(s, sprintf(" %d ", si), 0)
  - strstrofs(s, sprintf(" %d ", sj), 0);
}
string W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList(string o)
{
 float i;
 W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_order = o;
 for (i = WEP_FIRST; i <= (Weapons_COUNT - 1); ++i)
  W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[i - WEP_FIRST] = i;
 heapsort((Weapons_COUNT - 1) - WEP_FIRST + 1, W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_swap, W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_cmp,
  (0, world));
 o = "";
 for (i = WEP_FIRST; i <= (Weapons_COUNT - 1); ++i)
  o = strcat(o, " ", ftos(W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_buf[i - WEP_FIRST]));
 W_FixWeaponOrder_BuildImpulseList_order = nil;
 return substring(o, 1, -1);
}

float Net_Handle_wframe(entity this, entity sender, float isNew)
{
 WFRAME fr = ReadByte();
 float t = ReadCoord();
 float slot = ReadByte();
 float restartanim = ReadByte();
 entity wepent = viewmodels[slot];
 if(fr == WFRAME_IDLE)
  wepent.animstate_looping = false;
 else
 {
  vector a = '0 0 0';
  switch(fr)
  {
   default:
   case WFRAME_IDLE: a = wepent.anim_idle; break;
   case WFRAME_FIRE1: a = wepent.anim_fire1; break;
   case WFRAME_FIRE2: a = wepent.anim_fire2; break;
   case WFRAME_RELOAD: a = wepent.anim_reload; break;
  }
  a.z *= t;
  anim_set(wepent, a, !restartanim, restartanim, restartanim);
 }
 wepent.state = ReadByte();
 wepent.weapon_nextthink = ReadCoord();
 switch (wepent.state)
 {
  case WS_RAISE:
   wepent.weapon_switchdelay = wepent.activeweapon.switchdelay_raise;
   break;
  case WS_DROP:
   wepent.weapon_switchdelay = wepent.activeweapon.switchdelay_drop;
   break;
  default:
   wepent.weapon_switchdelay = 0;
   break;
 }
 return true;
}

void turret_remove(entity this)
{
 if(1){ entity _this = (this.tur_head); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this.tur_head); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();

 this.tur_head = (0, world);
}

.vector glowmod;
void turret_changeteam(entity this)
{
 this.glowmod = Team_ColorRGB(this.team - 1);
 this.teamradar_color = Team_ColorRGB(this.team - 1);

 if(this.team)
  this.colormap = 1024 + (this.team - 1) * 17;

 this.tur_head.colormap = this.colormap;
 this.tur_head.glowmod = this.glowmod;

}


void turret_head_draw(entity this)
{
 this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
}

void turret_draw(entity this)
{
 float dt;

 dt = time - this.move_time;
 this.move_time = time;
 if(dt <= 0)
  return;

 this.tur_head.angles += dt * this.tur_head.avelocity;

 if (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) < 127)
 {
  dt = random();

  if(dt < 0.03)
   te_spark(this.origin + '0 0 40', randomvec() * 256 + '0 0 256', 16);
 }

 if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) < 85)
 if(dt < 0.01)
  __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_SMOKE_LARGE.eent_eff_name), (this.origin + (randomvec() * 80)), '0 0 0', 1);

 if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) < 32)
 if(dt < 0.015)
  __pointparticles(_particleeffectnum(EFFECT_SMOKE_SMALL.eent_eff_name), (this.origin + (randomvec() * 80)), '0 0 0', 1);

}

void turret_draw2d(entity this)
{
 if(this.netname == "")
  return;

 if(!autocvar_g_waypointsprite_turrets)
  return;

 if(autocvar_cl_hidewaypoints)
  return;

 float dist = vlen(this.origin - view_origin);
 float t = (entcs_GetTeam(player_localnum) + 1);

 vector o;
 string txt;

 if(autocvar_cl_vehicles_hud_tactical)
 if(dist < 10240 && t != this.team)
 {

  o = project_3d_to_2d(this.origin + '0 0 32');
  if(o_z < 0
  || o_x < (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left)
  || o_y < (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top)
  || o_x > (vid_conwidth - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right))
  || o_y > (vid_conheight - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom)))
   return;
  o_z = 0;
  if(hud != HUD_NORMAL)
  {
   if((Turrets_from(this.m_id)).spawnflags & TUR_FLAG_MOVE)
    txt = "gfx/vehicles/turret_moving";
   else
    txt = "gfx/vehicles/turret_stationary";

   vector pz = drawgetimagesize(txt) * autocvar_cl_vehicles_crosshair_size;
   drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(o - pz * 0.5), txt, HUD_Scale(pz), '1 1 1', 0.7, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  }
 }

 if(dist > this.maxdistance)
  return;

 string spriteimage = this.netname;
 float a = this.alpha * autocvar_hud_panel_fg_alpha;
 vector rgb = spritelookupcolor(this, spriteimage, this.teamradar_color);


 if(this.maxdistance > waypointsprite_normdistance)
  a *= (bound(0, (this.maxdistance - dist) / (this.maxdistance - waypointsprite_normdistance), 1) ** waypointsprite_distancealphaexponent);
 else if(this.maxdistance > 0)
  a *= (bound(0, (waypointsprite_fadedistance - dist) / (waypointsprite_fadedistance - waypointsprite_normdistance), 1) ** waypointsprite_distancealphaexponent) * (1 - waypointsprite_minalpha) + waypointsprite_minalpha;

 if(rgb == '0 0 0')
 {
  this.teamradar_color = '1 0 1';
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/turrets/cl_turrets.qc", "116")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("WARNING: sprite of name %s has no color, using pink so you notice it", spriteimage); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }

 txt = spritelookuptext(this, spriteimage);

 if(time - floor(time) > 0.5 && t == this.team)
 {
  if(this.helpme && time < this.helpme)
  {
   a *= SPRITE_HELPME_BLINK;
   txt = sprintf(_("%s under attack!"), txt);
  }
  else
   a *= spritelookupblinkvalue(this, spriteimage);
 }

 if(autocvar_g_waypointsprite_uppercase)
  txt = strtoupper(txt);

 if(a > 1)
 {
  rgb *= a;
  a = 1;
 }

 if(a <= 0)
  return;

 rgb = fixrgbexcess(rgb);

 o = project_3d_to_2d(this.origin + '0 0 64');
 if(o_z < 0
 || o_x < (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left)
 || o_y < (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top)
 || o_x > (vid_conwidth - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right))
 || o_y > (vid_conheight - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom)))
  return;

 o_z = 0;

 float edgedistance_min = min((o.y - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top)),
 (o_x - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left)),
 (vid_conwidth - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right)) - o_x,
 (vid_conheight - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom)) - o_y);

 float crosshairdistance = sqrt( ((o.x - vid_conwidth/2) ** 2) + ((o.y - vid_conheight/2) ** 2) );

 t = waypointsprite_scale;
 a *= waypointsprite_alpha;

 {
  a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_distancefadealpha) * (bound(0, dist/waypointsprite_distancefadedistance, 1)));
  t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_distancefadescale) * (bound(0, dist/waypointsprite_distancefadedistance, 1)));
 }
 if (edgedistance_min < waypointsprite_edgefadedistance) {
  a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_edgefadealpha) * (1 - bound(0, edgedistance_min/waypointsprite_edgefadedistance, 1)));
  t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_edgefadescale) * (1 - bound(0, edgedistance_min/waypointsprite_edgefadedistance, 1)));
 }
 if(crosshairdistance < waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance) {
  a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_crosshairfadealpha) * (1 - bound(0, crosshairdistance/waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance, 1)));
  t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_crosshairfadescale) * (1 - bound(0, crosshairdistance/waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance, 1)));
 }

 float draw_healthbar = ((this.helpme && time < this.helpme) || !autocvar_g_waypointsprite_turrets_onlyhurt || hud != HUD_NORMAL);
 float draw_text = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_turrets_text;

 if(draw_healthbar || draw_text)
 {
  o = drawspritearrow(o, 3.14159265358979323846, rgb, a, SPRITE_ARROW_SCALE * t);
 }
 if(draw_text)
 {
  o = drawsprite_TextOrIcon(true, o, 3.14159265358979323846, (SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_WIDTH + 2 * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDER) * t, rgb, a, waypointsprite_fontsize * '1 1 0', txt);
 }
 if(draw_healthbar)
 {
  drawhealthbar(
    o,
    0,
    GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) / 255,
    '0 0 0',
    '0 0 0',
    0.5 * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_WIDTH * t,
    0.5 * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_HEIGHT * t,
    SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_MARGIN * t + 0.5 * waypointsprite_fontsize,
    SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDER * t,
    0,
    rgb,
    a * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDERALPHA,
    rgb,
    a * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_HEALTHALPHA,
    DRAWFLAG_NORMAL
    );
 }
}

void turret_construct(entity this, float isnew)
{
 entity tur = Turrets_from(this.m_id);

 if(this.tur_head == (0, world))
  this.tur_head = __spawn("entity", "./common/turrets/cl_turrets.qc" ":" "217", false);

 this.netname = tur.turret_name;

 setorigin(this, this.origin);
 _setmodel(this, tur.model);
 _setmodel(this.tur_head, tur.head_model);
 this.solid = SOLID_BBOX;
 this.tur_head.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 setsize(this, tur.m_mins, tur.m_maxs);
 setsize(this.tur_head, '0 0 0', '0 0 0');

 if(this.m_id == TUR_EWHEEL.m_id)
  setattachment(this.tur_head, this, "");
 else
  setattachment(this.tur_head, this, "tag_head");

 this.tur_head.classname = "turret_head";
 this.tur_head.owner = this;
 set_movetype(this.tur_head, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 this.tur_head.angles = this.angles;
 SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, 255);
 set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 set_movetype(this.tur_head, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 this.draw = turret_draw;
 this.entremove = turret_remove;
 this.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
 this.tur_head.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
 this.anim_start_time = 0;
 this.draw2d = turret_draw2d;
 this.maxdistance = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_turrets_maxdist;
 this.teamradar_color = '1 0 0';
 this.alpha = 1;

 if(isnew)
 {
  IL_PUSH(g_drawables, this);
  IL_PUSH(g_drawables_2d, this);
 }

 tur.tr_setup(tur, this);
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_TURRET(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 float sf;
 sf = ReadByte();

 if(sf & TNSF_SETUP)
 {
  this.m_id = ReadByte();

  this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  setorigin(this, this.origin);

  this.angles = (_vec2_x = (ReadAngle()), _vec2_y = (ReadAngle()), _vec2);

  turret_construct(this, isnew);
  this.colormap = 1024;
  this.glowmod = '0 1 1';
  this.tur_head.colormap = this.colormap;
  this.tur_head.glowmod = this.glowmod;
 }

 if(sf & TNSF_ANG)
 {
  if(this.tur_head == (0, world))
   this.tur_head = __spawn("entity", "./common/turrets/cl_turrets.qc" ":" "392", false);

  this.tur_head.angles_x = ReadShort();
  this.tur_head.angles_y = ReadShort();

 }

 if(sf & TNSF_AVEL)
 {
  if(this.tur_head == (0, world))
   this.tur_head = __spawn("entity", "./common/turrets/cl_turrets.qc" ":" "402", false);

  this.tur_head.avelocity_x = ReadShort();
  this.tur_head.avelocity_y = ReadShort();
 }

 if(sf & TNSF_MOVE)
 {
  this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  setorigin(this, this.origin);

  this.velocity = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);

  this.angles_y = ReadShort();

  this.move_time = time;
 }

 if(sf & TNSF_ANIM)
 {
  this.frame1time = ReadCoord();
  this.frame = ReadByte();
 }

 if(sf & TNSF_STATUS)
 {
  float _tmp;
  _tmp = ReadByte();
  if(_tmp != this.team)
  {
   this.team = _tmp;
   turret_changeteam(this);
  }

  _tmp = ReadByte();
  float myhp = GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH);
  if(_tmp == 0 && myhp != 0)
   turret_die(this);
  else if(myhp && myhp > _tmp)
   this.helpme = servertime + 10;
  else if(myhp && myhp < _tmp)
   this.helpme = 0;

  SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, _tmp);
 }
 return true;
}

float vehicle_altitude(entity this, float amax)
{
 tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin - ('0 0 1' * amax), MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
 return vlen(this.origin - trace_endpos);
}

vector vehicles_force_fromtag_hover(entity this, string tag_name, float spring_length, float max_power)
{
 force_fromtag_origin = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicles.qc", 12, __FUNC__, "this" ", " "gettagindex(this, tag_name)"), _gettaginfo_hidden(this, gettagindex(this, tag_name)) );
 v_forward = normalize(v_forward) * -1;
 traceline(force_fromtag_origin, force_fromtag_origin - (v_forward * spring_length), MOVE_NORMAL, this);

 force_fromtag_power = (1 - trace_fraction) * max_power;
 force_fromtag_normpower = force_fromtag_power / max_power;

 return v_forward * force_fromtag_power;
}

vector vehicles_force_fromtag_maglev(entity this, string tag_name, float spring_length, float max_power)
{
 force_fromtag_origin = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicles.qc", 24, __FUNC__, "this" ", " "gettagindex(this, tag_name)"), _gettaginfo_hidden(this, gettagindex(this, tag_name)) );
 v_forward = normalize(v_forward) * -1;
 traceline(force_fromtag_origin, force_fromtag_origin - (v_forward * spring_length), MOVE_NORMAL, this);


 if(trace_fraction == 1.0)
 {
  force_fromtag_normpower = -0.25;
  return '0 0 -200';
 }

 force_fromtag_power = ((1 - trace_fraction) - trace_fraction) * max_power;
 force_fromtag_normpower = force_fromtag_power / max_power;

 return v_forward * force_fromtag_power;
}

 float axh_id = bound(0, ReadByte(), MAX_AXH);
 entity axh = AuxiliaryXhair[axh_id];

 if(axh == (0, world) || wasfreed(axh))
 {
  axh = __spawn("auxiliary_crosshair", "./common/vehicles/cl_vehicles.qc" ":" "41", false);
  axh.draw2d = nil;
  axh.drawmask = MASK_NORMAL;
  axh.axh_drawflag = DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE;
  axh.axh_fadetime = 0.1;
  axh.axh_image = vCROSS_HINT;
  axh.alpha = 1;
  AuxiliaryXhair[axh_id] = axh;
  IL_PUSH(g_drawables_2d, axh);
 }

 if(sf & 2)
 {
  axh.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
 }

 if(sf & 4)
 {
  axh.colormod_x = ReadByte() / 255;
  axh.colormod_y = ReadByte() / 255;
  axh.colormod_z = ReadByte() / 255;
 }

 axh.cnt = time;
 axh.draw2d = AuxiliaryXhair_Draw2D;
 return true;
}

void Vehicles_drawCrosshair(string crosshair)
{
 vector tmpSize = '0 0 0';
 vector tmpPos = '0 0 0';


 if(crosshair)
 {
  tmpSize = draw_getimagesize(crosshair) * autocvar_cl_vehicles_crosshair_size;
  tmpPos.x = (vid_conwidth - tmpSize.x) / 2;
  tmpPos.y = (vid_conheight - tmpSize.y) / 2;

  vector wcross_color = '1 1 1';
  if(autocvar_cl_vehicles_crosshair_colorize)
   wcross_color = crosshair_getcolor((0, world), (0, g_stat_VEHICLESTAT_HEALTH));

  drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(tmpPos), crosshair, HUD_Scale(tmpSize), wcross_color, autocvar_crosshair_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }
}

void bumble_raygun_draw(entity this);

.vector bumble_origin;

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_BUMBLE_RAYGUN(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
    float sf = ReadByte();

    if(sf & BRG_SETUP)
    {
        this.cnt = ReadByte();
        this.team = ReadByte();
        this.count = ReadByte();

        if(this.count)
            this.colormod = '1 0 0';
        else
            this.colormod = '0 1 0';

        this.traileffect = EFFECT_BUMBLEBEE_HEAL_MUZZLEFLASH.m_id;
        this.lip = _particleeffectnum(EFFECT_BUMBLEBEE_HEAL_IMPACT.eent_eff_name);

        this.draw = bumble_raygun_draw;
        if (isnew) IL_PUSH(g_drawables, this);
    }


    if(sf & BRG_START)
    {
        this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
        setorigin(this, this.origin);
    }

    if(sf & BRG_END)
    {
        this.bumble_origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
    }
    return true;
}

.float bumble_raygun_nextdraw;
void bumble_raygun_draw(entity this)
{
    float _len;
    vector _dir;
    vector _vtmp1, _vtmp2;

    _len = vlen(this.origin - this.bumble_origin);
    _dir = normalize(this.bumble_origin - this.origin);

    if(this.bumble_raygun_nextdraw < time)
    {
        entity eff = Effects_from(this.traileffect);
        boxparticles(_particleeffectnum(eff.eent_eff_name), this, this.origin, this.origin + _dir * -64, _dir * -_len , _dir * -_len, 1, PARTICLES_USEALPHA);
        boxparticles(this.lip, this, this.bumble_origin, this.bumble_origin + _dir * -64, _dir * -200 , _dir * -200, 1, PARTICLES_USEALPHA);
        this.bumble_raygun_nextdraw = time + 0.1;
    }

    float i, df, sz, al;
    for(i = -0.1; i < 0.2; i += 0.1)
    {
        df = DRAWFLAG_NORMAL;
        sz = 5 + random() * 5;
        al = 0.25 + random() * 0.5;
        _vtmp1 = this.origin + _dir * _len * (0.25 + i);
        _vtmp1 += (randomvec() * (_len * 0.2) * (frametime * 2));
        Draw_CylindricLine(this.origin, _vtmp1, sz, "gfx/colors/white", 1, 1, this.colormod, al, df, view_origin);

        _vtmp2 = this.origin + _dir * _len * (0.5 + i);
        _vtmp2 += (randomvec() * (_len * 0.2) * (frametime * 5));
        Draw_CylindricLine(_vtmp1, _vtmp2, sz, "gfx/colors/white", 1, 1, this.colormod, al, df, view_origin);

        _vtmp1 = this.origin + _dir * _len * (0.75 + i);
        _vtmp1 += randomvec() * (_len * 0.2) * (frametime * 10);
        Draw_CylindricLine(_vtmp2, _vtmp1, sz, "gfx/colors/white", 1, 1, this.colormod, al, df, view_origin);

        Draw_CylindricLine(_vtmp1, this.bumble_origin + randomvec() * 32, sz, "gfx/colors/white", 1, 1, this.colormod, al, df, view_origin);
    }
}

string Buff_CompatName(string buffname);



# 1 "./common/mutators/mutator/buffs/all.inc" 1
string Buff_CompatName(string buffname)
{
    switch(buffname)
    {
        case "ammoregen": return "ammo";
        case "doubler": return "inferno";
        case "scout": return "bash";
        case "guard": return "resistance";
        case "revival": case "regen": return "medic";
        case "jumper": return "jump";
        case "invulnerability": return "vampire";
        case "kamikaze": return "vengeance";
        case "teleporter": return "swapper";
        default: return buffname;

    void DamageText_draw2d(DamageText this) {
        float since_hit = time - this.hit_time;

        float size = this.m_size - since_hit * this.m_shrink_rate * this.m_size;
        float alpha_ = this.alpha - since_hit * this.fade_rate;
        if (alpha_ <= 0 || size <= 0) {
            if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else builtin_remove(_this); }else voidfunc();
            return;
        }

        vector screen_pos;
        if (this.m_screen_coords) {
            screen_pos = this.origin + since_hit * autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_velocity;
        } else {
            vector forward, right, up;
            if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./common/mutators/mutator/damagetext/cl_damagetext.qc", 78, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
            vector world_offset = since_hit * autocvar_cl_damagetext_velocity_world + autocvar_cl_damagetext_offset_world;
            vector world_pos = this.origin + world_offset.x * forward + world_offset.y * right + world_offset.z * up;
            screen_pos = project_3d_to_2d(world_pos) + since_hit * autocvar_cl_damagetext_velocity_screen + autocvar_cl_damagetext_offset_screen;
        }
        screen_pos.y += size / 2;

        if (screen_pos.z >= 0) {
            screen_pos.z = 0;
            vector rgb;
            if (this.m_friendlyfire) {
                rgb = this.m_color_friendlyfire;
            } else {
                rgb = this.m_color;
            }
            if (autocvar_cl_damagetext_color_per_weapon) {
                Weapon w = ((this.m_deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((this.m_deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK));
                if (w != WEP_Null) rgb = w.wpcolor;
            }

            vector drawfontscale_save = drawfontscale;
            drawfontscale = (size / autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_max) * '1 1 0';
            screen_pos.y -= drawfontscale.x * size / 2;
            drawcolorcodedstring2_builtin(screen_pos, this.text, autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_max * '1 1 0', rgb, alpha_, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
            drawfontscale = drawfontscale_save;
        }
    }

    void DamageText_update(DamageText this, vector _origin, float _health, float _armor, float _potential_damage, float _deathtype) {
        this.m_healthdamage = _health;
        this.m_armordamage = _armor;
        this.m_potential_damage = _potential_damage;
        this.m_deathtype = _deathtype;
        setorigin(this, _origin);
        if (this.m_screen_coords) {
            this.alpha = autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_alpha_start;
        } else {
            this.alpha = autocvar_cl_damagetext_alpha_start;
        }
        this.hit_time = time;

        float health = rint(this.m_healthdamage / 128);
        float armor = rint(this.m_armordamage / 128);
        float total = rint((this.m_healthdamage + this.m_armordamage) / 128);
        float potential = rint(this.m_potential_damage / 128);
        float potential_health = rint((this.m_potential_damage - this.m_armordamage) / 128);

        float redundant = almost_equals_eps(this.m_healthdamage + this.m_armordamage, this.m_potential_damage, 5);

        string s = autocvar_cl_damagetext_format;
        s = strreplace("{armor}", (
            (this.m_armordamage == 0 && autocvar_cl_damagetext_format_hide_redundant)
                ? ""
                : sprintf("%d", armor)
            ), s);
        s = strreplace("{potential}", (
            (redundant && autocvar_cl_damagetext_format_hide_redundant)
                ? ""
                : sprintf("%d", potential)
            ), s);
        s = strreplace("{potential_health}", (
            (redundant && autocvar_cl_damagetext_format_hide_redundant)
                ? ""
                : sprintf("%d", potential_health)
            ), s);

        s = strreplace("{health}", (
            (health == potential_health || !autocvar_cl_damagetext_format_verbose)
                ? sprintf("%d", health)
                : sprintf("%d (%d)", health, potential_health)
            ), s);
        s = strreplace("{total}", (
            (total == potential || !autocvar_cl_damagetext_format_verbose)
                ? sprintf("%d", total)
                : sprintf("%d (%d)", total, potential)
            ), s);



        while (true) {
            float opening_pos = strstrofs(s, "{", 0);
            if (opening_pos == -1) break;
            float closing_pos = strstrofs(s, "}", opening_pos);
            if (closing_pos == -1 || closing_pos <= opening_pos) break;
            s = strcat(
                substring(s, 0, opening_pos),
                substring_range(s, closing_pos + 1, strlen(s))
            );
        }

        if(1){ if (this.text) { strunzone(this.text); } this.text = strzone(s); }else voidfunc();

        this.m_size = map_bound_ranges(potential,
            autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_min_damage, autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_max_damage,
            autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_min, autocvar_cl_damagetext_size_max);
    }

    DamageText spawnDamageText_9(DamageText this, float _group, vector _origin, float _screen_coords, float _health, float _armor, float _potential_damage, float _deathtype, float _friendlyfire) { return = this; } [[accumulate]] DamageText spawnDamageText_9(DamageText this, float _group, vector _origin, float _screen_coords, float _health, float _armor, float _potential_damage, float _deathtype, float _friendlyfire) {
        spawnDamageText_1(this );
        this.m_group = _group;
        this.m_friendlyfire = _friendlyfire;
        this.m_screen_coords = _screen_coords;
        if (_screen_coords) {
            this.fade_rate = 1 / autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_alpha_lifetime;
            this.m_shrink_rate = 1 / autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_size_lifetime;
        } else {
            this.fade_rate = 1 / autocvar_cl_damagetext_alpha_lifetime;
            this.m_shrink_rate = 0;
        }
        DamageText_update(this, _origin, _health, _armor, _potential_damage, _deathtype);
        IL_PUSH(g_drawables_2d, this);
    }
