float current_alpha(entity damage_text) {

    return damage_text.alpha - (time - damage_text.hit_time) * damage_text.fade_rate;
}

float Net_Handle_damagetext(entity this, entity sender, float isNew)
{
    (this).pure_data = true; (this).solid = SOLID_NOT;;
    float server_entity_index = ReadByte();
    float deathtype = ReadInt24_t();
    float flags = ReadByte();
    float friendlyfire = flags & DTFLAG_SAMETEAM;

    float health, armor, potential_damage;
    if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_HEALTH) health = ReadInt24_t();
    else health = ReadShort();
    if (flags & DTFLAG_NO_ARMOR) armor = 0;
    else if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_ARMOR) armor = ReadInt24_t();
    else armor = ReadShort();
    if (flags & DTFLAG_NO_POTENTIAL) potential_damage = health + armor;
    else if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_POTENTIAL) potential_damage = ReadInt24_t();
    else potential_damage = ReadShort();

    return = true;
    if (!isNew) return;
    if (autocvar_cl_damagetext == 0) return;
    if (friendlyfire) {
        if (autocvar_cl_damagetext_friendlyfire == 0) return;
        if (autocvar_cl_damagetext_friendlyfire == 1 && health == 0 && armor == 0) return;
    }

    float client_entity_index = server_entity_index - 1;
    entity entcs = al_ftoe(al_stof(bufstr_get(_entcs.al_buf, client_entity_index)));

    float can_use_3d = entcs && entcs.has_origin;
    float too_close = ((_vlen2 = (entcs.origin - view_origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_close_range) ** 2));
    float prefer_in_view = autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_out_of_view && !projected_on_screen(project_3d_to_2d(entcs.origin));
    float prefer_2d = spectatee_status != -1 && autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d && (too_close || prefer_in_view);

    if (can_use_3d && !prefer_2d) {


        for (entity e = findradius(entcs.origin, max(autocvar_cl_damagetext_accumulate_range, 1)); e; e = e.chain) {
            if (e.instanceOfDamageText
                && !e.m_screen_coords
                && e.m_group == server_entity_index
                && current_alpha(e) > autocvar_cl_damagetext_accumulate_alpha_rel * autocvar_cl_damagetext_alpha_start) {
                DamageText_update(e, entcs.origin, e.m_healthdamage + health, e.m_armordamage + armor, e.m_potential_damage + potential_damage, deathtype);
                return;
            }
        }
        (spawnDamageText_9(__spawn("DamageText", "./common/mutators/mutator/damagetext/cl_damagetext.qc" ":" "253", true) , server_entity_index, entcs.origin, false, health, armor, potential_damage, deathtype, friendlyfire)).pure_data = false;;
    } else if (autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d && spectatee_status != -1) {

        vector screen_pos = (_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth * autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_pos.x), _vec2_y = (vid_conheight * autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_pos.y), _vec2);
        if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_drawables_2d; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item; g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (it.instanceOfDamageText && it.m_screen_coords && it.m_group == server_entity_index) { { { DamageText_update(it, screen_pos, it.m_healthdamage + health, it.m_armordamage + armor, it.m_potential_damage + potential_damage, deathtype); return; }; } } if (g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_drawables_2d.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()


          ;


        if (DamageText_screen_first == (0, world)) {
            DamageText dt = spawnDamageText_9(__spawn("DamageText", "./common/mutators/mutator/damagetext/cl_damagetext.qc" ":" "264", true) , server_entity_index, screen_pos, true, health, armor, potential_damage, deathtype, friendlyfire);
            (dt).pure_data = false;;
            DamageText_screen_first = dt;
            DamageText_screen_count = 1;
        } else {
            screen_pos += autocvar_cl_damagetext_2d_overlap_offset * DamageText_screen_count;
            DamageText_screen_count++;
            (spawnDamageText_9(__spawn("DamageText", "./common/mutators/mutator/damagetext/cl_damagetext.qc" ":" "271", true) , server_entity_index, screen_pos, true, health, armor, potential_damage, deathtype, friendlyfire)).pure_data = false;;
        }
    }
}

void DrawItemsTimeItem(vector myPos, vector mySize, float ar, string item_icon, float item_time, float item_available, float item_availableTime)
{
    float t = 0;
    vector color = '0 0 0';
    float picalpha;

    if (autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_hidespawned == 2)
        picalpha = 1;
    else if (item_available)
        picalpha = blink(0.85, 0.15, 5);
    else
        picalpha = 0.5;
    t = floor(item_time - time + 0.999);
    if (t < 5)
        color = '0.7 0 0';
    else if (t < 10)
        color = '0.7 0.7 0';
    else
        color = '1 1 1';

    vector picpos, numpos;
    if (autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_iconalign)
    {
        numpos = myPos;
        picpos = myPos + eX * (ar - 1) * mySize_y;
    }
    else
    {
        numpos = myPos + eX * mySize_y;
        picpos = myPos;
    }

    if (t > 0 && autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_progressbar)
    {
        vector p_pos, p_size;
        if (autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_progressbar_reduced)
        {
            p_pos = numpos;
            p_size = (_vec2_x = (((ar - 1)/ar) * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2);
        }
        else
        {
            p_pos = myPos;
            p_size = mySize;
        }
        HUD_Panel_DrawProgressBar(p_pos, p_size, autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_progressbar_name, t/autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_progressbar_maxtime, 0, autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_iconalign, color, autocvar_hud_progressbar_alpha * panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
    }

    if(autocvar_hud_panel_itemstime_text)
    {
        if(t > 0)
            drawstring_aspect(numpos, ftos(t), (_vec2_x = (((ar - 1)/ar) * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2), color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
        else if(precache_pic("gfx/hud/default/checkmark"))
            if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", "checkmark"); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", "checkmark"); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = (_vec2_x = ((ar - 1) * mySize.y), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2); if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(numpos + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha * picalpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(numpos + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha * picalpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();
        else
            picpos.x = myPos.x + mySize.x / 2 - mySize.y / 2;
    }

float Item_ItemsTime_GetTime(float item)
{
    if(autocvar__hud_configure)
    {
        switch(item)
        {
            case ITEM_ArmorMega.m_id: return time + 0;
            case ITEM_HealthMega.m_id: return time + 8;
            case ITEM_Strength.m_id: return time + 0;
            case ITEM_Shield.m_id: return time + 4;
        }

        return -1;
    }
    else
        return ItemsTime_time[item];
}

      ;

.float ltime;
void orb_draw(entity this)
{
 float dt = time - this.move_time;
 this.move_time = time;
 if(dt <= 0)
  return;

 this.alpha = (this.ltime - time) / this.orb_lifetime;
 this.scale = min((1 - this.alpha)*this.orb_lifetime*4,1)*this.orb_radius;
 this.angles = this.angles + dt * this.avelocity;
}

float orb_drawtime;
void orb_draw2d(entity this)
{
 if(time <= orb_drawtime)
  return;

 if(boxesoverlap(view_origin - '1 1 1', view_origin + '1 1 1', this.absmin, this.absmax))
 {
  orb_drawtime = time;
  float orb_alpha = 0.65 * (this.ltime - time) / this.orb_lifetime;
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift('0 0 0'), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (vid_conwidth), _vec2_y = (vid_conheight), _vec2)), this.colormod, autocvar_hud_colorflash_alpha * orb_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
 }
}

{
 if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_NADE_ORB); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((e), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();

 vector size = '1 1 1' * e.orb_radius / 2;

 e.renderflags |= RF_ADDITIVE;
}

vector(OverkillNex this, float actor_colors, entity wepent) OverkillNex_wr_glow; .vector(OverkillNex this, float actor_colors, entity wepent) wr_glow; [[accumulate]] void spawnOverkillNex_static(OverkillNex this) { this.wr_glow = OverkillNex_wr_glow; } vector(OverkillNex this, float actor_colors, entity wepent) OverkillNex_wr_glow
{
 if (!(_wep_oknex.wepvar_charge)) return '0 0 0';
 float charge = max(0.25, wepent.oknex_charge);
 float animlimit = (_wep_oknex.wepvar_charge_animlimit);
 float f = min(1, charge / animlimit);
 vector mycolors = colormapPaletteColor_(actor_colors & 0x0F, true, time);
 vector g = f * (mycolors * 0.3);
 if (charge > animlimit)
 {
  f = (charge - animlimit) / (1 - animlimit);
  g += f * (mycolors * 0.7);
 }

 if (g == '0 0 0')
  g = '0 0 0.000001';
 return g;
}

        if (t < 192)
        {
            SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, t / 191.0);
            this.build_finished = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            t = (t - 192) * 256 + ReadByte();
            this.build_started = servertime;
            if (this.build_finished)
                this.build_starthealth = bound(0, GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH), 1);
            else
                this.build_starthealth = 0;
            this.build_finished = servertime + t / 32;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, -1);
        this.build_finished = 0;
    }

    if (sendflags & 64)
    {

        this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
        setorigin(this, this.origin);
    }

    if (sendflags & 1)
    {
        this.team = ReadByte();
        this.rule = ReadByte();
    }

    if (sendflags & 2)
    {
        if(1){ if (this.netname) { strunzone(this.netname); } this.netname = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
    }

    if (sendflags & 4)
    {
        if(1){ if (this.netname2) { strunzone(this.netname2); } this.netname2 = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
    }

    if (sendflags & 8)
    {
        if(1){ if (this.netname3) { strunzone(this.netname3); } this.netname3 = strzone(ReadString()); }else voidfunc();
    }

    if (sendflags & 16)
    {
        this.lifetime = ReadCoord();
        this.fadetime = ReadCoord();
        this.maxdistance = ReadShort();
        this.hideflags = ReadByte();
    }

    if (sendflags & 32)
    {
        float f = ReadByte();
        this.teamradar_icon = f & ((1 << (7)) - 1);
        if (f & (1 << (7)))
        {
            this.(teamradar_times[this.teamradar_time_index]) = time;
            this.teamradar_time_index = (this.teamradar_time_index + 1) % MAX_TEAMRADAR_TIMES;
        }
        this.teamradar_color_x = ReadByte() / 255.0;
        this.teamradar_color_y = ReadByte() / 255.0;
        this.teamradar_color_z = ReadByte() / 255.0;
        this.helpme = ReadByte() * 0.1;
        if (this.helpme > 0)
            this.helpme += servertime;
    }

    InterpolateOrigin_Note(this);

    this.entremove = Ent_RemoveWaypointSprite;
}



float spritelookupblinkvalue(entity this, string s)
{
    if (s == WP_Weapon.netname) {
        if (Weapons_from(this.wp_extra).spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_SUPERWEAPON)
            return 2;
    }
    if (s == WP_Item.netname) return Items_from(this.wp_extra).m_waypointblink;
    if(s == WP_FlagReturn.netname) return 2;

    return 1;
}

vector spritelookupcolor(entity this, string s, vector def)
{
    if (s == WP_Weapon.netname || s == RADARICON_Weapon.netname) return Weapons_from(this.wp_extra).wpcolor;
    if (s == WP_Item.netname || s == RADARICON_Item.netname) return Items_from(this.wp_extra).m_color;
    if (__Mutator_Send_WP_Format(0 , this, s))
    {
        return MUTATOR_ARGV_2_vector;
    }
    return def;
}

 if(autocvar_g_waypointsprite_spam && waypointsprite_count >= autocvar_g_waypointsprite_spam)

    if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Waypoints_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.netname == s) { { { return it.m_name; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

}

      ;

    return s;
}



void drawrotpic(vector org, float rot, string pic, vector sz, vector hotspot, vector rgb, float a, float f)
{
    vector v1, v2, v3, v4;

    hotspot = -1 * hotspot;


    v1 = hotspot;
    v2 = hotspot + '1 0 0' * sz.x;
    v3 = hotspot + '1 0 0' * sz.x + '0 1 0' * sz.y;
    v4 = hotspot + '0 1 0' * sz.y;


    rot = -rot;
    v1 = Rotate(v1, rot) + org;
    v2 = Rotate(v2, rot) + org;
    v3 = Rotate(v3, rot) + org;
    v4 = Rotate(v4, rot) + org;


    R_BeginPolygon(pic, f, true);
    R_PolygonVertex(v1, '0 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(v2, '1 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(v3, '1 1 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(v4, '0 1 0', rgb, a);
    R_EndPolygon();
}

void drawquad(vector o, vector ri, vector up, string pic, vector rgb, float a, float f)
{
    R_BeginPolygon(pic, f, true);
    R_PolygonVertex(o, '0 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + ri, '1 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + up + ri, '1 1 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + up, '0 1 0', rgb, a);
    R_EndPolygon();
}

void drawhealthbar(vector org, float rot, float h, vector sz, vector hotspot, float width, float theheight, float margin, float border, float align, vector rgb, float a, vector hrgb, float ha, float f)
{
    vector o, ri, up;
    float owidth;

    hotspot = -1 * hotspot;


    o = hotspot;
    ri = '1 0 0';
    up = '0 1 0';

    rot = -rot;
    o = Rotate(o, rot) + org;
    ri = Rotate(ri, rot);
    up = Rotate(up, rot);

    owidth = width + 2 * border;
    o = o - up * (margin + border + theheight) + ri * (sz.x - owidth) * 0.5;

    drawquad(o - up * border, ri * owidth, up * border, "", rgb, a, f);
    drawquad(o + up * theheight, ri * owidth, up * border, "", rgb, a, f);
    drawquad(o, ri * border, up * theheight, "", rgb, a, f);
    drawquad(o + ri * (owidth - border), ri * border, up * theheight, "", rgb, a, f);
    drawquad(o + ri * (border + align * ((1 - h) * width)), ri * width * h, up * theheight, "", hrgb, ha, f);
}


vector drawspritearrow(vector o, float ang, vector rgb, float a, float t)
{
    float size = 9.0 * t;
    float border = 1.5 * t;
    float margin = 4.0 * t;

    float borderDiag = border * M_SQRT2;
    vector arrowX = eX * size;
    vector arrowY = eY * (size+borderDiag);
    vector borderX = eX * (size+borderDiag);
    vector borderY = eY * (size+borderDiag+border);

    R_BeginPolygon("", DRAWFLAG_NORMAL, true);
    R_PolygonVertex(o, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(arrowY - borderX, ang), '0 0 0', '0 0 0', a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(borderY - borderX, ang), '0 0 0', '0 0 0', a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(borderY + borderX, ang), '0 0 0', '0 0 0', a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(arrowY + borderX, ang), '0 0 0', '0 0 0', a);
    R_EndPolygon();

    R_BeginPolygon("", DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE, true);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(eY * borderDiag, ang), '0 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(arrowY - arrowX, ang), '0 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_PolygonVertex(o + Rotate(arrowY + arrowX, ang), '0 0 0', rgb, a);
    R_EndPolygon();

    return o + Rotate(eY * (borderDiag+size+margin), ang);
}


vector drawsprite_TextOrIcon(float is_text, vector o, float ang, float minwidth, vector rgb, float a, vector sz, string str)
{
    float algnx, algny;
    float sw, w, h;
    float aspect, sa, ca;

    if (is_text)
        sw = stringwidth(str, false, sz);
    else
        sw = sz.x;

    if (sw > minwidth)
        w = sw;
    else
        w = minwidth;
    h = sz.y;


    aspect = vid_conwidth / vid_conheight;
    sa = sin(ang);
    ca = cos(ang) * aspect;
    if (fabs(sa) > fabs(ca))
    {
        algnx = (sa < 0);
        float f = fabs(sa);
        algny = 0.5 - 0.5 * (f ? (ca / f) : 0);
    }
    else
    {
        float f = fabs(ca);
        algnx = 0.5 - 0.5 * (f ? (sa / f) : 0);
        algny = (ca < 0);
    }


    o.x -= w * algnx;
    o.y -= h * algny;


    if (o.x < 0)
        o.x = 0;
    if (o.y < 0)
        o.y = 0;
    if (o.x > vid_conwidth - w)
        o.x = vid_conwidth - w;
    if (o.y > vid_conheight - h)
        o.y = vid_conheight - h;

    o.x += 0.5 * (w - sw);

    if (is_text)
        drawstring_builtin(HUD_Shift(o), str, sz, rgb, a, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
    else
        drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(o), str, HUD_Scale(sz), rgb, a, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

    o.x += 0.5 * sw;
    o.y += 0.5 * h;

    return o;
}

vector fixrgbexcess_move(vector rgb, vector src, vector dst)
{
    vector yvec = '0.299 0.587 0.114';
    return rgb + dst * ((src * yvec) / (dst * yvec)) * ((rgb - '1 1 1') * src);
}

vector fixrgbexcess(vector rgb)
{
    if (rgb.x > 1) {
        rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '1 0 0', '0 1 1');
        if (rgb.y > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 1 0', '0 0 1');
            if (rgb.z > 1) rgb.z = 1;
        } else if (rgb.z > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 0 1', '0 1 0');
            if (rgb.y > 1) rgb.y = 1;
        }
    } else if (rgb.y > 1) {
        rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 1 0', '1 0 1');
        if (rgb.x > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '1 0 0', '0 0 1');
            if (rgb.z > 1) rgb.z = 1;
        } else if (rgb.z > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 0 1', '1 0 0');
            if (rgb.x > 1) rgb.x = 1;
        }
    } else if (rgb.z > 1) {
        rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 0 1', '1 1 0');
        if (rgb.x > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '1 0 0', '0 1 0');
            if (rgb.y > 1) rgb.y = 1;
        } else if (rgb.y > 1) {
            rgb = fixrgbexcess_move(rgb, '0 1 0', '1 0 0');
            if (rgb.x > 1) rgb.x = 1;
        }
    }
    return rgb;
}

void Draw_WaypointSprite(entity this)
{
    if (this.lifetime > 0)
        this.alpha = (bound(0, (this.fadetime - time) / this.lifetime, 1) ** waypointsprite_timealphaexponent);
    else
        this.alpha = 1;

    if (this.hideflags & 2)
        return;

    if (autocvar_cl_hidewaypoints >= 2)
        return;

    if ((this.hideflags & 1) && autocvar_cl_hidewaypoints)
        return;

    InterpolateOrigin_Do(this);

    float t = entcs_GetTeam(player_localnum) + 1;
    string spriteimage = "";


    switch (this.rule)
    {
        case SPRITERULE_SPECTATOR:
            if (!(
                (autocvar_g_waypointsprite_itemstime == 1 && t == NUM_SPECTATOR + 1)
            || (autocvar_g_waypointsprite_itemstime == 2 && (t == NUM_SPECTATOR + 1 || warmup_stage || (0, g_stat_ITEMSTIME) == 2))
                ))
                return;
            spriteimage = this.netname;
            break;
        case SPRITERULE_DEFAULT:
            if (this.team)
            {
                if (this.team == t)
                    spriteimage = this.netname;
                else
                    spriteimage = "";
            }
            else
                spriteimage = this.netname;
            break;
        case SPRITERULE_TEAMPLAY:
            if (t == NUM_SPECTATOR + 1)
                spriteimage = this.netname3;
            else if (this.team == t)
                spriteimage = this.netname2;
            else
                spriteimage = this.netname;
            break;
        default:
            (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Invalid waypointsprite rule!"));
            break;
    }

    if (spriteimage == "")
        return;

    ++waypointsprite_newcount;

    float dist = vlen(this.origin - view_origin);
    float a = this.alpha * autocvar_hud_panel_fg_alpha;

    if(this.maxdistance > 0)
    {

        float maxnormdistance = bound(0, waypointsprite_normdistance, this.maxdistance - 1);
        a *= (bound(0, (this.maxdistance - dist) / (this.maxdistance - maxnormdistance), 1) ** waypointsprite_distancealphaexponent);
    }

    vector rgb = spritelookupcolor(this, spriteimage, this.teamradar_color);
    if (rgb == '0 0 0')
    {
        this.teamradar_color = '1 0 1';
        if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mutators/mutator/waypoints/waypointsprites.qc", "545")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("WARNING: sprite of name %s has no color, using pink so you notice it", spriteimage); print("^7", __s); if (str2chr(__s, strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    }

    float health_val = GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH);
    float blink_time = (health_val >= 0) ? (health_val * 10) : time;
    if (blink_time - floor(blink_time) > 0.5)
    {
        if (this.helpme && time < this.helpme)
            a *= SPRITE_HELPME_BLINK;
        else if (!this.lifetime)
            a *= spritelookupblinkvalue(this, spriteimage);
    }

    if (a > 1)
    {
        rgb *= a;
        a = 1;
    }

    if (a <= 0.003)
        return;

    rgb = fixrgbexcess(rgb);

    vector o;
    float ang;

    o = project_3d_to_2d(this.origin);
    if (o.z < 0
    || o.x < (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left)
    || o.y < (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top)
    || o.x > (vid_conwidth - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right))
    || o.y > (vid_conheight - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom)))
    {

        vector d;

        d = o - '0.5 0 0' * vid_conwidth - '0 0.5 0' * vid_conheight;
        ang = atan2(-d.x, -d.y);
        if (o.z < 0)
            ang += 3.14159265358979323846;

  float f1 = d.x / vid_conwidth;
  float f2 = d.y / vid_conheight;
  if (f1 == 0) { f1 = 0.000001; }
  if (f2 == 0) { f2 = 0.000001; }

        if (max(f1, -f1) > max(f2, -f2)) {
            if (d.z * f1 > 0) {

                d = d * ((0.5 - waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right) / f1);
            } else {

                d = d * (-(0.5 - waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left) / f1);
            }
        } else {
            if (d.z * f2 > 0) {

                d = d * ((0.5 - waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom) / f2);
            } else {

                d = d * (-(0.5 - waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top) / f2);
            }
        }

        o = d + '0.5 0 0' * vid_conwidth + '0 0.5 0' * vid_conheight;
    }
    else
    {

        ang = 3.14159265358979323846;





    }
    o.z = 0;

    float edgedistance_min = min((o.y - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_top)),
    (o.x - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_left)),
    (vid_conwidth - (vid_conwidth * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_right)) - o.x,
    (vid_conheight - (vid_conheight * waypointsprite_edgeoffset_bottom)) - o.y);

    float crosshairdistance = sqrt( ((o.x - vid_conwidth/2) ** 2) + ((o.y - vid_conheight/2) ** 2) );

    t = waypointsprite_scale;
    a *= waypointsprite_alpha;

    {
        a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_distancefadealpha) * (bound(0, dist/waypointsprite_distancefadedistance, 1)));
        t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_distancefadescale) * (bound(0, dist/waypointsprite_distancefadedistance, 1)));
    }
    if (edgedistance_min < waypointsprite_edgefadedistance) {
        a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_edgefadealpha) * (1 - bound(0, edgedistance_min/waypointsprite_edgefadedistance, 1)));
        t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_edgefadescale) * (1 - bound(0, edgedistance_min/waypointsprite_edgefadedistance, 1)));
    }
    if (crosshairdistance < waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance) {
        a = a * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_crosshairfadealpha) * (1 - bound(0, crosshairdistance/waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance, 1)));
        t = t * (1 - (1 - waypointsprite_crosshairfadescale) * (1 - bound(0, crosshairdistance/waypointsprite_crosshairfadedistance, 1)));
    }

    if (this.build_finished)
    {
        if (time < this.build_finished + 0.25)
        {
            if (time < this.build_started)
                SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, this.build_starthealth);
            else if (time < this.build_finished)
                SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, (time - this.build_started) / (this.build_finished - this.build_started) * (1 - this.build_starthealth) + this.build_starthealth);
            else
                SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, 1);
        }
        else
            SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, -1);
    }

    o = drawspritearrow(o, ang, rgb, a, SPRITE_ARROW_SCALE * t);

 string pic = "";
 float is_text = true;
 if (!autocvar_g_waypointsprite_text)
 {
  string spr_icon = spritelookupicon(this, spriteimage);
  pic = spr_icon;
  float icon_found = !(!spr_icon || spr_icon == "");
  if (icon_found)
  {
   pic = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", spr_icon);
   if(precache_pic(pic) == "")
   {
    pic = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", spr_icon);
    if(!precache_pic(pic))
     icon_found = false;
   }
  }
  if (icon_found)
   is_text = false;
 }

 vector sz;
 vector txt_color;
    string txt = nil;
    if (is_text)
    {
        txt = spritelookuptext(this, spriteimage);
        if (this.helpme && time < this.helpme)
            txt = sprintf(_("%s needing help!"), txt);
        if (autocvar_g_waypointsprite_uppercase)
            txt = strtoupper(txt);
        txt_color = rgb;
        sz = waypointsprite_fontsize * '1 1 0';
    }
    else
    {

        txt = pic;
        txt_color = ((autocvar_g_waypointsprite_iconcolor) ? '1 1 1' : rgb);
        sz = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_iconsize * '1 1 0';
    }

    drawfont = FONT_USER + 2;
    if (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) >= 0)
    {
        float align = 0, marg;
        if (this.build_finished)
            align = 0.5;
        else
            align = 0;
        if (cos(ang) > 0)
            marg = -(SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_MARGIN + SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_HEIGHT + 2 * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDER) * t - 0.5 * sz.y;
        else
            marg = SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_MARGIN * t + 0.5 * sz.y;

        float minwidth = (SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_WIDTH + 2 * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDER) * t;
        o = drawsprite_TextOrIcon(is_text, o, ang, minwidth, txt_color, a, sz, txt);
        drawhealthbar(
                o,
                0,
                GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH),
                '0 0 0',
                '0 0 0',
                SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_WIDTH * t,
                SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_HEIGHT * t,
                marg,
                SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDER * t,
                align,
                rgb,
                a * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_BORDERALPHA,
                rgb,
                a * SPRITE_HEALTHBAR_HEALTHALPHA,
                DRAWFLAG_NORMAL
                 );
    }
    else
    {
        drawsprite_TextOrIcon(is_text, o, ang, 0, txt_color, a, sz, txt);
    }

    drawfont = FONT_USER + 1;
}

void WaypointSprite_Load_Frames(string ext)
{
    float dh = search_begin(strcat("models/sprites/*_frame*", ext), false, false);
    if (dh < 0) return;
    float ext_len = strlen(ext);
    float n = search_getsize(dh);
    for (float i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    {
        string s = search_getfilename(dh, i);
        s = substring(s, 15, strlen(s) - 15 - ext_len);

        float o = strstrofs(s, "_frame", 0);
        string sname = strcat("/spriteframes/", substring(s, 0, o));
        string sframes = substring(s, o + 6, strlen(s) - o - 6);
        float f = stof(sframes) + 1;
        db_put(tempdb, sname, ftos(max(f, stof(db_get(tempdb, sname)))));
    }
    search_end(dh);
}

void WaypointSprite_Load();
[[accumulate]] void _static_WaypointSprite_Load_1(); [[accumulate]] void __static_init_1() { _static_WaypointSprite_Load_1(); } void _static_WaypointSprite_Load_1() {
    WaypointSprite_Load();
    WaypointSprite_Load_Frames(".tga");
    WaypointSprite_Load_Frames(".jpg");
}
void WaypointSprite_Load()
{
    waypointsprite_fadedistance = vlen(mi_scale);
    waypointsprite_normdistance = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_normdistance;
    waypointsprite_minscale = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_minscale;
    waypointsprite_minalpha = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_minalpha;
    waypointsprite_distancealphaexponent = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_distancealphaexponent;
    waypointsprite_timealphaexponent = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_timealphaexponent;
    waypointsprite_scale = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_scale;
    waypointsprite_fontsize = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_fontsize;
    waypointsprite_edgefadealpha = autocvar_g_waypointsprite_edgefadealpha;

void DrawCAItem(vector myPos, vector mySize, float aspect_ratio, float layout, float i)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float stat = -1;
 string pic = "";
 vector color = '0 0 0';
 switch(i)
 {
  case 0: stat = (0, g_stat_REDALIVE); pic = "player_red"; color = '1 0 0'; break;
  case 1: stat = (0, g_stat_BLUEALIVE); pic = "player_blue"; color = '0 0 1'; break;
  case 2: stat = (0, g_stat_YELLOWALIVE); pic = "player_yellow"; color = '1 1 0'; break;
  default:
  case 3: stat = (0, g_stat_PINKALIVE); pic = "player_pink"; color = '1 0 1'; break;
 }

 if(mySize.x/mySize.y > aspect_ratio)
 {
  i = aspect_ratio * mySize.y;
  myPos.x = myPos.x + (mySize.x - i) / 2;
  mySize.x = i;
 }
 else
 {
  i = 1/aspect_ratio * mySize.x;
  myPos.y = myPos.y + (mySize.y - i) / 2;
  mySize.y = i;
 }

 if(layout)
 {
  if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", pic); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", pic); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = (_vec2_x = (0.5 * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2); if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(myPos + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(myPos + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();
  drawstring_aspect(myPos + eX * 0.5 * mySize.x, ftos(stat), (_vec2_x = (0.5 * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2), color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }
 else
  drawstring_aspect(myPos, ftos(stat), mySize, color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
}

void HUD_Mod_CA_Draw(vector myPos, vector mySize, float layout)
{
 float rows, columns;
 float aspect_ratio;
 aspect_ratio = (layout) ? 2 : 1;
 rows = HUD_GetRowCount(team_count, mySize, aspect_ratio);
 columns = ceil(team_count/rows);

 float i;
 float row = 0, column = 0;
 vector pos = '0 0 0', itemSize;
 itemSize = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x / columns), _vec2_y = (mySize.y / rows), _vec2);
 for(i=0; i<team_count; ++i)
 {
  pos.x = myPos.x + column * itemSize.x;
  pos.y = myPos.y + row * itemSize.y;

  DrawCAItem(pos, itemSize, aspect_ratio, layout, i);

  ++row;
  if(row >= rows)
  {
   row = 0;
   ++column;
  }
 }
}

void DrawDomItem(vector myPos, vector mySize, float aspect_ratio, float layout, float i)
{
 if(1){ }else voidfunc(); if(1){ }else voidfunc();
 float stat = -1;
 string pic = "";
 vector color = '0 0 0';
 switch(i)
 {
  case 0: stat = (0, g_stat_DOM_PPS_RED); pic = "dom_icon_red"; color = '1 0 0'; break;
  case 1: stat = (0, g_stat_DOM_PPS_BLUE); pic = "dom_icon_blue"; color = '0 0 1'; break;
  case 2: stat = (0, g_stat_DOM_PPS_YELLOW); pic = "dom_icon_yellow"; color = '1 1 0'; break;
  default:
  case 3: stat = (0, g_stat_DOM_PPS_PINK); pic = "dom_icon_pink"; color = '1 0 1'; break;
 }
 float pps_ratio = 0;
 if((0, g_stat_DOM_TOTAL_PPS))
  pps_ratio = stat / (0, g_stat_DOM_TOTAL_PPS);

 if(mySize.x/mySize.y > aspect_ratio)
 {
  i = aspect_ratio * mySize.y;
  myPos.x = myPos.x + (mySize.x - i) / 2;
  mySize.x = i;
 }
 else
 {
  i = 1/aspect_ratio * mySize.x;
  myPos.y = myPos.y + (mySize.y - i) / 2;
  mySize.y = i;
 }

 if (layout)
 {

  color *= 0.5 + pps_ratio * (1 - 0.5);
  if (layout == 2)
   drawstring_aspect(myPos + eX * mySize.y, ftos_decimals(stat, 2), (_vec2_x = ((2/3) * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2), color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  else
   drawstring_aspect(myPos + eX * mySize.y, strcat( ftos(floor(pps_ratio*100 + 0.5)), "%" ), (_vec2_x = ((2/3) * mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2), color, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
 }

 if (stat > 0)
 {
  drawsetcliparea_builtin((myPos.x + hud_shift.x + hud_shift.z * (myPos.x - hud_scale_center.x)), (myPos.y + mySize.y * (1 - pps_ratio) + hud_shift.y + hud_shift.z * (myPos.y + mySize.y * (1 - pps_ratio) - hud_scale_center.y)), (mySize.y * hud_scale.x), (mySize.y * pps_ratio * hud_scale.y));
  if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", strcat(pic, "-highlighted")); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", strcat(pic, "-highlighted")); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = '1 1 0' * mySize.y; if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(myPos + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(myPos + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();

void HUD_Mod_Dom(vector myPos, vector mySize)
{
 mod_active = 1;

 float layout = autocvar_hud_panel_modicons_dom_layout;
 float rows, columns;
 float aspect_ratio;
 aspect_ratio = (layout) ? 3 : 1;
 rows = HUD_GetRowCount(team_count, mySize, aspect_ratio);
 columns = ceil(team_count/rows);

 float i;
 float row = 0, column = 0;
 vector pos, itemSize;
 itemSize = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x / columns), _vec2_y = (mySize.y / rows), _vec2);
 for(i=0; i<team_count; ++i)
 {
  pos = myPos + (_vec2_x = (column * itemSize.x), _vec2_y = (row * itemSize.y), _vec2);

  DrawDomItem(pos, itemSize, aspect_ratio, layout, i);

  ++row;
  if(row >= rows)
  {
   row = 0;
   ++column;
  }
 }
}

vector KH_SLOTS[4];

void HUD_Mod_KH(vector pos, vector mySize)
{
 mod_active = 1;


 float state = (0, g_stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS);
 if(!state) return;

 float i, key_state;
 float all_keys, team1_keys, team2_keys, team3_keys, team4_keys, dropped_keys, carrying_keys;
 all_keys = team1_keys = team2_keys = team3_keys = team4_keys = dropped_keys = carrying_keys = 0;

 for(i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
 {
  key_state = (bitshift(state, i * -5) & 31) - 1;

  if(key_state == -1)
   continue;

  if(key_state == 30)
  {
   ++carrying_keys;
   key_state = myteam;
  }

  switch(key_state)
  {
   case NUM_TEAM_1: ++team1_keys; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_2: ++team2_keys; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_3: ++team3_keys; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_4: ++team4_keys; break;
   case 29: ++dropped_keys; break;
  }

  ++all_keys;
 }


 vector slot_size;
 if(all_keys == 4 && mySize.x * 0.5 < mySize.y && mySize.y * 0.5 < mySize.x)
 {

  slot_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x * 0.5), _vec2_y = (mySize.y * 0.5), _vec2);
  KH_SLOTS[0] = pos;
  KH_SLOTS[1] = pos + eX * slot_size.x;
  KH_SLOTS[2] = pos + eY * slot_size.y;
  KH_SLOTS[3] = pos + eX * slot_size.x + eY * slot_size.y;
 }
 else
 {
  if(mySize.x > mySize.y)
  {

   slot_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x / all_keys), _vec2_y = (mySize.y), _vec2);
   for(i = 0; i < all_keys; ++i)
    KH_SLOTS[i] = pos + eX * slot_size.x * i;
  }
  else
  {

   slot_size = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x), _vec2_y = (mySize.y / all_keys), _vec2);
   for(i = 0; i < all_keys; ++i)
    KH_SLOTS[i] = pos + eY * slot_size.y * i;
  }
 }



 float alpha = 1;
 if(carrying_keys)
 {
  float blink = 0.6 + sin(2 * 3.14159265358979323846 * time) * 0.4;
  switch(myteam)
  {
   case NUM_TEAM_1: if(team1_keys == all_keys) alpha = blink; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_2: if(team2_keys == all_keys) alpha = blink; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_3: if(team3_keys == all_keys) alpha = blink; break;
   case NUM_TEAM_4: if(team4_keys == all_keys) alpha = blink; break;
  }
 }
 alpha *= panel_fg_alpha;



 i = 0;

 while(team1_keys--)
  if(myteam == NUM_TEAM_1 && carrying_keys)
  {
   if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", "kh_red_carrying"); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", "kh_red_carrying"); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = slot_size; if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(KH_SLOTS[i++] + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(KH_SLOTS[i++] + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();

  }

   if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", "kh_red_taken"); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", "kh_red_taken"); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = slot_size; if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(KH_SLOTS[i++] + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(KH_SLOTS[i++] + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();

   --carrying_keys;

{
 float leaders_count = (0, g_stat_REDALIVE);
 if(!leaders_count)
 {
  mod_active = 0;
  return;
 }

 float rows, columns;
 float aspect_ratio = 2;
 rows = HUD_GetRowCount(2, mySize, aspect_ratio);
 columns = ceil(2 / rows);

 vector pos = myPos;
 vector itemSize = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x / columns), _vec2_y = (mySize.y / rows), _vec2);

 float visible_leaders = (0, g_stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS);

 if (visible_leaders)
  if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", "flag_stalemate"); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", "flag_stalemate"); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = (_vec2_x = (0.5 * itemSize.x), _vec2_y = (itemSize.y), _vec2); if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ _drawpic_picpath = strcat(hud_skin_path, "/", "player_neutral"); if(precache_pic(_drawpic_picpath) == "") { _drawpic_picpath = strcat("gfx/hud/default/", "player_neutral"); } if(1){ _drawpic_imgsize = draw_getimagesize(_drawpic_picpath); if(_drawpic_imgsize != '0 0 0') { _drawpic_imgaspect = _drawpic_imgsize.x/_drawpic_imgsize.y; _drawpic_sz = (_vec2_x = (0.5 * itemSize.x), _vec2_y = (itemSize.y), _vec2); if(_drawpic_sz.x/_drawpic_sz.y > _drawpic_imgaspect) { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.x; _drawpic_sz.x = _drawpic_sz.y * _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.x) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + eX * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.x)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } else { _drawpic_oldsz = _drawpic_sz.y; _drawpic_sz.y = _drawpic_sz.x / _drawpic_imgaspect; if(_drawpic_sz.y) drawpic_builtin(HUD_Shift(pos + eY * 0.5 * (_drawpic_oldsz - _drawpic_sz.y)), _drawpic_picpath, HUD_Scale(_drawpic_sz), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL); } } }else voidfunc(); _drawpic_picpath = nil; }else voidfunc();
 drawstring_aspect(pos + eX * 0.5 * itemSize.x, ftos(leaders_count), (_vec2_x = (0.5 * itemSize.x), _vec2_y = (itemSize.y), _vec2), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 if (rows > 1)
  pos.y = myPos.y + itemSize.y;
 else
  pos.x = myPos.x + itemSize.x;

 float lives_diff = (0, g_stat_BLUEALIVE);

void cpicon_draw(entity this)
{

  this.cp_bob_dmg_z = this.cp_bob_dmg_z - 3 * frametime;

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_CONTROLPOINT_ICON(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 return = true;
 float sf = ReadByte();

 if(sf & CPSF_SETUP)
 {
  this.origin = (_vec3.x = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.y = (ReadCoord()), _vec3.z = (ReadCoord()), _vec3);
  setorigin(this, this.origin);

  SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, ReadByte());
  this.max_health = ReadByte();
  this.count = ReadByte();
  this.team = ReadByte();
  this.iscaptured = ReadByte();

  if(!this.count)
   this.count = (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) - this.max_health) * frametime;

  cpicon_changeteam(this);
  cpicon_construct(this, isnew);
 }

 {
  float _tmp = ReadByte();
  if(_tmp != this.team)
  {
   this.team = _tmp;
   cpicon_changeteam(this);
  }

  _tmp = ReadByte();

  if(_tmp != GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH))
   cpicon_damage(this, _tmp);

  SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, _tmp);
 }
}

 }
}

float Net_Handle_ENT_CLIENT_SURVIVALSTATUSES(entity this, entity sender, float isnew)
{
 (this).pure_data = true; (this).solid = SOLID_NOT;;

 if(1){ noref Stream _stream = 0; if(1){ sf = ReadByte(); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 if (sf & (1 << (0)))
 {
  for (float j = 0; j < maxclients; ++j)
   if (playerslots[j])
    playerslots[j].survival_status = SURV_STATUS_PREY;
 }
 if (sf & (1 << (1)))
 {
  for (float i = 1; i <= maxclients; i += 8)
  {
   float f = 0;
   if(1){ noref Stream _stream = 0; if(1){ f = ReadByte(); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   for (float b = 0; b < 8; ++b)
   {
    if (!(f & (1 << (b)))) continue;
    float j = i - 1 + b;
    if (playerslots[j])
     playerslots[j].survival_status = SURV_STATUS_HUNTER;
   }
  }
 }


 for (float i = 1; i <= maxclients; ++i)
 {
  entity e = playerslots[i - 1];
  if (!e) continue;

  float plcolor = SURV_COLOR_PREY;
  if(e.survival_status == SURV_STATUS_HUNTER)
   plcolor = SURV_COLOR_HUNTER;

  e.colormap = 1024 + plcolor;
 }

 return true;
}

float GetResource(entity e, Resource res_type)
{
 return e.(GetResourceField(res_type));
}

float SetResourceExplicit(entity e, Resource res_type, float amount)
{
 .float res_field = GetResourceField(res_type);
 if (e.(res_field) != amount)
 {
  e.(res_field) = amount;
  return true;
 }
 return false;
}

void SetResource(entity e, Resource res_type, float amount)
{
 SetResourceExplicit(e, res_type, amount);
}

void TakeResource(entity receiver, Resource res_type, float amount)
{
 if (amount == 0)
 {
  return;
 }
 SetResource(receiver, res_type, GetResource(receiver, res_type) - amount);
}

void TakeResourceWithLimit(entity receiver, Resource res_type, float amount, float limit)
{
 if (amount == 0)
 {
  return;
 }
 float current_amount = GetResource(receiver, res_type);
 if (current_amount - amount < limit)
 {
  amount = limit + current_amount;
 }
 TakeResource(receiver, res_type, amount);
}

 string GlobalSound_sample(string pair, float r)
 {
  float n;
  {
   string s = cdr(pair);
   if (s) n = stof(s);
   else n = 0;
  }
  string sample = car(pair);
  if (n > 0) sample = sprintf("%s%d.wav", sample, floor(r * n + 1));
  else sample = sprintf("%s.wav", sample);
  return sample;
 }

 float GlobalSound_pitch(float _pitch)
 {

  float a = 1.5;
  float b = 0.75;
  float c = 100;
  float d = _pitch;
  float pitch_shift = (b*d*(a-1) + a*c*(1-b)) / (d*(a-1) + c*(1-b));

  return pitch_shift * 100;
 }

 void PrecacheGlobalSound(string sample)
 {
  float n;
  {
   string s = cdr(sample);
   if (s) n = stof(s);
   else n = 0;
  }
  sample = car(sample);
  if (n > 0)
  {
   for (float i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
    precache_sound(sprintf("%s%d.wav", sample, i));
  }
  else
  {
   precache_sound(sprintf("%s.wav", sample));
  }
 }

# 46 "./common/effects/qc/lightningarc.qc"
 void cl_effects_lightningarc(vector from, vector to, float seglength, float drifts, float drifte,
 float branchfactor, float branchfactor_add)
 {
  float length = vlen(from - to);
  if (length < 1) return;



  float steps = min(16, floor(length / seglength));
  if (steps < 1)
  {
   te_lightning1((0, world), from, to);
   return;
  }

  float steplength = length / steps;
  vector direction = normalize(to - from);
  vector pos_l = from;
  if (length > seglength)
  {
   for (float i = 1; i < steps; i += 1)
   {
    float drift = drifts * (1 - (i / steps)) + drifte * (i / steps);
    vector dirnew = normalize(direction * (1 - drift) + randomvec() * drift);
    vector pos = pos_l + dirnew * steplength;
    te_lightning1((0, world), pos_l, pos);




    pos_l = pos;
   }
   te_lightning1((0, world), pos_l, to);
  }
  else
  {
   te_lightning1((0, world), from, to);
  }
 }

  return = true;

  if (autocvar_cl_effects_lightningarc_simple)

   te_lightning1((0, world), from, to);
  }
  else
  {

void CSQCModel_InterpolateAnimation_2To4_Do(entity this)
{
 if(autocvar_cl_nolerp || (autocvar_cl_lerpanim_maxdelta_framegroups == 0))
 {
  this.lerpfrac = this.csqcmodel_lerpfrac;
  this.lerpfrac3 = 0;
  this.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  float l13, l24, llf;
  float l24_13;

  if(this.frame3time == 0)
   l13 = 1;
  else
   l13 = bound(0, (time - this.frame1time) / autocvar_cl_lerpanim_maxdelta_framegroups, 1);

  if(this.frame4time == 0)
   l24 = 1;
  else
   l24 = bound(0, (time - this.frame2time) / autocvar_cl_lerpanim_maxdelta_framegroups, 1);

  if(this.csqcmodel_lerpfrac2time == 0)
   llf = 1;
  else
   llf = bound(0, (time - this.csqcmodel_lerpfractime) / autocvar_cl_lerpanim_maxdelta_framegroups, 1);

  l24_13 = this.csqcmodel_lerpfrac * llf + this.csqcmodel_lerpfrac2 * (1 - llf);

  this.lerpfrac = l24 * l24_13;
  this.lerpfrac4 = (1 - l24) * l24_13;
  this.lerpfrac3 = (1 - l13) * (1 - l24_13);

  if(l24_13 == 0)
  {
   this.frame2time = 0;
   this.frame4time = 0;
  }

  if(l24_13 == 1)
  {
   this.frame1time = 0;
   this.frame3time = 0;
  }
 }
}
void CSQCModel_InterpolateAnimation_1To2_Do(entity this)
{

 else
 {

   this.lerpfrac = 0;
  else
   this.lerpfrac = 1 - bound(0, (time - this.frame1time) / autocvar_cl_lerpanim_maxdelta_framegroups, 1);
 }
}

   CSQCPlayer_SetMinsMaxs(this);
   ++csqcplayer_moveframe;
  }
  while (csqcplayer_moveframe < endframe);
 }


 input_angles = view_angles;
}

float CSQCPlayer_IsLocalPlayer(entity this)
{
 return (this == csqcplayer);
}

float stairsmoothz;
float autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed = 200;
float autocvar_cl_smoothviewheight = 0.05;
float smooth_prevtime;
float viewheightavg;
vector CSQCPlayer_ApplySmoothing(entity this, vector v)
{
 float smoothtime = bound(0, time - smooth_prevtime, 0.1);
 smooth_prevtime = max(smooth_prevtime, drawtime);

 if(this.csqcmodel_teleported || !(this.pmove_flags & PMF_ONGROUND) || autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed <= 0 || this.ground_networkentity)
  stairsmoothz = v.z;
 else
 {
  if(stairsmoothz < v.z)
   v.z = stairsmoothz = bound(v.z - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT), stairsmoothz + smoothtime * autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed, v.z);
  else if(stairsmoothz > v.z)
   v.z = stairsmoothz = bound(v.z, stairsmoothz - smoothtime * autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed, v.z + (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT));
 }

 float viewheight = bound(0, (time - smooth_prevtime) / max(0.0001, autocvar_cl_smoothviewheight), 1);
 viewheightavg = viewheightavg * (1 - viewheight) + this.view_ofs.z * viewheight;
 v.z += viewheightavg;

 smooth_prevtime = time;

 return v;
}


.float stairsmooth_offset;
.float stairsmooth_prevtime;
.float stairsmooth_drawtime;
vector CSQCModel_ApplyStairSmoothing(entity this, float isonground, vector v)
{
 float smoothtime = bound(0, time - this.stairsmooth_prevtime, 0.1);
 this.stairsmooth_prevtime = max(this.stairsmooth_prevtime, this.stairsmooth_drawtime);

 if(this.csqcmodel_teleported || !isonground || autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed <= 0 || this.ground_networkentity)
  this.stairsmooth_offset = v.z;
 else
 {
  if(this.stairsmooth_offset < v.z)
   v.z = this.stairsmooth_offset = bound(v.z - (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT), this.stairsmooth_offset + smoothtime * autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed, v.z);
  else if(this.stairsmooth_offset > v.z)
   v.z = this.stairsmooth_offset = bound(v.z, this.stairsmooth_offset - smoothtime * autocvar_cl_stairsmoothspeed, v.z + (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STEPHEIGHT));
 }

 this.stairsmooth_prevtime = time;
 this.stairsmooth_drawtime = drawtime;

 return v;
}

float autocvar_v_deathtilt;
float autocvar_v_deathtiltangle;
void CSQCPlayer_ApplyDeathTilt(entity this)
{
 if(!this.csqcmodel_isdead || !autocvar_v_deathtilt)
  return;


 if (autocvar_cl_eventchase_death == 2 && this.csqcmodel_isdead)
  return;
 view_angles.z += min((time - this.death_time) * 8, 1) * autocvar_v_deathtiltangle;
}

float autocvar_v_idlescale;
float autocvar_v_ipitch_cycle;
float autocvar_v_iyaw_cycle;
float autocvar_v_iroll_cycle;
float autocvar_v_ipitch_level;
float autocvar_v_iyaw_level;
float autocvar_v_iroll_level;
void CSQCPlayer_ApplyIdleScaling(entity this)
{
 if(!autocvar_v_idlescale)
  return;
 view_angles.x += autocvar_v_idlescale * sin(time * autocvar_v_ipitch_cycle) * autocvar_v_ipitch_level;
 view_angles.y += autocvar_v_idlescale * sin(time * autocvar_v_iyaw_cycle) * autocvar_v_iyaw_level;
 view_angles.z += autocvar_v_idlescale * sin(time * autocvar_v_iroll_cycle) * autocvar_v_iroll_level;

}

float autocvar_cl_bob = 0;
float autocvar_cl_bobcycle = 0.5;
float autocvar_cl_bob_limit = 7;
float autocvar_cl_bob_limit_heightcheck = 0;
float autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit = 400;
float autocvar_cl_bobup = 0.5;
float autocvar_cl_bobfall = 0.05;
float autocvar_cl_bobfallcycle = 3;
float autocvar_cl_bobfallminspeed = 200;
float autocvar_cl_bob2 = 0;
float autocvar_cl_bob2cycle = 1;
float autocvar_cl_bob2smooth = 0.05;
float bobfall_swing;
float bobfall_speed;
float bob2_smooth;
vector CSQCPlayer_ApplyBobbing(entity this, vector v)
{
 if(this.csqcmodel_isdead || (((hud != HUD_NORMAL) != 0)) || !(this.isplayermodel & ISPLAYER_PLAYER))
  return v;


 float bob, cycle;


 if(autocvar_cl_bob && autocvar_cl_bobcycle)
 {
  float bob_limit = autocvar_cl_bob_limit;

  if(autocvar_cl_bob_limit_heightcheck)
  {

   vector bob_height_check_dest = v;
   bob_height_check_dest.z += autocvar_cl_bob_limit * 1.1;
   traceline(v, bob_height_check_dest, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, (0, world));
   float trace1fraction = trace_fraction;

   bob_height_check_dest = v;
   bob_height_check_dest.z += autocvar_cl_bob_limit * -0.5;
   traceline(v, bob_height_check_dest, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, (0, world));
   float trace2fraction = trace_fraction;

   bob_limit *= min(trace1fraction, trace2fraction);
  }



  cycle = time / autocvar_cl_bobcycle;
  cycle -= rint(cycle);
  if(cycle < autocvar_cl_bobup)
   cycle = sin(3.14159265358979323846 * cycle / autocvar_cl_bobup);
  else
   cycle = sin(3.14159265358979323846 + 3.14159265358979323846 * (cycle - autocvar_cl_bobup) / (1.0 - autocvar_cl_bobup));


  float xyspeed = bound(0, sqrt(this.velocity.x * this.velocity.x + this.velocity.y * this.velocity.y), autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit);
  bob = xyspeed * autocvar_cl_bob;
  bob = bound(0, bob, bob_limit);
  bob = bob * 0.3 + bob * 0.7 * cycle;
  v.z += bob;
 }


 if(autocvar_cl_bob2 && autocvar_cl_bob2cycle)
 {
  cycle = time / autocvar_cl_bob2cycle;
  cycle -= rint(cycle);
  if(cycle < 0.5)
   cycle = cos(3.14159265358979323846 * cycle / 0.5);
  else
   cycle = cos(3.14159265358979323846 + 3.14159265358979323846 * (cycle - 0.5) / 0.5);
  bob = autocvar_cl_bob2 * cycle;



  if((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) && !(input_buttons & (1 << (1))))
   bob2_smooth = 1;
  else
  {
   if(bob2_smooth > 0)
    bob2_smooth -= bound(0, autocvar_cl_bob2smooth, 1);
   else
    bob2_smooth = 0;
  }


  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./lib/csqcmodel/cl_player.qc", 381, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); }else voidfunc();

  float side = bound(-autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit, (this.velocity * v_right) * bob2_smooth, autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit);
  float front = bound(-autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit, (this.velocity * v_forward) * bob2_smooth, autocvar_cl_bob_velocity_limit);
  v_forward = v_forward * bob;
  v_right = v_right * bob;


  vector bob2vel;
  bob2vel.x = side * v_forward.x + front * v_right.x + 0 * v_up.x;
  bob2vel.y = side * v_forward.y + front * v_right.y + 0 * v_up.y;
  bob2vel.z = side * v_forward.z + front * v_right.z + 0 * v_up.z;
  v.x += bob2vel.x;
  v.y += bob2vel.y;
 }



 if(autocvar_cl_bobfall && autocvar_cl_bobfallcycle)
 {
  if(!(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
  {
   bobfall_speed = bound(-400, this.velocity.z, 0) * bound(0, autocvar_cl_bobfall, 0.1);
   if(this.velocity.z < -autocvar_cl_bobfallminspeed)
    bobfall_swing = 1;
   else
    bobfall_swing = 0;
  }
  else
  {
   bobfall_swing = max(0, bobfall_swing - autocvar_cl_bobfallcycle * frametime);
   float bobfall = sin(3.14159265358979323846 * bobfall_swing) * bobfall_speed;
   v.z += bobfall;
  }
 }

 return v;
}

float autocvar_cl_rollangle;
float autocvar_cl_rollspeed;
float CSQCPlayer_CalcRoll(entity this)
{
 if (!autocvar_cl_rollangle) return 0;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./lib/csqcmodel/cl_player.qc", 426, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); }else voidfunc();
 float side = (this.velocity * v_right);
 float sign = (side < 0) ? -1 : 1;
 side = fabs(side);

 if(side < autocvar_cl_rollspeed)
  side = side * autocvar_cl_rollangle / autocvar_cl_rollspeed;
 else
  side = autocvar_cl_rollangle;

 return side * sign;
}

float autocvar_chase_back;
float autocvar_chase_up;
float autocvar_chase_overhead;
float autocvar_chase_pitchangle;
vector CSQCPlayer_ApplyChase(entity this, vector v)
{
 vector forward;
 vector chase_dest;

 if(autocvar_chase_overhead)
 {
  view_angles.x = 0;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./lib/csqcmodel/cl_player.qc", 451, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); }else voidfunc();
  forward = v_forward;
  vector up = v_up;

  chase_dest.x = v.x - forward.x * autocvar_chase_back + up.x * autocvar_chase_up;
  chase_dest.y = v.y - forward.y * autocvar_chase_back + up.y * autocvar_chase_up;
  chase_dest.z = v.z - forward.z * autocvar_chase_back + up.z * autocvar_chase_up;


  traceline(v, chase_dest, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, (0, world));

  vector bestvieworg = trace_endpos;
  vector offset = '0 0 0';
  for(offset.x = -16; offset.x <= 16; offset.x += 8)
  {
   for(offset.y = -16; offset.y <= 16; offset.y += 8)
   {
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./lib/csqcmodel/cl_player.qc", 468, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); }else voidfunc();
    up = v_up;
    chase_dest.x = v.x - forward.x * autocvar_chase_back + up.x * autocvar_chase_up + offset.x;
    chase_dest.y = v.y - forward.y * autocvar_chase_back + up.y * autocvar_chase_up + offset.y;
    chase_dest.z = v.z - forward.z * autocvar_chase_back + up.z * autocvar_chase_up + offset.z;
    traceline(v, chase_dest, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, (0, world));
    if(bestvieworg.z > trace_endpos.z)
     bestvieworg.z = trace_endpos.z;
   }
  }
  bestvieworg.z -= 8;
  v = bestvieworg;

  view_angles.x = autocvar_chase_pitchangle;

 }
 else
 {
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./lib/csqcmodel/cl_player.qc", 486, __FUNC__, "\"view_angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(view_angles); }else voidfunc();
  forward = v_forward;
  if(autocvar_chase_front && spectatee_status != -1)
   forward = normalize(forward * -1);

  float cdist = -autocvar_chase_back - 8;
  chase_dest.x = v.x + forward.x * cdist;
  chase_dest.y = v.y + forward.y * cdist;
  chase_dest.z = v.z + forward.z * cdist + autocvar_chase_up;
  if (this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_NOCLIP)
  {

   trace_endpos = chase_dest;
   trace_plane_normal = '0 0 0';
  }
  else
  {
   traceline(v, chase_dest, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, (0, world));
  }
  v.x = 1 * trace_endpos.x + 8 * forward.x + 4 * trace_plane_normal.x;
  v.y = 1 * trace_endpos.y + 8 * forward.y + 4 * trace_plane_normal.y;
  v.z = 1 * trace_endpos.z + 8 * forward.z + 4 * trace_plane_normal.z;

  if(autocvar_chase_front && spectatee_status != -1)
  {

   vector newang = vectoangles(forward);
   view_angles.x = view_angles.x * -1;
   view_angles.y = newang.y;
  }
 }







 return v;
}

void CSQCPlayer_CalcRefdef(entity this)
{
 if(use_engine_refdef)
 {
  float refdefflags = 0;
  if (this.csqcmodel_teleported) refdefflags |= REFDEFFLAG_TELEPORTED;
  if (input_buttons & (1 << (1))) refdefflags |= REFDEFFLAG_JUMPING;

  if ((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) <= 0 && (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) != -666 && (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) != -2342) refdefflags |= REFDEFFLAG_DEAD;
  if (intermission) refdefflags |= REFDEFFLAG_INTERMISSION;
  V_CalcRefdef(this, refdefflags);
  return;
 }

 vector vieworg = this.origin;
 if(intermission)
 {

  vieworg.z += this.view_ofs.z;
 }
 else
 {
  vieworg = CSQCPlayer_ApplySmoothing(this, vieworg);
  if(autocvar_chase_active)
   vieworg = CSQCPlayer_ApplyChase(this, vieworg);
  else
  {

   CSQCPlayer_ApplyDeathTilt(this);
   view_angles = view_angles + view_punchangle;
   view_angles.z += CSQCPlayer_CalcRoll(this);


   vieworg = vieworg + view_punchvector;
   vieworg = CSQCPlayer_ApplyBobbing(this, vieworg);
  }
  CSQCPlayer_ApplyIdleScaling(this);
 }
 setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, vieworg);
 setproperty(VF_ANGLES, view_angles);
}


void CSQCPlayer_SetCamera()
{
 vector v0 = ((intermission && !autocvar_cl_movement_intermissionrunning) ? '0 0 0' : pmove_vel);
 float vh = (0, getstati(STAT_VIEWHEIGHT));
 vector pl_viewofs = (0, g_stat_PL_VIEW_OFS);
 vector pl_viewofs_crouch = (0, g_stat_PL_CROUCH_VIEW_OFS);
 entity e = csqcplayer;
 if (e)
 {
  if (servercommandframe == 0 || clientcommandframe == 0)
  {
   InterpolateOrigin_Do(e);
   e.view_ofs = '0 0 1' * vh;


   if (vh == pl_viewofs.z) e.flags &= ~FL_DUCKED;
   else if (vh == pl_viewofs_crouch.z) e.flags |= FL_DUCKED;


   e.flags = (pmove_onground ? (e.flags) | (FL_ONGROUND) : (e.flags) & ~(FL_ONGROUND));

   CSQCPlayer_SetMinsMaxs(e);


   e.view_ofs = '0 0 1' * vh;


   e.velocity = v0;
  }
  else
  {
   float flg = e.iflags; e.iflags &= ~(IFLAG_ORIGIN | IFLAG_ANGLES);
   InterpolateOrigin_Do(e);
   e.iflags = flg;

   if (csqcplayer_status == CSQCPLAYERSTATUS_FROMSERVER)
   {
    vector o = e.origin;
    csqcplayer_status = CSQCPLAYERSTATUS_PREDICTED;
    CSQCPlayer_PredictTo(e, servercommandframe + 1, false);
    CSQCPlayer_SetPredictionError(e.origin - o, e.velocity - v0, pmove_onground - (((e).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0));
    e.origin = o;
    e.velocity = v0;


    if (vh == pl_viewofs.z) e.flags &= ~FL_DUCKED;
    else if(vh == pl_viewofs_crouch.z) e.flags |= FL_DUCKED;


    e.flags = (pmove_onground ? (e.flags) | (FL_ONGROUND) : (e.flags) & ~(FL_ONGROUND));

    CSQCPlayer_SavePrediction(e);
   }
   CSQCPlayer_PredictTo(e, clientcommandframe + 1, true);






   CSQCPlayer_SetMinsMaxs(e);

   if (!(((e).classname == "ENT_CLIENT_MODEL") ? (e).csqcmodel_isdead : (GetResource((e), RES_HEALTH) <= 0)))
    e.angles.y = input_angles.y;
  }


  e.stairsmooth_drawtime = drawtime;
  e.origin = CSQCModel_ApplyStairSmoothing(e, (e.pmove_flags & PMF_ONGROUND), e.origin);
  setorigin(e, e.origin);
 }

 const entity view = CSQCModel_server2csqc(player_localentnum - 1);
 if (view)
 {
  if (view != csqcplayer)
  {
   InterpolateOrigin_Do(view);
   view.view_ofs = '0 0 1' * vh;
  }
  CSQCPlayer_CalcRefdef(view);
 }
 else
 {






 }
 viewloc_SetViewLocation();
}

void CSQCPlayer_Remove(entity this)
{
 csqcplayer = (0, world);
 cvar_settemp("cl_movement_replay", "1");
}

float CSQCPlayer_PreUpdate(entity this)
{
 if (this != csqcplayer) return false;
 if (csqcplayer_status != CSQCPLAYERSTATUS_FROMSERVER) CSQCPlayer_Unpredict(this);
 return true;
}

float CSQCPlayer_PostUpdate(entity this)
{
 if (this.entnum != player_localnum + 1) return false;
 csqcplayer = this;
 csqcplayer_status = CSQCPLAYERSTATUS_FROMSERVER;
 if (cvar("cl_movement_replay"))
  cvar_settemp("cl_movement_replay", "0");
 this.entremove = CSQCPlayer_Remove;
 return true;
}
# 12 "client/progs.inc" 2
# 1 "./lib/csqcmodel/interpolate.qc" 1
# 25 "./lib/csqcmodel/interpolate.qc"
.vector iorigin1, iorigin2;
.vector ivelocity1, ivelocity2;
.vector iforward1, iforward2;
.vector iup1, iup2;
.vector ivforward1, ivforward2;
.vector ivup1, ivup2;
.float itime1, itime2;
void InterpolateOrigin_Reset(entity this)
{
 this.iflags &= ~IFLAG_INTERNALMASK;
 this.itime1 = this.itime2 = 0;
}
void InterpolateOrigin_Note(entity this)
{
 float dt = time - this.itime2;

 float f0 = this.iflags;
 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_PREVALID) this.iflags |= IFLAG_VALID;
 else this.iflags |= IFLAG_PREVALID;

 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ORIGIN)
 {
  this.iorigin1 = this.iorigin2;
  this.iorigin2 = this.origin;
 }

 if ((this.iflags & IFLAG_AUTOANGLES) && this.iorigin2 != this.iorigin1)
  this.angles = vectoangles(this.iorigin2 - this.iorigin1);

 if ((this.iflags & IFLAG_AUTOVELOCITY) && this.itime2 != this.itime1)
  this.velocity = (this.iorigin2 - this.iorigin1) * (1.0 / (this.itime2 - this.itime1));

 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ANGLES)
 {
  vector forward, right, up;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./lib/csqcmodel/interpolate.qc", 60, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  if (f0 & IFLAG_VALID)
  {
   this.iforward1 = this.iforward2;
   this.iup1 = this.iup2;
  }
  else
  {
   this.iforward1 = forward;
   this.iup1 = up;
  }
  this.iforward2 = forward;
  this.iup2 = up;
 }

 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_V_ANGLE)
 {
  vector forward, right, up;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./lib/csqcmodel/interpolate.qc", 78, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  if (f0 & IFLAG_VALID)
  {
   this.ivforward1 = this.ivforward2;
   this.ivup1 = this.ivup2;
  }
  else
  {
   this.ivforward1 = forward;
   this.ivup1 = up;
  }
  this.ivforward2 = forward;
  this.ivup2 = up;
 }
 else if (this.iflags & IFLAG_V_ANGLE_X)
 {
  this.ivforward1_x = this.ivforward2_x;
  this.ivforward2_x = this.v_angle.x;
 }

 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_VELOCITY)
 {
  this.ivelocity1 = this.ivelocity2;
  this.ivelocity2 = this.velocity;
 }

 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_TELEPORTED)
 {
  this.iflags &= ~IFLAG_TELEPORTED;
  this.itime1 = this.itime2 = time;
 }
 else if (((_vlen2 = (this.iorigin2 - this.iorigin1), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((1000) ** 2)))
 {
  this.itime1 = this.itime2 = time;
 }
 else if ((this.iflags & IFLAG_VELOCITY) && ((_vlen2 = (this.ivelocity2 - this.ivelocity1), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((1000) ** 2)))
 {
  this.itime1 = this.itime2 = time;
 }
 else if (dt >= 0.2)
 {
  this.itime1 = this.itime2 = time;
 }
 else
 {
  this.itime1 = serverprevtime;
  this.itime2 = time;
 }
}


void InterpolateOrigin_Do(entity this)
{
 if (this.itime1 && this.itime2 && this.itime1 != this.itime2)
 {
  float f = bound(0, (time - this.itime1) / (this.itime2 - this.itime1), 1 + autocvar_cl_lerpexcess);
  float f_1 = 1 - f;
  if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ORIGIN)
   setorigin(this, f_1 * this.iorigin1 + f * this.iorigin2);
  if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ANGLES)
  {
   vector forward = f_1 * this.iforward1 + f * this.iforward2;
   vector up = f_1 * this.iup1 + f * this.iup2;
   this.angles = (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(forward, up), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);
  }
  if (this.iflags & IFLAG_V_ANGLE)
  {
   vector forward = f_1 * this.ivforward1 + f * this.ivforward2;
   vector up = f_1 * this.ivup1 + f * this.ivup2;
   this.v_angle = (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(forward, up), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);
  }
  else if (this.iflags & IFLAG_V_ANGLE_X)
  {
   this.v_angle_x = f_1 * this.ivforward1.x + f * this.ivforward2.x;
  }
  if (this.iflags & IFLAG_VELOCITY)
   this.velocity = f_1 * this.ivelocity1 + f * this.ivelocity2;
 }
}


void InterpolateOrigin_Undo(entity this)
{
 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ORIGIN) setorigin(this, this.iorigin2);
 if (this.iflags & IFLAG_ANGLES) this.angles = (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(this.iforward2, this.iup2), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);

vector AnglesTransform_Apply(vector transform, vector v)
{
 vector forward, right, up;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./lib/warpzone/anglestransform.qc", 8, __FUNC__, "\"transform\""); _makevectors_hidden(transform); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 return forward * v.x + right * (-v.y) + up * v.z;
}

vector AnglesTransform_Multiply(vector t1, vector t2)
{
 vector forward, right, up;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./lib/warpzone/anglestransform.qc", 15, __FUNC__, "\"t2\""); _makevectors_hidden(t2); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 forward = AnglesTransform_Apply(t1, forward);
 up = AnglesTransform_Apply(t1, up);
 return (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(forward, up), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);
}

vector AnglesTransform_Invert(vector transform)
{
 vector i_forward, i_up;
 vector forward, right, up;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./lib/warpzone/anglestransform.qc", 25, __FUNC__, "\"transform\""); _makevectors_hidden(transform); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();




 i_forward.x = forward.x;
 i_forward.y = -right.x;
 i_forward.z = up.x;
 i_up.x = forward.z;
 i_up.y = -right.z;
 i_up.z = up.z;
 return (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(i_forward, i_up), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);
}

vector AnglesTransform_TurnDirectionFR(vector transform)
{




 transform.x = -transform.x;
 transform.y = 180 + transform.y;
 transform.z = -transform.z;



 return transform;
}

vector AnglesTransform_TurnDirectionFU(vector transform)
{




 transform.x = -transform.x;
 transform.y = 180 + transform.y;
 transform.z = 180 - transform.z;
 return transform;
}

vector AnglesTransform_RightDivide(vector to_transform, vector from_transform)
{
 return AnglesTransform_Multiply(to_transform, AnglesTransform_Invert(from_transform));
}

vector AnglesTransform_LeftDivide(vector from_transform, vector to_transform)
{
 return AnglesTransform_Multiply(AnglesTransform_Invert(from_transform), to_transform);
}

vector AnglesTransform_Normalize(vector t, float minimize_roll)
{
 float need_flip;

 t.x = t.x - 360 * rint(t.x / 360);
 t.y = t.y - 360 * rint(t.y / 360);
 t.z = t.z - 360 * rint(t.z / 360);
 if(minimize_roll)
  need_flip = (t.z > 90 || t.z <= -90);
 else
  need_flip = (t.x > 90 || t.x < -90);
 if(need_flip)
 {
  if(t.x >= 0) t.x = 180 - t.x; else t.x = -180 - t.x;
  if(t.y > 0) t.y -= 180; else t.y += 180;
  if(t.z > 0) t.z -= 180; else t.z += 180;
 }
 return t;
}

vector AnglesTransform_CancelRoll(vector t)
{
 const float epsilon = 30;
 float f;
# 108 "./lib/warpzone/anglestransform.qc"
 f = fabs(t.x - (-90)) / epsilon;
 if(f < 1)
 {

  t.y += t.z;
  t.z = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  f = fabs(t.x - 90) / epsilon;
  if(f < 1)
  {

   t.y -= t.z;
   t.z = 0;
  }
 }
 return t;
}


vector AnglesTransform_ApplyToAngles(vector transform, vector v)
{
 v.x = -v.x;
 v = AnglesTransform_Multiply(transform, v);
 v.x = -v.x;
 return v;
}

 v = AnglesTransform_Multiply(transform, v);
 return v;

 return v;

 return v;

vector AnglesTransform_Multiply_GetPostShift(vector t0, vector st0, vector t1, vector st1)
{



 return st0 + AnglesTransform_Apply(t0, st1);
}
vector AnglesTransform_PrePostShift_GetPostShift(vector sf, vector t, vector st)
{
 return st - AnglesTransform_Apply(t, sf);
}

void WarpZone_Accumulator_Clear(entity acc)
{
 acc.warpzone_transform = '0 0 0';
 acc.warpzone_shift = '0 0 0';
}
void WarpZone_Accumulator_AddTransform(entity acc, vector t, vector s)
{
 vector tr, st;
 tr = AnglesTransform_Multiply(t, acc.warpzone_transform);
 st = AnglesTransform_Multiply_GetPostShift(t, s, acc.warpzone_transform, acc.warpzone_shift);
 acc.warpzone_transform = tr;
 acc.warpzone_shift = st;
}
void WarpZone_Accumulator_Add(entity acc, entity wz)
{
 WarpZone_Accumulator_AddTransform(acc, wz.warpzone_transform, wz.warpzone_shift);
}
void WarpZone_Accumulator_AddInverseTransform(entity acc, vector t, vector s)
{
 vector tt, ss;
 tt = AnglesTransform_Invert(t);
 ss = AnglesTransform_PrePostShift_GetPostShift(s, tt, '0 0 0');
 WarpZone_Accumulator_AddTransform(acc, tt, ss);

}
void WarpZone_Accumulator_AddInverse(entity acc, entity wz)
{
 WarpZone_Accumulator_AddInverseTransform(acc, wz.warpzone_transform, wz.warpzone_shift);
}

float WarpZoneLib_BoxTouchesBrush(vector mi, vector ma, entity e, entity ig)
{



 float f, s;

 if(!e.modelindex || e.warpzone_isboxy)
  return 1;



 if ((0, g_stat_Q3COMPAT) && ig != world)
  ig.dphitcontentsmask |= 128;

 s = e.solid;
 if (e.solid != SOLID_BSP)
 {
  e.solid = SOLID_BSP;
  setorigin(e, e.origin);
 }
 f = WarpZoneLib_BoxTouchesBrush_Recurse(mi, ma, e, ig);
 if (e.solid != s)
 {
  e.solid = s;
  setorigin(e, e.origin);
 }

 if ((0, g_stat_Q3COMPAT) && ig != world)
  ig.dphitcontentsmask &= ~128;

 return f;
}

void WarpZone_TraceToss_ThroughZone(entity e, entity forent, entity zone, WarpZone_trace_callback_t cb)
{
 float g, dt, i;
 vector vf, vr, vu, v0, o0;
 entity wz;

 o0 = e.origin;
 v0 = e.velocity;
 g = cvar("sv_gravity") * e.gravity;

 WarpZone_trace_forent = forent;
 WarpZone_trace_firstzone = (0, world);
 WarpZone_trace_lastzone = (0, world);
 WarpZone_Trace_InitTransform();
 WarpZone_tracetoss_time = 0;
 if(!warpzone_warpzones_exist)
 {
  tracetoss(e, WarpZone_trace_forent);
  if(cb)
   cb(e.origin, trace_endpos, trace_endpos);
  dt = vlen(e.origin - o0) / vlen(e.velocity);
  WarpZone_tracetoss_time += dt;
  e.velocity_z -= dt * g;
  WarpZone_tracetoss_velocity = e.velocity;
  e.velocity = v0;
  return;
 }

 vf = v_forward;
 vr = v_right;
 vu = v_up;


 wz = WarpZone_Find(e.origin + e.mins, e.origin + e.maxs);
 if(wz)
 {
  WarpZone_trace_firstzone = wz;
  WarpZone_trace_lastzone = wz;
  if(zone && wz != zone)
  {


   WarpZone_tracetoss_time = 0;
   trace_endpos = o0;
   goto fail;
  }
  WarpZone_Trace_AddTransform(wz);
  vector org = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(wz, e.origin);
  setorigin(e, org);
  e.velocity = WarpZone_TransformVelocity(wz, e.velocity);
 }
 WarpZone_MakeAllSolid();
 i = 16;
 for (;;)
 {
  if(--i < 1)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""CSQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./lib/warpzone/common.qc", "412")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Too many warpzones in sequence, aborting trace."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   trace_ent = (0, world);
   break;
  }
  tracetoss(e, WarpZone_trace_forent);
  if(cb)
   cb(e.origin, trace_endpos, trace_endpos);

float WarpZone_PlaneDist(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return (v - wz.warpzone_origin) * wz.warpzone_forward;
}

float WarpZone_TargetPlaneDist(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return (v - wz.warpzone_targetorigin) * wz.warpzone_targetforward;
}

vector WarpZone_TransformOrigin(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return wz.warpzone_shift + AnglesTransform_Apply(wz.warpzone_transform, v);
}

vector WarpZone_TransformVelocity(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return AnglesTransform_Apply(wz.warpzone_transform, v);
}

vector WarpZone_TransformAngles(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return AnglesTransform_ApplyToAngles(wz.warpzone_transform, v);
}

vector WarpZone_TransformVAngles(entity wz, vector ang)
{






 ang = AnglesTransform_ApplyToVAngles(wz.warpzone_transform, ang);






 ang = AnglesTransform_Normalize(ang, false);


 return ang;
}

vector WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return AnglesTransform_Apply(AnglesTransform_Invert(wz.warpzone_transform), v - wz.warpzone_shift);
}

vector WarpZone_UnTransformVelocity(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return AnglesTransform_Apply(AnglesTransform_Invert(wz.warpzone_transform), v);
}

vector WarpZone_UnTransformAngles(entity wz, vector v)
{
 return AnglesTransform_ApplyToAngles(AnglesTransform_Invert(wz.warpzone_transform), v);
}

vector WarpZone_UnTransformVAngles(entity wz, vector ang)
{
 float roll;

 roll = ang.z;
 ang.z = 0;

 ang = AnglesTransform_ApplyToVAngles(AnglesTransform_Invert(wz.warpzone_transform), ang);
 ang = AnglesTransform_Normalize(ang, true);
 ang = AnglesTransform_CancelRoll(ang);

 ang.z = roll;
 return ang;
}

vector WarpZoneLib_NearestPointOnBox(vector mi, vector ma, vector org)
{
 vector nearest;
 nearest.x = bound(mi.x, org.x, ma.x);
 nearest.y = bound(mi.y, org.y, ma.y);
 nearest.z = bound(mi.z, org.z, ma.z);
 return nearest;
}

vector WarpZone_FixNearClip(vector o, vector c0, vector c1, vector c2, vector c3)
{
 vector mi, ma;
 entity e;
 float pd;

 mi.x = min(o.x, c0_x, c1_x, c2_x, c3_x);
 ma.x = max(o.x, c0_x, c1_x, c2_x, c3_x);
 mi.y = min(o.y, c0_y, c1_y, c2_y, c3_y);
 ma.y = max(o.y, c0_y, c1_y, c2_y, c3_y);
 mi.z = min(o.z, c0_z, c1_z, c2_z, c3_z);
 ma.z = max(o.z, c0_z, c1_z, c2_z, c3_z);

 e = WarpZone_Find(mi, ma);
 if(e)
 {
  if(WarpZone_PlaneDist(e, o) < 0)
   return '0 0 0';

  pd = min(
    WarpZone_PlaneDist(e, c0),
    WarpZone_PlaneDist(e, c1),
    WarpZone_PlaneDist(e, c2),
    WarpZone_PlaneDist(e, c3)
   );
  if(pd < 0)
   return e.warpzone_forward * -pd;
 }

 return '0 0 0';
}

void WarpZone_FixPMove()
{
 entity e = WarpZone_Find(pmove_org, pmove_org);
 if(e)
 {
  pmove_org = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(e, pmove_org);
  input_angles = WarpZone_TransformVAngles(e, input_angles);
 }
}


float autocvar_cl_rollkillspeed = 10;

void WarpZone_FixView()
{
 entity e;
 vector org, ang, nearclip, corner0, corner1, corner2, corner3, o;

 warpzone_save_view_origin = org = getpropertyvec(VF_ORIGIN);
 warpzone_save_view_angles = ang = getpropertyvec(VF_ANGLES);

 e = WarpZone_Find(org, org);
 if(e)
 {
  org = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(e, org);
  ang = WarpZone_TransformVAngles(e, ang);
  WarpZone_View_Inside();
 }
 else
  WarpZone_View_Outside();


 float rick;
 float f;
 static float rollkill;
 if ((0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) > 0 || (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) == -666 || (0, getstati(STAT_HEALTH)) == -2342)
 {
  f = 0;

  if(autocvar_cl_rollkillspeed)
   f = max(0, (1 - frametime * autocvar_cl_rollkillspeed));
  if(rollkill)
   rollkill = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  f = 1;

  if(autocvar_cl_rollkillspeed)
  {
   rollkill += frametime * autocvar_cl_rollkillspeed;
   f = min(1, rollkill);
  }
  else if(rollkill)
   rollkill = 0;
 }

 rick = getproperty(VF_CL_VIEWANGLES_Z);
 rick *= f;
 setproperty(VF_CL_VIEWANGLES_Z, rick);
 ang.z *= f;


 setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, org);
 setproperty(VF_ANGLES, ang);

 vector width = '1 0 0' * cvar("vid_conwidth");
 vector height = '0 1 0' * cvar("vid_conheight");
 nearclip = '0 0 1' * (cvar("r_nearclip") * 1.125);
 corner0 = cs_unproject('0 0 0' + nearclip);
 corner1 = cs_unproject(width + nearclip);
 corner2 = cs_unproject(height + nearclip);
 corner3 = cs_unproject(width + height + nearclip);
 o = WarpZone_FixNearClip(org, corner0, corner1, corner2, corner3);
 if(o != '0 0 0')
  setproperty(VF_ORIGIN, org + o);
}

 if (!this.com_phys_ground && !this.com_phys_air) {





  ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);

  if (this.com_phys_friction_air) {
   const float grav = -this.com_phys_gravity;
   this.velocity_z += grav / 2;
   this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - dt * this.com_phys_friction);
   this.velocity_z += grav / 2;
  }
 }

 if (this.com_phys_water) {


  if (this.com_in_jump && this.waterlevel == WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING && this.velocity_z >= -180 && !this.viewloc && !(0, g_stat_FROZEN)) {
