   vector spot = this.origin + 24 * forward;
   spot_z += 8;
   traceline(spot, spot, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
   if (trace_startsolid) {
    spot_z += 24;
    traceline(spot, spot, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
    if (!trace_startsolid) {
     this.velocity = forward * 50;
     this.velocity_z = 310;
     ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
     ((this).flags &= ~FL_JUMPRELEASED);
    }
   }
  }
 }

 vector forward, right, up;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./ecs/systems/physics.qc", 216, __FUNC__, "\"vmul(this.v_angle, (this.com_phys_vel_2d ?  vector wishvel = forward * (this).movement.x
     + right * (this).movement.y
     + '0 0 1' * (this).movement.z * (this.com_phys_vel_2d ? 0 : 1);
 if (this.com_phys_water) {
  if ((0, g_stat_FROZEN))
  {
   if(this.waterlevel >= WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED && this.velocity.z >= -70)
    wishvel = '0 0 160';
   else if(this.waterlevel >= WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING && this.velocity.z > 0)
    wishvel = eZ * 1.3 * min(this.velocity.z, 160);
  }
  else
  {
   if (((input_buttons & (1 << (4))) != 0)) {
    wishvel.z = -(0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED);
   }
   if (this.viewloc) {
    wishvel.z = -160;
   } else if (wishvel == '0 0 0') {
    wishvel = '0 0 -60';
   }
  }
 }
 if (this.com_phys_ladder) {
  if (this.viewloc) {
   wishvel.z = (this).movement_old.x;
  }
  if (this.ladder_entity.classname == "func_water") {
   float f = vlen(wishvel);
   if (f > this.ladder_entity.speed) {
    wishvel *= (this.ladder_entity.speed / f);
   }

   this.watertype = this.ladder_entity.skin;
   f = this.ladder_entity.origin_z + this.ladder_entity.maxs_z;
   if ((this.origin_z + this.view_ofs_z) < f) {
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED;
   } else if ((this.origin_z + (this.mins_z + this.maxs_z) * 0.5) < f) {
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING;
   } else if ((this.origin_z + this.mins_z + 1) < f) {
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_WETFEET;
   } else {
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_NONE;
    this.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;
   }
  }
 }

 const vector wishdir = normalize(wishvel);
 float wishspeed = min(vlen(wishvel), this.com_phys_vel_max);

 if (this.com_phys_air) {
  if (!(this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP)) {

   float airaccelqw = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCEL_QW);
   float wishspeed0 = wishspeed;
   const float maxairspd = this.com_phys_vel_max;
   wishspeed = min(wishspeed, maxairspd);
   if (((((this).flags & FL_DUCKED) != 0))) {
    wishspeed *= 0.5;
   }
   float airaccel = this.com_phys_acc_rate_air;

   float accelerating = (this.velocity * wishdir > 0);
   float wishspeed2 = wishspeed;


   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTOPACCELERATE)) {
    vector curdir = normalize((_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2));
    airaccel += (this.com_phys_acc_rate_air_stop - airaccel) * max(0, -(curdir * wishdir));
   }
# 297 "./ecs/systems/physics.qc"
   float strafity = IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, -90) + IsMoveInDirection((this).movement, +90);
   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSTRAFESPEED)) {
    wishspeed =
        min(wishspeed,
     GeomLerp(this.com_phys_vel_max_air, strafity, this.com_phys_vel_max_air_strafe));
   }
   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCELERATE)) {
    airaccel = GeomLerp(airaccel, strafity, this.com_phys_acc_rate_air_strafe);
   }
   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCEL_QW)) {
    airaccelqw =
        (((strafity > 0.5 ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCEL_QW) : (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCEL_QW)) >= 0) ? +1 : -1)
        *
        (1 - GeomLerp(1 - fabs((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCEL_QW)), strafity, 1 - fabs((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSTRAFEACCEL_QW))));
   }


   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TURNACCEL) && accelerating && (this).movement.y == 0 && (this).movement.x != 0) {
    PM_AirAccelerate(this, dt, wishdir, wishspeed2);
   } else {
    float sidefric = maxairspd ? ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCEL_SIDEWAYS_FRICTION) / maxairspd) : 0;
    PM_Accelerate(this, dt, wishdir, wishspeed, wishspeed0, airaccel, airaccelqw,
     (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRACCEL_QW_STRETCHFACTOR), sidefric, (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRSPEEDLIMIT_NONQW));
   }

   if ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL)) {
    CPM_PM_Aircontrol(this, dt, wishdir, wishspeed2);
   }
  }
 } else {
  if (this.com_phys_ground && ((((this).flags & FL_DUCKED) != 0))) { wishspeed *= 0.5; }
  if (this.com_phys_water) {
   wishspeed *= 0.7;


   {

    float f = 1 - dt * (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION);
    f = min(max(0, f), 1);
    this.velocity *= f;

    f = wishspeed - this.velocity * wishdir;
    if (f > 0) {
     float accelspeed = min((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_ACCELERATE) * dt * wishspeed, f);
     this.velocity += accelspeed * wishdir;
    }


    if (this.com_in_jump && !this.viewloc && !(0, g_stat_FROZEN)) {





     this.velocity_z = 200;
     if (this.waterlevel >= WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED) {
      this.velocity_z = (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) * 0.7;
     }
    }
   }
   if (this.viewloc) {
    const float addspeed = wishspeed - this.velocity * wishdir;
    if (addspeed > 0) {
     const float accelspeed = min((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_ACCELERATE) * dt * wishspeed, addspeed);
     this.velocity += accelspeed * wishdir;
    }
   } else {

    PM_Accelerate(this, dt, wishdir, wishspeed, wishspeed, this.com_phys_acc_rate, 1, 0, 0, 0);
   }
   return;
  }
  if (this.com_phys_ground) {

   const float f2 = (_vlen2 = ((_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2)));
   if (f2 > 0) {


    const float realfriction = ((((this).flags & FL_ONSLICK) != 0))
        ? (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION_SLICK)
     : (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_FRICTION);

    float f = sqrt(f2);
    f = 1 - dt * realfriction
        * ((f < (0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STOPSPEED)) ? ((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_STOPSPEED) / f) : 1);
    f = max(0, f);
    this.velocity *= f;
# 406 "./ecs/systems/physics.qc"
   }
   const float addspeed = wishspeed - this.velocity * wishdir;
   if (addspeed > 0) {
    const float accelspeed = min((0, g_stat_MOVEVARS_ACCELERATE) * dt * wishspeed, addspeed);
    this.velocity += accelspeed * wishdir;
   }
   return;
  }

  if (!(this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP)) {
   PM_Accelerate(this, dt, wishdir, wishspeed, wishspeed, this.com_phys_acc_rate, 1, 0, 0, 0);
  }
 }
}

}

void sys_phys_update_single(entity this)
{
 sys_phys_simulate_simple(this, frametime);
}
